jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Join our innovative team as an AI Engineer and be at the forefront of developing cutting\-edge artificial intelligence solutions that transform data into actionable insights. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in machine learning, statistical analysis, and big data systems to design, implement, and optimize AI models that drive strategic decision\-making. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment where creativity meets technical excellence, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact. **Position Summary** The AI Engineer turns artificial intelligence concepts into production\-ready systems. They combine soft\-ware engineering, machine learning, data engineering, and product knowledge to build dependable AI applications. The AI Engineer reports to the Head of Information Technology \& Data. **Purpose** The AI Engineer designs, builds, tests, and deploys AI and machine\-learning systems. **Position Responsibilities** * *Build, Monitor \& Optimize*\- Use generative capabilities within a broader system that plans steps, makes decisions, executes actions autonomously, and adapts. Create test suites, datasets, and release criteria to ensure reliability and safety. Track performance, troubleshoot issues, and improve speed, accuracy, and scalability. * *Design AI systems*\- Develop algorithms, models, and AI\-powered applications focused on the underwriting process, and business insights. * *Data Pipeline Development*\- Collect, clean, and process large datasets for training and inference. * *Deploy \& integrate models*\- Implement models into production software, APIs, and cloud environments (Azure) * *Stay current on AI advancements\-* Keep up with emerging models, generative AI, and tooling. * Perform other related duties as requested, required, and/or as assigned in support of organizational goals. **Education, Training, and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science, information technology, engineering, or related discipline preferred Prior experience in insurance, financial services, or risk management environments strongly preferred * Experience creating AI skills, AI agents, Multiagentic agents, and/or LLM using RAG architecture ; * or * Equivalent combination of education and demonstrated experience. **Skills and Knowledge** * Programming skills (Python, Java, or similar) * Understanding of LLMs, generative AI, and retrieval\-augmented systems * Cloud computing experience (AWS, Azure, GCP) * Strong communication and collaboration skills. * Ability to work on a dynamic, Entrepreneurial team that has concurrent projects Experience with Fabric is a plus. * Understanding of insurance concepts such as loss ratios, underwriting performance, claim patterns, and risk segmentation is beneficial. **Competencies and Personal Characteristics** * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills. * Ability to translate technical findings into practical business recommendations. * Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset. * Ability to work collaboratively across departments. * High attention to detail and commitment to data integrity. * Performs effectively when changes in priorities, direction and resources occur. * Ability to perform duties under in a fast\-paced, high volume, office environment. * Capacity to deal calmly and effectively with problems and unknown situations. * Works with integrity and ethically. Upholds and supports the company’s goals and values. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Education: * Bachelor's (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer - Compute & Storage
jobs.description: **About Highrise AI** Highrise AI is a GPU\-native infrastructure platform built for modern AI workloads. Designed for developers and enterprises operating in performance\-critical and security\-sensitive environments, Highrise delivers scalable GPU compute across dedicated clusters, managed cloud, and confidential environments. Highrise combines bare\-metal performance with full\-stack orchestration, API\-driven access, and hardware\-enforced isolation to support training, fine\-tuning, and production\-scale deployment of AI models. From reserved GPU capacity to enterprise\-grade confidential compute, Highrise provides flexible infrastructure models tailored to the needs of builders operating at scale. Beyond infrastructure, Highrise integrates disciplined operations, advanced automation, and on\-site engineering expertise to sustain high uptime and predictable performance across deployments. These capabilities extend beyond Highrise\-owned fleets: through managed services, Highrise also operates third\-party GPU hardware on behalf of customers and partners, applying the same operational standards to infrastructure it does not own. Highrise is a subsidiary of Hut 8 Corp., an energy infrastructure platform. Hut 8 integrates power, digital infrastructure, and compute at scale. Highrise serves as the compute and operations layer—designing, deploying, and operating next\-generation GPU clusters from commissioning through production. **ROLE OVERVIEW** We are seeking a mid\-level AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer to provide Tier 2 operational support for large\-scale GPU compute and storage platforms. This hands\-on role focuses on owning technical tickets, restoring service, investigating recurring issues, and maintaining reliable day\-to\-day operation of production AI clusters. Working closely with the NOC, on\-site data hall technicians, SRE teams, and senior infrastructure engineers, the engineer will troubleshoot Linux\-based compute nodes, GPU systems, storage services, and their supporting software. Complex or systemic issues will be escalated to Tier 3 engineering with clear diagnostics and supporting evidence. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Tier 2 Incident and Ticket Management** * Own and manage escalated incidents, service requests, and problem tickets from initial technical triage through resolution, escalation, or documented handoff. * Diagnose compute and storage faults using system logs, monitoring dashboards, management interfaces, and approved diagnostic tools. * Assess severity and customer impact; coordinate with the NOC and site teams to restore service within operational and SLA targets. * Produce clear troubleshooting records, timely ticket updates, shift handovers, and actionable Tier 3 or OEM escalations. **Compute and GPU Platform Operations** * Troubleshoot Linux servers, GPU health alerts, boot failures, firmware/driver issues, hardware faults, and resource availability problems. * Support node provisioning, reimaging, configuration changes, routine maintenance, and return\-to\-service validation using established automation and runbooks. * Investigate Kubernetes and Slurm node or workload failures, working with platform engineers when application or scheduler\-level escalation is required. * Perform first\-level analysis of connectivity or GPU communication symptoms and engage network or Tier 3 engineers for deeper fabric and performance investigation. **Storage Operations and Troubleshooting** * Monitor and troubleshoot distributed and high\-performance storage systems, including capacity, throughput, availability, and client connectivity. * Investigate filesystem mount failures, storage\-node or disk alerts, degraded services, and access or performance complaints. * Execute approved recovery, maintenance, and component replacement workflows with storage vendors and data hall technicians. * Support operational tasks across file, object, and block storage platforms as deployed at Highrise sites. **Operational Readiness and Continuous Improvement** * Assist with upgrades, planned maintenance, cluster expansions, and validation activities following established change controls. * Maintain accurate asset, configuration, and ticket records; improve runbooks, troubleshooting checklists, and knowledge articles. * Identify recurring incidents and automate repeatable operational work with scripts and existing infrastructure management tools. * Collaborate with remote engineering teams, on\-site technicians, OEMs, and vendors to resolve issues safely and efficiently. **ABOUT YOU** **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 3–6 years of experience supporting Linux servers, HPC, cloud, or data center infrastructure in a production environment. * Practical troubleshooting experience with enterprise compute hardware, BMC interfaces (iDRAC/iLO or equivalent), operating systems, and monitoring tools. * Working familiarity with storage technologies such as NFS, distributed filesystems, object storage, and storage performance fundamentals. * Experience using ticketing systems, change management procedures, and Bash or Python scripting for routine diagnostics and automation. * Exposure to NVIDIA GPU systems, InfiniBand/RDMA, Kubernetes, Slurm, or AI/HPC storage platforms is a strong advantage. **Core Competencies** * Structured, evidence\-driven troubleshooting with sound judgment on when to remediate, collaborate, or escalate. * Strong ownership of tickets, attention to operational detail, and commitment to reliable customer service. * Ability to work effectively across NOC, SRE, hardware, network, storage, and Tier 3 engineering teams. * Clear written and verbal communication in English. **ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT** This is a full\-time, engineering role supporting large\-scale AI compute infrastructure across multiple sites. Travel to data centers for cluster commissioning, acceptance, and complex troubleshooting will be required. Flexibility to assist with critical incidents or maintenance activities outside regular business hours is expected. This role is hybrid or remote depending on location. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WHAT MAKES HIGHRISE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK** At Highrise, you will directly influence the performance, reliability, and production readiness of large\-scale AI clusters, work alongside experienced infrastructure engineers, and help define the technical standards for a growing global AI infrastructure platform. At Highrise, you will have the opportunity to: * Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting * Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government * Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team * Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting\-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: If you thrive in fast paced environments, enjoy hands\-on problem solving, and want to make a measurable impact while working with modern automation and control systems, this role offers the challenge, autonomy, and growth opportunities to take your engineering career to the next level. \*\*\*Schedule is M\-F 7 PM\-3 AM or 6 PM\-2 AM (must have a flexible schedule) In this role, you won’t just maintain systems—you’ll continuously improve them. You’ll apply your controls and automation knowledge to optimize preventive maintenance strategies, diagnose sophisticated issues, and enhance the performance of industry leading technologies such as conveyors, sortation systems, PLCs, scanners, vision systems, print\-and‑apply equipment, and SCADA platforms. Your work will directly influence uptime, safety, and operational excellence across mission critical facilities. What You’ll Do * Promote a safe working environment by complying with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agencies, and company directives related to system operations and work safety. * Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package. * Act as first level escalation in troubleshooting support, both on\-site and remotely, as well as during and after business hours, to repair all MHE controls software systems. Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning assistance as needed. * Inspect systems to ensure the operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieve operational conditions prescribed by the client. * Oversee scope of development, work request initiation, scheduling, and inspection of work performed by outside contractors, which includes proprietary work, licensed installations, upgrades, and maintenance and inspection of specialized systems. * Engineer process solutions and reliability improvement from concept to network implementation. * Monitor Industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS\-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems. * Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies. * Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts. * Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents. * Perform controls systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability. * Clearly communicate technical issues, project timelines, and product impacts with site leadership, operations and maintenance teams. * Cultivate positive working relationships with our Client and the Operations Maintenance team members. * Perform other job\-related duties as needed or assigned. What You’ll Need * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. * Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2\-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered. * Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming. * 2\+ years of experience working with PLC programming, robotics system components and controls, and SCADA\-based monitoring and control systems. * Ability to be available and work in a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays. * Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight. * Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more. * Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems. Preferred Qualifications * 2\+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming. * Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems. * Experience with robotic maintenance. * In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc. * Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset. * Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial\-related calculations. You should be proficient in: * PLC Programming Experience * SCADA Experience

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** AlderPoint Technologies is looking for a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to help maintain the systems and infrastructure that business applications depend on. You'll work with cloud services, server environments, networking, and automation to keep infrastructure reliable, secure, and manageable. The role involves both planned infrastructure work and troubleshooting when something goes wrong. You'll help investigate service issues, support deployments, review system configurations, and work with other technical teams to resolve problems. We need someone who approaches technical changes carefully, documents their work, and communicates clearly when an issue affects system performance or delivery. **What You'll Be Responsible For** * Configure, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure based on application and business requirements. * Manage cloud resources, including virtual machines, storage, networking, and access permissions. * Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, and resource usage to identify potential problems. * Troubleshoot server, connectivity, configuration, and deployment issues. * Support application releases and coordinate infrastructure changes with development and IT teams. * Review cloud configurations and access controls to identify security concerns. * Use scripting and automation to reduce repetitive infrastructure tasks. * Assist with backup procedures, recovery planning, and routine maintenance. * Investigate service interruptions and document the steps taken to resolve them. * Review resource consumption and identify opportunities to manage cloud costs. * Maintain infrastructure diagrams, configuration records, and technical procedures. * Follow change\-management processes and communicate risks before modifying production systems. **What You'll Bring** We are looking for someone with a practical understanding of cloud infrastructure and a methodical approach to technical problem\-solving. You should have: * Experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. * Knowledge of cloud computing, virtual machines, storage, and infrastructure networking. * Familiarity with Linux or Windows server environments. * An understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, and network troubleshooting. * Experience with scripting tools such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell. * Familiarity with system monitoring, access management, and infrastructure security. * The ability to investigate technical issues and explain findings clearly. * Good documentation habits and attention to detail. * The ability to work with developers, IT colleagues, and other stakeholders. * Sound judgement when making changes that could affect live services. Experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, Docker, or CI/CD tools is useful. Relevant cloud certifications are also an advantage. **What to Expect in the Role** You'll be expected to keep infrastructure records current, report problems promptly, and check changes before they affect live systems. When an issue cannot be resolved immediately, you should explain its impact, document what has been investigated, and communicate the next steps. You'll also help identify recurring technical problems and recommend practical improvements to infrastructure reliability, security, and maintenance. **Working Schedule** **Days:** Monday to Friday **Hours:** 9:00 AM–5:00 PM **Location:** Los Angeles, California **How to Apply** Apply through Indeed with your current Resume. Include your cloud infrastructure experience, the platforms and tools you have used, and any relevant certifications. You may also describe an infrastructure project or technical problem you worked on, explaining your contribution and the outcome. **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** **Applicants will be considered based on job\-related skills, experience, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable employment laws.** Pay: $166,000\.00 \- $171,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are seeking a Cloud Security Engineer to help protect cloud infrastructure, applications, and business data. This role focuses on identifying security weaknesses, implementing appropriate controls, monitoring potential threats, and supporting the secure operation of cloud environments. You will work with technical teams to review cloud configurations, investigate security alerts, improve access controls, and address vulnerabilities. The position requires sound technical judgement, a practical approach to security, and the ability to explain risks and recommended solutions clearly. **Key Responsibilities** * Review cloud infrastructure and services to identify security gaps, misconfigurations, and potential vulnerabilities. * Implement and maintain security controls across cloud environments. * Configure identity and access management policies, permissions, and authentication controls. * Monitor security alerts and investigate suspicious activity involving cloud resources. * Support incident response activities, including investigation, documentation, and remediation. * Conduct vulnerability assessments and coordinate corrective actions with engineering and IT teams. * Review cloud network configurations, encryption settings, logging, and data protection controls. * Maintain secure configuration standards and ensure changes follow established security procedures. * Support security assessments, technical audits, and compliance\-related activities. * Maintain accurate security documentation, investigation records, and remediation reports. * Recommend improvements that strengthen cloud security while minimising disruption to business operations. * Work with technical colleagues to incorporate security considerations into cloud deployments and infrastructure changes. **Skills and Qualifications** * Professional experience in cloud security, information security, cloud engineering, or a related technical field. * Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform, such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Understanding of identity and access management, network security, encryption, and cloud security controls. * Experience reviewing cloud configurations and identifying vulnerabilities or security risks. * Familiarity with security monitoring, logging, alert investigation, and incident response procedures. * Understanding of vulnerability management and security remediation practices. * Ability to document technical findings and explain security issues clearly. * Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. * Ability to collaborate effectively with IT, infrastructure, and engineering teams. Experience with infrastructure as code, cloud security posture management tools, security information and event management platforms, or recognised security frameworks would be beneficial. **What We Expect** We expect security findings to be investigated carefully, documented accurately, and communicated clearly. Recommended fixes should address the underlying risk, and unresolved issues should be tracked through to completion. The successful candidate will balance security requirements with operational needs, use evidence to support recommendations, and work constructively with colleagues to strengthen the organisation's security posture. **Work Location and Schedule** **Location:** Cincinnati, Ohio **Work Arrangement:** To be confirmed by the employer **Working Hours:** To be confirmed by the employer **How to Apply** Submit your résumé through Indeed, highlighting your experience with cloud platforms, security controls, vulnerability management, and incident investigation. Include relevant certifications or technical projects that demonstrate your cloud security knowledge. **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** We consider applicants based on their relevant skills, experience, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable employment laws. Pay: $135,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Data Warehouse Programmer/Analyst
jobs.description: The Supreme Court of Nevada, Administrative Office of the Courts (AOC), is seeking a Data Warehouse Programmer/Analyst to support and expand the Nevada Courts Data Warehouse. The Data Warehouse Programmer/Analyst plays a crucial role in Nevada Courts Data Warehouse in developing, maintaining, testing, and supporting the programming and data transformations that move court data into reliable statewide reporting structures. The incumbent applies advanced programming and database skills to develop complex queries, stored procedures, data transformations, and automated processes. This position works closely with stakeholders to understand business requirements, implement approved business rules, resolve data and programming issues, and expand the Data Warehouse and related data services to support current and future AOC initiatives. This position may require travel to various court locations throughout Nevada and occasional travel outside of Nevada. Occasional overtime and work on holidays, nights, and/or weekends may be required. This position can be located in Carson City or Las Vegas. After an initial training period, there may be an opportunity for a hybrid remote/in\-office schedule. **Please note: This position is inellegible to work fully remote. The selected candidate is required to work from the Carson City or Las Vegas office.** **Examples of Duties** * Business Analysis and Solutions Design: Work closely with business stakeholders to gather and document requirements, understand business processes, and identify opportunities for improvement. Create detailed technical designs and implement solutions that align with business requirements and architectural standards. * Translate business needs into technical specifications and actionable plans. * Support integration of new court systems, data sources, and AOC applications into the Data Warehouse and related reporting environment. * Support future AOC initiatives that depend on consistent data collection, transformation, integration, and reporting. * Participate in requirements analysis, technical design, coding, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation support for Data Warehouse enhancements. * Develop and execute test plans to validate solutions. * Work with other units of the AOC to ensure transformations reflect approved business rules and produce reliable reporting data and/or metrics. * Database Development: Develop, maintain, and support Data Warehouse code, scripts, queries, procedures, jobs, and data\-transformation processes. * Build and maintain extract, transform, and load processes that collect, standardize, validate, and load court data from approved source systems. * Develop and maintain SQL queries, stored procedures, views, functions, and other code used for data integration, validation, reporting, and analysis. * Optimize code and data\-processing workflows for performance, scalability, maintainability, and efficient use of resources. * Technical Support and Documentation: Provide support for production databases and applications, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions in a timely manner. Monitor and enhance system performance. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for database structures, processes, and system configurations. Ensure documentation is up\-to\-date and accessible. * Troubleshoot failed or incomplete data loads, transformation errors, mapping issues, performance problems, and other programming defects. * Maintain source\-to\-target mappings, transformation specifications, code documentation, dependencies, version history, and operational runbooks. * Assist with user acceptance testing and validation of data transformations, reports, and interfaces before production release. * Collaboration: Work with cross\-functional teams, including end users, developers, data analysts, and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery and integration. Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing. * Security: Apply secure coding, change\-management, source\-control, and release\-management practices established by the AOC. * Protect confidential, restricted, and sensitive court information and comply with applicable judiciary policies governing data access and use. * Follow department policies and procedures. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** * Professional programming or data\-engineering experience involving relational databases, structured data, integrations, or enterprise reporting environments. * Strong SQL skills and experience developing queries, stored procedures, scripts, or comparable database programming components. * Experience developing or maintaining ETL/ELT processes, data transformations, interfaces, or automated data workflows. * Knowledge of data structures, database concepts, testing, error handling, logging, source control, and software development practices. * Ability to analyze technical problems, trace data through multiple processing steps, and develop maintainable solutions. * Skilled at delivering precise, high\-quality documentation for system requirements, codebases, data mappings, test results, and technical dependencies. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, integration services, scripting languages, or the technologies used by the AOC Data Warehouse (AWS services including Redshift and Glue) is preferred. If this position is approved for remote/hybrid work, the incumbent is required to work a minimum of 40 hours in the office per pay period, in accordance with a supervisor\-approved schedule. The remaining work hours are eligible to be performed remotely in accordance with operational needs and applicable remote\-work policies. The incumbent must be able to work effectively and collaborate with employees while working remotely. The individual must be proficient in virtual meeting platforms such as Microsoft Teams and be able to perform all duties through a reliable internet connection provided by the employee. The internet connection must be sufficient to support all job functions, with a minimum download speed of 50–100 Mbps. Higher speeds may be necessary if the connection is shared with other members of the household. **Additional** **Benefits include:** * **Health Insurance:** medical, dental, prescription, vision, life and disability insurance programs for employees and dependents/family are offered through the Public Employees’ Benefits Program (PEBP). * **Vacation:** Accrual of three weeks of annual leave each year. * **Sick Leave:** Accrual of three weeks of sick leave each year. * **Holidays:** 12 paid holidays per year. * **Retirement:** Participation in the Nevada Public Employees’ Retirement System (PERS). * **Deferred Compensation:** The State has a voluntary deferred compensation program. * **No Nevada state income tax.** * **Positions are eligible for Public Service Loan Forgiveness.** * **Flexibility:** a work\-life balance beyond compare! Please note the posted salary is based on the Employee/Employer paid retirement contribution plan to PERS. **Applicants should submit a cover letter and resume.** **This recruitment is scheduled to close at 11:59 p.m. on October 29, 2026\. Based on the number of applications received, the recruitment may close early. Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.**

jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** AeroCharge is seeking an Embedded Firmware Engineer to develop and support firmware for our wireless power systems. The engineer will work closely with our mixed\-signal, antenna, mechanical, and systems engineering teams to implement and integrate embedded systems. **Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain microcontroller firmware using C/C\+\+. * Implement real\-time embedded software and complex algorithms. * Work cross\-functionally with hardware, antenna, mechanical, and systems engineers to define and implement requirements. * Interface with embedded hardware using SPI, UART, I2C, JTAG, USB, and BLE. * Debug, test, and optimize firmware and embedded systems. * Communicate progress, technical findings, and issues to the engineering team and management. **Qualifications** * Strong knowledge of embedded systems and C/C\+\+. * Experience with real\-time embedded software development. * Coursework or experience in communication systems and digital signal processing. * Experience implementing complex algorithms. * Familiarity with SPI, UART, I2C, JTAG, USB, and BLE. * Ability to debug and troubleshoot hardware/firmware systems. * Familiarity with FPGAs and VHDL is a plus. **Education \& Experience** * B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. * Senior engineering student or recent graduate. * Relevant internship, research, or project experience is a plus. **Compensation: $20–30/hour** **Schedule: Part\-time (20 hours per week) or Full Time** **About AeroCharge** AeroCharge is a technology startup developing long\-range wireless power and connected sensing systems for defense, industrial, and commercial applications. Our vision is to enable true wireless charging, allowing devices to receive power at a distance without traditional wired connections. We are a small, fast\-moving team developing new wireless power technology and products. This is an opportunity to work closely with experienced engineers and entrepreneurs on challenging, real\-world hardware and firmware systems. Pay: $20\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About Austin Sensing Company** -------------------------------- Austin Sensing Company builds radar, acoustic, and RF sensors for defense, public safety, critical infrastructure, and autonomous systems. We design and manufacture our hardware in Austin, Texas, with a focus on making high\-performance sensing reliable, affordable, and widely available. **About the Role** ------------------ We’re hiring an Embedded Systems Engineer to develop the firmware and embedded software that operate our sensing hardware. You’ll own code that brings up boards, controls peripherals, moves sensor data, and keeps deployed systems running reliably. You’ll work closely with electrical, RF, FPGA, and software engineers, taking systems from initial board bring\-up through production and customer deployment. We’re looking for someone who understands the hardware beneath their code and can diagnose problems at the bench and in the field. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Develop embedded firmware and software for microcontrollers and processors across our sensing products. * Bring up new boards, configure peripherals, and develop drivers alongside electrical engineers. * Implement sensor control, jobs.title: Founding AI Agent Engineer
jobs.description: **tl;dr/Overview:** =================== At Alleviate Health we’re building AI Agents that drastically accelerate clinical trials by autonomously communicating with patients to recruit them into trials and support them over years, pruning billions in excess spend. We’re solving the problem that keeps execs at the largest $100B\+ Pharma companies up at night. We bootstrapped to winning some of the largest enterprise accounts in the market and are seeing massive market pull. We’ve now raised a $4\.3M seed round led by a16z and are hiring a world\-class team to solve the largest problem in drug development and win one of the largest opportunities in AI – while slashing the time it takes to bring life\-changing medicines to the patients who desperately need them. **Context:** ------------ Conducting a clinical trial is the most complex and broken, but also the most high‑stakes and capital intensive, problem of our era. To bring a life\-saving medicine from the lab bench to patients, pharma companies spend **tens of billions a year** for research sites to **qualify \& screen hundreds of thousands of patients and then to stay in contact with those patients over years.** Approximately 80% of clinical trials are delayed due to problems with recruitment and between $600,000 and $8 million is lost for each day a trial is delayed. This enormous, labor\-intensive struggle of screening, recruitment, and retention of patients across thousands of small research sites in every single trial is the foundational bottleneck in clinical trials. **About Alleviate:** -------------------- At Alleviate we've built SOTA AI Agents that autonomously recruit \& retain patients in trials. Currently, our AI agents conduct over 100,000 conversations every month by: * Intelligently screening \& routing patients to the right trials. * Collecting necessary data for the trial from patients multiple times per week. * Answering patients’ questions perfectly and supporting them 24/7 throughout the trial \- reducing costly drop\-offs. * Continuously learning from each interaction to optimize performance. Our team worked at a small research site for months to understand the problem deeply \- personally calling and speaking to patients \- and then **bootstrapped to working with some of the largest clinical research organizations** in the world and conducting over a 100k conversations per month. **Some vitals on Alleviate (Achieved without a single dollar raised):** ----------------------------------------------------------------------- * **Hypergrowth**. We’re growing rapidly MoM (both within existing \& new accounts). We’ve landed (and realized) multiple 6 figure deals. Our largest live contract has an annual value of \>$350k. * **Our win rate on commercial deals is \>92%.** We’re the market leading solution \- we’ve never lost a deal to competitors and have actively poached multiple customers from competitors. * **Our market is gigantic and immensely painful.** We can’t mention their names publicly but have landed pilots with top 20 pharma(s) that will grow to $XM\+/yr. Our pipeline grows organically due to customer fear of falling behind after hearing from our existing customers. **Investors (a16z, Jack Altman…):** ----------------------------------- We’re now backed by Andreessen Horowitz and other investors like Jack Altman (Co\-Founder of Lattice), Zach Weinberg (Co\-Founder of Flatiron Health, the largest Pharma tech exit of all time), Ali Rowghani (Former CFO \& COO of Twitter), Trey Holterman (CEO \& Co\-Founder of Tennr) and many others who’ve built category defining healthcare \& pharma companies. **What you might work on:** --------------------------- * Orchestrating a fleet of AI agents that coordinate patient recruitment across hundreds of clinical trials across North America (For now). * Scaling language models across Voice, SMS, and email while keeping conversations consistent and personalized across all channels. We’re going after the largest problem in one of the largest markets in the world. We already replace tens of millions in excess spend and will replace billions of dollars of excess spend while slashing the time it takes to bring life\-changing medicines to the patients who desperately need them. We’re looking for exceptional founding engineers to help us realize this ambition. If you’re an engineer that finds this goal compelling, we'd love to talk.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (Python, React.js)
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will develop and support cloud\-native Python services on Amazon Web Services (AWS). But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you carrying user stories from refinement all the way through production. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build back\-end features in Python on a cloud\-native AWS stack, starting from user stories. * Build the React.js screens and components that put those features in front of users. * Automate workflows using AWS Lambda, Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\), and related AWS services. * Develop the application programming interfaces (APIs) and integrations that link internal systems with commercial products. * Write unit and integration tests, join code reviews, and resolve the defects you find, carrying the work all the way to production. * Help automate the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline, write code that is secure and accessible, and support your services in production. * Work with AI\-assisted development tools every day, and review and test everything they produce. * Help uphold quality development practices, including test\-driven development and automated testing. You deliver and own tested, working code through production, including the defects you identify and resolve. You automate business operations that replace manual checks, validations, and spreadsheet workflows, and you build deployment pipelines so releasing services becomes routine. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of professional hands\-on software development experience, with back\-end work in Python and front\-end work in React.js * Bachelor's degree * Familiarity with cloud development on AWS, including AWS Lambda and Amazon S3 * The ability to take a defined specification to working, tested code and own it through production, using object\-oriented design, design patterns, and data modeling * Experience with relational databases, for example PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or Oracle * Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or DynamoDB * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills, backed by sound analytical judgment * Delivery experience in an Agile framework such as Scrum or Kanban, tracking work in a tool such as Jira * Excellent communication skills, including working directly with non\-technical client stakeholders and translating business requirements into technical solutions * Accurate estimation of your assigned tasks and work effort * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Production workloads delivered hands\-on in AWS, an AWS certification, or a Python certification * Federal information technology experience * Consulting experience in a client\-facing setting * Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tools * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices **Who you are** You care about what you build, and you judge it by whether it works for the people who rely on it. You move with shifting priorities, and when you pick up a new tool or domain, you develop enough depth to make judgment calls in it rather than follow instructions. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * A practical command of modern cloud development, with the range to create something new or improve an existing system. * Delivery habits to match: version control, unit and integration testing, code review, secure coding, and accessibility. * Clear, plain\-language communication with the people who depend on your work, and the habit of listening for what they need. * The exactness to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $150,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer (Backend Focus)
jobs.description: **Full\-Stack Developer (Backend Focus)** Location: Southern California \| Hybrid Department: Engineering \& Product Experience Level: Junior to Mid\-Level Compensation: $35 to $45 per hour Schedule: Hybrid \| One day per week in person \| SoCal **Role Overview** AIVA MD is looking for a Full\-Stack Developer with a strong backend focus to join our engineering team. Exposure to any of the following is a plus: * AWS services * PostgreSQL * HIPAA\-compliant software development * WebSockets or real\-time features * Docker or containerization basics * EHR systems or healthcare data standards **What We're Looking For** We are looking for someone who is curious, careful, and takes ownership of their work. jobs.description: About Us: Every moment of every day, people around the world rely on the energy they access through infrastructure built by Quanta. Imagine what you could do here. What You'll Bring: * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. * 8–12 years of experience in software development, systems integration, or technical consulting, with recent hands\-on delivery experience. * At least 2 years in a technical lead, tech lead, or senior engineer capacity guiding the work of other engineers on a shared project. * Advanced proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Java). * Solid grounding in software architecture patterns, API design, data modeling, and full\-stack or backend delivery. * Fluency in at least one major cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern development practices (CI/CD, containers, version control workflows, testing). * Demonstrated experience applying AI tooling (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, vector search, prompt engineering, RAG patterns) in real delivery workflows. * Track record of shipping production software on tight timelines in a consultative or embedded setting. * Experience mentoring engineers and running effective code reviews. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between business stakeholders and engineers and to represent technical tradeoffs clearly. Preferred Education and Experience * Experience delivering AI, automation, or data\-intensive applications in enterprise environments. * Experience working within large, decentralized organizations or multi\-site enterprise environments. * Background in utility, energy, renewables, construction, or specialty contracting industries. * Prior experience in a Forward Deployed Engineer, solutions engineer, or delivery consultant role.
