jobs.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: * **Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach, Scale \& Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Ad Platforms is responsible for Disney’s industry\-leading ad technology and products – driving advertising performance, innovation, and value in Disney’s sports, news, and entertainment content, across all media platforms. The Ad Platform research team is under Ad Platforms and its mission is to transform advertising and Disney's Ad platform with AI and data science. We build solutions to measure and optimize every aspect of the advertising life cycle. Our tenant is a strong cross\-domain team to deliver E2E solutions for machine learning and data science. Our team is seeking a lead machine learning engineer who will be an outstanding addition and leading development for prediction or optimization engines for addressable ad platforms. The right person for this role should be experienced in crafting implementation for either machine learning technologies or data\-driven algorithms. If you are someone who is proactive and innovative in these domains, this is a phenomenal role for you! **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Drive ground\-breaking innovation and apply state of the art AI and machine learning in a variety of areas to enhance every aspect of advertising, including inventory forecasting, ad experience, ad pacing, pricing, targeting, and efficient ad delivery. * Invent and iterate novel solutions for complex ad challenges with fast turnaround. * Lead the ad algorithm architecture design and iteration of the advertising system. * Develop scalable and efficient approaches for large scale data analysis and model development. * Build and experiment new algorithms and models end\-to\-end, from production rollout to continuous optimization. * Collaborate with engineering teams, product managers, and program managers in an open and creative environment. * Mentor team members and support their technical growth. **WHAT TO BRING** * Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or relevant field * 7\+ years of working experience on large scale machine learning at leading internet companies. * Strong knowledge of AI/ML technologies, mathematics and statistics. * Proficient in Java, Python, Scala, large scale ML/DL platforms and processing tech stack. * Passionate about understanding the ad business, applying advanced research to relevant business scenarios, and seeking innovation opportunities to enhance business effectiveness. * Passionate about technology, open to interdisciplinary collaborations, and experienced in building data\-driven services and applications. * A proven track record of thriving in a fast\-paced, data\-driven, and collaborative work environment is required. **NICE\-TO\-HAVES** * MS or PhD in computer science or equivalent experience preferred * Experience in digital video advertising or digital marketing domain * Experience with CTR/CVR model, generative AI, forecasting algorithm model. * Experience with feature store, audience segmentation and MLOps * Experience with Tensorflow, Kubeflow or Sagemaker **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY This position is with Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs. We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
jobs.description: AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. Where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. We show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves. The Lead Technical Program Manager, Risk \& Security will drive the cross\-functional execution and operational alignment of critical security initiatives across stakeholder groups, including Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), IT, Business Systems, Marketing Operations, and more. By unifying application security, infrastructure security, vulnerability management, and adversarial testing under a single roadmap, this role ensures our security posture scales cleanly with AppFolio’s growth. Reporting within the Information Security organization, you will serve as the primary bridge between technical security functions and partner engineering teams, empowering our business to build safely, mitigate risks early, and maintain customer trust. **Your Impact** * Establish, maintain, and execute strategic roadmaps for core internal security initiatives across application security, infrastructure security, vulnerability management, and threat operations. * Partner directly with Engineering, SRE, IT, and Business Systems teams to scope requirements, track critical project milestones, and ensure operational deliverables remain on schedule. * Implement structured intake and prioritization processes to make security project handoffs transparent, well\-resourced, and aligned with overall business goals. * Proactively identify cross\-departmental blockers, resource gaps, and dependency conflicts, escalating issues with actionable options and strategic trade\-offs. * Serve as the single point of contact and primary cross\-functional liaison for security\-driven initiatives, streamlining communications with internal engineering partners and external third\-party vendors. * Deliver clear, executive\-ready reporting on program health, project progress, resource needs, and technical outcomes framed around business risk reduction and resilience. **Qualifications** * Able to translate complex, multi\-domain security initiatives (application security, infrastructure security, vulnerability management) into structured project roadmaps and clear operational deliverables. * Skilled at facilitating cross\-functional alignment between security, software engineering, site reliability, and IT operations teams. * Strong ability to evaluate technical dependencies, surface emerging risks early, and present clear options and trade\-offs to senior leadership. * Demonstrated competency in managing technical project workflows within tools like Jira to maintain clear accountability and visible tracking. * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the versatility to tailor messages effectively for software engineers, security practitioners, and executive leadership. **Must Have** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical technical leadership experience) required. * Proven track record in technical program or project management within an information security or engineering organization. * Experience managing cross\-functional technical projects that intersect with software development lifecycles, CI/CD pipelines, or SRE/IT operational workflows. * Hands\-on experience utilizing project management and issue\-tracking platforms (such as Jira) to manage complex backlogs, dependencies, and delivery timelines. * Experience coordinating deliverables across multiple security disciplines or managing vendor engagements aligned with internal project schedules. * Strong communication skills, including executive\-level reporting capabilities. **Compensation \& Benefits** The compensation that we reasonably expect to pay for this role is: $152,000 \- $190,000 base pay. The actual compensation for this role will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s skills, education, experience, and internal equity. Please note that compensation is just one aspect of a comprehensive Total Rewards package. The compensation range listed here does not include additional benefits or any discretionary bonuses you may be eligible for based on your role and/or employment type. Regular full\-time employees are eligible for benefits \- see here. **About AppFolio** AppFolio is the technology leader powering the future of the real estate industry. Our innovative platform and trusted partnership enable our customers to connect communities, increase operational efficiency, and grow their business. For more information about AppFolio, visit appfolio.com. **Why AppFolio** **Grow** \| We enable a culture of high performance, where delivering results is recognized by opportunities for growth and compelling total rewards. Our challenging and meaningful work drive the growth of our business, and ourselves. **Learn** \| We partner with you to realize your potential by investing in you from the start. We're cultivating a team of big thinkers through coaching and mentorship with our best\-in\-class leaders, and giving you the time and tools to develop your skills. **Impact** \| We are creating a world where living in, investing in, managing, and supporting communities feels magical and effortless, freeing people to thrive. We do this by innovating with purpose while cultivating a culture of impact. We learn as much from each other as we do our customers and our communities. **Connect** \| We excel at hybrid work by fostering an environment that feels flexible, personal and connected, no matter where we are. We create space to fuel innovation and collaboration, and we come together to celebrate, connect, and succeed. **Paddle as One.** Learn more at appfolio.com/company/careers ***Statement of Equal Opportunity*** *At AppFolio, we value diversity in backgrounds and perspectives and depend on it to drive our innovative culture. That’s why we’re a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we believe that our products, our teams, and our business are stronger because of it. This means that no matter what race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, age, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, or veteran status, you’re always welcome at AppFolio.* Compensation Range: $152K \- $190K

jobs.title: Machine Learning Systems Administrator / DevOps Engineer: Training Clusters & Inference Cloud
jobs.description: **The Role:** As a Machine Learning Systems Administrator / DevOps Engineer, you will maintain and build the core infrastructure behind both our model training and our inference cloud. You’ll split your time between our large\-scale training clusters and the deployments and services that run our models in production on heterogeneous compute, which spans multiple accelerator types and vendors. You’ll work closely with our training, inference, and product teams to keep these systems reliable, secure, and fast. You’ll also lay the groundwork for workflows that can scale with us. **You’ll Work Across:** *Training clusters* * Administration and automation of our Linux\-based cluster environments * User onboarding/offboarding, access control, and security auditing * Monitoring system resources, job scheduling, and cluster health * Bring\-up and validation of new hardware (compute, networking, storage) * Supporting and improving developer workflows (e.g., VSCode remote development, Docker) * Enabling and supporting large\-scale training jobs *Inference cloud* * Deploying, operating, and scaling inference services across heterogeneous accelerators * Managing container orchestration, CI/CD, and rollout pipelines for model deployments * Building observability for production services, including metrics, logging, alerting, and dashboards * Owning service reliability: uptime, incident response, and postmortems * Capacity planning, autoscaling, and utilization/cost tracking across hardware types * Securing production systems through secrets management, network policy, and tenant isolation You’ll own critical systems end to end. Your work will directly affect developer productivity, training throughput, and the performance and reliability of our inference platform. **What We’re Looking For / Requirements:** * Experience with Linux system administration, user and access management, and automation * Demonstrated expertise in scripting languages for system tooling and automation (bash, Python, etc.) * Experience with containers (Docker) and scheduling/orchestration systems (Slurm, Kubernetes) * Experience running production services, including monitoring and alerting (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana), deployment pipelines, and incident response * Experience building tooling for cluster validation and reliability (accelerator, networking, and storage health checks) * Experience setting up and managing developer tools and third\-party services (e.g., cloud storage providers, Docker Hub, Slack, Gmail, Telegraf, experiment trackers) * Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills across compute, storage, and networking * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and non\-technical teams **Qualifications / Additional Skills:** * Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Ansible, Terraform) * Prior work supporting ML/AI infrastructure, including GPU management and workload optimization * Experience deploying and operating LLM serving stacks (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, Ray) * Experience with multiple accelerator platforms (e.g., NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, TPUs) * Experience with high\-performance networking (InfiniBand, RoCE) and distributed storage * Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP * Familiarity with Apptainer and with integrating containers into Slurm and Kubernetes **Why Work at Zyphra:** * Our research methodology is grounded in methodical, step\-by\-step approaches to ambitious goals. Both deep research and engineering excellence are equally valued * We strongly value new and crazy ideas and are very willing to bet big on new ideas * We move as quickly as we can; we aim to minimize the bar to impact as low as possible * We all enjoy what we do and love discussing AI **Benefits and Perks:** * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and FSA plans * Competitive compensation and 401(k) plan * Relocation and immigration support on a case\-by\-case basis * In\-office snacks and meals provided * Unlimited PTO and company holidays * In\-person team in San Francisco with a collaborative, high\-energy environment

jobs.title: Performance Engineer
jobs.description: Headquartered in Houston, Texas, Panthera Grid Partners is a portfolio company of Brookfield, one of the world’s largest owners and operators of renewable power and sustainable solutions. Panthera Grid Partners delivers reliable, utility\-scale solar, wind and energy storage infrastructure to meet America’s growing demand for domestic energy. With a portfolio exceeding 10 gigawatts, Panthera Grid Partners operates in U.S. power markets where load growth, grid reliability and capital investment are most critical. The company develops, acquires, builds, and operates renewable energy assets with a disciplined, precision\-driven focus on execution, performance, and operational integrity. Through responsible land stewardship and strong local partnerships, Panthera Grid Partners delivers energy projects with respect for land, agriculture, and local priorities, working with landowners and communities to support long\-term land value and strengthen regional economies. **Job Summary** Panthera Grid is seeking an experienced and motivated Performance Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will have minimum 3 years of relevant experience in utility\-scale performance engineering. The Performance Engineer is responsible for maximizing the operational and financial performance of the company's utility\-scale solar and energy storage assets. This role serves as the technical lead for performance analytics, production forecasting, root cause analysis, and performance optimization initiatives across a portfolio of operating renewable energy facilities. The Performance Engineer will have extensive modeling experience with PVsyst, a strong understanding of all inputs required for generating P50 energy estimates and of PV plant construction and operation. The Performance position will report to the Reliability Engineering Manager. The successful candidate will possess strong expertise in solar plant and battery storage performance assessment, energy modeling, SCADA analytics, and operational troubleshooting. This individual will work closely with Asset Management, Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M), Commercial Operations, Development, Engineering, and third\-party service providers to identify performance risks and opportunities, improve fleet availability, and ensure achievement of energy production targets. The Performance Engineer will be a subject matter expert in photovoltaic system and Battery storage behavior, plant performance metrics, and operational analytics, helping drive continuous improvement across the renewable energy portfolio. **Responsibilities** * Monitor and analyze fleet\-wide solar plant performance, availability, and energy production against budget, P50 forecasts, and contractual guarantees. * Develop, maintain, and improve performance monitoring dashboards, KPIs, and reporting tools. * Assist in root cause analyses of underperformance events and production losses. * Evaluate SCADA, meteorological, inverter, tracker, and revenue meter data to identify operational issues and optimization opportunities. * Perform daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual performance assessments for operating assets. * Validate expected energy production through statistical analysis and comparison against performance models. * Support asset managers in assessing operational risks and revenue impacts associated with plant performance issues. * Collaborate with O\&M providers and internal resources to troubleshoot equipment failures and recurring performance losses. * Analyze inverter, tracker, module, and balance\-of\-system performance trends and degradation rates. * Lead performance guarantee evaluations, liquidated damages assessments, and contractual performance testing activities. * Review and update production forecasts, weather assumptions, and performance models as operating data becomes available. * Develop and maintain fleet degradation analyses and long\-term performance projections. * Identify and quantify opportunities for performance improvements and operational cost reductions. * Support due diligence efforts for project acquisitions, financing activities, and portfolio valuations. * Prepare technical reports, presentations, and executive summaries for internal and external stakeholders. * Stay current with evolving industry standards, technologies, and best practices related to solar PV, BESS, trackers, inverters, and energy analytics. * Develop automation tools, scripts, and analytical workflows using Python, SQL, Power BI, Excel VBA, or similar platforms. * Support incident investigations and recommend corrective actions to improve fleet reliability and performance. * Onboard new assets in performance platforms. **Requirements*** Minimum 3 years of renewable industry experience in a performance\-related role * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering (preferred), Meteorology, Statistics, Physics, or some other quantitative field * Strong knowledge of PV solar energy systems and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) * Proficiency in data analysis using Excel, Python, MATLAB, Fabric or other related software. * Understanding inverter operation, power conversion principles, and power electronics. * Advanced understanding of and experience with PVsyst software. * Professional verbal and written communication skills * Ability to discuss technical and advanced engineering concepts to both expert and non\-technical people. * Self\-motivated, able to work both independently with minimal oversight and in coordination with other groups and individuals. * Excellent time management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects, at times in a fast\-paced environment. **Preferred:** * Experience with utility\-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). * Experience supporting NERC, ISO, or utility compliance requirements. * Familiarity with SCADA platforms such as AlsoEnergy, Power Factors, OEM monitoring systems, or similar tools. * Experience with performance guarantee testing and ASTM performance testing protocols. * Knowledge of energy markets and renewable asset commercial operations. * Experience with machine learning, predictive analytics, or advanced data science applications in renewable energy. * Experience managing third\-party O\&M or EPC contractors Location: Hybrid in Houston, Texas (4 days in office, Fridays remote). **Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Visa sponsorship or transfer visas, including H\-1B or L\-2, are not available for this position.** **Benefits** Panthera Grid Partners offers an exciting benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, health savings account, flexible spending account, company\-paid life insurance and short\-term disability, voluntary life, and long\-term disability, paid paternal leave, and a retirement plan with matching contributions. Full\-time position with competitive compensation package, including bonus.

jobs.title: Principal AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Highrise AI** Highrise AI is a GPU\-native infrastructure platform built for modern AI workloads. Designed for developers and enterprises operating in performance\-critical and security\-sensitive environments, Highrise delivers scalable GPU compute across dedicated clusters, managed cloud, and confidential environments. Highrise combines bare\-metal performance with full\-stack orchestration, API\-driven access, and hardware\-enforced isolation to support training, fine\-tuning, and production\-scale deployment of AI models. From reserved GPU capacity to enterprise\-grade confidential compute, Highrise provides flexible infrastructure models tailored to the needs of builders operating at scale. Beyond infrastructure, Highrise integrates disciplined operations, advanced automation, and on\-site engineering expertise to sustain high uptime and predictable performance across deployments. These capabilities extend beyond Highrise\-owned fleets: through managed services, Highrise also operates third\-party GPU hardware on behalf of customers and partners, applying the same operational standards to infrastructure it does not own. Highrise is a subsidiary of Hut 8 Corp., an energy infrastructure platform. Hut 8 integrates power, digital infrastructure, and compute at scale. Highrise serves as the compute and operations layer—designing, deploying, and operating next\-generation GPU clusters from commissioning through production. **ROLE OVERVIEW** We are seeking a senior, hands\-on AI Cluster Integration Engineer to bring large\-scale GPU compute clusters from physical installation to validated, commercially ready production. Working alongside a team of senior infrastructure engineers, this person will own critical elements of cluster bring\-up, bare\-metal provisioning, advanced systems configuration, performance optimization, and acceptance testing. After deployment, the engineer will provide Tier 3 technical escalation and sustained performance support for operating clusters. The focus is on compute\-platform readiness and workload performance rather than primary ownership of network switch and fabric configuration. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Cluster Bring\-Up and Systems Integration** * Lead technical bring\-up of materially complete, racked, powered, and cabled AI clusters through production readiness and customer handoff. * Establish and validate system baselines across BIOS/BMC, firmware, GPU drivers, operating systems, and cluster software stacks. * Deploy and optimize automated bare\-metal provisioning, imaging, node configuration, and lifecycle workflows at scale. * Configure and troubleshoot advanced Linux and GPU systems, including kernel, driver, accelerator, and host\-level performance settings. * Integrate and validate Kubernetes and Slurm environments in partnership with platform, networking, and operations engineers. **Performance Engineering and Acceptance** * Execute NVIDIA Field Diagnostics, L11/L12 validation, burn\-in, stability, and hardware health qualification procedures. * Run and analyze NCCL collective communication tests, GPU benchmarks, and distributed workload performance at node, rack, and cluster scale. * Troubleshoot GPU, NVLink/NVSwitch, PCIe, RDMA, and InfiniBand/Ethernet performance issues, partnering with network engineers on fabric\-related remediation. * Identify configuration bottlenecks and optimize throughput, latency, scaling efficiency, and cluster reliability. * Own technical acceptance criteria, test evidence, defect tracking, remediation verification, and readiness recommendations for commercial service. **Tier 3 Operations and Reliability** * Serve as a senior escalation point for complex production incidents involving compute nodes, GPU software, provisioning, scheduling, and degraded performance. * Perform deep root cause analysis, coordinate vendor engineering escalations, and lead corrective actions for recurring or systemic issues. * Support fleet\-level upgrades, configuration changes, cluster expansions, and post\-maintenance validation with appropriate change controls. * Develop diagnostic tooling, automation, runbooks, and operational handoff material for SRE, NOC, and site support teams. **Cross\-Functional Execution** * Work closely with infrastructure engineering, site operations, OEMs, and software/platform teams to resolve cross\-stack issues and meet delivery milestones. * Provide concise technical status, benchmark findings, risks, and acceptance recommendations to engineering leadership and stakeholders. **ABOUT YOU** **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of hands\-on Linux systems engineering, HPC, cloud, or large\-scale infrastructure experience, including senior\-level troubleshooting. * Proven experience bringing GPU or HPC clusters into production and qualifying systems against performance and reliability targets. * Strong expertise in Linux, automation (Python/Bash/Ansible), bare\-metal provisioning, configuration management, and systems diagnostics. * Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA GPU platforms, NCCL, Field Diagnostics, and multi\-node performance testing. * Practical experience with Kubernetes and Slurm; familiarity with high\-speed Ethernet, InfiniBand/RDMA, and parallel or distributed storage. **Core Competencies** * Deep technical curiosity and the ability to isolate difficult problems across hardware, firmware, operating systems, and distributed workloads. * Strong ownership of outcomes, with a systematic approach to testing, documentation, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement. * Comfortable collaborating with highly experienced peer engineers while driving independent technical decisions and execution. * Clear communication with engineering leadership, vendors, site personnel, and customer\-facing stakeholders. **ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT** This is a full\-time, engineering role supporting large\-scale AI compute infrastructure across multiple sites. Travel to data centers for cluster commissioning, acceptance, and complex troubleshooting will be required. Flexibility to assist with critical incidents or maintenance activities outside regular business hours is expected. This role is hybrid or remote depending on location. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WHAT MAKES HIGHRISE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK** At Highrise, you will directly influence the performance, reliability, and production readiness of large\-scale AI clusters, work alongside experienced infrastructure engineers, and help define the technical standards for a growing global AI infrastructure platform. At Highrise, you will have the opportunity to: * Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting * Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government * Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team * Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting\-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

Following deployment, this person will provide Tier 3 technical escalation, advanced troubleshooting, and ongoing optimization of production infrastructure. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Systems Infrastructure Deployment and Integration** * Lead deployment and configuration of general\-purpose x86 servers, Linux operating systems, virtualization platforms, and supporting infrastructure services. * Design, deploy, and manage virtualized infrastructure using VMware, KVM, Proxmox, or equivalent technologies. * Implement and maintain automated bare\-metal provisioning, imaging, firmware management, and configuration workflows. * Deploy and integrate core infrastructure services, including DNS, DHCP, NTP, IPAM, and DCIM platforms such as Infoblox and NetBox. * Establish standardized configurations, infrastructure baselines, and scalable deployment procedures across multiple AI cluster environments. **Storage Infrastructure and Performance** * Deploy, configure, and optimize high\-performance storage platforms, including WEKA, VAST Data, and other distributed storage solutions. * Implement and manage file, object, and block storage services, including NFS and S3\-compatible interfaces. * Validate storage availability, performance, capacity, resilience, and integration with GPU compute environments. * Troubleshoot storage performance bottlenecks, connectivity issues, filesystem errors, and distributed storage failures. * Coordinate with storage vendors and engineering teams on deployment, acceptance testing, upgrades, and performance optimization. **Identity, Security, and Infrastructure Automation** * Deploy and maintain identity and access management services, including Active Directory/LDAP, SSO, SAML/OIDC, and role\-based access control (RBAC). * Integrate security and compliance infrastructure, including firewalls, access gateways, vulnerability scanning, logging, and audit systems. * Implement automated provisioning, configuration management, and infrastructure\-as\-code solutions using Ansible, Terraform, Python, or equivalent tools. * Establish secure administrative access, authentication, authorization, and privileged access management across infrastructure platforms. * Partner with security and compliance teams to implement infrastructure controls, system hardening, access policies, and audit requirements. **Systems Validation and Production Acceptance** * Lead integration testing and operational acceptance of supporting infrastructure prior to commercial cluster deployment. * Validate system availability, redundancy, failover, service dependencies, performance, and recovery procedures. * Identify and remediate configuration inconsistencies, integration issues, and infrastructure reliability risks. * Develop acceptance criteria, testing procedures, operational documentation, and production handoff requirements. **Tier 3 Operations and Reliability** * Serve as a senior tech ures. * Support infrastructure upgrades, maintenance, capacity expansion, and lifecycle management with appropriate change controls. * Develop diagnostic tooling, automation, operational runbooks, and monitoring standards to improve reliability and reduce operational overhead. * Collaborate with NOC, SRE, data hall technicians, engineering teams, and external vendors to resolve critical infrastructure issues. **ABOUT YOU** **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 10\+ years of hands\-on experience engineering and operating enterprise, cloud, HPC, or large\-scale data center infrastructure. * Expert\-level Linux systems administration, troubleshooting, automation, and infrastructure integration experience. * Strong experience with enterprise x86 platforms, virtualization technologies, and automated provisioning solutions. * Hands\-on experience deploying and supporting high\-performance or distributed storage platforms, preferably WEKA or VAST Data. * Strong understanding of DNS, DHCP, IPAM, identity management, SSO, RBAC, and core infrastructure services. * Experience with infrastructure automation using Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent technologies. * Familiarity with security infrastructure, compliance requirements, monitoring, and enterprise authentication systems. * Experience supporting AI/HPC clusters, GPU infrastructure, or large\-scale distributed computing environments is highly desirable. **Core Competencies** * Expert\-level troubleshooting and problem\-solving across hardware, operating systems, virtualization, storage, and infrastructure services. * Strong ownership of deployment outcomes, operational reliability, system performance, and technical documentation. * Ability to independently design and implement complex infrastructure solutions while collaborating with senior engineering peers. * Highly analytical, detail\-oriented, and comfortable operating in fast\-paced, mission\-critical environments. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with engineering leadership, vendors, and operational stakeholders. * Continuous improvement mindset with a strong emphasis on automation, standardization, and operational efficiency. **ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT** This is a full\-time, engineering role supporting large\-scale AI compute infrastructure across multiple sites. Travel to data centers for cluster commissioning, acceptance, and complex troubleshooting will be required. Flexibility to assist with critical incidents or maintenance activities outside regular business hours is expected. This role is hybrid or remote depending on location. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WHAT MAKES HIGHRISE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK** At Highrise, you will directly influence the performance, reliability, and production readiness of large\-scale AI clusters, work alongside experienced infrastructure engineers, and help define the technical standards for a growing global AI infrastructure platform. At Highrise, you will have the opportunity to: * Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting * Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government * Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team * Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting\-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Computer Vision & Edge AI
jobs.description: **QQR LABS** **Principal Engineer, Computer Vision \& Edge AI** **Fort Worth, TX / Cincinnati, OH / Austin, TX (full relocation covered) or Remote, US \| Full\-time** **$220,000 to $280,000 base \+ 20 to 25% milestone bonus** Freight fraud and cargo theft drain tens of billions of dollars a year from the US supply chain, and the industry still verifies trucks with paperwork. QQR Labs is building its first product where machine vision meets physical freight. The full scope and excitement of what we are building will be shared during the interview process. QQR Labs is the technology arm of QQR Freight, a platform whose sister companies include an asset\-based motor carrier and a nationwide 3PL brokerage. We are not a pitch deck. There are trucks, lanes, revenue, and customers behind this, which means a real\-world proving ground and a built\-in first customer from day one. We are hiring the first engineer on the product, and you will own it end to end: the hardware in the field, the models on the edge, and the platform customers log into. **What you will build** * Ruggedized capture hardware: industrial cameras, IR illumination, Jetson\-class GPU compute, cellular backhaul, weatherproof enclosures built for unattended outdoor duty * On\-device ML: detection, classification, and OCR on vehicles at highway speed, day and night * The data platform: high\-volume ingestion, entity resolution, search, alerting, APIs * The data engine: auto\-labeling pipelines, continuous retraining, and evaluation loops fed by real\-world captures * Fleet tooling: provisioning, over\-the\-air updates, and health monitoring for hardware deployed far from a desk **Requirements** **Who we want** * You have shipped computer vision on real hardware in the real world, not just in a notebook. Detection, tracking, OCR, deployed where weather, vibration, and glare live. * A camera\-first mindset: multi\-camera perception, vision\-only stacks, and models that hold up in rain, glare, and darkness * Edge and embedded fluency: Linux on ARM, camera pipelines (GStreamer or similar), model optimization (TensorRT, ONNX, quantization) * Cloud and data competence: Python, AWS or GCP, streaming ingestion, practical MLOps * You make hardware decisions, work without a playbook, and own outcomes * If you have built vision systems that live outdoors or on vehicles at scale, you already know this class of problem. Come build one where you hold real skin in the game. **Benefits** **The package** * $220,000 to $280,000 base, plus a 20 to 25% annual bonus tied to build milestones (first unit live in the field, accuracy targets, deployment count) * Long\-term upside beyond salary, covered in the interview process. We want an owner, not an employee. * Full relocation to Fort Worth, Cincinnati, or Austin, or remote (US) with regular time at HQ and in the field * Visa sponsorship available, including H\-1B transfers * A funded hardware lab and field deployment budget from day one * You interview with, and report to, the CEO

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. Where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. We show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves. **Realm\-X** is AppFolio's AI\-native platform powering this transformation. It enables a new generation of intelligent capabilities across our products, including Realm\-X Assistant (copilot), Flows (AI Agentic workflows) and Performers (autonomous AI Agents). Realm\-X serves as both a **foundation for internal teams to build and scale AI\-powered products**, and a **core layer delivering intelligent, high\-impact experiences directly to our customers**. At its core, Realm\-X is built on a **structured domain ontology and a set of shared business primitives**—such as transactions, actions, reports, metrics, and skills—that enable AI systems to deeply understand and operate across the full context of property management workflows. This foundation allows us to build **context\-aware, action\-oriented AI systems** that go beyond simple assistance to power real automation and decision\-making. **Who We Are Looking For** We're seeking a **Principal Machine Learning Engineer** to help define and lead the next generation of AI systems within Realm\-X, and to drive AppFolio's long\-term **autonomous** Real Estate Performance Management (RPM) platform — autonomous AI agents that can deliver property management performance. This is a **company\-impact role**. You will own mission\-critical AI capabilities, shape long\-term technical strategy, and act as a **technical visionary and advisor** across teams and leadership. You'll operate at the intersection of **traditional machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI**, building systems that go beyond AI assistance into **execution, automation, and optimization**. This role is for someone who doesn't just build systems — but **redefines how they should be built**. **Your Impact** * **Architect \& Lead:** Help define the technical vision and architecture for AI systems across Realm\-X in partnership with senior leadership. * **Scale Intelligent AI Agents:** Design and deploy advanced AI Agentic systems that combine reasoning, planning, and execution, including multi\-agent orchestration across specialist agents (e.g., maintenance, leasing, accounting, collections). * **Improve the Foundation:** Establish platform primitives and abstractions to enable context\-aware, action\-oriented AI that goes beyond simple assistance to true automation. Improve the standards for end\-to\-end ML systems: data collection, model training, evaluation, deployment, and inference infrastructure. * **Production Excellence:** Architect and build scalable, multi\-modal, and real\-time AI applications, ensuring high\-quality deployment standards. * **ML for Autonomous Property Management:** Drive AppFolio's transition toward autonomous property management operations. Use existing LLMs today and instrument the proprietary data collection now that will let us selectively train, fine\-tune, and RL\-optimize open source LLM and SLM for the RPM domain — optimizing performance, latency, and cost. * **Reinforcement Learning for Agent Policies:** Build the data and feedback loops needed to enable Reinforcement Learning over agent action policies in the partially observable, high\-stakes property management environment. **Qualifications** * **Systems thinker:** You think in terms of systems, platforms, and long\-term leverage, not just features. * **Production builder:** You've built and scaled ML/AI systems in production with meaningful business impact. * **Ambiguity:** You operate effectively in high ambiguity, turning unclear problems into a clear direction. * **Influence:** You've led or influenced large, cross\-team technical initiatives. * **Originality:** You introduce new ideas, architectures, or paradigms — not just implement existing ones. * **Owner\-operator:** You bring a founder / owner\-operator mindset: you take ownership, act with urgency, and focus on outcomes. * **Pace:** You have a strong desire to move fast and deliver impact, while maintaining sound engineering judgment. * **Collaboration:** You are humble, collaborative, and low\-ego, and you elevate those around you. * **Sustainability:** You value work\-life balance as a foundation for sustained high performance. * **Vertical conviction:** You bring genuine interest in winning a specific industry vertical (real estate) rather than chasing horizontal AI hype. **Must Have** * Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (required). * 10\+ years of expe ial scale. * **Full ML lifecycle:** Strong understanding of data extraction, model training, evaluation, deployment, and integration into production software. * **Core stack:** Expert in Python, PyTorch, NumPy, AWS, Docker, SQL, embeddings, and RAG. * **Agent tooling:** Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and LLM observability tools (LangSmith). * **Production ML at scale:** Experience designing and operating production\-grade ML systems at scale. * **Ontology \& knowledge graphs:** Applied experience with ontology\-driven systems, knowledge graphs, or semantic layers used to model business domains for AI systems. * **AI\-native engineering:** Proficiency with AI coding tools and workflows (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, code generation tools). **Nice to Have** * **Reinforcement Learning depth:** Deep RL expertise applied to sequential decision\-making under partial observability. * Experience designing evaluation and benchmarking systems for AI. * Background in distributed systems and real\-time architectures. * Experience building platforms used by multiple engineering teams. * Contributions to industry thought leadership (publications, talks, open source, etc.). **Location** Find out more about our locations by visiting our site. All late\-stage candidates complete an in\-person meeting with an AppFolian as part of our hiring process. **Compensation \& Benefits** The compensation that we reasonably expect to pay for this role is:$264,000 \- $363,000 base pay. The actual compensation for this role will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s skills, education, experience, and internal equity. Please note that compensation is just one aspect of a comprehensive Total Rewards package. The compensation range listed here does not include additional benefits or any discretionary bonuses you may be eligible for based on your role and/or employment type. Regular full\-time employees are eligible for benefits \- see here. **About AppFolio** AppFolio is the technology leader powering the future of the real estate industry. Our innovative platform and trusted partnership enable our customers to connect communities, increase operational efficiency, and grow their business. For more information about AppFolio, visit appfolio.com. **Why AppFolio** **Grow** \| We enable a culture of high performance, where delivering results is recognized by opportunities for growth and compelling total rewards. Our challenging and meaningful work drive the growth of our business, and ourselves. **Learn** \| We partner with you to realize your potential by investing in you from the start. We're cultivating a team of big thinkers through coaching and mentorship with our best\-in\-class leaders, and giving you the time and tools to develop your skills. **Impact** \| We are creating a world where living in, investing in, managing, and supporting communities feels magical and effortless, freeing people to thrive. We do this by innovating with purpose while cultivating a culture of impact. We learn as much from each other as we do our customers and our communities. **Connect** \| We excel at hybrid work by fostering an environment that feels flexible, personal and connected, no matter where we are. We create space to fuel innovation and collaboration, and we come together to celebrate, connect, and succeed. **Paddle as One.** Learn more at appfolio.com/company/careers ***Statement of Equal Opportunity*** *At AppFolio, we value diversity in backgrounds and perspectives and depend on it to drive our innovative culture. That’s why we’re a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we believe that our products, our teams, and our business are stronger because of it. This means that no matter what race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, age, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, or veteran status, you’re always welcome at AppFolio.* Compensation Range: $264K \- $363K

jobs.title: Product Manager, Network Rules & Governance
jobs.description: **Context** Altic is the rules\-based operational network that enables private markets to operate within managed accounts at scale. It is the infrastructure layer that did not exist before. Not a platform, not a portal, not a workflow tool. The right historical reference is not the alternatives access platforms of the last decade, it is what NSCC and Omgeo did for equities: common standards, rules and infrastructure that allowed an entire asset class to operate at volume. The network is built in a sequence, and the sequence is not arbitrary. Rules, then digitisation, then intelligence, then scale. You cannot digitise without rules. You cannot get to intelligence without digitisation. This is why Altic starts with the rulebook. What follows from that is the part people miss. The rulebook, the technical specification and the participant agreement are not paperwork sitting alongside the technology. They are what the technology gets built on. A legal framework agreed once across every participant is what makes a common technical standard possible, and that standard is what turns a set of bilateral relationships into market infrastructure. The rules work is the foundation of the network build, not a condition of being allowed to start it. Every large network has a function that owns its rules. Payments has Visa Rules Management and a Rules Committee. ACH has Nacha's operating rules. Securities settlement has the DTCC and SWIFT standards bodies. Private markets has never had one. This role is the first of its kind for the asset class. **Purpose of the Role** You will own the Altic rulebook, the technical specification and the network's participant agreement as products, not as documents. That means being accountable for what they say, how they change, who agrees to them, and how quickly the network can absorb a change once it is agreed. It also means being the face of them. Externally, you are the rulebook. The immediate job is twofold. Give the network a genuine product owner of its rules, and formalise the governance framework that decides how those rules change, including standing up the committee structure that does not exist yet. Where it goes after that is harder to predict, but as the scope of the network grows the manual version of this job stops scaling. Part of the role is building towards the capability that replaces it: a change\-management capability that captures participant feedback, assesses impact across the network, and shortens the cycle from a raised issue to a published rule. You define the rules and the requirements the network is built against, working closely with technical product management and engineering as the build takes shape. The test of your work is not whether the documents are well drafted. It is whether the rules are agreed, adopted, and clear enough to build against. **Key Stakeholders** * Legal and governance, internal and outside counsel * GPs and asset managers participating in the network * Wealth managers and platform participants * Service providers including transfer agents, fund administrators and custodians * Business Development, Partnerships and Strategy * PMN Technical Product Management and Engineering * PMN Product and Operations **Why This Role Is Different** This role offers: * A first of its kind mandate. Nobody has built a rules function for private markets. There is no incumbent playbook to inherit and no template to fill in. * The governance framework does not exist yet. You will formalise it and stand up the committee structure, rather than inherit someone else's process and administer it. * The rules are the foundation of the build. What gets agreed in the rulebook is what the technical network is designed against, so this is not documentation that sits to one side. * Ownership of the artefacts the entire network depends on, rather than a slice of a roadmap someone else set. * A genuinely external role. You will present the rulebook, teach it, and run the forums and events where the network argues it out, in person and virtually. The rulebook is not a document you maintain. It is the product the network runs on, and you are the person who stands behind it. **How you will provide meaningful contributions:** **What You'll Actually Be Doing** This role sits between legal, engineering and the participants themselves, and a lot of it happens in front of people. On any given week, you might be: * Walking a GP's counsel through a rule they have taken issue with, and coming back with a change the rest of the network can actually absorb. * Presenting the rulebook to a wealth platform's operations leadership, then staying in the room for the two hours of questions that follow. * Turning a legal position agreed with outside counsel into a clear requirement the technical product and engineering teams can specify against without guessing. * Working out whether the exception a participant is asking for is a waiver, a rule change, or a signal that the rule itself is wro the latest AI techniques to automate and prototype. Comfortable across AI, no\-code and low\-code tools, and inclined to build a working thing rather than write a requirements document about it. **Domain experience (beneficial, not required):** any of the following gives you a head start, and none of them on its own is the role: direct experience at a network participant or service provider, whether a transfer agent, fund administrator, custodian, GP or wealth platform; alternatives product or operations experience from a firm such as iCapital or CAIS; knowledge of the wealth management channel and of managed accounts, including model\-driven and portfolio\-driven trading; a legal background in financial markets, private markets or funds; or a legal\-tech background. **Personal Attributes** * Comfortable being the first person to do something, with no incumbent process to inherit. * Patient with detail and impatient with drift. Rules reward both. * Shows rather than tells. Defaults to a working prototype over a slide deck. * Holds a position under pressure from a large counterparty, and changes it when the argument is genuinely better. * Treats a recurring exception as a design problem rather than an administrative one. * Happy to be the named owner of something the whole network can disagree with in public. **About InvestCloud** InvestCloud, a global leader in wealth technology, aspires to enable a smarter financial future. Driving the digital transformation of the wealth management industry, the company serves a broad array of clients globally, including Wealth and Asset Managers, Wirehouses, Banks, RIAs, and Insurers. In terms of scale, the company’s clients represent more than 40 percent of the $132 trillion of total assets globally. As a leader in delivering personalization and scale across advisory programs, including unified managed accounts (UMA) and separately managed accounts (SMA), the company is committed to the success of its clients. jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you making the design decisions that join a solution's components and carrying the result through production. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Design and deliver the Python services and application components that form your part of the platform. * Design the React.js front end that users work in, and set the standards other developers build it to. * Build automated workflows across AWS Lambda, Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS), Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\), and Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS). * Design the application programming interfaces (APIs), integrations, and data flows that link your services to the rest of the platform. * Build and improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and automated tests your team releases through, along with how it supports production. * Run code reviews, resolve design tradeoffs, tackle difficult production issues, and mentor the developers around you. * Use AI\-assisted development tools to speed up implementation and review, while staying accountable for the code you deliver. * Take the lead on quality development practices, including test\-driven development, code reviews, and application security standards. * Produce accurate project estimates and contribute to project planning, delivery forecasting, and resource allocation. You deliver one integrated solution whose parts work together to a single quality bar. You turn spreadsheet\-bound validations and workflows into automation, and the way you work makes the developers around you better. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 7\+ years of professional hands\-on back\-end software development experience in Python * 5\+ years of hands\-on front\-end software development experience in React.js * Bachelor's degree * Strong hands\-on experience building cloud\-native applications on AWS, using AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, Amazon SQS, and Amazon RDS * Strong experience with relational databases, for example PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or Oracle * Strong experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or DynamoDB * Advanced knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems, design patterns, object\-oriented programming, data modeling, and database design * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills * Experience leading Agile delivery under Scrum or Kanban, with work tracked in an issue tracker such as Jira * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted developer tools such as Amazon Q Developer or GitHub Copilot * A track record of leading a development team and mentoring its developers * Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technical teams * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * An AWS certification or a Python certification * Federal information technology experience * Experience leading technical delivery teams in client\-facing consulting * Experience applying DevSecOps best practices and implementing CI/CD pipelines **Who you are** You own what you build, and you put real time into making the developers around you better, through code review, through explaining your reasoning, and through the standard you set. People bring you the hard calls because you make them well, and you keep the team steady and productive when priorities shift. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Deep command of modern cloud development, with the range to create something new or improve what is already in operation. * Strong delivery habits across version control, automated testing, code review, secure coding, and accessibility, with the standing to set them for a team. * The judgment to weigh competing solution approaches, settle design tradeoffs across components, and own the technical direction of your assigned area. * Plain explanations of your work for the people who depend on it, and careful listening for what they need. * Precision where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $180,000 per year. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. jobs.description: **About SirenOpt** SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro\- and nano\-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks. SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non\-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics\-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real\-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made. We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia. **About the job** **Job Title:** Software Engineer (Early Career) – C\+\+ \& Systems **Location:** On\-Site (San Leandro, CA) **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Role Overview** SirenOpt is seeking a **Software Engineer** to help build and maintain the real\-time data pipeline behind our sensing platform: acquiring data from multiple sensors, processing and storing it on Linux\-based systems, and delivering it to the applications our customers rely on. You will work primarily in modern C\+\+ and Python, with mentorship from senior engineers, and you will be hands\-on with real hardware in our lab to test and validate what you build. This is a role for someone who wants to grow into a well\-rounded systems engineer by shipping production software end to end, from a first design discussion to a feature running at a customer site. **What You'll Do** * Develop and maintain software components in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\) for Linux\-based systems, with guidance from senior engineers * Implement features, fix bugs, and write unit and integration tests across the data pipeline, from sensor acquisition through processing and storage to the services that deliver results to applications * Write and maintain Python scripts for automation, testing, and data analysis * Read, and where needed modify, existing code written in other languages across our codebase * Use AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, and verify their output through testing, profiling, and code review * Run the system on real hardware in the lab to test and validate your changes, including setting up sensors and collecting data * Participate in code reviews, both receiving and giving feedback, and follow team conventions for code quality * Help diagnose and debug issues across software and hardware boundaries, working with firmware and hardware engineers * Measure and improve performance of existing code under the direction of senior engineers * Document your work so that others on the team can build on it **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (recent graduates welcome) * 0–2 years of professional software development experience; internships, co\-ops, research, and substantial personal or open\-source projects count * Solid foundation in C\+\+, including memory management, references and pointers, the standard library, and basic object\-oriented and generic programming * Strong ability to read, understand, and write Python, including working within existing Python codebases used for automation, testing, and data analysis * Ability to pick up new programming languages quickly; our codebase spans several languages and you will need to read, and occasionally modify, code outside of C\+\+ and Python * Understanding of core computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and concurrency basics * Comfortable with the everyday toolchain: Linux command line, build tools (CMake or similar), a debugger, and Git\-based workflows (branches, pull requests, code review) * Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of a real development workflow, and the judgment to review and test what they produce * Comfortable working hands\-on with lab and test equipment: setting up sensors, running the system on real hardware, and collecting data for testing and validation (we will train you on our specific equipment) * Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work well with teammates across disciplines **Nice to have:** * Experience with Qt, gRPC, or Protocol Buffers * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing * Experience with profiling and debugging tools such as perf, Valgrind, GDB, or sanitizers * Familiarity with hardware communication interfaces such as Ethernet, USB, or Serial * Contributions to open\-source projects **What You'll Learn** You will work on a real\-time sensing platform that is already running at some of the largest manufacturers in the world, on a small team where your code reaches customers quickly. * How a high\-throughput, multi\-sensor data pipeline is built end to end, from acquisition through processing and storage, and kept reliable in production * Modern C\+\+ and Linux systems engineering, with regular code review and mentorship from senior engineers * How software, firmware, and hardware teams work together to ship a physical product * How to use AI coding tools effectively and responsibly jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
jobs.description: Software Engineer, Platform Engineering is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Software Engineer, Platform Engineering assignments. * Grade cloud \& platform engineering solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Software Engineer, Platform Engineering work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Cloud \& platform engineering * Software engineering **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process. **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer
jobs.description: Who Are We? Prolaio believes that continuous learning and collaboration can make a significant difference in how heart care is administered. We are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology\-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes. This is precision cardiology, and we know it's within reach. What Will You Do? **The Overview** As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and run that pipeline in a regulated environment. You will work closely with the data science/clinical teams, which owns the medical and research questions. You will also work with the Data Architect on platform standards, data models, and governance. **The Specifics** **Build and Evolve the Data Platform (Prolaio Data Ecosystem)** * + Design, build, and maintain batch, streaming, and hybrid pipelines orchestrated with Dagster. These cover ingestion, validation, transformation, enrichment, and publishing of the data. + Develop and maintain dbt models in BigQuery, including staging, intermediate, and mart layers, with tests, documentation, and clear ownership. + Ingest and normalize heterogeneous sources (both structured and unstructured data), including cardiology wearables and device signals, EHR, claims, medication, and patient\-reported data. + Make well\-reasoned decisions about storage, compute, partitioning, cost, and APIs, and contribute to the target\-state architecture and the reference patterns. **Data Quality, Lineage, and Compliance** * + Contribute to data lifecycle controls into pipelines: retention, access control, lineage, provenance, reproducibility, and auditability. + Use Dagster assets and dbt lineage to keep data traceable from source to output. + Support validated operation in a regulated setting by documenting pipelines, keeping traceability, and working with Quality and Security teams. + Back every pipeline change with thorough automated tests and data quality checks. **Enable Data Science and ML** * + Treat data scientists as your customers, and give them the tools and processes to experiment and iterate efficiently. + Contribute to the ML workflows that support feature generation, training, deployment, and monitoring. + Contribute to internal applications and Python libraries **Operate and Monitor** * + Own CI/CD for the data platform using GitLab CI, including dbt and Dagster deployments. + Help monitoring pipeline health, performance, and BigQuery cost with Datadog, and take part in incident response. + Help mentoring other engineers and setting engineering standards for the data team. **Why Prolaio?** * **Impactful Work:** You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology. * **Innovative Environment****:** You will be part of an organization doing something that's never been done before. * **Professional Growth****:** You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow. * **Collaborative Team****:** You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology. **Who You Are?** * 6\+ years in data engineering * Expert Python and SQL * Experience with GCP (or AWS/Azure) * Production experience with dbt, including modeling, testing, macros, and incremental models. * Experience with BigQuery or a comparable cloud data warehouse (Databricks, Redshift). * Experience with Dagster or a comparable orchestrator (Airflow, Prefect). * Experience with Docker and large\-scale data processing. * Experience with structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data, including time\-series data. * Understanding of MLOps concepts and production ML workflows. * Experience collaborating with data scientists, product, and clinical or quality stakeholders. * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. **Additional Qualifications (Nice to Haves)** * Hands\-on GCP experience (IAM, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, networking). * Infrastructure as code with Terraform * Experience with Datadog * Metadata, lineage, and catalog tools, plus retrieval or vector tooling for AI use cases. * Experience with Databricks * Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, medtech, or other patient data. * Experience in regulated or validated environments (SaMD, FDA, GxP, HIPAA). * Streaming tools such as Pub/Sub or Kafka. **Why You'll Love Working Here** * **Meaningful Compensation**: Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity so you can share in what we build. * **Great Health Coverage:** Medical, dental, and vision plans with multiple options and strong company contributions. * **Flexible Spending Perks:** HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and a $1,200 annual Lifestyle Spending Account to support wellness, commuting, family needs, and more. * **Time to Recharge:** Generous paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays. * **Family\-First Benefits**: Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and support for growing families. * **Security \& Peace of Mind**: Company\-paid life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability coverage. * **Plan for the Future**: 401(k) plan to help you build long\-term financial security. * **Care When You Need It:** Easy access to telehealth and optional supplemental coverage for life's unexpected moments. Starting Salary is at $150,000\.00 (Exact Compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location)

Realm\-X serves as both a **foundation for internal teams to build and scale AI\-powered products**, and a **core layer delivering intelligent, high\-impact experiences directly to our customers**.
