This foundation allows us to build **context\-aware, action\-oriented AI systems** that go beyond simple assistance to power real automation and decision\-making. **Who We Are Looking For** We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to design and ship the next generation of voice and conversational AI agents within Realm\-X. This role helps define AppFolio's production voice and chat agent pipelines, working at the intersection of LLM agent frameworks, real\-time voice technology, and streaming infrastructure. able to deploy with Docker on AWS. * **Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to lead a small team, mentor engineers, and partner credibly with Product and Design. **Nice to Have** * Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or related technical discipline. * Experience fine\-tuning Small Language Models for domain\-specific voice applications. * Familiarity with RAG over structured business data and tool\-using agents over API surfaces. * Prior experience in regulated or customer\-facing industries with strict reliability requirements. * Publicly verifiable work on GitHub, in open\-source agent frameworks, or in community competitions. **Location** Find out more about our locations by visiting our site. All late\-stage candidates complete an in\-person meeting with an AppFolian as part of our hiring process. **Compensation \& Benefits** The compensation that we reasonably expect to pay for this role is: $167,200 \- $229,900 base pay. Please note that compensation is just one aspect of a comprehensive Total Rewards package. The compensation range listed here does not include additional benefits or any discretionary bonuses you may be eligible for based on your role and/or employment type. Regular full\-time employees are eligible for benefits \- see here. **About AppFolio** AppFolio is the technology leader powering the future of the real estate industry. Our innovative platform and trusted partnership enable our customers to connect communities, increase operational efficiency, and grow their business. For more information about AppFolio, visit appfolio.com. **Why AppFolio** **Grow** \| We enable a culture of high performance, where delivering results is recognized by opportunities for growth and compelling total rewards. Our challenging and meaningful work drive the growth of our business, and ourselves. **Learn** \| We partner with you to realize your potential by investing in you from the start. We're cultivating a team of big thinkers through coaching and mentorship with our best\-in\-class leaders, and giving you the time and tools to develop your skills. **Impact** \| We are creating a world where living in, investing in, managing, and supporting communities feels magical and effortless, freeing people to thrive. We do this by innovating with purpose while cultivating a culture of impact. We learn as much from each other as we do our customers and our communities. **Connect** \| We excel at hybrid work by fostering an environment that feels flexible, personal and connected, no matter where we are. We create space to fuel innovation and collaboration, and we come together to celebrate, connect, and succeed. **Paddle as One.** Learn more at appfolio.com/company/careers ***Statement of Equal Opportunity*** *At AppFolio, we value diversity in backgrounds and perspectives and depend on it to drive our innovative culture. jobs.title: Staff Embedded Linux Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About SirenOpt** SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro\- and nano\-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks. SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non\-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics\-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real\-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made. We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia. **About the job** **Job Title:** Staff Embedded Linux Software Engineer — Firmware Team **Location:** On\-Site (San Leandro, CA) **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Role Overview** SirenOpt is seeking an **Embedded Linux Software Engineer** to join a small, high\-impact firmware team building the embedded software stack for a commercial bench\-top scientific instrument. The platform is an AMD/Xilinx FPGA SoC (Zynq / UltraScale\+) running PetaLinux, with a mix of userspace applications, device drivers, and real\-time control interfacing with custom programmable logic. You'll work alongside an embedded systems architect who owns the Linux application layer, peripheral subsystems, protocol design, and hardware integration. Your core mandate is threefold: share the Linux application workload, own test automation infrastructure, and establish CI/build reliability. You'll write production code and the tooling that proves it works. This is a small, documentation\-driven team, and you'll be expected to write clear design docs and track progress in Jira/Confluence. The role combines hands\-on lab work with prototype hardware and desk\-based software development, following a sequenced release cadence (HDL OS/drivers embedded applications system integration). **What You'll Do** * Develop embedded Linux application software in C (userspace, POSIX) * Develop userspace and kernel\-space drivers for internal and external devices (sensors, actuators, instruments) * Implement and extend application\-level command/control/data protocols over TCP/IP * Implement communication drivers for industrial instruments (mass flow controllers, vacuum gauges, motor controllers) over serial and CAN interfaces * Design, build, and maintain hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) automated test systems * Develop host\-side test tooling (Python GUIs, emulators, scripted instrument drivers) * Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines and reproducible build infrastructure * Participate in hardware bring\-up, board\-level validation, and lab bench debugging * Contribute to architecture decisions, documentation, and design reviews **What We're Looking For** * S., M.S., or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, with 10\+ years of relevant industry experience * C for embedded Linux userspace, including threading, IPC, and POSIX APIs * Python for test automation (pytest or equivalent framework) and scripted instrumentation * TCP/IP socket programming on Linux (non\-blocking I/O, connection lifecycle, streaming) * UDP for discovery and lightweight telemetry * Bus and serial protocols: UART, SPI, I2C, and CAN * RS\-232 and RS\-485, including byte\-level protocol implementation (framing, CRC, state machines, multi\-device arbitration) * Hardware bring\-up and board\-level debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers * Producer\-consumer and ring buffer patterns for real\-time data flow * Hardware\-in\-the\-loop test development and execution **Nice to have:** * Linux DMA programming (scatter\-gather, buffer pool management, AXI\-DMA) * CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Docker\-based build environments) * Yocto or PetaLinux BSP experience * Unit test frameworks for C (gtest, cmocka, Unity) * Familiarity with FPGA register interfaces (UIO, devmem, register maps) * Performance profiling and network analysis (Wireshark, throughput characterization) * Python GUI development for test/operator tooling (Tkinter, PyQt) * Familiarity with scientific or process\-control instrumentation **Benefits** * Equity and Salary compensation depends on experience * Health, Dental, Vision plans provided * 401k matching provided * Time off: 20 days of PTO per year, plus approximately 15 paid US holidays per year

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Latent Defense** Latent Defense is building the world model for cybersecurity; the product graphs a company's entire system across all layers, identifies all attack paths and assigns criticality rankings, and provides remediation for each path. The team is building an autonomous system that rigorously models attack paths, orchestrates agents to validate each path, and remediates confirmed vulnerabilities at every step of the attack chain. Latent Defense is a small, seed\-stage team scaling from a sharp early product into something that runs autonomously across real\-world environments, from git repos to cloud deployments. **About the Role** Latent Defense is hiring a Staff Software Engineer to help take its infrastructure from a scrappy MVP to a hardened, GA\-ready product. This person will own customer deploys (Kubernetes, Docker), the telemetry platform, and the hardening and scaling work that comes with moving real customers into production. They'll operate with significant autonomy on a team that's still building out its staff\-level bench, and will be trusted to redesign systems rather than just add to them. *This role is based in New York City. 3\+ days/week in Nomad office* **What You'll Do** * Own deployment of Latent Defense's product into customer infrastructure, including Kubernetes and Docker\-based environments * Build and harden the telemetry platform that lets the team measure and improve system\-wide reliability and efficacy * Redesign infrastructure and backend systems as the company moves from an early MVP to a scaled, GA product * Operate with significant autonomy — take on ambiguous infrastructure problems and drive them to resolution without heavy direction * Use AI coding agents as a core part of your workflow, while keeping the underlying engineering judgment that agents can't replace * Partner with the rest of the engineering team (currently more junior) to raise the technical bar and unblock hard problems * Work closely with the Director of Engineering on architecture, technical direction, and delivery rigor as the team scales **What You Bring** * 7\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with real infrastructure/backend depth * Fluency with TypeScript, Python, and Postgres * Experience deploying and supporting software directly in customer\-owned infrastructure, not just centrally\-hosted SaaS * A track record of redesigning or hardening systems as they scale, not just building new features * Comfortable operating with minimal direction in a small, fast\-moving team * Agent\-native — uses AI coding tools fluently, but has the underlying engineering instinct to know when to trust them and when not to * Experience at a seed\-stage startup; jobs.description: **COMPANY** At 0x, our mission is to "Create a Tokenized World Where All Forms of Value Can Flow Freely". Founded in 2017, we’ve processed over 211M\+ transactions and $180B\+ in trading volume from users trading on Matcha, Coinbase Wallet, Robinhood Wallet, Phantom, Rainbow, DefiLlama, MetaMask, Zerion, Zapper, and many more. Next, they’re building new products that give developers even more tools for building trading apps. **About the role** We’re hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to expand what the API Products team can take on. You’ll lead projects from first idea to production, on new products and on the APIs that are already live, working closely with our product team and some of our biggest customers. Remote, EU timezones preferred. **What you’ll do** * Build new APIs and trading products, from researching the problem and designing the architecture to shipping the first version. * Maintain and extend our existing APIs, including support for new chains, bridges and customer\-requested features. * Keep our APIs fast and reliable as traffic grows, and participate in the on\-call rotation. * Investigate failed trades and stuck transfers using logs, traces and onchain data, and resolve the root cause. * Work with product, legal and GTM, turning business and compliance needs into technical decisions. * Write design documents for your work and review your teammates’ designs and pull requests. **Who you are** * **6\+ years of backend engineering** experience, including at least **2 years in DeFi** at a trading app, wallet, DEX aggregator, onchain data company or similar. * Senior or Lead Engineer with a track record of **owning complex projects end to end**. * **Built and maintained developer\-facing APIs.** * **Deep onchain knowledge**, especially **EVM**: how transactions work, including calldata, contract interfaces, gas and approvals. * Strong **system design experience** for production\-scale backend services. * You’re an **AI power user** who uses it to multiply your impact as an engineer, yet you don’t let it replace your judgment. * Clear communicator, comfortable explaining technical tradeoffs to non\-engineers. * Aligned with our core values: do the right thing, consistently ship, and focus on long\-term impact. * Able to attend annual in\-person team offsites around the globe. **Nice to have** * Experience with cross\-chain/bridging, or DEX aggregation. * Experience with other ecosystems outside of EVM such as Solana. * Experience with TypeScript and/or Rust, our main languages. **BENEFITS** * The base salary range for this position is USD $150,000 \- $230,000 \+ equity \+ ZRX tokens \+ benefits. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Mission:** 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. **Our People:** People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry\-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference\-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. **Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Platform** **Location:** San Francisco Bay Area or Austin, TX (Hybrid) **About the Role** ------------------ 6sense has agents and an MCP server in production today, used by real customers. This role takes them further by building more capable agents, strengthening the API and tool layer, and expanding an ecosystem that external agents, clients, and partners can connect to. You'll work across the full path from a customer's agent to 6sense data and actions, including APIs, tools, MCP, orchestration, context, evaluation, and security. 6sense is working to become the default Contextual Intelligence layer for B2B, and agents and MCP are how that context reaches customers, partners, and their AI tools. You'll partner closely with the team building contextual intelligence, write production Python daily, own multi\-month projects, support the teams and customers who depend on these systems, and keep the platform current as the agent tooling landscape evolves. **What You'll Own** ------------------- ### **Agents and Orchestration** * Extend LangGraph orchestrators with typed state, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointing, durable execution, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Select and implement routing, orchestrator\-worker, plan\-and\-execute, reflection, and multi\-agent handoff patterns based on business needs. * Run agents headless through API\-first and MCP\-first architectures across in\-app, chat, workflow, and partner surfaces from a shared core. * Build and maintain reusable components for state management, memory, tool\-calling, and agent\-to\-agent delegation with scoped permissions. ### **APIs, Tools, and MCP** * Evolve the APIs and tools agents use to access 6sense data and take action for both human and LLM consumers. * Optimize tool design for agent success, including naming, descriptions, schemas, response formats, error handling, and token efficiency. * Re\-design and scale the MCP layer for production workloads, including concurrency, per\-tenant quotas, latency budgets, caching, graceful degradation, backward compatibility, and adoption of emerging MCP capabilities. * Onboard external MCP clients, AI assistants, agent platforms, and partners. Develop integration guides and reference clients and define trust boundaries for third\-party MCP server integrations. * Strengthen platform reliability through idempotency, retries, rate limits, permissions, spend controls, and standards for tool contracts, versioning, and discovery. ### **Context and Evaluation** * Partner with the Contextual Intelligence team to expose context through MCP, APIs, and tools, enabling a unified context layer across all customer touchpoints. * Define and enforce contracts around returned data, freshness, provenance, and tenant and user\-level access controls. * Improve permission\-aware retrieval and grounding through chunking, hybrid search, reranking, citations, context assembly, and memory management within token and latency constraints. * Expand evaluation frameworks using golden datasets, tool\-selection accuracy, tool\-call accuracy, end\-to\-end task success metrics, regression testing, release gates, and context quality measurements. * Enhance tracing and usage analytics while reporting on task success rates, tool\-call precision, groundedness, latency, and cost efficiency. ### **Security, Privacy, and Trust** * Make security a first\-class consideration across every tool, API, agent, and MCP change. * Review your own and teammates' work for vulnerabilities and security risks. * Enforce tenant isolation and user\-level authorization for all requests while maintaining short\-lived, scoped credentials. * Protect against prompt injection, tool poisoning, excessive agent autonomy, and data leakage through jobs.title: Azure Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: The Azure Infrastructure Engineer is a hands\-on infrastructure role that designs, builds, migrates, secures, and operates production Azure infrastructure extending our on\-premises VMware and Windows datacenter. Focus areas: Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, virtual machines and platform services, disaster recovery, and migration execution. The role is DevOps\-savvy, not DevOps engineering: the engineer uses Infrastructure\-as\-Code, Git, and pipelines to keep infrastructure repeatable and auditable, following and extending team standards. The engineer partners with Infrastructure, Networking, Security, Database, and Application Development teams and external consultants. **Key Responsibilities** **Azure Infrastructure Engineering \& Operations** * Independently design, deploy, and maintain Azure infrastructure: landing zones, management groups, VMs, storage, backup, monitoring, and governance. * Troubleshoot connectivity, performance, access, and availability issues across VM, OS, network, DNS, firewall, and identity layers; perform root\-cause analysis and implement durable fixes. * Develop runbooks and operational standards; participate in incident response, change management (CAB), maintenance windows, and on\-call. **Hybrid Networking, DNS \& Application Delivery** * Design and troubleshoot VNets, NSGs, routing/UDRs, hub\-and\-spoke or Virtual WAN, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute, including BGP and failover behavior. * Design name resolution across Azure and on\-premises (Private DNS, DNS Private Resolver, conditional forwarding). * Implement private connectivity to PaaS services using private endpoints. * Support application delivery with Front Door, Application Gateway, load balancing, and WAF, including TLS certificate lifecycle and failure\-mode design when an edge service or policy fails. * Work with Networking on firewall rules, IP addressing, NAT, and datacenter, branch, and third\-party connectivity. **Migration Execution** * Plan and execute VMware and Windows migrations to Azure: dependency assessment, Azure Migrate, lift\-and\-shift, test migrations, cutover, and post\-migration support. * Produce cutover plans, validation checklists, and rollback criteria; execute off\-hours production cutovers. * Support Azure infrastructure for SQL Server migrations (Always On to Azure SQL Managed Instance or SQL Server on Azure VMs). * Maintain hybrid domain controllers, DNS, and AD integration for Azure workloads. **Resiliency, Backup \& Disaster Recovery** * Design and test DR using Site Recovery, geo\-redundant storage, and region/availability\-zone design against RTO and RPO targets. * Operate Azure Backup and evaluate it against third\-party backup and replication platforms for new Azure data stores; document and report recovery test results. **Platform Services Infrastructure** * Provide infrastructure for App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, and API Management: VNet integration, private endpoints, identity, Key Vault, and monitoring. * Support AKS at the platform level (private cluster, CNI, node pools, ingress, managed identity) with Application Development. **Automation \& Infrastructure\-as\-Code** * Build, modify, and troubleshoot Terraform following team standards: modules, remote state, environment separation, and drift. * Use Git pull requests and code review; maintain Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines, including approval gates and self\-hosted agents reaching private endpoints. * Automate operations with PowerShell and Azure CLI. **Identity, Security \& Governance** * Apply Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Conditional Access, and managed identities to enforce least privilege and segregation of duties. * Implement guardrails with Azure Policy, management groups, tagging, and Defender for Cloud. * Partner with Security, Compliance, and Audit on PCI DSS, NIST, and CIS controls, remediation, and audit evidence. **Observability \& Cost Management** * Build Azure Monitor and Log Analytics alerts, workbooks, and dashboards; tune alert noise and logging volume; use Application Insights for tracing. * Right\-size and manage cost with Cost Management, Advisor, reservations, and savings plans, after establishing baselines. **Collaboration \& Cross\-Training** * Share knowledge both ways: train teammates in Azure and cloud practices, and learn from them in their areas of expertise. **Required Qualifications** ***Note:*** *Candidates must demonstrate each item below with specific examples of work they performed as an individual contributor.* * Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; equivalent professional experience considered. * 5\+ years of enterprise infrastructure engineering, including 3\+ years of hands\-on production Azure. * Hybrid networking: hands\-on VNets, NSGs, routing, DNS, and ExpressRoute or site\-to\-site VPN; can explain tradeoffs and failure behavior. * On\-premises to Azure migrations: direct involvement in preparation, cutover, rollback planning, and post\-migration support. * Working knowledge of VMware vSphere, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, and Group Policy. * Resiliency: Azure Backup and Site Recovery (or equivalent DR design) against RTO/RPO targets. * Automation: working proficiency with Terraform (state, modules, environments), PowerShell, Git, and Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines. * Identity and governance: Entra ID, RBAC, least privilege, and Azure Policy. * Independent troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis of complex Azure issues. * Experience supporting PCI DSS, NIST, CIS, or similar compliance requirements. **Technical Skills** Working knowledge * Platform services: App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Azure SQL Managed Instance, SQL Server on Azure VMs. * Azure Virtual Desktop/FSLogix, Bicep/ARM, Defender for Cloud, and Sentinel. * AKS, Docker, Helm, and Cosmos DB. **Preferred Qualifications** * Azure certifications (AZ\-104, AZ\-305, AZ\-700, AZ\-500, AZ\-400\) or HashiCorp Terraform Associate; must be current. * AKS platform operations, Azure SQL Managed Instance, or IIS/.NET application migrations. * PCI DSS audit evidence, CrowdStrike or similar security platforms, and multi\-site hybrid environments. * Experience mentoring peers and using AI tools to speed scripting and troubleshooting. **Work Details** * Remote; jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer, Platform and Automations
jobs.description: **About us** AbuvThePar runs an Amazon wholesale education program. Our students learn how to open accounts with real brands, buy inventory at wholesale, and sell it on Amazon. Behind the program are teams for purchasing, brand outreach, and student coaching, plus the software that ties all of it together. **About the role** We run the business on our own apps and automations: a platform for our students, an ops platform for our team, and scheduled jobs that move data between them and the tools we use every day. Most of it was built with AI coding tools, and it has grown past what our current team can keep up with. This role keeps all of it running, fixes what breaks, and ships what's next. If AI\-built code makes you nervous, this isn't the role. If it makes you curious, keep reading. **What's already builtAcre: the student platform** The app our students use to run their wholesale business day to day. * Find brands to work with and build lead lists * Look up the right contacts at each brand (email and phone), from our own brand database and outside data providers * Research a brand before a call: prep notes, talking points, and the brand's products on Amazon * Track every brand from first contact to closed deal, with tasks, notes, and files * Write emails that land as drafts in the student's own Gmail, and pull in the replies * Listing tools: copy checks for Amazon listings and product image generation * A background job system for long\-running work, with usage limits for each student Next up on the roadmap: more Amazon data sources, usage credits, and speed work as more students join. **Ivy: the ops platform** The internal app our team uses to run purchasing, offers, and fulfillment. It is several apps in one codebase. * **Purchasing:** upload purchase orders, check the profit on each product, approve or decline * **Student offers:** turn approved orders into offers for students, with a Google Sheet and a Gmail draft for each student * **Offer tracking:** see which offers were sent, accepted, or declined, with weekly reports * **PO flow:** follow each order from close through supplier payment, warehouse receiving, and invoicing (Xero) * **Account management:** track which products each student is approved to sell * **Brand outreach:** a database of 20,000\+ brands and their contacts, with contact lookup and call queues * **Coach workspace:** student profiles and rosters for our coaching team **Automations** * Offer texts: when an offer email goes out, the student gets a text (through GoHighLevel) and one reminder 48 hours later * Gmail sync that tracks offer emails and replies * Scheduled jobs (GitHub Actions and cron) that keep Ivy, Google Sheets, and our CRM in sync * Email sequences to students and brands (Hunter) * Brand research and contact lookup pipelines in Python and Node, using Hunter, Apollo, SerpAPI, and LLMs **Tech stack** * **Apps:** Next.js and React. Acre is TypeScript, Ivy is JavaScript (pnpm \+ Turborepo monorepo) * **Database:** Supabase (Postgres, row\-level security, storage) * **Hosting:** Vercel (Acre), Railway (Ivy) * **Code and CI:** GitHub, GitHub Actions * **Testing:** Vitest, Playwright * **Scripts:** Node and Python * **Outside services:** Google Workspace APIs (Gmail, Sheets, Drive), GoHighLevel, Hunter, Apollo, SerpAPI, OpenRouter for LLM calls, Xero * **AI coding tools:** Claude Code, Codex **What you'll doEvery week** * **Fix bugs** across Acre, Ivy, and the automations. When someone says "it's broken," find which step broke, fix it, ship it, and check it on the live app. Same day when you can. * **Run deploys** on Vercel and Railway, watch the logs, and roll back fast when something goes wrong. * **Change the database safely:** write and apply migrations, keep row\-level security tight, and keep backups current. * **Keep the automations healthy:** notice when a scheduled job or sync stops, find out why, and get it running again. * **Watch usage and limits** on outside APIs (contact lookup, AI, texting) so nothing runs out without warning. **Projects** * Ship Acre roadmap features end to end * Clean up screens that confuse students or staff, in both apps * Speed up slow pages as more students and data come in * Add tests for the parts that break most often * Keep a short doc for each system, so nobody has to guess how it works The bug work matters most. Done means you saw it working live, not "it should work now." **Your first 90 days** * **First 30 days:** Get access to everything. Map how Acre, Ivy, and the automations fit together: what calls what, where the data lives, and what runs on a schedule. Fix your first live bugs. * **By day 60:** You own the bug queue and deploys for both apps. * **By day 90:** You ship Acre roadmap features end to end, from the idea to checking it live. **What you're good at** * Reading a system you didn't write and mapping it: what calls what, where the data lives, what runs in the background * Deploys and keeping apps up: GitHub, Vercel, Railway, env vars, logs, rollbacks * Postgres and Supabase: migrations, row\-level security, and never deleting what you can't get back * Next.js, React, and TypeScript, enough to fix it and ship it * A good eye for UX/UI. You can tell when a screen is confusing and make it simpler. * Working with AI coding tools and checking their work instead of trusting it * Clear written updates: what broke, what you changed, and how you checked it **Nice to have** * Experience with Amazon selling, ecommerce, or wholesale * Python for scripts and data jobs * Connecting tools through their APIs: Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, GoHighLevel, or other CRMs * Background jobs, queues, and scheduled tasks **How we work** * Find out why something broke before you fix it. * Small changes shipped often beat big risky ones. * Back up before you change data. Never delete what you can't get back. * AI writes a lot of the code. You check all of it. **This isn't for you if** * You need a full spec before you start anything * "It works on my machine" feels like done to you * You'd rather rebuild a system from scratch than learn the one that's already running **How to apply** Skip the long cover letter. When you apply, send us three things: * One thing you built or fixed, with a link if you can share it * What broke along the way, and how you found it * Your available hours and time zone A resume is fine too, but we read those three answers first. Pay: Up to $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Work from home Work Location: Remote

Our radiation therapy for cancer makes treatment shorter, safer, personalized and more effective, ultimately enabling patients to live longer, better lives. **Job Description** The Motion Controls \& Robotics Software Engineer contributes to the research, planning, design, implementation, and verification of software that controls critical electro\-mechanical and robotic motion mechanisms contributing to the function and performance of Accuray’s radiation therapy products. This is a software\-forward motion control role for early\-career candidates with foundational experience or strong demonstrated capability developing software that interfaces with physical hardware. The role supports high\-level architecture, detailed implementation, integration, and verification of these motion devices while building cross\-functional experience across Software, Mechanical, Electrical, and Systems Engineering to solve complex engineering problems. **Essential duties and responsibilities:** PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT * Object\-oriented software development and hands\-on hardware integration for Accuray’s control systems, including robotic manipulators, precision positioning systems, thermal and pneumatic control systems. Detailed analysis reports (design reviews, control system models, DFMEA, etc.), debugging, reliability cycling, system integration, and formal software/hardware testing are key components of the development activities. * Researches, analyzes, plans, and implements the control system design in accordance with product requirements as established from various sources including marketing, manufacturing, reliability, and customer specification documents. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. #### **The Role** The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers. As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship. This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi\-day engagements. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment\-based visas such as H\-1B, F\-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment. #### **What You'll Do** * Build AI\-powered agents and tools end\-to\-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production * Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval\-augmented workflows * Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain\-specific * Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality * Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client\-specific work into product features * Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines) * Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance #### **Who You Are** * 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language) * Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs * Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data\-grounded AI workflows * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) * You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified. * A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate. * You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code does * BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience #### **Nice to Have** * Experience building agentic systems (multi\-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows) * Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment) * Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting) * Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container\-based deployments * Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality **Our Values** * **Act Like an Owner \-** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. * **Build Together \-** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. * **Champion Our Clients \-** Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. * **Drive Innovation \-** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. * **Embrace Learning \-** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

As we build a new Ads business and evolve Marketplace into a best in class shopping experience, improving search is one of our highest leverage investments to create an experience users choose and merchants want to invest in. **What You'll Do** * With the support of your team, you will work on tasks that contribute to the team's projects and goals. * You will work collaboratively and proactively with your team and stakeholders, bringing them along for your work and helping to create visibility and dialog regarding the risks and trade\-offs related to your work. * You will strike the right balance of speed and quality in your work, ensuring that we hit our business goals while protecting our systems from downtime. * You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities. **What We Look For** * You have previous work or internship experience working with Javascript/Typescript. * You have previous work or internship experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale and are experienced using Python or Kotlin. * You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code. * You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews. * Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders. * You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team. * This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field. **Base Pay Grade** \- J **Equity Grade** \- 5 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. jobs.title: Head of Engineering, AI Platform
jobs.description: **About AiDASH** AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection \& Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com. The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\. Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together! **The Role** AiDASH is scaling fast — our satellite and AI\-powered utility products are set for aggressive customer growth over the next two years, and engineering is at the heart of making it happen. We're hiring a **Head of Engineering, AI Platform** to join our engineering leadership team in a newly created role. In this role, you'll build our new Data Inference AI Pipeline team from the ground up to support our rapidly growing customer base. This is a rare opportunity to build both the team and the system from scratch: you'll shape the architecture, culture, and hiring bar of a new AI team from day one, and own the pipeline that powers our AI products as our customer base grows. In this role, you will report to the VP of Engineering and have real ownership over technical decisions, team design, and engineering practices. Our pending acquisition by Schneider Electric will accelerate our mission as we bring our combined offering to our joint customer base, and the systems you build will power outcomes at an even greater scale. **Location:** Palo Alto, CA (hybrid/2 days per week in the office) **How** **you'll** **make an impact:** * **Build the Data Inference AI Pipeline team** + Define the team's charter, headcount plan, and hiring bar, and make the first several hires, bringing in talent from both within AiDASH and outside + Architect a multimodal data inference pipeline that scales with customer growth while keeping compute and infrastructure cost per inference efficient + Build the model training and human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) feedback loops that keep our AI accurate and continuously improving + Establish strong engineering practices from day one, including code review, testing, on\-call, and release process * **Lead and grow the team** + Hire, coach, and develop engineering managers and leads, and manage performance as needed, building a high\-performing, high\-ownership culture + Partner with Product, Data Science, and Design to shape roadmap trade\-offs and sequencing + Own technical decisions within your team's scope, and partner with the VP of Engineering on cross\-org architecture decisions + Give the leadership a clear, reliable view of progress, risks, and resourcing needs **What success looks like in your first 6 months:** * The Data Inference AI Pipeline team is staffed with its first core hires, from within AiDASH and outside, and running on an architecture that scales with growing data volume without a proportional rise in infrastructure cost * The team has clear ownership, a steady delivery cadence, and visible engineering practices (code review, on\-call, release process) in place * Leadership has a clear, reliable read on the team's progress, risks, and resourcing needs **What** **we're** **looking for:** **Minimum Qualifications** * 10\+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3\-5\+ years leading engineering teams (managing managers or senior ICs) * A track record of building a team or system from scratch, not just scaling an existing one * Hands\-on experience architecting data/ML pipelines at scale, with a strong grasp of throughput, latency, and cost\-efficiency trade\-offs for inference workloads * Experience building modern AI systems, including reasoning frameworks, agentic capabilities, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), self\-correction loops, and memory and state management, that shipped to production for real customers, not as research or internal proof\-of\-concept work * Strong background in cloud\-native, multi\-tenant SaaS architectures (AWS, Kubernetes, microservices) * Proven ability to improve delivery predictability and accelerate onboarding and go\-live for enterprise customers * Confidence owning technical decisions within a defined scope, while partnering with a VP on strategy and resourcing * Experience managing global, distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones * High ownership mindset, low ego, and a collaborative spirit, with a passion for building teams that do their best work * Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with geospatial data, satellite imagery, or remote\-sensing pipelines * A background in utilities, energy, or infrastructure * Experience hiring and scaling a net\-new engineering team in a high\-growth (Series B/C) startup environment * Open\-source contributions, technical certifications, or published engineering writing **What you'll love:** * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: 100% coverage for employees and 80% for their spouses and children * Health Reimbursement Account (HRA): 100% funded by AiDASH to cover medical deductibles * 401(k) Plan: Begin contributing after two months of employment to prepare for your future. Currently, no company match is offered * Parental Leave: Supportive parental leave with 16 weeks for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers * Generous Vacation Policy: Accrue 20 vacation days per year, plus enjoy an additional flex holiday to celebrate whatever feels most important to you * Winter Break: From December 25th through January 1st, we give everyone time off to recharge and enjoy time with family and friends! jobs.description: **About Airwallex** ------------------- Airwallex is the AI\-native financial operating system for a real\-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85\+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific. We're co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder\-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. **How you'll make impact** -------------------------- Growth Engineering at Airwallex is building an AI\-native platform that powers customer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion. We're developing scalable infrastructure, intelligent decision systems, and automation capabilities that connect product, sales, and marketing to drive measurable business outcomes. As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll play a critical role in defining the technical architecture and building the foundational systems that power Growth at scale. * **Drive technical strategy and architecture** for critical Growth Engineering platforms, influencing engineering decisions across multiple teams and leading complex initiatives from design through production. * **Build scalable backend infrastructure**, including high\-performance APIs, distributed services, event\-driven architectures, and real\-time data processing systems that power growth automation and intelligent decision\-making. * **Develop AI\-native platform capabilities** that transform customer signals, product usage, lifecycle events, and business context into personalized experiences, next\-best actions, and automated workflows. * **Design for reliability and scale**, establishing strong foundations for performance, fault tolerance, observability, security, and operational excellence. * **Translate ambiguous business challenges into technical solutions**, partnering with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, and engineering teams to deliver measurable outcomes. * **Elevate engineering excellence** through architectural leadership, technical mentorship, thoughtful design reviews, and hands\-on contributions to complex engineering problems. US: You'll work from our San Francisco office three days a week. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- ### **Essentials** * **8\+ years of professional software engineering experience**, with substantial experience in backend development and a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * **Strong proficiency in Python, Java, Kotlin, or a comparable backend language**, with solid computer science fundamentals, object\-oriented design skills, and experience with frameworks such as FastAPI or Spring Boot. * **Deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture**, including domain\-driven design, event\-driven architectures, scalability, reliability, and modern engineering practices. * **Proven Staff\-level technical leadership**, with a track record of driving complex, cross\-team engineering initiatives, shaping architectural decisions, and mentoring other engineers. * **Strong ownership and execution skills**, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, make pragmatic technical tradeoffs, and deliver high\-quality solutions from design through production operations. ### **Preferred** * Experience building growth platforms, experimentation systems, customer segmentation engines, marketing automation, or data\-intensive applications. * Experience building AI\-powered applications or agentic workflows, including LLM integration, tool orchestration, evaluation, and production observability. * Experience with real\-time data pipelines, streaming technologies, or large\-scale event processing. * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP, containerization, and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience with production observability and jobs.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. Role Summary: Unlike traditional operational support roles focused on standard preventative maintenance, the Lead Reliability Engineer for Electrical systems serves as the supreme technical authority for medium and low\-voltage electrical topology, switchgear, UPS architecture, and power quality across Aligned's fleet. Acting as the strategic bridge between Site Operations and Platform Delivery, this role utilizes advanced electrical forensics to identify systemic vulnerabilities. The Lead Reliability Engineer translates complex power distribution data into binding engineering mandates and operational protocols, eliminating single points of failure and protecting enterprise SLAs. **Core Responsibilities:** * **Advanced Forensic Investigations (RCA Governance):** Lead deep\-dive forensic analyses during critical fleet electrical incidents. Investigate complex failure mechanisms such as harmonic distortions, breaker coordination failures, ground faults, and electrical transient events, translating findings into immediate, binding corrective actions. * **Engineering Design Mandates:** Review Single Line Diagrams, Sequence of Operations, and equipment specifications for all new capital projects. Issue Engineering Change Orders to Platform Delivery to correct architectural vulnerabilities, ensuring all power distribution and backup generation topologies meet strict fleet reliability standards prior to site deployment. * **Proactive Fleet Auditing:** Conduct rigorous, programmatic audits of active Data Center electrical systems. Ensure strict site compliance with Aligned's electrical MOPs/SOPs, breaker trip settings, arc flash boundaries, and critical maintenance intervals for UPS and generator fleets. * **Innovation \& System Integration:** Evaluate next\-generation electrical technologies (e.g., advanced battery chemistries, high\-density power distribution for AI racks). Partner with the Advanced Cooling Lab to validate the electrical impacts of new mechanical topologies, specifically focusing on VFD harmonics and the power resilience of liquid cooling architectures. * **Executive Advisement \& Incident Response:** Serve as the definitive Tier\-3 technical escalation point for severe electrical anomalies. Translate highly technical power quality data and breaker coordination issues into clear, executive\-level risk assessments for senior leadership. **Required Qualifications:** * **Experience:** 8\+ years of advanced electrical industry experience specifically focused on hyperscale data center infrastructure, complex power distribution, and massive\-scale backup generation. * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent highly specialized training/experience in critical environments. * **Technical Expertise:** Expert\-level knowledge of medium and low\-voltage systems, UPS topologies, diesel generators, switchgear routing, and EPMS telemetry. Deep understanding of protective relaying, short circuit/coordination studies, and power quality analysis. * **Strategic Leadership:** Proven ability to transition localized operational findings into fleet\-wide engineering policy, combined with the executive acumen to communicate critical electrical risks directly to C\-suite leadership and cross\-departmental stakeholders. **BENEFITS \& PERKS:** Aligned Data Centers is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package to support the health, well\-being, and financial security of our team members. jobs.description: **Who We Are:** **Alpaca is a US\-headquartered, global leader in agent\-first brokerage infrastructure** for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more. Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional\-grade APIs. This includes broker\-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open\-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award\-winning, developer\-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it. **Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top\-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.** **Our Team Members:** We're a dynamic team of 400\+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. **About the Role** ------------------ As a Senior Full Stack Engineer on the Platform Team, you will develop and operate Alpaca's authentication, authorization, and Identity Provider (IdP) systems \- the systems that handle user login, access control, and secure access across our APIs, customer products, and internal tools. We are looking for experienced engineers who are comfortable owning services end to end: API design, data modeling, deployments, and production debugging. Most of your time will be spent writing Go (backend services, gRPC/REST APIs, shared client libraries), with meaningful work in React/TypeScript for auth\-related UI, and occasionally Java for identity\-provider extensions. You will also work with Helm charts, analyze logs and metrics, manage deployments, and help other teams to integrate with our services. #### **Things You Get To Do** * Build and improve authentication\-related experiences in customer and partner web applications, including login, permissions, and credential management. * Develop and maintain the platform's authentication, authorization, and IdP services. * Create and evolve shared libraries and SDKs. * Integrate with identity providers and keep login and access policies working reliably across products. * Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot identity services in production. * Help modernize legacy authentication patterns as the platform evolves. * Own work end to end, from requirements through delivery and follow\-up. * Collaborate with other engineering teams on identity and access integration. * Maintain high code quality, write tests, and participate in code reviews. * Help investigate incidents and bugs, including on\-call rotation. #### **Who You Are (must\-haves)** * You have **5\+ years of experience** writing code in strongly\-typed languages, with at least **one year of experience in Go**. * You have experience building web applications with **React and TypeScript**. * You have worked with relational databases before \- we use **PostgreSQL**, but we are not particularly picky about this one as long as you have a solid grasp on the fundamentals. * You have worked at a **startup** before \- you thrive in ambiguous environments, embrace changing priorities, know when to balance technical debt with speed, and proactively tackle whatever needs to get done without relying on pre\-existing processes or documentation. * You are not afraid of **taking a task from start to finish** \- gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results. * You have worked at least 3 years on **systems at scale**. #### **Who You Might Be (nice\-to\-haves)** * You know what a **JWT** token is, and how **OpenID Connect** and **SAML** work. Maybe you even heard about **Keycloak**, or have worked on authentication systems before. * You have experience with **role\-based access control**. * You have built or maintained **OpenAPI\-driven** HTTP APIs. * You are familiar with **Kubernetes and Helm**. * You have experience with **Java**. * You understand how **Kafka** works \- maybe you even worked with **Redpanda** before. * You have experience with **Grafana**'s observability stack \- **Prometheus**, **Tempo** and all the rest. You might have even written a **PromQL** query for a new alert once or twice. ### **How We Take Care of You:** * Competitive Salary \& Stock Options * Health Benefits * New Hire Home\-Office Setup: One\-time USD $500 * Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card *Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.* *Recruitment Privacy Policy*

teach audiences with different levels of technical experience * Ability to build and deploy automations, integrations, or internal applications using AI coding, APIs, scripting, and workflow tools, with working knowledge of cloud infrastructure * Low ego, high empathy: you listen to different perspectives, question your assumptions, and use evidence to find the best solutions * High agency: you take initiative, manage priorities, navigate ambiguity, collaborate effectively, and proactively communicate progress, risks, and blockers * Sound judgment about managing sensitive data, access controls, API credentials, and third\-party integrations * Ability to analyze usage, cost, and outcome data and translate findings into practical recommendations to improve AI usage and efficiency * Strong communication skills: clear writing and polished public speaker and presenter The anticipated salary range for this role is between $189,000 \- $221,000, actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope. jobs.title: Senior PLM Software Engineer, Manufacturing Systems
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. ### **ABOUT THE TEAM** Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build the software\-defined shipyard. That means the full technology stack running Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, ArsenalOS (our manufacturing execution system that workers and planners use every shift), the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations. This work is anchored by Arsenal\-2, our software\-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6\.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base. ArsenalOS is the digital backbone of that yard. It connects fabrication and outfitting to material movement and inspection. Planners get one real\-time view of production. We aren't waiting for the yard to open. Development is already underway here in Orange County, California. The team is proving out the manufacturing methods and digital workflows that will scale across the shipyard network. MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory\-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship. This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end\-to\-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out\-build, out\-adapt, and out\-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70\+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up. ### **ABOUT THE JOB** MDP is building the manufacturing digital thread that connects engineering release to the machines and inspection systems on the factory floor. You'll own the Development and integration integration layer between Teamcenter and Anduril's ArsenalOS platform so CAM programs, CAI/CMM programs, tools and fixtures, and inspection results move automatically instead of by hand. #### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Build and own the integrations that carry CAM and CAI data out of Teamcenter and onto the shop floor, including NX CAM outputs, DNC dispatch to machine controls and the return path for as\-run data. * Develop custom Teamcenter extensions using ITK and SOA, along with BMIDE data model changes and Active Workspace interfaces, to support manufacturing workflows that off\-the\-shelf configuration can't reach. * Close the inspection loop by integrating CAI and metrology systems so measured results land back in the digital thread as structured data rather than static reports. * Make EBOM to MBOM propagation and model\-based definition data flow automatically into downstream manufacturing and quality systems. * Unblock partner teams across scheduling, applied AI and manufacturing systems by exposing manufacturing data through APIs they can build on. * Partner with manufacturing engineers and factory operators to understand production workflows and translate them into software requirements. * Write production\-quality code with comprehensive tests, participating in code review and architectural discussions. * Deploy and operate your systems in factory environments, including edge compute clusters and OT networks. * Leverage AI tooling (coding assistants, automation) in your development workflow and contribute to team engineering practices. * Join an on\-call rotation supporting production factory systems. #### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 8\+ years of experience in a software engineering rol MI, and with QIF for inspection data exchange. * Familiarity with frontier AI tooling, AI coding assistants, and AI\-enabled software development workflows. * Experience in hyper\-growth startup\-like environments, with demonstrated success balancing speed, ambiguity, and long\-term system health. * Familiarity with enterprise systems such as ERP, MES, WMS, or manufacturing planning systems. * Experience in manufacturing industries with hands\-on exposure to assembly lines or production environments. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * **Please always verify communications:** + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Life Sciences)
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As an Applied AI Engineer on the Startups team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the top AI\-native life sciences and biotech startups as they grow from early product to scale. Some of these companies build products on Claude that they sell to the rest of the industry, and others do the science themselves and want Claude woven into how their own research runs, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with startup engineering and scientific teams to help them build their products on Claude and run their own research with it, advising on implementation and agent design as they build what is newly possible with AI in the life sciences. You will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what the life sciences need, working alongside some of the strongest teams in the field on problems that matter and pushing the boundaries of AI in science as you go. Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll help startups build at the edge of what is possible with Claude. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise and your scientific domain knowledge to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the technical resources that enable life sciences startups to succeed with Claude. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Serve as a deep technical advisor to high\-potential life sciences and biotech startups, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they make discoveries, working alongside them to build innovative use cases that push the boundaries of AI in scientific research and development * Work hands\-on with startup engineering teams and their scientists through pair programming and architecture reviews that accelerate their development, and understand their scientific workflows end to end so that your guidance fits into real research pipelines * Develop prototypes and technical documentation, including evaluation suites, scientifically grounded benchmarks, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable startups to build, operate, and scale with Claude * Create reference implementations and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, such as example MCP servers for domain\-specific data sources like genomics platforms, literature databases, and experimental repositories, along with agent skills for common scientific workflows * Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements * Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about deploying AI in the life sciences such as heterogeneous data, auditability requirements, and the gap between a working prototype and a system that scientists trust, and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team, including feedback on the model capabilities and product features that would most accelerate discovery work * Create technical content for startup audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code * Represent Anthropic across the life sciences startup ecosystem and foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, in\-person founder events, and research show and tells * Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building **You may be a good fit if you have** ------------------------------------- * Deep experience in the life sciences or biotech, gained through research or industry work in areas such as genomics, drug discovery, molecular design, lab automation, or clinical development, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and what the life sciences need * 4\+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, ML or research engineer, computational biologist, research scientist, or technical founder, with either production experience building LLM\-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, or a track record of successfully applying AI to real scientific work in the lab or in research * Experience with startups or high\-growth companies and a love of working with founders and small teams that move quickly * Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans for both enginee itch across scientific domains and use cases, and a passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $280,000 \- $320,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications.
