jobs.description: **Position Overview** We are seeking a talented AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered applications using modern Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI technologies. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and Python\-based application development. The candidate will work with engineering and business teams to build intelligent applications, integrate AI capabilities into existing systems, and deliver scalable, reliable solutions for real\-world business problems. **Key Responsibilities** Design, develop, and maintain AI\-powered applications using Python and modern AI frameworks. Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), including GPT, Claude, Llama, or similar models, into enterprise applications. Build and optimize RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and document retrieval. Develop AI agents and intelligent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies. Implement prompt engineering, tool calling, and model evaluation techniques to improve AI response quality and reliability. Develop REST APIs and backend services to integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, databases, and external systems. Work with structured and unstructured data to support AI applications, knowledge retrieval, and model inference. Deploy and maintain AI applications on cloud platforms such as AWS or Microsoft Azure. Test, troubleshoot, and optimize AI applications for accuracy, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. Implement logging, monitoring, security controls, and appropriate safeguards for production AI systems. Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into practical AI solutions. **Required Qualifications** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 3\+ years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, or application development experience. Strong programming skills in Python and experience building backend applications or APIs. Hands\-on experience with LLMs, Generative AI, or machine learning applications. Understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases. Experience with at least one AI development framework, such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex. Experience developing REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks. Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably AWS or Azure. Knowledge of Git, software testing, debugging, and collaborative development practices. Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience building AI agents, agentic workflows, or multi\-step AI automation. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool calling, and agent orchestration. Experience with AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Azure AI Foundry. Familiarity with vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, or ChromaDB. Knowledge of machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit\-learn. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or MLOps/LLMOps practices. Familiarity with SQL, data pipelines, Apache Spark, or PySpark. Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, or conversational AI solutions. Knowledge of AI evaluation, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and responsible AI practices. **What We're Looking For** **Mid\-Level Engineers:** Strong hands\-on development skills, a solid understanding of LLMs and RAG, and the ability to build and maintain AI applications with appropriate guidance. **Senior Engineers:** Deeper experience designing production AI solutions, optimizing RAG and agent workflows, making technical decisions, and supporting deployment and performance improvements. Candidates do not need to have experience with every technology listed. Strong Python development skills and practical experience building AI applications are the primary priorities. Pay: From $85,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Vision insurance Experience: * Copilot Studio: 4 years (Required) * Contact Center: 4 years (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sterling, VA 20166

jobs.title: Staff Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: Apollo.io is the leading go\-to\-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1\.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members. **Role Overview** The Staff Application Security Engineer leads application security strategy for Apollo’s Security department and delivers it through hands\-on work and technical leadership. This role takes on the hardest AppSec problems across product, platform, and AI\-powered features, including problems with no established playbook. The role shapes the roadmaps of Engineering, Product, and Platform teams so secure patterns become the default, and sets the AppSec standard that helps many teams build securely without relying on any single person. **Key Responsibilities** *AppSec strategy, standards, and influence* * Lead Apollo’s multi\-year AppSec strategy and turn it into multi\-quarter, cross\-team initiatives that move Security department KRs. Report progress, risks, and tradeoffs to Security leadership on a regular cadence. * Shape Engineering, Product, Platform, and Data roadmaps so security work is planned in early, and represent AppSec in cross\-department decisions. * Set the secure design, code review, and risk model standards used across the department and adjacent engineering teams, including expectations for AI\-generated and agent\-generated code. * Mentor senior engineers and security champions, grow the champions program, and help raise the hiring bar, so the AppSec program does not depend on one person’s expertise. *Secure architecture and vulnerability depth* * Lead security architecture reviews and threat modeling for ambiguous, high\-scale, multi\-team systems, including AI and agent features, and define the approach where no precedent exists. * Design and drive adoption of secure\-by\-default building blocks, such as shared authorization, safe OAuth and token handling, and SSRF\-safe HTTP clients, so whole classes of issues stop appearing. * Shape vulnerability management across internal reviews, bug bounty, pentests, and SCA and runtime findings, with a focus on root causes, bug classes, and clear risk\-based severity decisions. * Stay hands\-on for the hardest cases: read code across teams, develop exploits, test bypasses, and lead variant analysis and staged remediation across teams. *Tooling, automation, and AI (AI\-native by default)* * Set the standard for AI\-augmented AppSec in the department. Use AI and agents for code review, threat modeling, triage, and remediation, and build automation that teams outside Security adopt, with measured gains in speed, coverage, and signal quality. * Define how Apollo secures its AI systems and agent features, including input and output handling, AI\-exposed APIs, prompt and response guardrails, tool permissions, and data\-exfiltration paths. **What Good Looks Like** *(drafted from your mission and success sections)* * Owns AppSec strategy across a multi\-year horizon and gets it committed in other teams’ roadmaps. * Solves ambiguous, no\-playbook problems and defines the approach for others to follow. * Makes hard risk calls under ambiguity and aligns technical and non\-technical leaders without formal authority. * Builds guardrails, standards, and people so AppSec scales beyond any one person. **Required Skills \& Experience** * A track record of leading AppSec strategy that changed how several engineering teams build, with measurable results, typically backed by 10\+ years in software engineering or application security. * Expert code review, penetration testing, and exploit development skills, with the ability to find design flaws in unfamiliar codebases and land fixes that hold up against bypass attempts. * Strong software development skills and the ability to ship production code. Ruby and Ruby on Rails experience is highly valuable, and Python is a plus. Strong Linux and cloud fundamentals, ideally GCP and Kubernetes. * Deep experience with secure architecture and authentication and authorization patterns, and with building security building blocks that other teams adopt. * Hands\-on experience securing AI\-powered systems or agent features, and a clear point of view on how AI changes application security. * The judgment to make hard risk calls under ambiguity, and the influence to align technical and non\-technical leaders without formal authority. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience leading security for AI\-native products, internal agents, or AI\-assisted engineering workflows at scale. * Experience building or scaling a security champions or developer enablement program. * Public security work, such as CVEs, research, talks, or open\-source tools, or certifications such as OSCP or OSWE. **Example Success Outcomes** * An AppSec strategy tied to Security department KRs, with supporting work committed in other teams’ roadmaps. * A measurable drop in high\-risk vulnerability classes, backed by shared guardrails or libraries. * AI\-assisted AppSec workflows adopted by teams outside Security, with clear gains in speed or signal quality. **Our Tech Stack** React on the front end; Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Python, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch on the backend; Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform in infrastructure; GCP for cloud. The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD\&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits. Pay Transparency Range $225,400 \- $281,800 USD ### **We are AI Native** Apollo.io is an AI\-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here. ### **Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo** At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we **take extreme ownership** of our work, **move with focus and urgency**, and **learn voraciously** to stay ahead. We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to **own your role and make a real impact**. Collaboration is at our core—we’re **all for one**, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage **bold ideas and courageous action**, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

jobs.description: Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. We are looking for a Platform \& Data Engineer to own the systems that thousands of internal engineers rely on every day. This is a rare, broad role: you will operate at the intersection of Kubernetes platform engineering and large\-scale data engineering, owning both the compute platform our internal tools run on and the data layer that makes them useful. You will not just keep these systems healthy \- you will build the products and interfaces that let other teams move faster. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) - Enterprise Technology Services
jobs.description: Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. The IS\&T Enterprise Business Application group is seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) with a proven track record of sustaining high\-quality enterprise software solutions. Our group owns Apple's enterprise Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) transformation initiative \- delivering a next\-generation Product Information Management (PIM) platform that drives Apple's product innovation across hardware, software, and services lines of business. In this position, you will work closely with key business stakeholders to build an enterprise PIM platform that enables product innovation and collaboration across Apple's product value chain. We are looking for someone with extensive experience building and delivering large\-scale, on\-premise and cloud\-based enterprise solutions \- especially PLM. This individual should have sound technical and functional knowledge of PLM domains and modern test frameworks. A great candidate will create a collaborative work environment that fosters autonomy, transparency, innovation, and learning. **Description** This hands\-on role demands the best and brightest; the ideal candidate will be well rounded and offer a diverse set of skills that aligns with the key qualifications listed below. This is a highly cross\-functional role \- we interact closely with technical and business teams all across Apple and with third\-party partners. Collaboration \& Engineering Partnership Partner with engineering, infrastructure, site reliability, program management, and partner technical and business teams to formulate engineering specifications and testable acceptance criteria. Participate in design and architecture reviews as the quality voice \- surface testability gaps, missing observability, and risky integration points before a line of code is written. Act as the quality advocate in agile ceremonies: refine stories into verifiable behaviors, estimate test effort, and hold the team's definition of done. Test Strategy, Design \& Automation Craft test plans, test cases, and the associated automation for complex full\-stack PLM workflows; set standards, estimate effort, and coordinate execution across functional, integration, regression, and release cycles. Own the automation architecture in TypeScript: build and maintain a strictly typed, reusable, data\-driven UI and API test framework on Playwright Test \- custom fixtures, page\- and service\-object layering, shared typed clients, parallel sharded execution, and no flaky tests tolerated. Treat test code as production code: strict TypeScript configuration, lint and format gates, typed API contracts generated from schema rather than hand\-written, and peer\-reviewed pull requests. Apply the test pyramid deliberately \- push coverage down to unit and service layers, and reserve end\-to\-end UI suites for genuine business\-critical journeys. Build service\-virtualization and mocking capability (Playwright network interception and WireMock stubs) so downstream integrations can be tested without waiting on partner environments. Engineer test data management for PLM: item/BOM/change\-order fixtures, revision and lifecycle states, seeded via API or ITK/SOA rather than hand\-built in the UI; guarantee repeatable setup and teardown. Asynchronous \& Distributed Systems Testing Automate and validate asynchronous, event\-driven, and distributed behavior \- message queues and streams (Kafka), workflow engines, scheduled jobs, and batch/ETL pipelines. Write deterministic assertions over eventual consistency: typed polling helpers with bounded waits and expect.poll\-style retries, idempotency and replay checks, out\-of\-order and duplicate message handling, and dead\-letter/retry paths \- never sleep\-based waits. Verify data integrity end to end across system boundaries \- reconciliation between source PLM, the PIM platform, and downstream consumers, including migration and cutover validation. CI/CD \& Quality Engineering Infrastructure Integrate automated suites into CI/CD (Jenkins and Rio) so every commit and every deployment is gated by meaningful, fast, trustworthy feedback; manage the toolchain, dependency hygiene, and build caching that keeps those runs fast. Manage on\-demand, isolated test environments so suites can run in parallel without contention. Maintain reporting and traceability \- Playwright traces and Allure dashboards, requirement\-to\-test coverage mapping, and clear triage of every failure as product bug, test bug, or environment issue. Non\-Functional \& Resilience Testing Design and execute performance, load, and soak tests for large BOM structures, bulk imports, and peak concurrent usage; define and defend latency and throughput budgets. Validate security and access control: role\- and project\-based permissions, data segregation, authentication/SSO flows, and audit trails \- critical in a system holding unreleased product data. Cover accessibility, cross\-browser, and cross\-platform behavior for the PIM user experience. Defect Management \& Quality Metrics Identify and document defects with crisp reproduction steps, evidence, and impact; collaborate with stakeholders to prioritize and drive resolution. Engage with stakeholders to define and consistently assess metrics that monitor product quality \- automation coverage and pass rate, escaped\-defect rate, mean time to detect and repair, regression cycle time, and environment stability. Drive root\-cause analysis on escaped defects and convert every one into a durable automated test. **Preferred Qualifications** Depth in the Playwright Test ecosystem \- custom fixtures, projects and sharding, network interception, trace viewer, visual comparison, and component testing. Extensive knowledge of back\-end development technologies, particularly Java and related frameworks (Spring/Spring Boot, microservices) \- enough to read the services under test and debug alongside their developers. Working knowledge of browser technologies and frameworks such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React, including the DOM and accessibility semantics that make an application testable. Proficiency in relational database technologies such as Oracle or Postgres. Depth in Siemens Teamcenter \- Active Workspace, BMIDE data model, SOA/ITK services, workflows, and Teamcenter Integration Framework (TcIF). Experience with PLM data migration and cutover validation \- extract, transform, load, and reconciliation at scale. Experience with message brokers and streaming platforms (Kafka via kafkajs, JMS/ActiveMQ) and with ETL or data pipeline testing. Experience with performance and resilience testing of enterprise workloads. Familiarity with test management and defect tracking practices, including requirement\-to\-test traceability and Allure\-based reporting. Self\-motivated, proactive, and meticulous individual with excellent written and oral English communication skills. **Minimum Qualifications** Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in quality assurance or software engineering. Proficient in developing test plans and automation strategies for intricate full\-stack applications. Experience testing and automating browser\-based applications across platforms using Playwright (TypeScript), Selenium, or equivalent. Experience testing and automating enterprise applications such as Siemens Teamcenter or an equivalent PLM system. Hands\-on experience automating and testing asynchronous and distributed systems. Strong programming ability in TypeScript \- typed interfaces and generics, async/await, clean code practices, code review, and Git\-based workflows. Our automation codebase is TypeScript end to end, with Java used on the services and integrations under test. Experience with API and contract testing (REST/SOAP, JSON/XML) using Playwright's API request client, Postman/Insomnia, or equivalent, including JSON Schema validation. Working knowledge of SQL for test data setup and backend verification. Experience integrating automated test suites into a CI/CD pipeline.

jobs.description: Overview: *Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current sponsorship. Aptean is unable to sponsor work authorization at this time.* **Are you ready for what’s next, now?**### **Role Overview** Aptean is seeking a hands\-on Data Engineer to build, test, and maintain scalable data ingestion and transformation pipelines on Microsoft Fabric. This role is execution\-focused and centered on delivering high\-quality data solutions that support enterprise reporting, analytics, and AI use cases. The ideal candidate brings experience in modern lakehouse environments and a strong sense of ownership with a willingness to learn.### **About the Role** As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining data pipelines across the medallion architecture (bronze, silver, gold) using Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies. You’ll work closely with senior engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable, scalable data engineering solutions. This role requires strong hands\-on experience with Python, PySpark, and data pipeline orchestration tools, as well as a focus on data quality, performance optimization, and operational excellence.### **Key Responsibilities** * Build and maintain data ingestion pipelines using Microsoft Fabric (Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks) and Azure Data Factory * Develop Python and PySpark notebooks to cleanse, transform, and enrich data across medallion architecture layers * Implement Delta Lake patterns including partitioning, schema evolution, and incremental loads * Apply data quality checks including null handling, duplicate detection, schema validation, and SCD logic * Develop reusable, metadata\-driven, and parameterized pipeline frameworks * Troubleshoot pipeline failures, performance issues, and data discrepancies; perform root\-cause analysis * Participate in code reviews, testing, and CI/CD processes using Git\-based workflows * Support gold\-layer datasets and semantic models for Power BI consumption * Monitor pipelines and resolve operational issues within defined SLAs; support on\-call rotations as needed * Maintain technical documentation such as data dictionaries, mappings, and runbooks * Collaborate cross\-functionally to deliver high\-quality data engineering solutions ### **About You** * 3–5 years of experience building data pipelines in production or near\-production environments * Hands\-on experience with Python and PySpark * Experience with Azure Data Factory or similar orchestration tools * Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric (or strong experience in Azure Synapse/Databricks with willingness to learn Fabric) * Solid understanding of SQL, data modeling, and performance optimization * Knowledge of medallion architecture and Delta Lake concepts * Experience implementing data quality checks and basic SCD handling * Familiarity with Git, branching, and CI/CD practices (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) * Exposure to Power BI and semantic data models is a plus * Understanding of data governance concepts such as schema versioning and access controls preferred * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset * Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate with technical and business teams ### **What’s in It for You** * Opportunity to work with modern data technologies including Microsoft Fabric and Azure * Collaborative environment with experienced data engineering professionals * Exposure to enterprise\-level data, analytics, and AI initiatives * Growth opportunities through hands\-on learning and ownership of impactful projects **About Aptean** At Aptean, our mission is to solve tomorrow’s unique challenges today with unrivaled, purpose\-built software and superior customer experiences from people who care. Aptean’ s purpose\-built ERP and supply chain management solutions help address the unique challenges facing process and discrete manufacturers, distributors and other focused organizations. Aptean’ s compliance solutions are built for companies serving specific markets such as finance, healthcare, biotech and pharmaceuticals, over 10,000 highly specialized organizations in more than 20 industries and 80 countries rely on Aptean to streamline their everyday operations. “At Aptean, our global and diverse employee base is our greatest asset. It is through embracing and understanding our differences that we are able to harness our individual power to maximize the success of our customers, our employees and our company.” – TVN Reddy *Aptean pledges to promote a company culture where diversity, equity and inclusion are* *central. Celebrating our diverse experiences, opinions and beliefs* *allows us to embrace what makes us unique and to use this as an asset in bringing* *innovative solutions to our customer base.*

jobs.description: **Position:** AI and Data Platform Engineer – Full Time/Exempt **Department:** Information Technology **Reports to:** Director, Cloud and System Engineering **Location:** Arizona Cardinals (Tempe, AZ) *NOTE: Starting 2028, this role will be based at the* *new Arizona Cardinals Training Facility in north Phoenix, AZ* (https://www.azcardinals.com/news/new\-arizona\-cardinals\-practice\-facility\-on\-target\-for\-opening\-in\-2028\)*.* **Format:** In\-person *Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a student or employment Visas (including, but not limited to F\-1, M\-1, J\-1, H\-1B, OPT and/or CPT programs, etc.).* **Cardinals Organizational Summary:** The Arizona Cardinals Football Club is a professional football team within the National Football League (NFL). Learn more about the Arizona Cardinals and see what’s happening here (https://www.azcardinals.com/community/). **Job Summary:** The Arizona Cardinals are seeking a highly motivated, innovative, and technically skilled AI and Data Platform Engineer to support the organization's expanding Artificial Intelligence, data management, and enterprise technology strategy. This position will be required to work at all home games and team functions at the State Farm Stadium located in Glendale, AZ. **Primary Job Duties:** The AI and Data Platform Engineer position will have the daily responsibilities, without limitation, to include the following: AI Platform Administration \& Enablement * Administer and support enterprise AI platforms including Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI services, approved large language model (LLM) platforms, and future AI technologies. * Partner with business units to evaluate, prioritize, and implement AI use cases that drive operational efficiency and business value. * Support AI training, prompt development, adoption programs, and end\-user enablement initiatives. * Assist with AI model integrations, automation workflows, and AI\-powered business processes. * Monitor AI platform usage, performance, security, and adoption metrics. * Serve on the Cardinals AI Council to manage the AI use case requests and communication with the NFL. * Support AI governance initiatives, documentation, and compliance requirements. * Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure AI solutions are implemented securely and align with organizational policies. Database \& Data Systems Administration * Design, administer, monitor, optimize, and maintain enterprise databases and data repositories. * Ensure database performance, availability, reliability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery capabilities. * Manage SQL Server and other database technologies su ing, data warehousing, and data mesh/data product concepts. + Knowledge of data modeling, database architecture, and data integration methodologies. + Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise data environments. * Systems Integration * + Experience developing and supporting APIs, integrations, ETL processes, and enterprise workflows. + Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Fabric, Databricks, AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or comparable services + Understanding of cloud\-based integration services and modern data architectures. + Experience integrating AI services with enterprise applications and business systems. * Cloud \& Enterprise Technologies * + Knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud services and enterprise cloud architectures. + Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Active Directory, Entra ID, and enterprise collaboration tools. + Understanding of data warehousing, analytics, and business intelligence solutions. * Cybersecurity \& Governance * + Understanding of cybersecurity best practices related to databases, AI platforms, and enterprise applications. + Knowledge of data governance, data privacy, retention, and compliance principles. + Experience implementing security and access controls across enterprise systems. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Excellent organizational and project management skills. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder management skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, highly visible environment. * Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging AI and data technologies. * Experience supporting Generative AI deployments in an enterprise environment, preferred. * Familiarity with data cataloging, data classification, and data governance platforms, preferred. * Experience within professional sports, entertainment, media, or large event\-based organizations, preferred. * Experience supporting mission\-critical operations requiring high availability and rapid issue resolution, preferred. * Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays; hours will vary depending on business needs. * Must complete all pre\-employment forms and successfully pass a background check. **Cardinals Benefits/Perks Summary:** The Arizona Cardinals Football Club has developed a comprehensive benefits package that provides economic and inclusive benefits to full\-time employees. The Cardinals benefits offer care, protection, and support for employees and their loved ones. The Cardinals organization encourages an environment that is conducive to living a healthy, productive, and flexible lifestyle. Benefits and Perks include, but are not limited to: * Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance options; effective the first day of hire * 401 (k) retirement option with employer match contribution * Paid Time Off Accruals (including sick time accruals) * Paid Time Off for most Federal holidays * Time off for Maternity, Paternity, Military, and Bereavement * MDLIVE: 24/7 medical support * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) \& Health Care Saving Account options * Discounts on Cardinals gear \& paraphernalia * Tuition reimbursement \& Professional Growth opportunities * Daily free lunch * Complimentary season tickets * Subsidized gym memberships *The Arizona Cardinals Football Club is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.* *\#LI\-Onsite* Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description: **Junior Software Engineer, Boulder, CO or Raleigh, NC (Hybrid)** We're building a pipeline of top\-tier **Software Engineer** candidates at Ascend Analytics to be part of a collaborative team advancing software solutions and analytics to support the clean\-tech power revolution. Your strong software engineering skills will support mission critical decision analytics for renewable and battery storage power providers around the globe. While we may not have an immediate start date for every applicant, we review applications on an ongoing basis and reach out directly as new openings arise. **Our Mission** At Ascend Analytics, our mission is to create sustainable economic value for energy buyers and producers and transform the power industry. Our team combines advanced analytics, cloud\-based technology, and deep market expertise to help our clients solve complex challenges across grid reliability, power market volatility, renewable integration, infrastructure development, and energy investment strategy. As a high\-growth, private equity\-backed company, Ascend continues to expand its market presence while investing in innovation, talent, and scalable solutions for an increasingly dynamic energy market. **Your Impact** Real influence. Real outcomes. At every level. * **Technical ownership.** Build and ship features across our SaaS platform, writing clean, tested, well\-documented code that our customers and internal teams rely on. You’ll take real tickets from day one and own them from design through deployment. * **Growth with support.** Work alongside senior engineers who invest in your development through code reviews, pairing, and mentorship, so your technical skills grow with every sprint you ship. * **Engineering excellence.** Help keep our codebase healthy by writing unit and integration tests, contributing to CI/CD pipelines, triaging bugs, and improving the reliability and performance of the systems that power our analytics products. * **Collaborative partnership.** Work closely with product managers, data scientists, and fellow engineers to turn ideas into working software, and be a dependable voice in standups, design discussions, and cross\-functional projects. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and write clean, scalable, production code (our backend team primarily works in Python, SQL, SAS, and C\#; our frontend team works in React). * Refactor code for improved performance, stability, and scalability. * Develop automatic tests. * Work with our team of analysts and data scientists to integrate, generalize, and prototype mathematical and data science models within production software. * Communicate clearly and effectively (orally and in writing) with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * The software development team follows an agile scrum process, and all team members are expected to contribute to technical design reviews, implementation strategies, operational system support, and sprint planning. **Required Qualifications** * BS in Engineering, Computer Science, Data/Information Science, Mathematics, or a related field. * 3\.0 cumulative GPA or higher. * Demonstrated academic or professional software coding experience in one or more of the following languages: Python, Ruby, .NET, Java, C\+\+, C\#, Kotlin, Rust, or JavaScript, including object\-oriented design. * Strong background in programming related to applied mathematical, engineering, and physical sciences. * Team player with a willingness to learn. * Strong interpersonal skills, teamwork skills, and work ethic. **Preferred Qualifications** * Self\-starter who has implemented full\-stack solutions (front\-end and back\-end development). * Candidates with the drive, work ethic, and desire to learn and quickly advance in their careers. * Knowledge of referential databases, such as SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL. * Knowledge of wholesale electricity markets is a plus. **Our Values** Ascend Analytics promotes a culture of teamwork, inclusion, work\-life balance, creative thinking, and learning. We work with five core pillars: * **Integrity:** We act with honesty and uphold the highest ethical standards, doing the right thing even when it's difficult. * **Purpose Driven:** We are united with a shared purpose to deliver meaningful impact on our customers, our industry, and the energy transition to a low\-carbon future. * **Belonging:** We foster a respectful, inclusive environment where everyone is valued, diverse perspectives are embraced, and fair opportunities are provided for all. * **Innovation:** We predict and address new challenges, embracing change and continuous improvement * **One Team Mindset:** We collaborate across teams and functions, supporting one another and prioritizing shared success over individual wins. **Your Value** We offer generous, fair compensation, calibrated to your experience and structured to grow with you, along with a comprehensive benefits package: * **Medical, dental, and vision** coverage. * **Life and disability** insurance. * **Parental leave** for growing families. * **FSA, HSA, and dependent care** accounts. * **401(k)** with a 3% non\-elective contribution. * **Flexible PTO** to take time when you need it. **Join a team that values your work, supports your growth, and invests in your future!** We offer a competitive salary range of $78,000 — $91,000\. fast, transparent, and human, whether or not they join * **You'll thrive here if** you enjoy building, move quickly, and like finding creative ways to solve hard hiring problems. ### **What You'll Need** * 3\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting, with significant experience hiring GTM roles (sales, customer success, marketing) at B2B SaaS, API, or developer\-tools companies, ideally at a high\-growth startup * A track record of hiring at volume (25\+ GTM hires a year) across levels, from SDR to senior AE * Strong passive sourcing skills: boolean search, creative channels, and comfort jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** -------------------- AssetMark is a leading strategic provider of innovative investment and consulting solutions serving independent financial advisors. We provide investment, relationship, and practice management solutions that advisors use in helping clients achieve wealth, independence, and purpose. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We are seeking a strategic and technically strong Director of Service/Site Reliability Engineering and Observability to lead the reliability, monitoring, performance, and operational excellence of an enterprise environment hosted exclusively on Microsoft Azure. This leader will own the strategy and operating model for SRE and observability across both Azure Infrastructure\-as\-a\-Service (IaaS) and native Azure managed services. The scope includes real\-time applications, APIs, virtual machines, containers, serverless workloads, integrations, databases, messaging platforms, data pipelines, and batch\-processing systems. The role requires a combination of enterprise leadership, Azure architecture knowledge, application\-development experience, production troubleshooting expertise, and the ability to build scalable practices that improve availability, performance, resilience, security, and customer experience. The Director will partner closely with application development, cloud infrastructure, security, architecture, data, service management, and business teams to ensure Azure\-hosted systems are observable, supportable, secure, resilient, and ready for production. At AssetMark, reliability is a first\-order expression of client obsession. Our SRE team plays a critical role in delivering the consistent, trusted technology experience that advisors depend on to run their businesses. **We can only consider candidates for this position who are able to accommodate a hybrid work schedule and are close to our Charlotte, NC office.** **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **SRE and Observability Strategy** * Define and execute an enterprise\-wide SRE and observability strategy aligned with business priorities, technology objectives, and risk\-management requirements. * Establish standards for metrics, logs, traces, events, dashboards, alerting, instrumentation, service ownership, telemetry quality, and data retention. * Develop a multi\-year roadmap for Azure observability platforms, reliability engineering, automation, resilience, and operational maturity. * Define service\-level indicators, service\-level objectives, service\-level agreements, error budgets, availability targets, latency objectives, and performance standards. * Establish operational\-readiness requirements for new applications, major releases, infrastructure changes, Azure service implementations, and third\-party integrations. * Evaluate and govern observability platforms, tools, vendors, integrations, licensing, access, security, and operating costs. * Promote consistent reliability and observability practices across Azure subscriptions, resource groups, environments, and service teams. ### **Azure Platform Reliability and Observability** * Lead reliability and observability practices across Azure IaaS and native Azure services, including virtual machines, scale sets, containers, serverless workloads, managed databases, storage, messaging, integration services, and data platforms. * Establish Azure\-native monitoring and telemetry standards using capabilities such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Azure Managed Grafana, Activity Logs, Resource Health, and Azure Service Health. * Ensure end\-to\-end visibility across application, infrastructure, platform, network, identity, security, data, and third\-party dependencies. * Define standards for Azure diagnostic settings, centralized logging, metric collection, distributed tracing, correlation IDs, alert routing, dashboard design, and telemetry retention. * Partner with cloud platform and architecture teams to improve the reliability of Azure subscriptions, management groups, networking, identity, access controls, policies, and shared services. * Ensure Azure\-hosted services are designed with appropriate availability, scalability, recoverability, monitoring, and operational support requirements. ### **Real\-Time Monitoring and Operational Excellence** * Lead the design and operation of real\-time monitoring for business\-critical applications, customer\-facing services, APIs, Azure infrastructure, databases, networks, messaging systems, and integrations. * Improve the quality, relevance, and actionability of alerts while reducing alert fatigue and unnecessary escalations. * Create executive, operational, and engineering dashboards that clearly communicate system health, business impact, trends, and emerging risks. * Establish effective on\-call, escalation, incident response, major incident management, and service\-restoration practices. * Participate in root\-cause analysis, problem management, post\-inc ngineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. **Measures of Success** ----------------------- Success in this role will include: * Improved availability, reliability, performance, and resilience of critical Azure\-hosted enterprise services. * Increased observability coverage across Azure IaaS, native Azure services, real\-time applications, integrations, and batch systems. * Faster detection, diagnosis, communication, and resolution of incidents. * Reduced alert noise, repeat incidents, manual effort, and operational risk. * Consistent adoption of SLOs, instrumentation, Azure monitoring standards, operational\-readiness requirements, and effective runbooks. * Higher batch\-processing success rates and improved on\-time completion of critical workloads. * Stronger collaboration between development, operations, cloud infrastructure, security, data, and business teams. * A mature, scalable, and high\-performing SRE and observability organization. *Compensation: The Base Salary range for this position is between $180,000\-$219,000\.* *This information reflects a base salary range that AssetMark reasonably expects to pay for the position based on a number of factors which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, education, experience, and actual work location. This position will also be eligible for additional variable incentive compensation and competitive benefits.* *Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US to be considered. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.* \#LI\-hybrid \#LI\-TN1 **Who We Are \& What We Offer:** We are AssetMark, a company on the move, shaping the future of financial services. Growth is in our DNA. Every day, we combine technology, insight, and collaboration to create new possibilities for advisors, for our people and for our investors. At AssetMark your ideas matter; they’re heard, valued, and drive meaningful change. Join a team that sets new standards and creates space for you to thrive and do your best work. **Our Mission** Our mission is simple: to help our 10,500\+ financial advisors make a meaningful difference in their clients’ lives. We do this by combining powerful technology, holistic support, and expert consulting to help advisors run stronger, more efficient businesses. Backed by a comprehensive suite of investment solutions and a trust company that boasts of $150B\+ AUM, our platform empowers advisors to deliver exceptional service and an outstanding client experience. **Our Values** Heart. Client Success. Integrity. Respect. Excellence. Our values are how we show up every day. **We believe in:** * Leading with Heart, in truly making a difference in the lives of others: teammates, clients, investors and communities. * Obsessing over Client Success, bringing a relentless focus on what matters to clients that sets us apart and creates loyal, lasting relationships. * Unyielding Integrity, doing what’s right, always. Even when it’s hard. * Collective Respect, in being authentic, inclusive and valuing all voices while winning together. * Operating with Excellence, in learning fast, continuously improving, innovating and collaborating to find new and better solutions. These values shape our culture, guide our decisions, and define what it means to be part of the AssetMark family. **Our Culture \& Benefits** Our culture brings our mission and values to life. Here, we do what’s right, embrace diverse ideas, and innovate together. We also offer a wide range of benefits to support you and your family—because thriving at work starts with thriving in life. * Flex Time or Paid Time Off and Sick Time Off * 401K – 6% Employer Match * Medical, Dental, Vision – HDHP or PPO * HSA – Employer contribution (HDHP only) * Volunteer Time Off * Career Development / Recognition * Fitness Reimbursement * Hybrid Work Schedule As an Equal Opportunity Employer, AssetMark is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued.

context dependent. * Strong understanding of trustworthy AI practices, and how to design provenance, access control, and uncertainty handling directly into a working system. * Excellent written and verbal communication across engineering, scientific, clinical, quality, and executive audiences. * Evidence of leading cross\-functional delivery through influence, including prioritization, conflict resolution, and shipping decisions under ambiguity. **Desirable Skills/Experience:** * Direct experience with clinical trial conduct, site monitoring, risk\-based monitoring, medical monitoring, platforms. * Experience designing reusable product capabilities across multiple therapeutic areas, studies, or business units. * Familiarity with observability, LLMOps/MLOps, and production monitoring for deployed AI systems, and how evaluation results feed release decisions. * Publications, patents, open\-source contributions, or a record of shipping technically differentiated AI products. Can you think big, be bold, and harness the power of digital and AI to tackle longstanding life sciences challenges? Then Evinova, a new health tech business part of the AstraZeneca Group, might be for you! Transform billions of patients’ lives through technology, data, and innovative ways of working. You’re radical, decisive, and transformative. Someone excited to use technology to improve patients’ health. We’re building a new Health\-tech business – Evinova, a fully\-owned subsidiary of AstraZeneca Group. Evinova delivers market\-leading digital health solutions that are science\-based, evidence\-led, and human experience\-driven. Thoughtful risks and quick decisions come together to accelerate innovation across the life sciences sector. Be part of a diverse team that pushes the boundaries of science by digitally empowering a deeper understanding of the patients we’re helping. Launch pioneering digital solutions that improve the patients’ experience and deliver better health outcomes. Together, we have the opportunity to combine deep scientific expertise with digital and artificial intelligence to serve the wider healthcare community and create new standards across the sector. We are in an active growth phase. Our platform is evolving quickly, our customer base is growing, and our delivery capability is scaling alongside it. We operate in a regulated environment, with sophisticated sponsor customers who have high expectations and real experience of enterprise implementation. We are building delivery capability that matches the quality of our product ambition. That means hiring great people who bring structure and who are motivated by building something, not just running it. **WHAT THE ROLE IS** As a Program Director, you own a customer account implementation program end to end — from kick\-off through go\-live and into the ongoing customer relationship. An account program may be a single workstream or several running in parallel. You are the accountable delivery lead across all of it: the customer's primary point of contact, the owner of the plan and its risks, and the person who keeps the team coordinated and on track, building the customer's confidence along the way. The program’s size and complexity, will drive the specific activities needed to be performed. Some account implementation programs will also be assigned a Project Manager. Where one is assigned, they own the day\-to\-day plan mechanics, RAID log upkeep, and status cadence for their workstream(s), freeing you to focus on the customer relationship, risk ownership, cross\-functional blocking issue, and the judgement calls that come with an evolving platform. Where no Project Manager is assigned, you run that workstream directly yourself. Either way, you hold customer account program\-level accountability — the plan, the risk, and the relationship — start to finish. This is a hands\-on role; you are close enough to the build and rollout to spot problems before they raise. Accountability does not shift at debut. Post\-go\-live, you continue to own the overall customer relationship — including quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and ongoing relationship management — while a Project Manager, where one is assigned, becomes the customer's day\-to\-day point of contact for post\-go\-live implementation needs within their workstream. This role is the engine that turns a signed contract into a live, adopted solution. You will be joining a team that is scaling. Part of this role is contributing to how we deliver — documenting what works, improving what doesn't, and helping us get better as we grow. **WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING** * Managing customer implementation programs end to end across your active portfolio — from a single workstream to several running in parallel * Owning the delivery plan, achievements, dependencies, and RAID log at the program level — actively, not administratively * Coordinating Solution Engineers, testers, Product Engineering, and, where assigned, one or more Project Managers to keep the program on track * Acting as the primary customer contact for delivery status, risk, and critical issue throughout implementation * Identifying where product development timelines or release scope create delivery risk — and managing that risk transparently with customers and internal teams * Adapting delivery approach across deployment models — forward deployed, guided, and self\-serve * Closing out hypercare cleanly: lessons captured, handover documented, no lingering post\-go\-live noise * Owning the customer relationship post\-go\-live — QBRs and ongoing relationship management — while a Project Manager, where assigned, handles day\-to\-day, post\-go\-live implementation needs within their workstream * Contributing to the delivery playbook — documenting approach, flagging gaps, helpi mbiguous and there is no established playbook to follow Customer and collaborator management * Has managed sophisticated customers with high governance standards — pharma, life sciences, or similarly regulated enterprise environments * Surfaces risk early and directly; does not manage it away to protect the relationship * Communicates delivery status, product constraints, and timeline risk honestly — including when the message is uncomfortable * Builds trust through delivery, not through reassurance Technical literacy * Technically literate enough to lead engineers, read a data model, and understand integration dependencies — without being an engineer * Comfortable engaging with Product Engineering on build sequencing, release scope, and configuration constraints * Understands how AI\-enabled product features affect implementation sequencing and data readiness * Can identify when a product gap requires partner concern and frame it clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences Ways of working * Brings structure to environments that do not yet have it — does not wait to be given a framework * Has experience demonstrating AI tooling as part of their workflow for delivery planning and project management — not an aspiration * Comfortable contributing to process development alongside live delivery * Resilient under competing pressure from customer, commercial, and product directions simultaneously Non\-negotiables * Has delivered SaaS implementations on enterprise platforms — not just managed projects within a vendor\-delivered model * Has done it while the product was evolving, not only after it stabilized * Technical literacy is active, not passive * Has worked in pharma, life sciences, or a regulated enterprise environment This role is approved for remote working. The remote designation reflects the global nature of the customer portfolio and the expectation that meaningful, high\-quality in\-person engagement with customers is a core part of how this role operates, not an occasional addition to it. The annual base pay for this position ranges from $172,466\.40 \- $258,699\.60 USD Annual. At Asurint, each member of our team plays and integral part as we work together to drive informed decisions through advanced screening solutions for fair and safe workplaces and communities. **Summary** The Business Intelligence Engineer is responsible for delivering innovative BI solutions and reliable and accurate data marts that help drive business growth and make operations more efficient. **Responsibilities** * Designs, builds, and deploys BI solutions for both internal and external customers and maintains and supports data analytics platforms. * Recognizes data trends and corrects data quality issues quickly, completely, and permanently. * Collaborates with IT peers and business partners to focus on production support, service requests, and roadmap initiatives to ensure a balanced delivery of services and solutions aligned with business objectives. * Provides support for operational systems by troubleshooting and testing (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, BI tools). * Creates database queries, stored procedures, functions, and views as needed. * Shares domain and technical expertise, providing technical mentorship and cross\-training to other peers and team members. * Maintains BI documentation and source system data mapping documentation. * Follows the software development life cycle in all development efforts. * Creates and maintains Business Intelligence documentation. * Performs continual remediation of BI systems and data structures to improve overall performance as well as data accuracy, integrity, and security. * Provides ad hoc reports as needed/identified in support of the business where self\-service is not available/possible. * Other duties as required. If you do any work\-related driving while at Asurint, a driver’s license and ability to maintain a driving record that is satisfactory to the company’s liability insurance carrier is required. * Years of relevant experience: 5 to 7 years is preferred. * Years of experience supervising: None. **Working Conditions** * The work environment involves everyday risks or discomforts that require normal safety precautions typical of offices, including the need for general safe workplace practices with office equipment and computers, avoidance of trips and falls, and observance of fire regulations. * This position is performed remotely within the United States or in an office setting in the Cleveland, Ohio headquarters, although off\-site meetings in various settings may occur. * Inside Asurint’s office environment, the noise level is usually quiet to moderate. * In a remote setting, the employee is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure work environment, for arranging the off\-site workspace in an ergonomically sound manner, and for maintaining standard Internet speeds in order to work effectively. * In a remote setting, the employee is required to ensure that all equipment and records that are the property of Asurint but have been relocated to the off\-site workplace, are maintained in a safe and secure manner and are used only for business purposes. * The schedule is generally normal Eastern Time Zone business hours (unless otherwise communicated based on position or working location), although the employee may be required to perform work, attend meetings and events before or after normal workings hours, and occasionally on weekends and evenings. * Some travel by personal automobile and a valid driver’s license may be required. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Atlas Air Worldwide. Move the World with Us!** At Atlas Air Worldwide, we're not just an airline, we're a global engine powering cargo, passenger, and leasing operations across more than 70 countries. As a leader in outsourced aviation logistics, we're built on a foundation of **safety**, **service excellence**, **integrity**, **innovation**, **teamwork**, and **responsibility**. With over 30 years of history, a modern all\-Boeing fleet, and nearly 5,000 teammates collaborating across operations, technical, and corporate functions, we're driven by purpose. **If you're ready to grow, innovate, and help us deliver excellence every single day, you belong here.** **Position Summary:** Atlas Air is seeking a Data Engineer to join our Data Platform and Engineering team. This is an early\-career individual contributor role for an engineer who can deliver well\-defined data solutions with guidance, build strong engineering fundamentals, and grow ownership over increasingly complex work. As we continue to build our data environment on Databricks, you will help build and operate reliable data pipelines, transformations, and data models. You will work within established architecture and standards, partner with more experienced engineers, and author production\-quality code that supports analytics, data science, AI/ML, and operational decision\-making. **Major Accountabilities:** **Data Pipeline Development** * Build, test, deploy, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines for structured and semi\-structured data sources using established patterns and frameworks. * Develop data transformations that convert source data into accurate, documented, and reusable datasets. * Implement data models and data products based on defined business requirements and technical designs. * Use Databricks, Spark, orchestration tools, and cloud services to complete scoped engineering work with support from senior team members. * Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality, maintainability, and performance. **Data Quality \& Operations** * Create automated tests, validation checks, logging, and monitoring the pipelines and datasets you develop. * Investigate data quality, reliability, and performance issues; resolve routine issues independently and escalate broader problems appropriately. * Produce clear technical documentation, including data definitions, lineage, runbooks, and support notes. * Participate in the team's on\-call and incident response practices, with appropriate guidance and escalation support. * Follow established security, privacy, governance, and access control requirements. **Collaboration \& Growth** * Work with Data Analytics, Data Science, Software Engineering, IT, Security, and business partners to clarify requirements and deliver fit\-for\-purpose solutions. * Break defined requirements into engineering tasks, communicate progress and risks, and deliver work within agreed timelines. * Contribute to team standards for source control, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and operational readiness. * Learn the Atlas Air business domain and use that understanding to improve the usefulness and reliability of data products. * Seek feedback, share knowledge, and progressively take ownership of larger components and less\-defined problems. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent practical experience. * Minimum 1 year of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related field. * Working proficiency in SQL and at least one general\-purpose programming language (e.g., Python, TypeScript, Rust, Java, C\+\+, etc.). * Experience building or supporting data pipelines, transformations, or data models in a professional, internship, academic, or substantial project setting. * Familiarity with core data engineering concepts, including ETL/ELT, relational data modeling, data quality testing, and pipeline orchestration. * Experience with Git\-based development practices and an understanding of code review, automated testing, and deployment workflows. * Ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical partners. **Desired Qualifications:** * Hands\-on exposure to Databricks, Apache Spark, or another distributed data\-processing platform. * Experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework and an orchestration tool such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster. * Familiarity with one major cloud platform and its data services: AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Exposure to streaming or event\-driven technologies such as Kafka, Kinesis, Spark Structured Streaming, or Flink. * Familiarity with BI, data science, or machine learning workflows and the data products that support them. * Experience in aviation, transportation, logistics, or another operationally complex industry. At **Atlas Air Worldwide**, we believe in the power of people, the promise of innovation, and the responsibility we hold to each other, to our customers, and to the planet. Join us and be part of a team that lifts more than cargo; we lift ambition.

jobs.title: Software Validation Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description **Your role** ------------- The Software Validation Engineer is responsible for product validation execution as well as planning with directions from customer/key account management teams. The work focuses on software integration, hardware functionality testing, feature validation, and interfacing with controls infrastructure including robotics and PLC systems. **Your day\-to\-day** --------------------- * Lead validation strategy and execution for joining, dispense, and vision products. * Collaborate with global and local product teams to plan validation for launches. * Develop validation plans, test matrices, criteria, setups, and schedules. * Configure and troubleshoot robotic, PLC, controls, vision, dispense, joining, and signal interfaces. * Perform functional, performance, reliability, interface, fault\-recovery, and customer testing. * Analyze test data; document methods, results, risks, conclusions, and recommendations. * Resolve product issues via root cause analysis and retesting. * Translate customer needs into feedback for development and engineering. * Create system references, validation reports, standard work, and lessons learned. * Support equipment portfolios, test assets, lab capabilities, and best practices. * Coordinate validation with customers and teams on readiness, equipment, software, and safety. * Maintain safe, organized test environments per site and company policies. * Provide hands\-on setup, programming, integration, troubleshooting, testing, and data collection. * Plan validation, coordinate stakeholders, review risks, schedule, and track readiness. * Analyze data, follow up on issues, investigate root causes, and report conclusions. * Engage in continuous learning across joining, dispense, vision, robotics, PLC, controls, and connectivity. **Your skills and experience** ------------------------------ Required: * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, mechatronics, automation, robotics, controls engineering, manufacturing engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience. * Experience developing and executing test plans, validation specifications, acceptance criteria, and technical reports. * Experience with industrial robotics and/or PLC controls. Experience with both is strongly preferred. * Experience integrating or troubleshooting automated equipment in an OEM, Tier supplier, industrial manufacturing, systems integration, or laboratory environment. * Ability to verify hardware and software performance against customer requirements, standards, and specifications. Preferred: * Automotive body shop, general assembly, battery, aerospace, or other advanced manufacturing automation experience. * Experience with fastening or joining systems, industrial dispensing equipment and materials, and/or machine vision systems. * Experience with robot brands, PLC platforms, industrial networks, safety circuits, traceability, data collection, and manufacturing interfaces. * Working knowledge of electrical controls, schematics, digital and analog I/O, sensors, actuators, field signals, interlocks, and industrial communications. * Knowledge of material characteristics and process variables relevant to adhesive, sealant, or other dispense applications. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you. Apply now **Uniting curious minds** ------------------------- Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we are uniting curious minds, and you could be one of them. Information at a Glance Atlas Copco delivers innovative products and solutions that help businesses grow and drive progress. Our portfolio spans compressed air and gas systems and treatment, vacuum solutions, industrial power tools, assembly systems, and power and flow solutions. We bring a commitment to long\-term success built on expertise, reliable service, and uptime. When you level up to the Atlas Copco experience you enter a partnership based on quality, sustainability, and ease of collaboration. The technology we bring, and the decades of experience support the future\-proofing of your business. Atlas Copco is a brand within Atlas Copco Group. Visit the Atlas Copco website **Uniting curious minds** ------------------------- Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we are uniting curious minds, and you could be one of them. jobs.title: Principal AI Developer Experience Engineer
jobs.description: At Atom Computing, we build quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped neutral atoms that will empower customers to achieve unprecedented computational breakthroughs. Join a world\-class team of scientists, engineers, and business professionals to advance the state\-of\-the\-art in quantum computing. Atom Computing is seeking a Principal AI Developer Experience Engineer to improve how our physicists and engineers use AI in their daily work. You will set best practices for AI\-assisted engineering and build shared tooling that lets teams quickly adopt new AI\-driven workflows. You will also influence product architecture to broaden where LLM\-driven workflows apply, including areas where hardware, timing, or reliability requirements have typically called for conventional methods. This role’s aim is to accelerate work in experiment analysis, optics development, PCB and FPGA design, and quantum control software (C\+\+/Rust) development. Due to the need to engineer physical systems, the role will be on\-site in Boulder, CO at least 3 days per week. ### **Responsibilities** * Define, document, and maintain best practices for AI\-assisted coding, testing, code review, and research workflows. * Influence guidelines for using LLMs on performance\-critical software, including embedded C\+\+ and Rust, RTOS applications, and kernel device drivers: where AI assistance is appropriate, how generated code is reviewed and tested, and how memory safety, timing, and determinism are verified before merge. * Make forward\-looking electronics architecture improvements to our AI tooling and integrations so they keep pace with advances in models and agents and with shifts in engineers' tool preferences, and track industry benchmarks for AI\-assisted developer productivity so our practices stay current. * Build ways to measure the output of AI and LLM\-driven workflows, such as defect and revert rates of AI\-assisted changes, review findings, test coverage, performance regressions, new capabilities added, and time saved, and use the results to refine tools and guidelines. * Ensure safe and reliable operation of AI in quantum processors. ### **Experience \& Education** * Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Artificial Intelligence * 8\+ years of software development ### **Qualifications** * Strong software engineering skills in Python, and experience writing embedded software in C\+\+ or Rust, including manual memory management, hard real\-time constraints, and kernel device driver implementation. * Influencing an organization of \> 50 engineers using AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot) on a daily basis, identifying pitfalls and measuring impact. * Working knowledge of how LLMs behave in practice: context management, prompting, agentic workflows, harnesses, effective safety practices, tool use, and judging output quality. * Clear written and spoken communication with audiences ranging from physicists to new software hires. An ability to influence a multi\-discipline engineering organization. Atom Computing provides a wide variety of perks and benefits, including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees and their dependents. Additionally, unlimited paid time off, 401K company matching, short\- and long\-term disability, FSA, dependent care benefits, and life insurance. We also offer drinks, snacks, and catered team lunches in our offices, every day! The base salary range for this position is between $170,000 \- $200,000, commensurate with experience. In addition to salary, we offer an annual bonus and equity in the company. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
