jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Core Services
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. ### **Who We Are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly to make transportation safer, increasingly accessible, and more reliable and efficient than ever before. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you'll solve massively complex problems alongside other passionate, smart people, growing as an expert while broadening your field of knowledge. For Aurora’s latest news, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are excited about building the future of transportation that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient \& accessible for all. We are searching for an exceptional Backend Software Engineer to join the Aurora Services Engineering team and take on a critical role in building Aurora's suite of fleet management tools. The Aurora Services Engineering org creates full\-stack solutions including backend services, web apps, mobile apps, and real\-time onboard code that enable commercial operation of autonomous vehicle fleets at scale. Our mission is to build the software that drives the commercial side of our platform such as assigning work to autonomous vehicles, providing remote support, managing a fleet of vehicles, and receiving orders from customers. As Aurora prepares to massively scale its fleet and integrate with partners on an API level, the tools we build are critical to the efficient daily operation of our business. We are looking for a Software Engineer II to join the Core Services team under Aurora Services. You will help the Aurora Services Org to build the new asset management solution to scale up the autonomous vehicles fleet. ### **In this role, you will** * Design complex systems from the ground up. Partnering closely with Software, Hardware and infrastructure engineering teams. * Partner with Product Managers, Designers and Operation Stakeholders to deliver the benefit of Self Driving Vehicles quickly, safely and broadly. * Design, implement and maintain a micro\-services running in the Aurora’s AWS cloud used to monitor and manage the entire Aurora Self Driving Fleet. * Design, implement the fleet management solution and the vehicle communication system. * Establish technology and infrastructure to scale our products with high availability and reliability. * Contribute and evolve our team culture around mentorship, feedback,collaboration, and engineering excellence. ### **You will be a good fit if you have** * 2 or more years of experience in building backend services. * Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field. * Experience with web communication protocols, including REST, gRPC and GraphQL. * Experience with building large scale, high concurrent, high throughput and safety critical backend services. * Phenomenal communication skills. We build software with people and for people. You know how to write an effective technical spec, provide feedback to others, translate technical concepts into lay terms, and incorporate feedback into your efforts. You value and practice openness, empathy, kindness, and collaboration. * A preference for action. You will use good judgment to balance speed and quality. You will deliver products that are built in a responsible and sustainable way. You will use a self\-starter mentality to thrive in a growing environment where all hands are on deck, and consider no obstacle too big or too small. You will notice where there is a need and will hustle to fill it. * The drive to make teams stronger. You're excited to work hard and fast to the finish line on new opportunities with a collaborative and integrated team. You will be proactive in engaging conflict with openness, patience and kindness in an environment where it is safe to lean on each other and learn from failures. * Motivation to own the product lifecycle end to end. You’re happy to engage with our product and design teams and our internal customers to understand their needs and find ways to meet them. You ensure that product development stays on course all the way through release and post\-release support. ### **Desirable Experience** * Experience with autonomous vehicle development. * Experience with IoT, real time communication between devices and cloud. * Experience with application release strategies such as feature flagging, A/B testing and canary release. * Experience with observability and monitoring of safety critical systems. * Experience with fleet management solutions for Robots, Vehicles or Aerial Drones. * Experience with external customer facing software including production rollout with real customers. * Experience with safety and mission critical applications. *For roles based in Mountain View, CA:* The salary range for this position is $139,000 \- $223,000 per year. *For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA:* The salary range for this position is $126,000 \- $201,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. **Working at Aurora** At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in\-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in\-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs. Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom. **Our commitment to safety** At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best\-in\-class self\-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long\-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what. **Our commitment to inclusion** Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech. *For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.*

jobs.title: Senior Process Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Process Engineer (Pharma) **Location:** Mason, OH (preferred); open to consideration for opportunities in Oak Brook, IL, and Cedar Rapids, IA. **Your Role at BSI** Our Process Engineers design safe, compliant, and economic manufacturing systems for regulated drug product and drug substance manufacturing. You will work capital projects from concept through startup for clients producing oral solid dosage forms, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), drug products, and nutraceutical and consumer health products. We design for patient safety, product quality, contamination control, throughput, regulatory compliance (FDA 21 CFR Parts 210/211 and current Good Manufacturing Practice, or cGMP), and total installed cost. To support collaboration, mentorship opportunities, and effective project execution, BSI Engineering has adopted a hybrid work schedule in which employees are in the office a minimum of three days per week. **Responsibilities and Scope** * Lead site visits, walk\-downs, and existing\-condition surveys in operating cGMP facilities, including cleanroom classification assessments and utility capacity verification. * Develop discipline scope, deliverables, assumptions, and estimated budget for proposals across greenfield, brownfield, capacity\-expansion, and technology\-transfer projects. * Develop and review User Requirement Specifications (URS), Basis of Design (BOD), and Process Design Basis reports that capture client requirements and regulatory expectations in a single controlled document. * Create Block Flow Diagrams (BFDs), Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping \& Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs), and Mass \& Energy Balances (M\&EBs) for process, clean utility, and support systems. * Design and specify clean utilities including PW, WFI, clean steam, process gases, and CIP/SIP systems, with attention to loop hydraulics, dead\-leg control, sanitization, and material of construction and surface finish requirements. * Develop process descriptions, contamination control strategy input, cross\-contamination and segregation strategies, and regulatory and client compliance documentation. * Perform equipment sizing, prepare specifications, prepare technical bid evaluations (TBEs), review vendor submittals and 3D models, and maintain equipment lists. Equipment scope routinely includes reactors, TFF systems, fillers, dryers (tray, vacuum, fluid bed, and lyophilizers), granulators, tablet presses, coaters, blenders, mills, isolators and Restricted Access Barrier Systems (RABS), autoclaves, parts washers, CIP/SIP skids, transfer panels, and clean utility generation and distribution. * Coordinate process requirements with piping, mechanical, HVAC, electrical, automation, architectural, structural, and project management disciplines, including review of cleanroom layouts, pressure cascades, and construction documents for process intent. * Perform process calculations using BSI spreadsheets and commercial software (e.g., PIPE\-FLO for hydraulics); perform process simulation where applicable. * Prepare process safety studies, relief calculations, code review studies and Occupancy reports, and Hazardous Area Classification (HAC) reviews and drawings for solvent\-handling and API operations. Participate in Process Hazard Analyses (PHAs) and Dust Hazard Analyses (DHAs). * Develop facility and equipment layouts consistent with cleanroom classification, unidirectional personnel and material flow, airlock strategy, closed\-system processing, and containment requirements. * Write process functional descriptions, operating procedures, and CIP/SIP sequences to support automation design and qualification. * Develop and execute Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs) and Site Acceptance Tests (SATs); support commissioning and qualification (C\&Q) including Installation, Operational, and Performance Qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) protocol development, execution support, discrepancy resolution, and turnover package review. * Lead or independently support construction, startup, with minimal disruption to adjacent operating production. * Interface directly with clients, quality and validation groups, contractors, equipment vendors, and project management. * Manage assigned discipline scope, schedule, budget, and change\-order identification. * Maintain workload forecasts for process engineering staff on assigned projects. * Mentor less experienced engineers and provide training on cGMP design, clean utilities, and contamination control fundamentals. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor of Science in Chemical, Biochemical, or Mechanical Engineering. * 10\+ years of process engineering experience, with a substantial portion in pharmaceutical, API, or other cGMP\-regulated manufacturing. * Demonstrated process design experience in a regulated cGMP environment spanning feasibility and conceptual design through detailed design and construction support, including working knowledge of 21 CFR Parts 210/211, FDA expectations for facility, utility, and equipment design, and how design decisions drive qualification effort (URS, Design Qualification, FAT/SAT, IQ/OQ/PQ, process validation). * Strong understanding of fundamentals in chemistry, fluid dynamics, heat and mass transfer, material and energy balances, and unit operations and separations relevant to pharmaceutical manufacturing, including drying, filtration, mixing, size reduction, and separation processes. * Ability to visit project job sites to gather field information. Typical travel duration is up to 7 days, several times per year. **Desired Qualifications** * Professional Engineer (PE) license. * Direct project experience in oral solid dosage, sterile fill\-finish, API and both small \& large molecule, or nutraceutical facilities. * Knowledge of reaction kinetics, crystallization, and distillation as applied to API and drug substance manufacturing. * Knowledge of ASME BPE (Bioprocessing Equipment) and ASME B31\.3 (Process Piping). * Knowledge of ASME BPVC Section VIII Div 1 for pressure vessel design. * Familiarity with ISPE Baseline Guides, including Vol. 1 (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients), Vol. 2 (Oral Solid Dosage Forms), Vol. 4 (Water and Steam Systems), Vol. 5 (Commissioning and Qualification), and Vol. 7 (Risk\-Based Manufacture of Pharmaceutical Products). * Familiarity with International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) guidelines Q7, Q8, Q9, and Q10, and with ISO 14644 cleanroom classification. * Knowledge of NFPA Standards applicable to pharmaceutical manufacturing, including NFPA 30, 68, 69, 70, 497, 499, and 660\. * Familiarity with API 520/521/2000 for relief systems, and OSHA Process Safety Management (29 CFR 1910\.119\) where covered chemicals apply. * Experience with closed\-system and single\-use technology strategies and their impact on facility classification and layout. * Experience with containment design, Occupational Exposure Band and Occupational Exposure Limit (OEB/OEL) banding, and highly potent API handling. * Familiarity with hydraulic modeling (e.g., PIPE\-FLO) and process modeling software (e.g., Aspen Plus, ProSim, CHEMCAD). * Experience developing scope, estimating hours, and scheduling professional labor for capital projects. **What We Offer** * Competitive base salary * Generous bonus programs * Paid Parental Leave * PTO and Paid Holidays * Paid overtime * 401(k) with matching * Health, Dental, and Vision * Paid Charitable Effort Time * Tuition Reimbursement * Flexible Telecommuting Policy **Our Values:** Be Inspiring Be Invested Be Improving Be Innovative Be Impactful Be Involved Be In Demand **Who We Are** Our Purpose: Creating Solutions, Improving Lives. BSI lives by the mantra “Serve the client, satisfy the employee” and we hold true to it in all aspects of our company. Our employees have consistently voted us a Top Workplace, commenting specifically on our dedication to company culture, employee appreciation, and employee well\-being. Founded in memory of a friend, BSI carries on the legacy of Bryan Speicher, who had a vision to create a company that gives back to its employees and community. Our founding president, Phil Beirne, helped cultivate this legacy, and Beirne \& Speicher Inspired continues to grow and succeed. At the heart of it all, we are our people, and we are grateful that you are considering a career with BSI Engineering.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Berry Street is building on the convergence of AI, GLP\-1s, and the consumerization of healthcare — while leveraging insurance to make life\-changing metabolic care as accessible as possible for all. Our platform connects patients with 2,000\+ clinicians and AI tools to treat obesity, diabetes/prediabetes, cardiovascular disease, kidney disease, maternal health, and dozens of other chronic and acute conditions, working with major health plans, health systems, and care management companies across all 50 states. We launched in 2023, have served hundreds of thousands of patients, and are Series B — backed by investors like Khosla, Northzone, FJ Labs, and the founders of Revolut, Grow Therapy, and Spring Health. The Role This is a founding\-caliber engineering role. You'll work directly with our founder and leadership team to build the AI\-native infrastructure and consumer experiences you’ve always wished existed in healthcare. You'll be one of a small number of engineers shaping how the system scales from hundreds of thousands of patients in the US to millions across the globe. We move fast. What you ship today will affect real patients and providers tomorrow. That's the job. AI is at the core of everything we build, both internally and externally. What You’ll Work On* Architect and ship AI\-native systems from the ground up: autonomous clinical agents, LLM\-powered workflows that replace manual processes, intelligent tools that make dietitians dramatically more effective and help us prescribe and monitor GLP\-1s at scale * Build the infrastructure that makes AI reliable in a clinical setting: evaluation pipelines, guardrails, feedback loops, the unglamorous stuff that makes the difference between a demo and a product * Set technical direction on our platform, making architectural calls that shape how Berry Street scales from tens of thousands of patients to millions * Own features end\-to\-end across provider\- and patient\-facing surfaces, from scoping and architecture through to production * Be a force multiplier for the engineering team: raise the bar on code quality, tooling, and practices without slowing anyone down * Work directly with our patients and providers to deeply understand what they actually need and translate that into systems that hold up at scale **Requirements** * **5\+ years of engineering experience.** You've built and maintained production systems at scale. You've made hard architectural calls and lived with the consequences — good and bad. * **AI\-led, not AI\-assisted.** We're not looking for someone who uses Cursor / Claude Code / Codex to autocomplete slop faster. We're looking for someone who thinks about how to architect AI\-driven architecture from the ground up: autonomous systems that do things that weren't possible two quarters ago. You've shipped something in this space, you have opinions about where it's going, and you're already building for that future. * **A product brain.** You think about users, not just systems. You push back when a spec doesn't make sense and offer better alternatives. You NEED to understand the ‘why’. * **Full\-stack, back\-end leaning.** You're comfortable across the stack but strongest on the platform and API side. You know our stack well: React, Next.js, NestJS, TypeORM, PostgreSQL, AWS. TailwindCSS and TypeScript are not intimidating. * **An ownership mindset.** You take a project from "vague idea" to "shipped and working" without needing someone to hand\-hold you through the middle. You flag problems early, drive decisions, and follow through * **A bias for speed.** You understand the difference between moving fast and cutting corners, and understand when situations call for one or the other. Our Tech Stack* React \& React Native * TypeScript * Next.js / NestJS * TailwindCSS * TypeORM * PostgreSQL * AWS **Benefits** * Competitive base salary * Generous equity package * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Unlimited dietitian and GLP\-1 care * 401k with match * Generous PTO * In\-office, Madison Square Park * Citibike and One Medical memberships

jobs.title: Help Desk Specialist
jobs.description: **Important Notice for Applicants:** At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor\-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included. Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. **Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?** If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at talent@bixal.com and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays. ### **Why Bixal?** Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence\-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement. **Our values:** * **People\-First**: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work. * **Collaboration and Transparency**: Valuing teamwork and open communication. * **Growth Mindset**: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement. * **Creating Lasting Impact**: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change. **About the role:** Bixal is seeking a Help Desk Specialist to be the first point of contact for users of a federal platform that supports governmentwide regulatory planning and review. Federal agencies, oversight offices, and the public rely on these systems, which must stay available 24/7/365 while a modern replacement is built alongside them. You will provide both Tier 1 and Tier 2 support, diagnosing and resolving issues directly, from access and account problems to errors inside complex, role\-based regulatory workflows, and escalating to engineering only when a fix requires a code or infrastructure change. You will also be the team's early\-warning system: spotting patterns in tickets that point to defects, escalating outages immediately, and feeding what users experience back to the engineering team. As new capabilities are released on the modernized platform, you will support users through each change, so we're looking for an experienced support professional who can work independently across both a legacy system and a new one. This role is technical and service\-oriented. You will work closely with our engineers, trainers, and change enablement lead, and with client stakeholders who depend on fast, accurate support. This is a full\-time position on an awarded contract with a 12\-month base period and two 12\-month option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human\-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose\-driven culture and prepares you for future success. ##### **Location** This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship. ##### **Compensation:** The salary range for this role is $90,000 – $110,000\. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate. **Responsibilities:** ***User Support \& Issue Resolution*** * Serve as the first point of contact for agency and oversight office users by web, phone, and email, providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 support and resolving technical, access, account, and process issues directly whenever possible. * Triage, categorize, and log every incident and service request in Zendesk, including requestor, description, time logged, and time to resolve. * Meet contractual service levels: an initial tailored response to 95% of tickets within 3 business hours, and resolution or escalation of 98% within 1 business day. * Handle user access and authorization requests, login issues, and questions about workflows, roles, and system status. * Investigate complex issues using application logs, database queries, and system monitoring tools, and escalate those that need engineering support with clear reproduction steps, root\-cause findings, and user impact. ***Monitoring, Escalation \& Reporting*** * Monitor incoming tickets for patterns that suggest widespread issues or defects, and flag systemic problems to the engineering team. * Report outages and serious issues immediately to the technical team by phone and email, especially those affecting public availability, system performance, or data integrity. * Produce weekly and ad hoc help desk reports covering ticket volume, response and resolution times by priority, and trends. * Feed recurring user pain points into the product backlog as inputs for future fixes and enhancements. ***User Enablement \& Release Support*** * Create and update targeted help content, including online tips, FAQs, and user guide updates. * Support training materials and workshops in partnership with the training and change enablement leads. * Support users through each new release on the modernized platform, answering questions and capturing early feedback. * Help maintain help desk procedures, ticket categories, and knowledge base content as systems change. * Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. * At least 4 years of experience providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support for enterprise\-level web applications, including complex, workflow\-driven or role\-based systems. * Demonstrated experience resolving issues independently through Tier 2 troubleshooting, and knowing when and how to escalate to engineering teams. * Hands\-on experience with Zendesk or a comparable ticketing system (such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management), including ticket categorization, workflow configuration, and reporting. * Experience consistently meeting defined service\-level agreements for response and resolution times. * Working knowledge of SQL and application log analysis to investigate and diagnose user\-reported issues. * Strong troubleshooting skills across user access and permissions, browser, application, and integration issues, with the ability to document root causes and reproduction steps for engineers. * Experience analyzing support data to identify trends and systemic defects, and turning findings into clear reports and recommendations. * Experience writing user\-facing help content, FAQs, or knowledge base articles. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a patient, professional approach to supporting users of varied technical backgrounds, including senior government stakeholders. * This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract. **Nice to Have Skills and Experience:** * ITIL Foundation or CompTIA A\+ certification. * Experience supporting federal agency users or a federal help desk. * Familiarity with federal regulatory processes, such as rulemaking, the Unified Agenda, or Paperwork Reduction Act information collections. * Experience supporting applications built on Java and Oracle, or similar enterprise technology stacks. * Experience supporting users through a system migration or the rollout of a new platform. * Familiarity with accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG) for user\-facing content. **How We Support Our Team:** * Flex hours * 401K with matching incentive * Parental Leave * Medical/dental/vision benefits * Flex Spending Account * Company provided short\-term disability and life insurance * Commuter benefits * Paid Time Off (PTO) * 11 Paid holidays Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti\-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

jobs.title: Field CTO – Mainframe Modernization
jobs.description: Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start\-ups. **Our Culture** --------------- **Who we are:** Led by two pioneering co\-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500\. **How we work:** * **We move Blitzy Fast:** Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally. * **Championship Mindset:** We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in\-person, and remaining focused on the mission. * **Passion for Invention:** We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration. * **We Work for the Customer:** We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships. **About the Role** ------------------ Blitzy is looking for an exceptional Field CTO with deep mainframe expertise to help solve one of enterprise technology’s hardest problems: making decades of mission\-critical software understandable, transformable, and ultimately capable of continuous evolution. Mainframes have earned their reputation for extraordinary reliability. Modernizing them responsibly requires much more than translating COBOL. It requires understanding and preserving the intricate relationships among business logic, data, transaction processing, concurrency, recovery, and operational behavior, while removing the architectural constraints that make change so difficult and expensive. Blitzy already reverse\-engineers and transforms complex enterprise software at extraordinary scale, including mainframe applications. Our platform has demonstrated the ability to understand codebases exceeding 30 million lines in days, and modernization programs are underway at Fortune 500 financial institutions. Our ambition goes further. We want to progressively turn the hardest challenges of enterprise modernization into automated software capabilities, making each successive transformation faster, safer, and less dependent on scarce specialist expertise. We are looking for someone who combines the depth of a world\-class mainframe architect with the curiosity and imagination of a builder. Someone who respects why these systems work, understands where conventional modernization approaches fall short, and wants to help invent a fundamentally better way. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Mainframe Architecture and Modernization** * Serve as a senior technical authority on mainframe systems, application and data architectures, transaction processing, and operational resilience. * Lead the architectural understanding of how application logic, data models, transaction boundaries, batch workloads, and runtime behavior interact across complex mainframe estates, ensuring modernization preserves system\-level correctness rather than merely functional equivalence. * Work with customers’ most experienced architects to design target\-state architectures that preserve business logic, concurrency, recovery, and operational guarantees. * Guide decisions about what to translate, rearchitect, or retain, minimizing migration risk and protecting operational continuity. **Platform and Offering Evolution** * Partner with Blitzy’s engineering, product, partnerships, and sales teams to improve how the platform discovers, transforms, and validates complex applications. * Identify the most difficult and recurring challenges in mainframe modernization and work with engineering to turn their solutions into automated, reusable platform capabilities, progressively reducing the need for specialized human intervention. * Help extend Blitzy’s World Model to capture relationships among business logic, application behavior, data, and runtime dependencies, creating a richer foundation for automated transformation and validation. * Develop reusable validation approaches, reference architectures, and scalable service offerings; strengthen testing of functional equivalence, transactional integrity, and operational resilience. * Explore emerging AI and autonomous engineering approaches with curiosity and technical rigor, making each successive migration easier. **Customer and Executive Leadership** * Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, engineering leaders, and senior mainframe specialists, communicating credibly at both architectural and executive levels. * Lead technical discovery, architecture reviews, workshops, proofs of concept, and technical validation for complex modernization opportunities. * Help customers articulate pragmatic long\-term visions, connecting architecture choices to business outcomes, cost, risk, and strategic flexibility. * Work closely with Partnerships, Enterprise Sales, AI Solutions Consultants, and Customer Success to support customer decisions, adoption, and expansion. **Strategic Partner Engagement** * Serve as a senior technical counterpart to cloud providers, global systems integrators, and specialist modernization partners. * Build relationships with partner CTOs, distinguished engineers, architects, and delivery leaders; establish confidence in Blitzy’s technical approach. * Co\-design joint solutions, reference architectures, technical validation frameworks, and repeatable delivery methods partners can take to enterprise customers. * Support joint workshops and customer engagements, bringing implementation insights back into Blitzy’s product and service roadmap. **Technical and Market Leadership** * Help define Blitzy’s long\-term technical vision for mainframe modernization, challenging conventional approaches and identifying opportunities to fundamentally change how complex enterprise systems are understood, transformed, and operated. * Contribute technical thought leadership through executive conversations, partner engagement, and selected industry forums. * Promote practical problem\-solving, technical rigor, intellectual curiosity, and continuous learning. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Deep, hands\-on knowledge of IBM Z and z/OS, including technologies such as CICS, Db2, IMS, JCL, VSAM, Parallel Sysplex, RACF, MQ, and batch scheduling, with particular depth in several of these areas. * Demonstrated ability to reason about complex mainframe application behavior, data dependencies, transaction integrity, concurrency, recovery, and security—not simply COBOL syntax or hardware. * Strong understanding of modern distributed systems, cloud architectures, and enterprise modernization, including tradeoffs involved in translating mainframe behavior into modern environments. * Experience solving difficult technical problems in mission\-critical enterprise systems and turning insights into practical modernization plans. * Ability to earn the confidence of experienced systems engineers and senior technology executives alike. * Passion for technology, customer outcomes, building better Through the BrainOS® Robotics Platform, which powers the largest global fleet of the Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) in operation in commercial public spaces, Brain Corp delivers insightful and efficient automated solutions in both commercial floor cleaning and inventory management, empowering organizations and their employees to achieve more. Brain Corp currently powers more than 50,000 AMRs, representing the largest fleet of its kind in the world. Brain Corp is funded by the SoftBank Vision Fund, Clearbridge, and Qualcomm Ventures. This includes ownership of the Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL), telemetry systems, and core C\+\+ middleware.This role is highly hands\-on and strategic, driving the re\-architecture of foundational robotics software to improve modularity, scalability, and performance. telemetry and replay systems, improving observability, reliability, and data quality * Lead the migration of middleware components from Python to high\-performance C\+\+ implementations * Architect cameras, and IMUs * Optimize system performance across the robotics stack, including latency, throughput, memory usage, and CPU efficiency * Collaborate closely with hardware, apps, autonomy, and QA teams to ensure seamless system integration and deployment * Establish and enforce best practices in software design, code quality, testing, and documentation * Provide technical mentorship and leadership to engineers, guiding design reviews and complex debugging efforts * Contribute hands\-on code to critical components while balancing long\-term architectural improvements * Drive continuous improvement of development workflows, testing strategies, and system reliability **Education and/or Work Experience Requirements**: * Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, hardware abstraction layers (HAL) * Demonstrated experience leading complex technical initiatives or driving architectural changes in production systems **Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and tooling, and system integration * Deep understanding of hardware abstraction layers and low\-level system design * Hands\-on experience integrating sensors such as LiDARs, cameras, and IMUs into production systems * Strong experience with Linux\-based development environments (e.g., Ubuntu) * Experience designing and developing middleware systems or inter\-process communication frameworks * This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants hands\-on experience across the full stack, from desktop UI to backend services. **How You Will Contribute:** * Analyze Arrowhead business processes and requirements. * Make decisions regarding the implementation and creation of software. * Perform maintenance of existing software, with bug fixes and enhancements. * Design, code and maintain software applications using .NET, Entity Framework, Angular, Javascript, HTML, CSS, XML, XSL, and SQL. * Design, build, and maintain WPF desktop applications using the MVVM pattern. * Write and optimize MS SQL queries, stored procedures, and database schemas. * Develop and support .NET web applications and REST APIs. * Troubleshoot basic networking and connectivity issues across environments. * Collaborate using Git workflows including feature branching, pull requests, and code review. * Contribute to and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated builds and deployments. * Participate in sprint planning, code reviews, and team knowledge\-sharing sessions. * Utilize Agentic development to implement and troubleshoot systems. **Skills \& Experience to be Successful:** * High level of independent thinking, analysis, and issue resolution skills. Example: A Software Engineer will make decisions regarding the automation of a particular software process. A Software Engineer will make decisions regarding names of software components, a vital factor in the readability and maintainability of software. * Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. * Ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals. * Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients and customers. * Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. * Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. **Teammate Benefits \& Total Well\-Being** We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well\-being of our teammates, including: * *Health Benefits*: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance * *Financial Benefits*: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement * *Mental Health \& Wellness*: Free Mental Health \& Enhanced Advocacy Services * *Beyond Benefits*: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more. *Not reflective of all benefits. Benefit details and offerings may vary for subsidiary entities or in specific geographic locations.* **Recruiting Vendor Disclosure Statement** Brown \& Brown does not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiters, recruitment vendors or employment agencies ("Recruiting Vendors"). Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Brown \& Brown or its employees become the property of Brown \& Brown, and no fees will be paid for such submissions. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description: **Compensation:** $130,000\-$160,000 per year **Location:** United States – Remote or Omaha, NE \- Hybrid **The job:** As a Senior Data Engineer\-Data Platform at Buildertrend, you'll lead the migration of our data platform onto a modern Databricks lakehouse built on dbt, replacing today's patchwork of legacy systems with a single, reliable source of truth. You'll design the pipelines that bring in data from tools like Salesforce, SQL Server and Gong, turning it into curated, trustworthy datasets that teams across the business, and the AI tools built on top of them, can rely on without double\-checking the numbers. Your work directly cuts down on the manual firefighting that eats into engineering time today, and sets the technical standards other engineers will build on for years. **What you will do:** * Design, build and maintain Buildertrend's Databricks lakehouse using a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) architecture in dbt, and set the layer standards, naming conventions and build rules other engineers follow. * Build ELT pipelines with Databricks, dbt and Fivetran that bring in data from SQL Server, Salesforce, MongoDB, Gong, OpenTelemetry and vendors like Zonda, turning it into curated, analytics\- and AI\-ready datasets. * Lead the exit from legacy systems like BigQuery, Data Fusion and Cloud Fusion by refactoring pipelines rather than copying them over as\-is, untangling circular dependencies, and repointing tools like Tableau to the new platform with clear owners and deadlines. * Strengthen reliability by improving SQL Server log\-ship replication and Fivetran ingestion, and by building automation like auto\-recovery, full\-refresh jobs and watchdog orchestration that cuts down on manual fixes and outages. * Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring and quality metrics using dbt tests, Unity Catalog and Fivetran metadata, so stakeholders can trust the numbers without double\-checking them. * Design access controls for large datasets, including permission models, per\-team clusters, service principals and scoped access for AI tools, and handle privacy requests through tools like DataGrail to meet CCPA requirements. * Set up data contracts with product engineering so upstream schema changes don't silently break the warehouse, and write documentation (data dictionary, ERDs, spec docs, column notes) clear enough for people and AI tools to use. * Build and improve the curated data products that let stakeholders and customers turn raw data into decisions. * Partner with data science, machine learning and AI teams to build and curate the datasets their models and experiments depend on, alongside the broader data products that help stakeholders and customers turn raw data into decisions. * Partner with engineers, analysts, business leaders and other stakeholders to prioritize work, manage dependencies and deliver meaningful platform improvements. * Mentor other engineers, contribute to architectural decisions, evaluate emerging technologies and grow toward a technical leadership role while using AI thoughtfully to improve productivity and engineering outcomes. **Who you are and what you need:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field is required. * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, data science or data analytics. * Previous experience at a B2B SaaS company is preferred. * Hands\-on, production\-level experience with Databricks, including building and orchestrating pipelines, managing jobs and clusters, and using Unity Catalog for governance is required. * Hands\-on, production\-level experience with dbt, including building and maintaining models, tests and macros in a real production environment is required. * Proven experience leading a data platform migration, such as moving off a legacy warehouse onto a modern lakehouse, from planning through delivery, including setting deadlines and owning the outcome. * Experience partnering with data science, machine learning, or AI teams to build and curate datasets to support model development and experimentation. * Strong proficiency in SQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Python and working with APIs and large, complex datasets. BigQuery or FiveTran experience is a plus! * Deep understanding of data modeling, ETL and ELT pipelines, medallion architecture and building analytics and machine learning\-ready datasets. * Experience writing data tests, setting up freshness and alerting monitors, and building access controls or governance policies in a live production environment (not just in a sandbox or one\-off project). * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, especially during a system migration where people need clear, direct answers about what's changing and when. * Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers, reviewing technical work and influencing engineering standards. **We are giving you:** * Exceptional health packages, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability benefits * A 401(k) plan with Buildertrend matching contributions to help you plan for the future * Generous paid time off, 11 paid holidays, plus personal days to make sure you have time to recharge * Parental leave and paid sabbaticals to support you during life’s big moments * Volunteer time off – because giving back matters * Wellness program and onsite fitness center to keep you feeling your best * Opportunities for hybrid or remote work to give you the flexibility you need * Technology reimbursement to help cover costs for the tech you need to do your job from home * Free daily lunches when you're at our HQ office, plus monthly events to connect with your team **Who we are:** Great builders don’t just manage projects – they run successful businesses. That’s where Buildertrend comes in. As the leading residential construction management platform, we give contractors the power to control their financials, schedules, team workflows and client relationships – all in one system. No more juggling disconnected tools or guessing on profitability. With nearly two decades of industry expertise, Buildertrend helps builders work smarter, scale faster and stay ahead of the competition. If you want to learn more about us, check out: https://buildertrend.com/about/ **Working at Buildertrend:** At Buildertrend, we fully recognize that we all work so we can live better lives—we appreciate and respect that this is a job and not your whole life. What makes Buildertrend so special is a commitment to ensuring you can have the best job, work with the best people, and live your best life outside of work. Our goal is to create a culture where everyone can make an impact on our customers, communities, and each other. In short: We want you to be who you are, love what you do, and build your best life. *Buildertrend Solutions, Inc. is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee based on race, including natural or protective hairstyle, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy and pregnancy\-related conditions, childbirth, breastfeeding, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, reproductive decision\-making), age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. The information collected by this application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity, and maintain employment statistics on applicants.* *Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A “reasonable accommodation” is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Buildertrend Solutions, Inc. Please inform the company's personnel representative if you need assistance completing this application or to otherwise participate in the application process. To see the complete list of Essential Job Functions, visit* *https://buildertrend.com/essential\-job\-functions\-notice/*

jobs.title: Bldg Engineer - Data Center Night Shift
jobs.description: **Job Description** **About the Role:** As a CBRE Building Engineer, you will be responsible for monitoring, maintaining and repairing building system operations and the performance of various areas including plumbing, electrical, painting, roofing, heating, and cooling. This job is part of the Engineering and Technical Services job function. They are responsible for providing support, preventive maintenance, and repairs on equipment and systems. **What You’ll Do:** * Rounds \& Tours: Perform routine site rounds and facility tours to inspect mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems, identifying potential points of failure before they impact operations. * Operations \& Maintenance: Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair critical equipment. Oversee third\-party vendors during specialized maintenance and repairs to ensure strict adherence to data center standards. * Procedure Execution: Review, update, and flawlessly execute Method of Procedure (MOP), Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), and Emergency Standard Operating Procedure (ESOP) documents during routine or emergency operations. * Technical Excellence: Utilize your deep knowledge of power infrastructure (UPS, generators, switchgear) and mechanical cooling systems (chillers, CRAHs, cooling towers) to drive operational excellence. * Incident \& Escalation Management: Adhere strictly to corporate policies for incident reporting, and promptly escalate critical facility issues to the Site Lead or appropriate tier management. * Safety \& Training: Complete all required safety and technical training modules. Actively monitor the safety of site staff and contractors, ensuring total compliance with OSHA and critical environment safety guidelines. * Explain difficult or sensitive information.**Why CBRE** When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward\-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants. **Our Values in Hiring** At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications. **Applicant AI Use Disclosure** We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process. **Disclaimers** Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. **Qualifications** **What You’ll Need:** * Experience: Minimum of 3 to 5\+ years of experience in critical environment operations, specifically within tiered data centers, critical hospitals, or high\-reliability industrial plants. * Education/Certifications: Universal EPA Refrigerant certification, licensed electrician/HVAC credentials, or equivalent military training (e.g., US Navy Nuke). * Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in operating and managing Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). * Availability: Ability to work flexible schedules, including nights, shift coverage, to support a 24/7/365 operational model. **Additional Information** If you require any adjustments or support in connection with your application or the recruitment process, please contact Candidate.Care@cbre.com. We are committed to ensuring that all candidates can participate fully in the process.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer II
jobs.description: **The Position** ---------------- Join the City of Modesto’s IT team as a Systems Engineer and play a key role in maintaining and improving the networks and systems that keep our city connected. If you’re passionate about technology and public service, we’d love to meet you. **Salary Incentives:** 2\.5% Education Incentive (bachelor's degree) 5% Education Incentive (master's degree) The Systems Engineer is responsible to perform duties pertaining to the management of Network Operating Systems (NOS), Local Area Networks/Wide Area Networks (LAN/WANs), telecommunications networks and/or other computing platforms; and to analyze, plan, install, evaluate, monitor, test, and maintain system and application software in a personal computer, client/server, or web environment. **APPLICATION PROCESS** Applicants will be assessed on the application submitted. It is the applicant's responsibility to fill out the "Education" and "Work Experience" sections of the application with complete information and adequate detail. Applications will be screened to the most qualified. Please do not substitute any part of the application with the words "see resume". The following information is provided for use as a reference and as a planning tool. Human Resources is unable to schedule make\-up examinations. **Applicants considered to be the most qualified will be invited to continue in the testing process.** The Human Resources Department reserves the right to revise the testing process to best meet the needs of the City. **Tentative Testing Schedule** Online exam October 30, 2026 \- November 5, 2026 The City of Modesto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of inclusion. A City application is required, including Supplemental Questionnaire. The City of Modesto does not sponsor H\-1B Visas. Salary offered depends on candidate’s experience. **Essential and Marginal Function Statements** ---------------------------------------------- *Essential and other important responsibilities and duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:* **Essential Functions****:** **All Assignments:** Assist with the development and implementation of network\-related projects. Communicate and work with third\-party vendor sales, applications, and support. Implement standards and procedures relating to network and operating systems software products. Utilize current and emerging network, communications, and/or operating system technologies. Monitor the performance of assigned operating systems and communications software; identify problems, as required. Stay current and aware of "state\-of\-the\-art" information technology practices. Prepare procedures, handbooks, manuals, and other documentation. Assist with the development of project proposals and yearly work program/budget. Plan, install, evaluate, monitor, and maintain client/server operating system releases, enhancements, and/or application software. Work with department management, internal customers, and information technology professionals to provide solutions to short and long\-range computer services and integrated network needs. Perform project cost estimates and ensure billing procedures and costs are correct, timely, and in compliance with general accounting principles. Work with the organizational team and vendor personnel to implement changes or resolve technical questions related to the operating system, as necessary. Establish operational and technical procedures for the utilization of client/server systems and program products. Monitor and evaluate system performance, status, and resources; develop and write scripts, as needed. Perform hardware installation, configuration, and maintenance. Prepare and develop budget recommendations related to client/server environment. Provide resolution to systems errors and/or problems; apply "fixes" to system and program product software. Build and maintain positive working relationships with co\-workers, other City employees, and the public using principles of good customer service. Observe and maintain a safe working environment in compliance with established safety programs and procedures. **When assigned to LAN/WAN System Engineering:** Participate in LAN/WAN installations and configurations. Assist with the quality execution of LAN/WAN task(s), within budget while maintaining the schedule integrity. Assist in resolving LAN connectivity issues and maintaining LAN and Internet connections. Execute Networking/Communications (LAN/WAN) projects. Develop LAN/WAN system requirement definitions and functional and technical specifications. Resolve LAN connectivity issues and maintain LAN and Internet connections. Perform LAN/WAN installations, upgrades, support, and maintenance. Develop cost data for LAN/WAN project cost estimating. Perform LAN/WAN system analysis, at the workgroup, department, and enterprise level. When Assigned to NOS Engineering: Assist with the installation and  twork printing and print server technology. Telephone network design, configuration, and provisioning; PBX and carrier network technologies and protocols. Radio frequency coordination and Federal Communication Commission licensing processes. Voice messaging systems; local and long\-distance carrier providers and rates, Automated Call Distribution (ACD) systems; Interactive Voice Response (IVR) systems. Industry standard LAN/WAN, communications protocols, and network speeds; LAN configuration, and topologies; departmental LANs, WANs, and multiple server LANs; LAN/WAN implementation, maintenance, and support. Capabilities and limitations of current micro and mini hardware, operating systems, and communications software. Methods for implementing and managing network operating systems such as Novell NetWare and Microsoft, and administering network security. Data communications, telecommunications, and integration with networks, telephone network design, configuration, provisioning, PBX, and carrier network access technologies and protocols. **Ability to:** **Depending on Assignment:** Carry out moderately complex networking/communication/telecommunications project life cycle from analysis through deployment. Analyze moderately complex systems engineering problems and develop appropriate solutions. Manage projects within project costs, resources, and schedules. Develop project plans and reasonable timelines. Recommend measures to optimize network performance and response. Install, configure, and support complex network infrastructure elements, security devices, operating systems, Web servers, Intranet/Internet servers, and other system servers. Conduct and obtain approval of feasibility study reports for telecommunications projects. **Experience and Training Guidelines:** *Any combination of experience and training that would likely provide the required knowledge and abilities is qualifying. A typical way to obtain the knowledge and abilities would be:* **Experience:** Three years of increasingly responsible experience performing network administration, installation, and implementation, monitoring communications or operating system software and hardware, maintaining high\-end computing platforms or automated business systems, technological project management, and the implementation of new systems using client server technology. **OR** Two years of responsible experience equivalent to Systems Engineer I with the City of Modesto. **Training:** Equivalent to a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in business information systems, computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field. **License or Certificate:** Possession of, or the ability to obtain, a valid California driver’s license. **Additional Requirements:** Incumbent must be able to pass a P.O.S.T. level background investigation prior to appointment for clearance to work on Police Department Information Systems. **Physical and Mental Requirements** ------------------------------------ **Mobility**: frequent use of keyboard; frequent sitting for long periods of time; occasional bending or squatting. **Lifting**: frequently up to 50 pounds; occasionally up to 75 pounds. **Vision**: constant use of overall vision; frequent reading and close\-up work; frequent color and depth vision. **Dexterity**: frequent repetitive motion; frequent writing; frequent grasping, holding, and reaching. **Hearing/Talking**: frequent hearing and talking, in person and on the phone. **Emotional/Psychological**: frequent decision\-making and concentration; frequent public and/or coworker contact; occasional working alone. **Environmental**: frequent exposure to computer noise. **WORKING CONDITIONS** Work is performed in a typical temperature\-controlled office environment subject to frequent noise from computers and related equipment. Some work may occur at remote locations. Positions may require occasional overtime or weekend work and travel is rare.

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cyngn, Inc.** Based in Mountain View, CA, Cyngn is a publicly\-traded autonomous technology company. We deploy self\-driving industrial vehicles \-**specifically autonomous tuggers**\- to factories, warehouses, and other facilities throughout North America. To build this emergent technology, we are looking for innovative, motivated, and experienced leaders to join us and move this field forward. If you like to build, tinker, and create with a team of trusted and passionate colleagues, then Cyngn is the place for you. **Key reasons to join Cyngn:** **We are small and big.** With under 100 employees, Cyngn operates with the energy of a startup. On the other hand, we’re publicly traded. This means our employees not only work in close\-knit teams with mentorship from company leaders—they also get access to the liquidity of our publicly\-traded equity. **We build today and deploy tomorrow.** Our autonomous vehicles aren’t just test concepts—they’re deployed to real clients right now. That means your work will have a tangible, visible impact. **We aren’t robots. We just develop them.** We’re a welcoming, diverse team of sharp thinkers and kind humans. Collaboration and trust drive our creative environment. At Cyngn, everyone’s perspective matters—and that’s what powers our innovation. **About the role** As a **Senior Robotics Systems Software Engineer on Cyngn’s Autonomy team**, you will develop, integrate, and deploy software across the autonomous driving stack for our industrial vehicles. This role is ideal for a strong robotics generalist who enjoys working across subsystem boundaries. Depending on the problem, you may contribute to behavior and decision\-making, motion planning, controls, localization, perception interfaces, simulation, or vehicle integration. You will work closely with engineers across autonomy, vehicle infrastructure, hardware, QA, and deployment to turn robotics algorithms into reliable production systems operating on autonomous tuggers and forklifts at customer sites. **What you'll do** * Design, develop, test, and deploy software for autonomous industrial vehicles across areas including behavior and decision\-making, motion planning, controls, and vehicle systems. * Write and maintain production\-quality C\+\+ and Python software running on Cyngn’s autonomous vehicle platforms. * Develop and integrate algorithms for navigation, trajectory generation, vehicle control, obstacle handling, and autonomous behaviors. * Integrate autonomy software with sensors, drive\-by\-wire systems, vehicle hardware, and other onboard software components. * Bring up, validate, and debug software on real vehicles, tracing issues across autonomy modules, middleware, hardware interfaces, and vehicle behavior. * Develop simulation scenarios, testing infrastructure, metrics, and regression tests to validate autonomy behavior before deployment. * Investigate field issues and edge cases, reproduce failures, identify root causes, and implement robust production solutions. * Support deployment and validation of autonomous vehicles at customer facilities, translating real\-world observations into improvements across the autonomy stack. * Collaborate closely with engineers in Planning, Controls, Perception, Localization, Vehicle Infrastructure, Hardware, QA, and Operations. * Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical design, and continuous improvement of Cyngn’s autonomy software. **Priorities: 3\-6\-12 Month Goals** **First 90 Days** * Build a working understanding of Cyngn’s autonomy architecture, simulation environment, vehicle platforms, development workflow, and deployment process. * Partner with engineers across autonomy, infrastructure, hardware, QA, and operations to trace representative vehicle behaviors, build working relationships, and identify high\-value reliability, integration, and test\-coverage risks. * Deliver one scoped production improvement—such as fixing a well\-understood autonomy defect, adding a regression scenario, or improving diagnostic tooling—and validate it in simulation and, where appropriate, on a vehicle. * Propose a prioritized plan for addressing one or two larger cross\-stack risks, including candidate success metrics, data sources, and how each metric will be measured. **By 6 Months** * Complete a production\-quality autonomy improvement that spans two or more subsystem boundaries and has been accepted into a release candidate and/or at production customer sites. * Establish the agreed baseline metrics and demonstrate early improvement, such as improved scenario pass rate, fewer interventions, reduced tracking error, or faster failure resolution. * Add reusable simulation scenarios, regression tests, diagnostics, or validation tools that are incorporated into the team’s release\-candidate testing. * Publish a technical design or process improvement that is reviewed and adopted by the affected teams. **By 12 Months** * Demonstrate sustained, measurable ics, and CI/CD infrastructure for robotic systems. * Familiarity with Linux, Git, Docker, CMake, and modern software development workflows. * Experience taking robotics functionality from prototype through validation and production deployment. ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision) through Aetna, Kaiser Permanente, and Guardian, with multiple plan tiers to choose from * Ancillary benefits including accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity plans (Voya) * Company\-paid basic life insurance, plus voluntary (supplemental) life for you and your dependents * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, fully paid by Cyngn * HSA and FSA (Health \& Dependent Daycare) * Employee Assistance Program * 1:1 Health Concierge * Company 401(k) * Commuter Benefits * Flexible PTO policy * Paid Parental Leave * Daily lunches for in\-office employees and fully\-stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages ### **What You Can Expect (Cyngn’s interview process)** * A real person will review your application * We’ll kick off the process with a one\-sided video interview where you’ll share a little more about yourself and we’ll get some basic questions out of the way * A Recruiter touch point will go over the process in more detail and answer your questions * A 45\-minute interview with the hiring manager * A full\-loop interview process consisting of 3\-4 additional conversations to gauge technical and soft skills and culture fit. * A final onsite interview with the team. *W**e may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.* ***Equal Opportunity Employer*** *Cyngn is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, benefits, training, promotion, discipline, and termination.* *If you require accommodation during the application or interview process due to a disability, please let us know and we will work with you to provide reasonable accommodation* ***A Note on Recruitment Scams*** *We've seen an increase in fraudulent job offers and phishing attempts impersonating real companies, including Cyngn.* *To protect yourself:* * *All official communication from Cyngn recruiters and hiring managers will come from an email address ending in* ***@cyngn.com****. We will never contact you from a personal email (Gmail, Yahoo, etc.) or via unsolicited text message or messaging app.* * *Cyngn will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, background checks, or any other fees as part of the application or hiring process.* * *We will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information (e.g., bank account or Social Security number) before you've been extended and have accepted a formal offer through official channels.* * *If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Cyngn, please do not respond with personal information, and feel free to verify by reaching out to us directly through our official careers page.* **The pay range for this role is:** 180,000 \- 200,000 USD per year(HQ \- Terra Bella)
