jobs.title: AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: Founded in Richmond, Virginia in 1997, CapCenter exists to help individuals and families achieve one of life's most meaningful milestones—homeownership. By bringing mortgage, realty, and insurance services together under one roof, we provide a simpler, more transparent experience designed to save clients time and money. Our commitment to innovation, including our Zero Closing Cost mortgage, has earned the trust of thousands of clients and fueled our growth through repeat business and referrals. At CapCenter, our mission extends beyond serving clients. We foster a collaborative, high\-impact environment where employees are empowered to do meaningful work, grow professionally, and make a real difference in the lives of the people we serve. **Job Overview:** We are seeking an innovative **AI Software Engineer** to design, build, and deploy advanced software solutions that transform both internal mortgage operations and external customer experiences. This role combines software engineering, artificial intelligence, cloud\-native infrastructure, and mortgage\-industry problem\-solving to deliver tools that increase efficiency, enhance customer engagement, and support data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. **Key Responsibilities:** ***AI\-Driven Software Development*** * Architect, develop, and deploy AI\-powered applications for internal operations (e.g., loan processing tools, underwriting automation, compliance checks, workflow optimization). * Build customer\-facing and marketing\-facing software such as intelligent chat assistants, personalized loan recommendation engines, automated prequalification tools, and interactive calculators. * Integrate AI models (LLMs, predictive models, generative AI) into new or existing products using modern development frameworks and APIs. ***Cloud Infrastructure \& Deployment*** * Design, deploy, and operate applications on Microsoft Azure, using services such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Storage, Key Vault, and Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry. * Containerize applications with Docker and run them on Kubernetes. This includes writing and maintaining manifests and Helm charts, and managing deployments, scaling, ingress, secrets, and resource limits. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) that take code from commit to production reliably and repeatably. * Manage cloud resources with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates). * Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics) to keep production AI services healthy, and troubleshoot cluster and application issues when they come up. * Apply cloud security best practices, including Entra ID (Azure AD) identity and role\-based access, managed identities, network isolation, and secure secrets handling. All of this should meet the data\-protection requirements for sensitive borrower information. * Optimize cloud cost and performance for AI workloads, including model hosting, inference scaling, and GPU/compute usage. ***Collaborative Product Engineering*** * Partner with operations, loan officers, compliance, marketing, and customer experience teams to identify high\-impact use cases for AI and translate them into scalable products. * Work closely with data engineering to source, prepare, and validate datasets used for model training and evaluation. * Develop secure, compliant, and well\-documented systems aligned with mortgage regulatory requirements. ***Model Development \& Optimization*** * Train, fine\-tune, or customize AI models to improve accuracy, performance, and relevance to mortgage workflows. * Implement continuous monitoring, versioning, and quality checks for AI models in production. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend adoption paths for the organization. ***Technical Leadership \& Best Practices*** * Establish development standards for AI\-enabled software, including testing strategies, documentation, and model governance. * Provide guidance on responsible AI usage, data protection, and fair lending considerations in all deployments. * Contribute to long\-term AI strategy to modernize the company’s tech stack and customer experience. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 3–5\+ years of software engineering experience building web or backend applications. * Hands\-on experience with machine learning or generative AI tools (OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, LangChain, vector databases, etc.). * Proficiency in languages such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or C\#. * Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including hands\-on experience deploying, securing, and operating production workloads (compute, networking, identity, storage, and Key Vault). * Solid experience with containers and Kubernetes (preferably AKS), including deployments, services, ingress, config/secrets, autoscaling, and debugging workloads with kubectl. * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for containerized applications. * Understanding of APIs, microservices, and modern software architecture patterns. **Preferred:** * Experience in fintech or mortgage/lending systems. * Familiarity with mortgage workflows: LOS, POS, underwriting, rate/pricing engines, and compliance considerations. * Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., AZ\-204 Developer, AZ\-104 Administrator, AZ\-305 Solutions Architect, or AI\-102 AI Engineer) and/or Kubernetes certifications (CKA or CKAD). * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform or Bicep) and GitOps or Helm\-based deployment workflows. * Experience deploying and scaling AI/LLM workloads on Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, or self\-hosted models on AKS). * Knowledge of MLOps tools and frameworks for model deployment. * Experience building customer\-facing digital experiences. **Key Competencies:** * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to map operational processes to technical solutions. * Ability to work cross\-functionally and communicate complex concepts to non\-technical teams. * Ownership of systems in production, from architecture through deployment, monitoring, and incident response. * Curiosity and eagerness to explore new AI capabilities. * Commitment to data security, fair lending, and responsible AI use. **Compensation:** The estimated range of $90,000 – $115,000 reflects the budgeted amount for this position. Individual compensation will be determined based on job\-related business considerations, such as relevant qualifications, experience, location, education, certifications, skills, and other job\-related reasons. Where applicable, this position is eligible for incentive compensation and/or discretionary bonus opportunities. **Benefits:** CapCenter offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid vacation, paid holidays, and other programs designed to support the well\-being and professional growth of our employees. **Physical Requirements and Work Environment:** Work is primarily performed in a professional office environment and may involve extended periods of sitting, computer use, keyboarding, and telephone or virtual communication. The position may require managing competing priorities, responding to time\-sensitive matters, maintaining accuracy and attention to detail, and working effectively in a fast\-paced environment. **Reasonable Accommodation:** As required by law, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** CapCenter is an Equal Opportunity Employer (Veteran/Disability). All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of race, color, national origin, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Perception and Controls
jobs.description: **Workplace Type:** Hybrid — Onsite 3–4 days per week across Santa Cruz and West Menlo Park, CA, with at least 1 day per week in Santa Cruz **Reports To:** Robotics \& Controls Manager **About Capstan Medical** ------------------------- At Capstan Medical, we're building one of the most exciting and innovative companies in medtech: a first\-of\-its\-kind robotic platform for minimally invasive heart valve treatment. Our team combines surgical robotics, catheter\-based delivery, and next\-generation implants to turn complex procedures into safer, lower\-stress solutions for patients and clinicians. We're a collaborative, hands\-on team that moves fast, wears multiple hats, and believes the best ideas can come from anyone. Based in Santa Cruz, our workspace blends Bay Area innovation with a lifestyle near trails, beaches, and open space—a great place to do meaningful, career\-defining work. ### **About the Role** **Teach a heart valve robot to see where it is.** We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our robotics and controls team. You'll help our robot understand where its devices are inside the patient, using intraprocedural imaging such as fluoroscopy and echocardiography. That means building perception for image\-to\-robot registration and pose estimation, and taking it from research into a clinical system. This is not a model\-in\-a\-notebook role. Your work runs on a real\-time robotic system, informs what physicians see during the procedure, and ships under FDA design controls. You'll also help shape how we collect, organize, and learn from our robot and imaging data, and use it to improve our device models and controllers. You'll have a large say in how ML is done here, from the tools and standards we adopt to which problems we tackle first, and you'll be the person the rest of the team turns to for ML judgment. ### **What You'll Do** * Develop methods to register intraprocedural imaging, such as fluoroscopy and echocardiography, to the robot. * Estimate the pose of catheters and implants from medical images. * Combine image\-based estimates with robot kinematics and other sensing, and quantify the uncertainty of each estimate. * Build data pipelines that capture, align, label, and version imaging and robot data for training and evaluation. * Use simulation and synthetic data where real clinical data is limited. * Fit and improve models of device behavior from data, and work with controls engineers to turn them into better control. * Work with clinical engineers and physicians to learn what the images show, what matters in the procedure, and what accuracy is good enough. * Read the literature, prototype what looks promising, and tell us plainly what works on our data and what doesn't. * Deploy models on the robot and meet real\-time latency budgets. * Write the validation, test datasets, and design documentation that let learned components pass FDA design controls. ### **Skills** * **Real\-World Machine Learning:** You've taken models out of notebooks and into products that run on real data, with all its noise, drift, and edge cases. * **Computer Vision:** Strong background in classical and learned computer vision, especially pose estimation, segmentation, tracking, or 2D/3D registration. * **3D Geometry:** Solid grasp of rigid transforms, rotations, camera projection models, and calibration. * **Programming:** Strong Python and PyTorch skills. Comfortable reading and writing C\+\+. * **Data Engineering:** You build pipelines, datasets, and evaluation harnesses that others can trust and reuse. * **Research and Prototyping:** You keep up with recent papers, can tell which ideas will survive contact with our data, and enjoy turning them into working prototypes. * **Problem\-Solving:** Comfortable with high ambiguity. You can take a fuzzy goal, break it into experiments, and pick a direction without a spec. * **Communication:** Excellent communicator who can explain ML clearly to controls engineers, clinical engineers, and physicians, document work effectively, and help the team decide when a model is good enough to trust. ### **Requirements** * MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. PhD is a plus. * 4\+ years of professional experience in computer vision or machine learning, classical or learned, including at least one system shipped to production on real\-world data. * Experience working with scarce, noisy, or expensive data, using synthetic data, augmentation, self\-supervision, or physics priors to make up for it. * Experience building ML on data from physical systems such as robots, cameras, medical imaging, or sensors. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment and own problems end\-to\-end. * Ability to work onsite 3–4 days per week, split flexibly between our Santa Cruz, CA and West Menlo Park, CA offices, with at least 1 day per week in Santa Cruz. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Ultrasound or echocardiography experience, strongly preferred. Fluoroscopy or X\-ray experience is also valuable, including 2D/3D registration or digitally reconstructed radiographs. * Experience tracking catheters, needles, surgical tools, or continuum robots in images. * Sensor fusion and state estimation, such as Kalman filters or factor graphs. * System identification or learned dynamics for control, including residual models on top of physics. * Robotics software experience with ROS/ROS2 and on\-device inference under latency constraints (ONNX, TensorRT). * Data platform and MLOps experience, including practices like dataset versioning and experiment tracking. * Medical device or safety\-critical background, including validating ML under FDA design controls. * Experience as an early ML engineer on a team, setting up the tools, data practices, and evaluation that others build on. * Publications at venues such as MICCAI, IPCAI, CVPR, ICRA, or IROS. ### **Why join us:** * We offer a fun, fast\-paced, collaborative environment where you will be working on transformational technologies in the cardiac healthcare space. * We offer outstanding benefits with medical, dental, and vision covered at 100% for you and your family, as well as flex time off. * We thrive in our work\-hard, play\-hard environment. Bring your bike or running shoes if you’d like or just be ready to enjoy a fun office outing. We enjoy time inside the office and out! We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Principal Architect – Simulation Engine (Physical AI)
jobs.description: **Career Area:** Technology, Digital and Data**Job Description:** **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.** When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. **Help Build the Future of Caterpillar –** At Caterpillar, technology always has a purpose, which is to solve our customers’ toughest challenges. Through Cat Technology, we are solving problems by building the intelligence layer that connects machines, data, and people to make jobsites safer, more productive, and more sustainable. By combining deep domain expertise in physical systems with software, connectivity, autonomy, and AI, we deliver solutions that work in the real world—on real jobsites, at global scale. You’ll build and deploy against one of the most unique data foundations—over 1\.6 million connected assets generating real\-world data daily. These data and platform capabilities are enabling the development of AI models, edge computing architectures, and software systems that scale across fleets, products, and industries. The result will be a new generation of machines that continuously learn, improve, and deliver performance at scale. **Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites** Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality. Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes of high\-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against. If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations. Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar. Job Summary: The Simulation Engine Architect owns how our virtual world runs — the physics, sensors, scenarios, time, determinism, and scale that let autonomy be developed, trained, and proven before it ever touches a real machine. The Principal Digital Architect – Simulation Engine defines the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for the simulation platform that underpins Physical AI and autonomy development for Caterpillar’s construction and mining machines. This platform must reproduce the physical behavior of excavators, dozers, loaders, and haul trucks interacting with deformable terrain and material; the behavior of cameras, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and inertial sensors in dust, rain, low light, and vibration; and the behavior of dynamic jobsites with people, vehicles, and changing ground. It must do this deterministically, at high fidelity where fidelity matters, and at a scale of millions of scenario executions per day across GPU clusters. The architect sets direction for the core simulation abstractions — world and asset representation (OpenUSD), the physics and rendering stack (NVIDIA Omniverse / Isaac Sim, PhysX, Unreal Engine), sensor models, scenario definition and generation, the execution model for open\-loop replay and closed\-loop software\-in\-the\-loop / hardware\-in\-the\-loop runs, and the interfaces that expose the simulator as a training environment for reinforcement learning and world\-model\-based (“neural”) simulation. The role establishes measurable standards for fidelity, determinism, performance, and developer experience, and leads the sim\-to\-real correlation program that keeps the simulator trustworthy against field data. The architect works with the simulation engineering team, the Digital Twin and AI Factory architects, autonomy and perception teams, and controls and machine engineering to converge on one platform, reduce fragmentation, and raise engineering velocity across the organization. What You Will Do: * Developing detailed architecture deliverables to solve business problems. * Designing an application's technical infrastructure, such as specific databases, programming languages, utilities, and testing approaches * Leading the evaluation and deployment of new technologies to add or enhance existing digital technical capabilities. * Participating in addressing business requirements for applications and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver digital solutions that meets business results. What You Will Have: * Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; e engineering with ownership of a production simulation platform for autonomous vehicles or robotics: core abstractions, deterministic execution, replay and closed\-loop modes, SIL/HIL integration. * **Omniverse and Game Engines** – Hands\-on NVIDIA Omniverse / Isaac Sim (Kit, OpenUSD, PhysX, RTX) and/or Unreal Engine as a simulation foundation; Applied Intuition, CARLA, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, or Project Chrono a plus. * **High\-Fidelity Physics** – Multibody dynamics, contact and friction, deformable terrain and granular material, track/tire\-ground interaction, hydraulics and powertrain; models calibrated and validated against test data. * **Sensor Simulation** – Physically based camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU models including dust, weather, noise, and calibration effects, validated against real sensor logs; exposure to 3D Gaussian Splatting / NeRF. * **World and Scenario Simulation** – Large outdoor terrain and geospatial environments; procedural and generative scenario generation with coverage tied to the ODD; familiarity with ASAM OpenSCENARIO and SOTIF / ISO 26262\. * **Reinforcement Learning and Neural Simulation** – Gym\-style RL environments and large\-scale closed\-loop training (Isaac Lab, Ray); understanding of world foundation models (NVIDIA Cosmos) alongside physics simulation. * **Scale and Performance** – Simulation on GPU clusters and cloud (Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, CUDA) with a record of improving throughput, determinism, and cost per simulation. * Software Engineering – Expert modern C\+\+ and strong Python; gRPC / Protocol Buffers, Bazel or CMake, CI/CD for large monorepos; Rust or CUDA a plus. * **Architecture Leadership** – Served as architectural authority across multiple teams; influences senior leaders and mentors principal, staff, and senior engineers. * **Domain Exposure** – Off\-highway, mining, or construction autonomy, or AV/robotics simulation at companies such as Applied Intuition, NVIDIA, Waabi, Wayve, Zoox, GM/Cruise, or Foretellix. * Bachelor’s, master’s, or doctoral degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or related field, or equivalent experience. **Additional Details:** * This position requires the candidate to work full\-time at the Irving, TX office (Dallas) * Domestic relocation assistance is available for this position. * Visa sponsorship is available with this position. **Why Caterpillar** You'll work on some of the most challenging applications of AI in the physical world, helping build systems that transform vast amounts of machine and sensor data into the intelligence that powers autonomous and AI\-enabled equipment. If you're excited about applying AI to real\-world machines operating in complex environments, we'd like to hear from you. **Summary Pay Range:** $159,120\.00 \- $258,570\.00 Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. The Engineering Superintendent, Production will also provide mentoring and direction to other staff as needed. **RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL DUTIES** Manage the Production Engineering Team and oversee the team’s execution of the following responsibilities, * Initiate and support the development of systems and processes that drive operational excellence within the Production team. * Facilitate access approvals and maintenance activities for applications including, Shiploading Logbooks, PI, CCLEAR and CFAR. * Participate in regulatory agency, accounting and internal audits. * Support procedure development and training related to capital projects, temporary or new modes of operation, and compliance. * Reinforce safety and environmental awareness through frequent job observations and by interfacing with plant personnel. * Work with Engineering and Construction department to assure O \& M interests are represented on major projects. * Work with Production during 2\-year reviews of procedures. * Support turnaround planning organization to develop an optimized turnaround execution strategy. * Demonstrate thorough understanding of the Operational (Quantities, Scheduling, Quality, Measurement) aspects of the Sale and Purchase agreement and Gas Supply Tariffs. * Manage components of the department budget. * Coach, mentor, and lead the Production Engineering team. Production Reporting * Perform daily Energy Balances and review daily Production Loss Reporting and Ship Loading Reports. * Provide monthly Energy Balance close documentation to corporate business teams. * Develop, measure, and report against departmental KPIs. * Prepare Production performance summaries summarizing data on total production, capacity utilization, operating reliability, unit efficiency, production loss categories and quantities, and energy utilization. This includes Inlet Feed Gas measurement and allocation, LNG/NGL Production, Emissions and Waste measurements, and Efficiency monitoring. * Develop tools to quantify facility emissions to support environmental and compliance reporting. * Accountable for developing, maintaining and utilization of appropriate tools used to calculate and track flared quantities to ensure compliance with Environmental Regulatory requirements. Production Forecasting \& Scheduling * Develop and utilize forecasting and scheduling tools and communicate with Commercial Operations and Gas Supply so that daily, monthly, and annual production requirements can be set. Utilizing these tools, advise Production Management of limitations or deficiencies that may impact production. * Monitoring and ordering of catalyst, chemicals and refrigerants needed to operate and manage the facility. Provide forecasts and historical allocations for proficient financial accounting. Manage relationships and contracts with suppliers. * Develop strategies to minimize downtime and provide input into maintenance plans including the alignment of maintenance events across the supply chain. * Monitor LNG inventories and provide guidance to both Marine and Commercial Operations on appropriate loading times. Communicate risk of curtailments due to high inventories when appropriate and develop curtailment plans, that minimize net production impacts, when necessary. Production Optimization and Support * Participate in daily strategy planning with Production management and work to optimize production, and ensure safe, reliable operation. * Develop and utilize optimization tools that monitor process efficiency and make improvement recommendations that will increase productivity. * Perform evaluations to understand and quantify the impacts of production upsets and initiatives. Develop tools to monitor, predict and mitigate the impact of operating limitations. * Support plant Production personnel in troubleshooting process issues and concerns. * Interact with Engineering Services and Process Services engineers to define problems that need further study, design and carry out tests in the interest of enhancing production or solving process problems, and identify potential tie\-ins espectful relationship with 1\) management, 2\) peers and 3\) the various facility level workers (Plant Manager, plant supervision and plant workers) whom are all responsible for ensuring good operations. + Organized; planning skills; able to manage multiple activities and programs in timely fashion and with a high degree of accuracy; able to meet work deadlines. + Exceptional problem solving and analytical skills. + Accomplished public speaker, able to create and deliver industry\-specific presentations. + Computer savvy including Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, Access, Project and PowerPoint. + Proficient using Sigmafine, PI Vision, PI System Explorer and Aspen Hysys is a plus. **KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:** **Knowledge:** Understands all facets of Feed Gas allocation, and LNG/NGL production, storage, and shipping, including health, safety, governmental regulations, and associated codes and standards. Understands the principles of fluid flow, heat transfer, thermodynamics, and hydrocarbon process chemistry as applied to an operating process unit. Familiar with the hazards of hydrocarbon processes and the methods used to keep process facilities safe. **Skills:** **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * **Education and Certifications:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Process/Chemical Engineering required. A Professional Engineer’s (PE) License is a plus. * **Experience:** Ten (10\) years’ experience as a Production Engineer or Process Engineer in an LNG Liquefaction Facility is preferred. Other Process related experience in petrochemical, NGL, cryogenic natural gas processing, or other hydrocarbon processing experience is a plus. **DIRECT REPORTS** Production Engineers and Production Schedulers are direct reports to this position. **FREEDOM TO ACT** The Engineering Superintendent, Production requires minimal supervision. **WORK CONDITIONS** * Job is performed in an industrial plant environment. * Regularly, work will be performed from home, after normal work hours or on weekends. * Limited travel required, as business conditions dictate. * Subject to drug and alcohol testing, per applicable federal regulations or as required by Cheniere. * While performing the duties of this job, the employee is often required to stand, walk, sit, climb stairs, work at height above ground on stairs and catwalks, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, talk or hear, smell, type and write. * Must be able to board a ship via a gangway, climb to the top of a tank (200\+ steps), scale vertical steel ladder up to forty feet or more in height and lift and move objects weighting up to 50 pounds. * While performing the duties of this job, the employee will work indoors and outdoors, and be exposed to year\-around weather conditions, ocean environment, and noise. There is a considerable amount of outdoor activities involved. * Specific vision abilities required include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus. * Required to pass regularly scheduled physical examinations mandated by regulatory authorities. * Required to obtain mandated certification by attending Company\-sponsored training in basic first aid, CPR, and LNG firefighting. * Must maintain a Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) card in good standing status. **ADA JOB REQUIREMENTS:** Reasonable accommodations will be made to ensure that the essential functions of the job can be performed and not hinder the employee's performance due to physical, mental or emotional disability. **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY:** Cheniere Energy is an equal opportunity workplace. All employment decisions are made without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, marital or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected categories. This includes providing reasonable accommodation if requested for disabilities or religious beliefs and practices.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Query
jobs.description: ### **About CircleCI Engineering** CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them. At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here. ### **About the Query Team** Every pipeline, job, and test that runs on CircleCI generates data, and that history is one of our biggest advantages in an agentic software delivery lifecycle. Flaky test detection, test insights, pipeline search, and agents that reason about why a build failed all depend on fast, reliable access to it. The Query team owns the system that makes this possible. We pull product data out of the transactional services that create it and store it in datastores built for historical and analytical workloads. We serve it through domain\-level APIs to CircleCI's product teams and to customers through our public API. Our goal is to make storing data "fire and forget" for every other team, and querying it fast and dependable at a scale that keeps growing. ### **What You'll Do** * **Build AI\-natively.** AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved. * **Shape how we store data at scale.** Own and harden our ClickHouse\-based storage layer. Design schemas for known and emerging access patterns, and tune ingestion and query performance to support production\-scale data. * **Build the pipelines that move our data.** Design and own ingestion from event streams and durable workflows built on Temporal. Data should arrive reliably, stay queryable while it's in transit, and never slow down the critical path of the services that produce it. * **Serve data to the product and to customers.** Evolve our platform into the default path for historical queries. Make getting historical data easy, not a bottleneck. Teams should be able to get what they need quickly and with minimal hand\-holding, while Query keeps enough visibility into how the data is used to optimize ingestion and reads across every consumer. Build in the indexing, caching, and tiered storage required to keep it performant. * **Set technical direction.** When the problem is complex or the answer isn't obvious, you lead the design discussion, write up the architecture decision, and make the call. You help decide which data domain we migrate next and how. * **Champion observability.** Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to understand ingestion lag, query latency, and data correctness. For a data platform, operational data drives stability, not just incident response. * **Keep things moving.** You take ambiguous data problems from design to production quickly, and you help the people around you move faster too. You don't just patch problems, you ask why they happened. You'll fix the immediate issue, then solve the underlying team practice, process, or system that let it through. ### **What You'll Bring** * **AI\-native engineering practices.** You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short. * **Hands\-on data experience.** You've built or owned data\-intensive systems such as ingestion pipelines, event\-driven architectures, or analytical and time\-series datastores. You understand the tradeoffs between transactional and analytical storage, and you've designed schemas and tuned queries for high\-volume workloads. Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar database is a strong plus. * **Backend depth in Go.** You're strong in Go, or strong in a comparable language and eager to work in Go: interface design, data modeling, service integration, and concurrency. Familiarity with React and TypeScript is a plus, since you'll occasionally work on the product surfaces that display this data. * **Distributed systems judgment.** You understand delivery guarantees, idempotency, backpressure, and failure recovery. You know when to rely on a framework's reliability guarantees rather than building your own. * **Technical leadership.** You've led the design of complex systems and made tradeoffs deliberately. You leave foundations others can build on. You raise the quality bar through reviews, mentoring, and direct feedback, not just through the code you write. * **A track record of shipping.** 5\+ years building and operating production backend systems. Your work has served real users, and you've treated latency, reliability, and correctness as design concerns. ### **Sound like you?** You care about how data powers the product, not just where it lives. You know how to make a datastore fast at scale, and have tuned schemas and queries against real production load. You think like a platform engineer, measuring your work by how much it unblocks the teams building on it. AI isn't a tool you reach for occasionally; it's a core part of how you approach and solve problems. If that sounds like you, we want to talk. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. **About CircleCI** CircleCI is the world's largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most\-used DevOps tools \- processing more than 3 million jobs a day \- CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture\-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. **How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring** At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you. **Where we may use AI** * *Job descriptions and messaging*: AI may help draft job descriptions and role\-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate. * *Application review*: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications. * *Interview notes*: With advance notice, an AI note\-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected. * *Outreach*: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending. **Our commitment** AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change. **Your choices** You can ask for human\-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note\-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications. * *Interview notes*: With advance notice, an AI note\-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected. * *Outreach*: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending. **Our commitment** AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change. **Your choices** You can ask for human\-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note\-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com. For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

jobs.description: **Discover your future at Citi** -------------------------------- Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. **Job Overview** ---------------- **About Citi:** Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Operations \& Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first\-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services. Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well\-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. jobs.description: The successful candidate will bring a strong background in engineering with a capacity to learn, analyze, and use communication skills needed to work effectively with contractors, elected officials, executive leadership, employees, and external partners. **Minimum qualifications** The City of Crest Hill is seeking an experienced and collaborative engineering professional to serve as its new Assistant City Engineer. This newly created position offers an exciting opportunity to play a key leadership role in a growing Engineering Department. This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to shaping an organization because the City is committed to economic development, including the development of the new state\-of\-the\-art Illinois correction facility campus and major infrastructure investment with the City’s switch to a new water supply being provided by the Grand Prairie Water Commission. **Join a Thriving Community** Located in Will County, approximately 40 miles southwest of Chicago, Crest Hill is a growing, financially sound community with a strong municipal team and a commitment to continuous improvement. The City operates with a professional management structure, an engaged Mayor and City Council, and a workforce dedicated to responsive public service. Crest Hill’s $50 million budget, AA bond rating, low debt, and healthy reserves reflect the City’s financial strength. **Position Overview** As Assistant City Engineer, you will work closely with the City’s Director of Engineering, learning the City’s systems and infrastructure, and coordinating major projects, while developing potential for future professional advancement. The City of Crest Hill operates under a City Administrator form of government, with the Mayor and City Council establishing policy. The Engineering Department, who works directly under the City Administrator and closely with other departments, including Public Works, is a core component of service delivery, ensuring safe streets, reliable utilities, effective stormwater management and forward\-looking infrastructure solutions for residents and businesses. **Key Responsibilities** * Assist the Director of Engineering to manage, plan, and implement the capital improvement program and development review programs. * Coordinate with management and City staff completing development reviews including managing processes and timelines. * Ensure the accurate review of plans and completion of reports for residential and commercial private development projects for compliance with City design standards, state regulations and municipal codes. * Ensure the accurate review and approval of right\-of\-way permits for both City and non\-City projects. * Coordinate with management and City staff on completing Capital Improvement Projects, including providing engineering and construction management. **Ideal Candidate** * Bachelor’s degree in accredited Civil Engineering program. * Registration as a Professional Engineer (P.E.) in the State of Illinois or ability to obtain registration is preferred. * A minimum of 2\+ years of professional level Civil Engineering work experience is required, with a minimum of 5\+ years’ experience preferred. * Valid Drivers license and the ability to travel to various construction sites. **Desired Knowledge and Skills** * Proven work experience as a designer, construction inspector or similar role is preferred. * Ability to read and understand civil roadway and pump station plans and project specifications. * Knowledge of complex and modern civil engineering as applied to municipal Public Works projects and developments. * Ability to coordinate, manage, and track multiple projects activities on several projects concurrently. * Skilled in managing design and construction of capital improvement projects including budget, schedule, scope, and project risks. **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** * Full\-time position; generally Monday–Friday, 40 hours per week. * Work hours may vary; early mornings, evenings, and weekends, as necessitated by project or emergency. * Work performed indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions. * Physical work requires standing, walking, and driving, ability to navigate construction site; reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties. **Why Crest Hill** * Opportunity to serve in a leadership role within a stable municipal organization * Meaningful work that directly supports employees and the community * Professional environment that via email to HR@cityofcresthill.com. jobs.title: City Engineer

This position provides engineering services for all city departments primarily the Utilities and Public Works Departments; provides as needed technical assistance to Planning/Codes; and may interface with other City departments regarding engineering needs. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include the following. Other duties may be assigned. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions * Advises the administration and department heads engaged in traffic, property acquisition, construction inspection, information management, and maintenance scheduling for public streets and utilities. * Performs engineering management functions as applicable for all City Utilities (Water Treatment, Water Distribution, Wastewater Treatment, and Wastewater Collection) and other Public Works functions (Streets, Sanitation); as well as for Storm Water Drainage (Tennessee MS4 Program); TDOT (Tn. Department of Transportation; TDEC (Tn. Dept. of Environment and Conservation) and other functions as assigned. * Manages or performs the survey, design, drafting, preparation of specifications and bid packages, prepares right\-of\-way or easement documents, negotiates with property owners and manages construction for funded capital improvement projects. * Manages the process and information flow of Title VI information relative to projects for the city and interacts with contractors/subcontractors to ensure proper contractor compliance and documentation. * Prepares the scope of work for the engineers involved, reviews and approves preliminary and final design plans and specifications and manages key construction activities for funded capital improvement projects. * Prepares and recommends ordinances and revisions to city code regarding construction standards. * Confers with the City Attorney or representative concerning the legality of various matters, contracts and agreements, litigation on contracts, and preparation of proposed legislation. * In coordination with the Public Works Director, assists in preparation of the capital budget for the construction, rehabilitation, and maintenance of street and utilities. * Assists in preparation of various alternative multi\-year capital budgets for new roads, road rehabilitation, street paving and drainage improvements. * Observes delivery of services in the field, inspects infrastructure projects on site, and attends meetings regarding the progress and status of project completion. * Reviews and approves periodic estimates of expenditures; reviews and approves payment of invoices prepared by contractors. * Must attend all Regional Planning Commission meetings and work with Buildings \& Codes Enforcement in making recommendations to the Board. * Meets with citizens, citizens’ committees and neighborhood groups concerning services and project implementation; responds to questions, complaints, suggestions and other concerns. * Maintains continuous liaison with various state and federal agencies regarding regulations, project approvals, and funding of projects. * Supervises the investigation of citizens’ concerns and complaints; prepares reports of the concern; confers with the Public Works Director and City Manager regarding the severity of the concerns; and outlines actions to alleviate the concern. * Coordinates with other city departments, city boards, and other local governments concerning the status of projects. * Reviews and approves plans and specifications prepared by consultants to the Public Works Department. * Prepares Requests for Qualifications to engineering consultants, reviews qualifications received, assists in the selection process of professional engineering services, negotiates agreements, recommends, through the Public Works Director and/or City Manager, the selected consulting firm to the Council for approval for major project designs and services; reviews and approves work performed. * Reviews and approves, through the assistance of department heads and staff, plans and specifications developed by engineers and architects for private developments. * Other related duties may be assigned. **QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * 1\+ years of experience in managing and supervising others. * Knowledge of the principles and practices of civil engineering, particularly as applied to municipal government. * Knowledge of municipal design, construction, maintenance methods, materials and equipment. * Knowledge of applicable laws and regulatory codes related to the development and construction of public improvement projects; * Experience in engineering and project management within the regulations of TDOT (Tn. Dept. of Transportation) and TDEC (Tn. Dept. of Environment and Conservation) or comparable entities. * Ability to plan, schedule and supervise complex civil engineering programs. * Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, verbally and in writing, to groups and individuals. * Ability to establish and maintain an effective working relationship with subordinates, contractors, engineers, the public, and elected officials. * Be available to work hours as needed or as necessary, including attending meetings scheduled after normal working hours. * Ability to supervise, coordinate, delegate and negotiate. * Ability to make sound financial and budgetary decisions. * Ability to analyze and resolve complex and sensitive problems. * Advanced working knowledge of personal computers/software and capable of utilizing engineering computer software programs. * Ability to be bonded. **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:** * Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or appropriate engineering field required. * 5\+ years of verifiable, acceptable experience in civil engineering, preferably in a municipal environment; OR * Equivalent combination of education and experience. **LICENSES \& CERTIFICATIONS:** * Licensed as a Professional Engineer in the State of Tennessee or possess comparable PE license with ability to obtain State of Tennessee licensing within city\-approved time frame. * Possess a valid driver’s license. jobs.title: Application Developer
jobs.description: **Applications Development Manager** **Clark Construction Company \| Lansing, MI \| Full\-time** We buy the big systems. We build everything else. Clark has 28\+ internal apps built with AI, used by 300 people every day, replacing paid tools one at a time. We are hiring the person who will own that platform and help lead the company on AI. If you have built apps on your own and learned that building was the easy part\-and finding users was the hard part\-this is the job where that problem is already solved. The users are here, and they have been asking for it. **About the Role** This is a builder\-first, manager\-second role. You will develop on an AI\-native application platform using the best\-fit models and tools, ship working versions in days, and define what a Clark application should look like for employees in the field and the office. You will lead a growing applications group, currently with one developer, and serve as Clark's technical lead on AI alongside the Director of IT. The applications team is one of three IT divisions, with direct access to the people you build for and no unnecessary layers. **Based in Lansing \- Ideal candidates may live near Lansing, East Lansing, Jackson, DeWitt, Potterville, Charlotte, Howell, Brighton, or other surrounding areas** **What You'll Do** * Build, test, and launch practical business applications and AI\-enabled features. * Set standards for user experience, quality, security, and maintainability across Clark\-built applications. * Lead and grow the applications team while remaining hands\-on in development. * Own application security, risk management, support, bug resolution, and the change queue. * Partner directly with employees to understand operational problems and translate them into useful solutions. * Explain technical choices, opportunities, and risks clearly to employees and executives. **What You Bring** * A track record of shipping business applications that people use. Side projects count; what you have built matters more than how long you have been building. * Deep, current knowledge of AI tools and models, including experience shipping AI features\-not just using a chatbot. * Working knowledge of SQL and data design, with the judgment to lead specialists who go deeper. * Strong UI/UX instincts and a security mindset. You move quickly without being reckless. * The ability to work with people across the business, uncover the real problem, and translate it into something buildable. * An interest in leading without giving up hands\-on development. First\-time managers are welcome if they have led work and earned others' trust. **Why Work with Us?** We are an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to superior construction management. Our passion lies in delivering high\-quality buildings safely and sustainably. We offer a comprehensive benefits package, but not limited to: * Profit sharing * Generous paid time off * 401(k) with company match * Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance * Support for ongoing education and professional development * **Clark is a Certified Veteran Friendly Employer (VFE)**

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Clayco is a full\-service, turnkey real estate development, master planning, architecture, engineering, and construction firm that safely delivers clients across North America the highest quality solutions on time, on budget, and above and beyond expectations. With $8\.1 billion in revenue for 2025, Clayco specializes in the "art and science of building," providing fast track, efficient solutions for mission critical, industrial, life sciences, power \& energy, aviation, commercial, institutional, residential and sports \& entertainment related building projects. **The Role We Want You For** Across Clayco, people have built their own AI tools to get through the document\-heavy parts of their work — reviewing submittals, finding the right procedure, pulling history off a past project. Nobody asked them to. The work is tedious, the tools were available, and no one had given them a better option. That appetite is both the opportunity and the problem. We run governed agents on a Snowflake semantic layer today, with far more of the work ahead of us than behind. The gap is between what people will build for themselves and what we can actually stand behind. You will close it. jobs.title: Analytics Engineer, Semantic Layer
jobs.description: Cloaked is building a cyber expert at your side \- one that watches, advises, and acts to keep you safe and private in the age of AI. 600k\+ paying members already use Cloaked to take back control of their data, their identity, and who can reach them: masked emails, phone numbers, and payment cards, data removal from broker sites, and an AI voice agent that screens calls before they ring through. We've protected 10M\+ identities, screened 50M\+ calls, and removed 1B\+ records from the data brokers who profit off personal information. Backed by a $375M Series B, we're now building the agents that turn detection into action \- for individuals, families, and the companies that want to protect their people. **About the Role** We're looking for an **Analytics Engineer** to own the semantic layer at Cloaked \- the governed set of metrics, entities, and relationships behind every dashboard, self\-serve analysis, and AI\-driven answer across the company. Every number at Cloaked should mean the same thing, no matter who asks or which tool they use. You'll make that true. This is a builder's role. You'll turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well\-tested definitions that both people and AI agents can rely on, working closely with the Data team and partners across Product, Growth, Finance, and CX. **What will you do?** * Design, build, and maintain the semantic layer, including metric definitions, dimensions, joins, and entity relationships across product, subscription, and lifecycle data * Build and maintain BI artifacts \- models, explores, and dashboards \- on top of the semantic layer for teams across the company * Build and curate certified metrics and queries that power AI\-assisted, natural\-language data querying, and improve answer accuracy over time * Partner with stakeholders to resolve conflicting metric definitions and document the agreed source of truth * Write clean, tested, version\-controlled SQL and transformation code with data quality checks and clear documentation * Work closely with data engineering on upstream models, and with analysts on how the layer gets used **What skills and experiences will help you?** * 3\-5 years of experience in analytics engineering, BI engineering, or a closely related role * Strong SQL and solid dimensional data modeling skills * Hands\-on experience building semantic models in a tool like Looker (LookML), Omni, dbt Semantic Layer, or Cube (we care more about the modeling fundamentals than any specific tool) * Experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework, Git\-based workflows, and code review * Familiarity with cloud data platforms (AWS/Athena, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar) * AI\-forward: you use AI tooling (Claude, ChatGPT, and others) fluently to ship faster, and you're excited to structure data that AI agents query directly. Experience building semantic models for LLM\-driven analytics is a plus, not a requirement * Clear communication, and comfort pushing back on a vague metric until it's well defined **What do we like?** * **Demand Clarity** \- push back on a vague metric until it's well defined. Then… * **Build Value** \- we ship insights and value to our stakeholders over fancy tech / dashboards. * A value add mindset. Cloaked is hungry for insights. We must feed everyone with data. * Startup or growth\-stage company experience * Care and respect for our customers' privacy as if it were your own * **“Work hard and be nice to people”** is a way of working. Not nice to have. **What we offer** ----------------- Cloaked is a well\-funded Series B startup based out of NYC. Although we are a distributed team, the NYC team operates with a hybrid model. We have two floors of our building, with two state of the art kitchens packed with drinks, snacks and everything else you'd need to get through the day. The Cloaked team has diverse interests and so we frequently embark on team outings and go out for socials! **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- We offer above market rate pay and equity based off of the market's best commercially available data. Your compensation will be a combination of salary, bonus and equity. For full\-time US employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package: medical, dental and vision with Cloaked covering the majority of employee premiums, company\-paid basic life, and a 401(k) with company match. We offer flexible work arrangements and the ability to work remotely as needed. Cloaked provides a home office stipend in addition to a new company laptop (and other tech depending on the role). **Perks** --------- **Competitive PTO:** PTO, floating holidays and sick days \- and we push people to actually use them. We see time off as a preventative burnout measure, not a balance to hoard. **Parental Leave:** Paid leave for all new parents \- birth, adoption, or foster placement \- because the people building privacy deserve time with their families. **Monthly wellness \& meals stipend:** Used for any kind of physical, mental or emotional care you'd like to take for yourself, be it a gym membership, a meditation app, or time with a personal trainer \- plus lunch and coffee during the workday. **Professional Growth:** Opportunities for career development and personal growth are provided to all employees who seek to further their knowledge and capabilities through an unlimited professional development fund. Additionally team members are encouraged to regularly attend conferences and industry events. We are really excited about having you join our mission\-driven team and help us build the future of online privacy! Compensation Range: $160K \- $180K

Develop and execute test plans for DLP solutions across multiple environments (development, staging, production) to ensure robust deployment and minimize risk. * **Qualifications** ================== * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (preferred but not required). * 5\+ years of experience in data loss prevention or data security engineering. * 7\+ years of experience in information security. * 2\+ years of experience in a senior\-level engineering role. * Hands\-on experience with: * Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MIP labels, Purview DLP). * Enterprise DLP administration and configuration. * Integration of DLP with SIEM, CASB, and endpoint protection platforms. * Ability to lead technical projects and collaborate in a global environment. Excellent problem\-solving, documentation, and communication skills. * **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) * CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) Experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft O365 * VISA sponsorship is not available for this position. \#LI\-AB1 **Benefits – How We’ll Support You:** * Numerous development opportunities offered to build your skills * Be part of a company with a higher purpose and contribute to making the world a better place * Health benefits for you and your family on your first day of employment * Four weeks of paid time off and two weeks of well\-being pay per year, plus paid holidays * Excellent parental leave which includes a minimum of 16 weeks for mother and father * Future planning with our competitive retirement savings plan and tuition reimbursement program * * Check out life at Corteva! www.linkedin.com/company/corteva/life Are you a good match? Apply today! We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team. Corteva Agriscience is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing our differences to enrich lives, advance innovation, and boost company performance. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, military or veteran status, pregnancy related conditions (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), disability or any other protected status in accordance with federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer (Backend)
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Through a partnership\-based approach, Coterie helps insurance professionals unlock untapped revenue in the small commercial space. With an innovative quoting platform that delivers accurate pricing and bindable quotes in less than one minute, Coterie makes small business insurance effortless. We are on a mission to build and foster a world\-class team to bring speed, simplicity, and service to commercial insurance. We value integrity, humility, passion, and intelligence. If you want to push yourself and reshape a $200B\+ market, we’re excited to talk to you! **What will the Sr Software Engineer (Backend) do?** The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for leading the design, development, and maintenance of complex software systems that support organizational goals. This role provides technical direction, contributes to architectural decisions, and ensures the quality, scalability, and performance of engineering solutions. The Senior Software Engineer mentors team members, drives continuous improvement, and collaborates with cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver reliable and efficient software aligned with business needs. All engineers are granted a Claude Code premium license and are encouraged to leverage AI in their work **Key Responsibilities:** * Designs and implements complex systems; mentors others * Owns end\-to\-end delivery of significant features * Ensures code quality, scalability, and maintainability * Influences technical direction and team practices. **Required Qualifications:** * 5\+ years software engineering experience * 5\+ years working in the insurance industry * 5\+ years building production ready APIs in C\# with .NET 5\+ * Experience working within a micro\-services architecture in a containerized environment. * Experience working with cloud\-based SQL and NoSQL Databases, and other cloud\-based services to build scalable applications. * Experience using Git and GitHub to collaborate and review code. * Experience writing Unit tests and automated integration tests (Postman or equivalent) * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to debug issues and improve system performance. * Collaborates effectively with cross\-functional teams and participates in code reviews. * Willingness to learn new technologies and contribute to continuous improvement. **Our interview process:** Our hiring process generally consists of 4 phases. The goal is to provide an opportunity for us to learn more about our candidates while allowing them to get to know us as well! * **Phase 1**: Qualified candidates will first meet with a member of our People Operations team for a phone interview. This discussion is a high\-level conversation to understand more about your background and interests and for us to share more about Coterie and the position. * **Phase 2**: Selected candidates will be invited to meet with our Hiring Manager for a 2nd interview via Teams video. This interview is designed to be more detail oriented and allows you to learn more about the role and expected to be 30 minutes in length. * **Phase 3**: Top candidates will be invited to interview with members of our engineering team via Teams video. This series will include participating in live coding exercise/discussion. This series is expected to be 2 hours in length. * **Phase 4:** Final candidates will receive an invite to interview with our CTO. This video interview is expected to be 30 minutes in length. **What's in it for you:** Coterie has excellent benefits for all full\-time employees. We offer the following: * 100% remote * Health insurance through Aetna (we pay 100% of premiums) * Dental and vision insurance through Guardian (we pay 100% of premiums) * Basic life insurance (we pay 100% of premiums) * Access to flexible spending account (FSA) or health savings account (HSA) (for those using HSA eligible plans) * 401K plan (up 4% match with immediate vest). Must be 21 years of age or older to participate * Flexible PTO policy offering employees up to 4 weeks of PTO in their first 12 months. Thereafter, PTO usage aligns with company standards and typically does not exceed 5 weeks per calendar year. * 12 company\-paid holidays each year * Continuing education annual stipend * Annual salary estimated between $140,000\-$165,000 based on national data. Candidates who meet all the minimum requirements and possess additional relevant experience, as outlined in the job description, may be considered for a salary above the midpoint of the above range. Salary is based on internal equity; internal salary ranges; market data/ranges; applicant’s skills; prior relevant experience; degrees or certifications, etc. **Work Authorization:** At this time, Coterie Insurance is unable to consider candidates who require current or future visa sponsorship. Applicants must have authorization to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future. Falsification of an application, including work authorization status, is immediate grounds for dismissal from consideration.

tests to verify correctness, stability, and performance. * Investigate software defects and resolve complex database\-related issues. * Contribute to distributed systems features, replication, and data consistency mechanisms. * Participate in code reviews and follow established software engineering standards. * Collaborate with product managers, quality engineers, and other developers on jobs.title: Staff, Back-end engineer (Inventory Platform)
jobs.description: **Company Introduction** We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did we ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we're collectively disrupting the multi\-billion\-dollar e\-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest\-growing e\-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce. We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurial surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world. **Job Overview** Coupang relies on technology to provide on\-time, fast delivery of products to customers every day. Inventory Platform organization comprises critical services and platforms that take care of delivering customer orders optimally right from the moment the order is placed up until it is successfully delivered at the doorstep of the customer. Building highly available and scalable systems to handle billions of order \& delivery transactions and support Coupang's rapidly growing Product Commerce business is a complex architectural challenge. We are responsible for delivering products to millions of online shopping customers by improving order reconciliation with technology. To deliver this challenge, we are looking for an experienced and passionate engineer who can design and build large\-scale, multi\-tiered, distributed services. **Key Responsibilities** Demonstrate excellence resulting in scalable systems and services with the highest quality architecture and design. Responsible for benchmarking the Platform, collecting metrics \& publishing results. Responsible for measuring \& ensuring reliability and uptime of the Platform with 99\.995% guarantees. Responsible for capacity estimation \& provisioning of cluster for different customer workloads. Responsible for production incident Monitoring \& Alerting for the Platform. Detail oriented and hands on engineer who can analyze OSS Platform components and code. Dive deep into critical system issues, proactively addressing similar root causes, and raise the bar on Operational Excellence. Exposure to one of the SQL or NoSQL database systems. (Cassandra, MySQL etc.) Collaborate with other teams to make the platform open and extensible to unlock innumerable opportunities for innovations. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math, or a closely related field * 8 years of experience in backend software development * Experience working in cloud environments, particularly AWS * Demonstrated experience in building and maintaining highly available, distributed systems **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in developing and operating backend services and web applications. * Experience building complex, high\-performance, and highly available distributed software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers. * Strong familiarity developing with Java and Spring Framework as well as experience in an AWS environment. * Extensive experience in managing mission critical services with high throughput and low latency. * Solid engineering skills as a lead engineer to coach and lead high performing software engineers and keep them motivated. * Excellent communication skills to shepherd communication with end users, technical \& business teams to collect requirements, describe product features, and develop technical designs to achieve business goals. * Knowledge of Agile software engineering practices \& patterns for the full software development lifecycle including coding standards, code reviews, build processes, testing, and live site operations. * Demonstrated leadership in cross\-functional, highly collaborative environment. **Pay \& Benefits** Our compensation reflects the cost of living across several US geographic markets.
