jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Essential Job Functions** * Write production code every week across the storefront, backend, and front end, and carry a meaningful share of the team's delivery personally. * Own the production portal end to end: uptime, page performance, checkout reliability, and defects that affect orders or conversion. Lead incident response and drive durable fixes rather than one\-off patches. * Serve as the primary technical contact for Bag Caddie stakeholders. Translate business requirements into technical scope, surface risks early, and commit to realistic delivery dates. * Design the architecture that connects Shopify with Crane's systems: order, inventory, shipment, and tracking data flows, API contracts, and the backend services that support them. * Build and customize the Shopify storefront and custom apps using Liquid, theme architecture, and the Shopify Admin, Storefront, and GraphQL APIs. * Implement and maintain payment processing and credit card handling to tokenization and PCI standards. * Build and lead the team: define hiring needs, interview and select engineers, onboard them, set expectations, give feedback, and run performance and career conversations. Scale the team up or down as the customer's roadmap requires. * Set and uphold engineering standards for testing, code review, security, observability, secrets handling, feature\-flag hygiene, and formal change management for production releases. * Use storefront analytics (GA4, Shopify Analytics, heatmaps) to find conversion and usability problems, and prioritize fixes with the customer and product. * Run the team's agile cadence: sprint planning, stand\-ups, retrospectives, and release planning, with clear ownership for each piece of work. * Partner with the Application Engineering, Client Integrations, and platform teams so the portal uses Crane's shared tooling and patterns instead of one\-off solutions. * Document system design, deployment procedures, and runbooks so the portal does not depend on any single person. * Participate in the on\-call rotation and provide extended coverage during customer peak sales periods. * Other duties as assigned. **Physical Requirements** * Talking, hearing and using hands to operate computer equipment * Vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus * Job may require extended sitting or standing, use of standard office equipment. * Job may require punctual attendance and regular presence on\-site at the assigned work location. **Other Skills \& Abilities** Shopify expertise: building and customizing Shopify storefronts; Shopify Liquid and theme architecture; the Admin, Storefront, and GraphQL APIs; custom app and custom functionality development; storefront performance and conversion optimization; an understanding of e\-commerce UI/UX and customer experience. Payments and post\-purchase integrations: online payment processing and credit card handling practices, including tokenization and PCI compliance; direct experience with PaySafe or a comparable processor (Stripe, Braintree, Authorize.net); experience integrating shipping, tracking, or e\-commerce services through REST or GraphQL APIs, with AfterShip or a similar tracking platform as a plus. Backend fluency on Crane's stack: C\# or F\# on .NET, REST API design, SQL Server and PostgreSQL schema design and query tuning, AWS services, event\-driven messaging (Kafka, SQS, or Azure Service Bus), CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (Terraform). Working knowledge of accessibility practices. Operations: GitHub and GitHub Actions, feature flagging and progressive delivery (LaunchDarkly or equivalent), dashboards and alerting (Grafana or equivalent), incident management tooling and process (Incident.io or equivalent), and a track record of supporting a production e\-commerce site independently. Leadership: hiring, onboarding, and developing engineers; running an agile team; setting technical direction and aligning a team behind it; working directly with customer and business stakeholders; and communicating technical trade\-offs clearly in writing and diagrams. * **Leads from the keyboard**: stays hands\-on in the code while building and directing the team. * **Thinks Analytically**: weighs the costs, benefits, risks and chances for success when making a decision. * **Is Proactive**: takes on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy and enthusiasm. * **Focuses on Performance**: holds self and others accountable to meet commitments. * **Develops Talent**: gives direct feedback, creates growth opportunities, and builds a team that can operate without constant supervision. * **Collaborates**: builds partnerships internally and externally to meet shared objectives. * **Influences**: gains support for ideas and proposals through clear, audience\-aware communication. **Education \& Experience** * Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related field preferred. * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience * 2\+ years leading engineers as a manager or technical lead, * Hands\-on experience building and operating a production Shopify storefront. **Certification \& Licenses** Professional certification may be required in some areas, CHB license preferred Certified Customs Specialist (CCS) Preferred. **WHY SHOULD YOU WORK FOR CRANE?** At Crane, we believe in providing our employees with excellent benefits at a Great Place to Work. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. Engineering 1 is a foundational role at Creation Technologies, focused on executing moderate to moderately complex engineering tasks required in the creation, configuration and optimization of industrial processes required to produce and/or test Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs) and/or box assemblies. This entry\-level engineering position is crucial for those starting their career in electronics manufacturing services, providing an opportunity to apply theoretical knowledge in a practical setting while developing first areas of subject matter expertise and learning industry standards and practices. This role supports engineering activities under the guidance of Engineering Management. It’s a role that combines hands\-on experience with professional growth, offering insights into manufacturing processes and a pathway for future advancement in the field.* Executes MFG engineering tasks and activities under the direction of Manufacturing Engineering management. * Ability to work with and familiar with PLM and MES systems. * Ensures the translation of customer requirements to assembly and test processes by Managing Bill of Materials (BOM), document control, and validates routing; supports New Product Introduction * (NPI) and Engineering Change Order (ECO) processes. * Engages in detailed manufacturing process documentation, including work instructions, as received * from customer, and prepped for release to production floor. * Create Assembly documents, Bill of Process and SMT/AOI Machine files (use of CAM350, Factory * Logix, or other MES and CAD/CAM software). * Generate, and support the control, and distribution of manufacturing process documentation * including Process Plans and Procurement specifications. * Perform Design for Manufacture analysis with cross functional teams and reporting. * Supports schedules for engineering projects, including coordinating tasks and resources for above schedule within the engineering team. * Participates in cross\-functional teams to support manufacturing process improvements to enhance production efficiency and product quality. * Supports the review and update of manufacturing procedures to ensure they are current and effective. * Provides technical support to the manufacturing team, aiding in the resolution of engineering issues that affect production and prevent continuous production flow. * Monitors key performance indicators (KPIs) and analyzes data to identify and resolve systemic process and performance issues. QUALIFICATIONS: Education and Required Experience * Bachelor's Degree (4 year) in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial, Mechatronic, or other relevant discipline) or a related field with a focus on electronics and manufacturing processes or equivalent industry or military training experience. * New graduates or candidates with up to 4 years of engineering support experience in electronics manufacturing preferred. Skills Required * Ability to interpret a variety of technical documents such as wiring diagrams and drawings effectively. * Understanding of manufacturing processes and quality standards such as ISO9001/13485 or AS9100\. * Understanding of the concepts of New Product Introduction and how to execute projects including supporting functions. * Understands and can execute Design for Assembly and Test tasks as required. * Ability to follow detailed instructions and adhere to safety guidelines. * Problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Capacity to learn and apply new skills in a dynamic manufacturing services environment. * Awareness of IPC standards, Lean principles, six sigma and industrial ergonomics preferred. * Proficient in using Computer systems and knowledge of CAD/CAM and programming preferred. * Engineering project management and project leadership skills an asset. WORKING ENVIRONMENT CONDITIONS Physical and/or Mental Demands While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and use hands to finger, handle, or feel office equipment, objects, tools, or controls. jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** The Principal Data Engineer holds a pivotal role in enabling data\-driven decision\-making across CTS. This position involves designing, building, and maintaining the processes that collect, store, and process data for analysis and business use. This individual is responsible for creating data pipelines that transform raw data into usable formats for analysts, data scientists, visualization engineers, and other stakeholders. This includes developing and maintaining databases, data warehouses, and other data infrastructure. The Principal Data Engineer collaborates closely with stakeholders to deliver and support business operations, with a focus on democratizing data and building robust analytics solutions. This role will develop data solutions, enhance internal analytics platforms, and streamline processes to drive efficiently. **Job Description** **PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Conceptualizes and implements foundational data models, Data Lake, ETL pipelines and curated layer servicing multiple reporting platforms. * Writes and optimizes SQL queries for high performance and cost\-effectiveness in large\-scale data environments. * Develops and manages data engineering architecture, and designs and implements Lakehouse and analytics solutions. * Develops and coordinates cloud architecture across diverse areas including application development, identity and access management, network and data management, and security. * Implements data management best practices including cleansing, deduplication, validation, and governance to ensure data integrity and quality. * Designs, develops, and maintains robust scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines across multiple data sources and destinations. * Collaborates with data analysts, data scientists, and software engineers to understand data needs and translates them into technical solutions. * Optimizes data workflows for performance, scalability, and reliability. * Builds and maintains data models and warehouse schemas in support of analytics and business intelligence initiatives. * Optimizes query performance and database operations * Ensures data quality, integrity, and compliance across all systems. * Participates in architectural discussions and help drive best practices in data engineering. * Collaborates with fellow data \& analytics colleagues to foster a culture of teamwork and innovation. * Mentors junior data engineers and contributes to the development of team standards and practices. * Monitors data pipelines and resolves production issues in a timely manner. * Partners closely with DevOps and platform teams to manage infrastructure and deployment of data tools. * Performs all assigned duties in compliance with internal SOPs and external regulations. Brings compliance issues to the attention of management. * Assures quality customer service to all customers. * Maintains good attendance and punctuality per the absence policy. * Performs all other duties, at the discretion of management, as assigned. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering or related field of study, or equivalent technical experience. * Experience: A minimum of ten (10\) years of data engineering related experience; solid understanding of query languages (e.g., SQL), data transformation techniques, data modeling, warehousing concepts, and best practices. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Knowledge of Azure cloud platform, Fabric data platform, ADF and DevOps is highly preferred * Professional database certification **SKILLS \& ABILITIES** * Strong business acumen, critical thinking, and ability to work cross functionally through collaboration with engineering and business partners. * Ability to read and understand various data structures. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team. * Strong analytical, technical, and troubleshooting skills. * Familiarity with data governance, privacy, and compliance standards. * Must possess the skills and abilities to successfully perform all assigned duties and responsibilities. * Must be able to maintain confidentiality. * Ability to work in a team environment and participate as an active team member. * Effective oral and written communication skills. * Able to organize, prioritize, and execute a variable workload and multiple priorities. **PHYSICAL \& TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS** * Office work environment * Travel: \< 10% * 5\+ hours per shift: Sitting, finger dexterity, reaching waist to shoulder * Up to 3 hours per shift: Standing, walking, bending, squatting, kneeling, handling, driving, reaching above shoulders, reaching waist to shoulder, reaching knee to waist, reaching floor to knee, grasping items, lift/carry/move items up to 40 pounds, push/pull items up to 10 pounds ### ***The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by people assigned to this job. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (API/Agentic)
jobs.description: **Company Description** Cricut® empowers people to make and personalize almost anything—from custom cards and apparel to everyday items and home décor. Our smart cutting machines, design apps, and materials make creativity easy and accessible for everyone. We believe everyone is born creative, and our mission is to put the power of handmade into the hands of all. With a passionate community of Makers around the world, Cricut helps turn inspiration into real, tangible creations—one project at a time. Let’s make. **Job Description** * Spend most of your time writing, reviewing and shipping production backend code. * Use agentic coding tools as a core part of your daily workflow, including AI\-assisted code review, automated test generation and AI\-augmented development, while keeping code quality, security and human oversight in place. * Design and build APIs and services end to end, from technical approach and API contract through implementation, testing and release. * Contribute to backend architecture across our C\#/.NET and Python services, keeping them modular, maintainable and testable. * Define clear, versioned API contracts that client teams on iOS, Android and desktop can consume easily. * Work closely with Product Management, UX and client engineers to take defined features from spec to shipped, raising technical tradeoffs and feasibility early. * Optimize service performance and scalability, including latency, throughput, database query efficiency, caching, concurrency and cloud cost. * Write and maintain automated unit, integration and contract tests for your services. * Drive CI/CD automation, release quality and deployment processes for containerized cloud services. * Ship behind feature flags with progressive rollout and kill switches, and validate new behavior with production telemetry before ramping up. * Own service health through observability, tracking SLOs, error rates, latency budgets and defect trends, and take part in on\-call and incident response. * Take part in code reviews and share knowledge with other engineers. * Evaluate new backend, cloud, AI and tooling technologies, and recommend adopting them where they would meaningfully improve the team's work. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field. * 8\+ years of professional backend software development experience, with deep, production\-level expertise in either C\#/.NET (ASP.NET Core) or Python (FastAPI/Django). * Proven experience designing and running backend architectures at scale: microservices or modular monoliths, event\-driven and asynchronous messaging (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS, Azure Service Bus), and distributed systems patterns. * Strong API design skills using REST, including versioning, pagination, idempotency, error handling and OpenAPI documentation. * Strong experience with relational and NoSQL data stores (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis), including schema design, indexing and query tuning. * Strong understanding of the concurrency model in your primary language (async/await and the Task Parallel Library in .NET, or asyncio in Python). * Hands\-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP), containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or equivalent). * At least one year of hands\-on, practical use of modern AI engineering tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.), with experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into backend services where relevant (agentic patterns, evals, and latency/cost/reliability tradeoffs). * Experience with architectural patterns such as Clean Architecture, Domain\-Driven Design, CQRS or hexagonal architecture. * Strong debugging, profiling and performance optimization skills with tools such as dotTrace/PerfView, py\-spy/cProfile and APM tracing. * Experience with automated testing (unit, integration, contract, load) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). * Experience instrumenting services with observability tools (e.g., Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana). * **Bonus:** experience with both C\# and Python. * **Bonus:** experience working with client engineering teams (iOS, Android, Electron/Angular) to design APIs that fit mobile and desktop needs. Soft Skills * Communicates clearly in writing and in person with engineering, product and design. * Works well with Product Management, UX and client teams, and builds agreement on scope and tradeoffs. * Shares knowledge readily and helps other engineers on the team grow. * Stays curious about new tools and techniques, especially in AI\-assisted development, and brings practical improvements to the team. **Additional Information** **We’ve Got You Covered** At Cricut, we take care of our people. Enjoy competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, a 401(k) match, generous PTO, tuition reimbursement, and a yearly lifestyle stipend to support your wellness and passions. You’ll also receive exclusive employee discounts—and best of all, you’ll be surrounded by some of the most talented, creative, and curious minds out there. **A Quick Note Before You Apply…** Cricut is in an exciting chapter of transformation. We’re evolving fast—refining our strategy, growing our teams, and raising the bar across everything we do. This is an incredible opportunity for the right kind of person—but it’s not for everyone. We’re looking for A\-players—people who thrive in dynamic environments, turn challenges into momentum, and consistently deliver their best work. If that sounds like you, read on. **Here’s what makes someone a great fit for this role (and for this moment at Cricut):** * You move with urgency. You don’t wait for perfect clarity to act—you start, learn, and adjust. * You set high standards. You take ownership, deliver quality, and hold yourself accountable. * You stay focused when things move fast. You prioritize what matters most and tune out the noise. * You collaborate like a pro. You elevate others, communicate clearly, and bring a low\-ego, high\-output energy. * You embrace AI as part of your toolkit. From idea exploration to data analysis and creative problem\-solving, you leverage AI to accelerate innovation and amplify impact—because technology and creativity go hand\-in\-hand here. **One More Thing (It’s a Big One)** This role is in\-office at least 4–5 days per week. We believe real collaboration, innovation, and culture are built face\-to\-face. If you’re energized by working alongside smart, kind, creative people—and love those hallway conversations that spark the next great idea—you’ll feel right at home. If you’re looking for a fully remote role, this may not be the right fit. But if you’re excited by challenge, purpose, and building something better—let’s make something amazing together. **Relocation Statement:** * This position is eligible for relocation assistance. **What to Do Next:** Please attach your resume, cover letter and/or include links to your portfolio or other social presence. If you want to show your super powers in other ways – include that information too. You can be sure that Cricut® is an employer who values individuality, equality and diversity, so tell us what you’re all about. If you are a Maker or a DIY enthusiast, whether you think you are a good one or not, we would love to hear about it when you send us your information. Cricut® is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. This position is contingent on successfully completing a Criminal Background Check upon hire. Cricut participates in E\-Verify.

jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer, Frontier Agentic AI (Remote)
jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** CrowdStrike is seeking a Distinguished Engineer to research, define, and build the future of cybersecurity AI within our Cybersecurity Superintelligence Lab. This role brings together frontier AI research, deep cybersecurity expertise, and large\-scale systems engineering. The mandate is broad: understand where AI is going, identify new approaches to cybersecurity, and build systems that fundamentally improve how defenders operate. You will build against what is possible today while anticipating what advances in models and agentic systems could make possible over the next 12\-24 months. That means thinking about the entire application and the systems behind it, from models and agents to security data, tools, and execution environments. The work may span autonomous investigation, threat hunting, adversary simulation, detection, response, and remediation. Some of the most important use cases have yet to be defined. As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be one of the senior technical leaders of the Lab. You will make original technical contributions while setting direction for teams working on these problems. You will identify important research questions, develop new approaches, build prototypes, establish rigorous evaluations, and help turn successful research into capabilities that operate at CrowdStrike scale. **What You'll Do:** * Define the future of cybersecurity AI. Track advances at the frontier of AI and determine what they make possible for cybersecurity. Identify new capabilities and use cases early, with a particular focus on transforming how defenders operate. Set the research directions and technical approaches required to pursue them. * Invent and build new cybersecurity AI systems. Design end\-to\-end applications that reason across security context, use tools, coordinate, and execute complex security tasks. Determine how models, agents, security telemetry, and execution environments should work together to enable new capabilities. * Develop systems that improve through experience. Use investigations, adversary behavior, simulations, and expert feedback to improve system behavior. Explore how offensive validation and defensive outcomes can generate better evidence, evaluations, and training signals. Work directly with threat researchers, incident responders, red teamers, and other security experts to keep the research grounded in real\-world defense. * Establish rigorous evaluations. Build benchmarks, cyber environments, and evaluation harnesses that expose capabilities and failure modes. Measure security efficacy, reliability, performance, and cost. * Set technical direction across the Lab. Lead consequential research and architecture decisions across teams. jobs.description: **About Curative** Curative is building the future of health insurance with a first\-of\-its\-kind employer\-based plan designed to remove financial barriers and make care truly accessible: one monthly premium with $0 copays and $0 deductibles\*. Backed by our recent **$150M in Series B funding** and valuation at **$1\.275B**, Curative is scaling rapidly and investing in AI\-powered service, deeper member engagement, and a smart network designed for today’s workforce. Our north star guides everything we do: **healthcare only works when people can actually use it**. That belief drives every decision we make: from how we design our plan, support our members, to how we collaborate as a team. If you want to do meaningful work with a team that moves fast, experiments boldly, and cares deeply, Curative is the place to do it. We’re growing fast and looking for teammates who want to help transform health insurance for the better.**About the Platform Team** --------------------------- The Platform team's mission is to create a highly productive environment for application developers to experiment and ship new business features and systems. We own the cloud infrastructure, developer experience tooling, CI/CD, and shared platform services that the rest of engineering builds on. Our primary stack is **AWS, OpenTofu, Python, and Go**. **The Role** ------------ As a Platform Engineer (L2\), you'll own meaningful pieces of our infrastructure end\-to\-end — designing, deploying, and maintaining services that other engineers rely on every day. You'll work on projects on roughly 4\-week horizons, ship infrastructure changes with minimal day\-to\-day guidance, and steadily deepen your specialization in cloud architecture, reliability, and developer tooling. This role is a good fit if you've shipped production infrastructure at one or more prior organizations, have a working grasp of IaC fundamentals, and want to grow your platform engineering craft on a team that takes developer experience seriously. This is a fully remote position. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Deploy and maintain infrastructure with OpenTofu, with a focus on fault tolerance and operational simplicity. * Own the lifecycle of services and subsystems — design, deployment, production support, and ongoing improvements. * Build and improve CI/CD pipelines so application teams can ship safely and quickly. * Investigate and resolve moderately complex infrastructure and performance issues, developing structured troubleshooting habits along the way. * Integrate security and compliance considerations — including HIPAA — into infrastructure decisions. * Participate in architecture design discussions, and help engineers across the org navigate cloud and automation frameworks. * Contribute to broader platform reliability improvements and process optimization across engineering. * Take on small\-scale project leadership: scoping work, managing timelines, and coordinating with teammates. * Participate in the on\-call rotation for systems your team owns. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * A few years of professional experience as a software, platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineer, including time at more than one organization. * Hands\-on experience with a major cloud provider; AWS preferred. * Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code — OpenTofu, Terraform, or equivalent. * Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines. * Proficiency in at least one of Python or Go, and willingness to work in both. * Solid fundamentals in networking, storage, and monitoring. * Ability to debug production issues independently and communicate clearly about what you found. * Comfort participating in an on\-call rotation. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, finance) with compliance requirements like HIPAA. * Exposure to Kubernetes (EKS) or other container orchestration. * Experience with observability tooling (Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus). * Background in developer experience or internal platform work. **Perks \& Benefits*** Curative Health Plan (100% employer\-covered medical premiums for you and 50% coverage for dependents on the base plan.) + $0 copays and $0 deductibles (with completion of our Baseline Visit ) + Preventive and primary care built in + Mental health support + One\-on\-one care navigation + Chronic condition programs (diabetes, weight, hypertension) + Maternity and family planning support + 24/7/365 Curative Telehealth + Pharmacy benefits * Comprehensive dental and vision coverage * Employer\-provided life and disability coverage with additional supplemental options * Flexible spending accounts * Generous PTO policy plus 11 paid annual company holidays * 401K for full\-time employees * Generous Up to 8–12 weeks paid parental leave, based on role eligibility.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a seed\-stage AI company, backed by a top\-tier venture firm, building the ad layer for the AI era: interactive brand experiences embedded natively into apps and websites. Its ads are generated dynamically in real time and personalized to every single user, so every impression is hyper\-relevant. The recommendation stack is already live, serving ads across millions of daily interactions, reaching tens of millions of users, with millions in annualized ad spend. Dozens of AI\-generated playable mini\-game and video ads run in production inside major AI apps, built on the company's own playable engine and editor, and its ad SDK (Swift, Kotlin, React, React Native) is live in top App Store and Google Play apps. The team is small and based in San Francisco, with multiple prior exits and experience from leading tech and finance companies. ### **About the Role** The Applied AI Engineer owns the engine that makes real\-time, personalized ads possible: agents that generate playable mini\-games, short\-form video, and every variant in between on the fly, then learn from how they perform across millions of daily interactions and millions in annualized ad spend. This is a full\-stack applied AI role spanning model selection, agent orchestration, and production infrastructure, with direct business impact at every layer. The architecture isn't defined yet, and this hire helps define the approach. The agents plug into a recommendation stack that is already serving ads in production, and every ad they create is served to real users and measured against real advertiser dollars. The stack runs on GCP, Redis, MongoDB, and Temporal. The role comes with ownership, equity, and a direct line to what ships. ### **What You'll Own** * **Playable generation agents:** Agents that turn an advertiser or app brief into a working, on\-brand HTML5 playable ad. * **Automated QA:** Checks that catch broken playable builds before a human does. * **Video generation pipelines:** Multimodal pipelines that produce short\-form video ads and variants across formats, hooks, and styles using frontier image and video models. * **Real\-time personalization loop:** Connect generation to the recommendation and ranking engine so each user gets creative made for them, read what wins (engagement, CTR, installs, ROAS), and feed it back so every impression gets more relevant. * **Agent infrastructure:** Orchestration, evals, and reliability so all of this runs in production at scale, not just in a demo. ### **What's Already Live** You inherit a working system with real traffic, not a blank slate: * A recommendation stack already serving ads across millions of daily interactions, reaching tens of millions of users with millions of dollars in annualized ad spend * Dozens of AI\-generated playable mini\-game and video ads running in production inside major AI apps, built on the company's own playable engine and editor * A proprietary ad SDK (Swift, Kotlin, React, React Native), live in top App Store and Google Play apps ### **Must\-Have** * Strong applied AI experience: has built and shipped an LLM, multimodal, or agentic system in production, beyond simple API wrappers. * Backend depth across infra, data, and serving end\-to\-end, not just the model layer (GCP, Redis, MongoDB, Temporal). * Comfort with ambiguity: the architecture isn't defined yet, and this hire helps define the approach. * Bias toward shipping, suited to an early\-stage company that moves fast and figures things out. ### **Key Details** * **Location:** San Francisco, CA (in\-person) * **Employment:** Full\-time * **Experience:** 4\+ years * **Salary:** $200,000 – $250,000 USD per year, plus equity * **Visa Sponsorship:** Not available ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Equity * Ownership and a direct line to what ships ### **Interview Process** * Interview with the CTO * Take\-home assignment * Work trial * Offer

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Build the Technology Behind Medical Imaging \- This role is not hybrid or remote, must be able to work in office in Bloomingdale, IL location. Are you an experienced embedded software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems at the intersection of firmware, electronics, and motion control? Del Medical is looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to help develop, improve, and support the embedded systems powering our medical imaging equipment. This is an opportunity to take meaningful technical ownership of real\-world products, work closely with electrical and mechanical engineers, and see your engineering solutions move from development into production. We are particularly interested in engineers who understand what happens below the application layer—people who can write efficient firmware, debug hardware\-software interactions, and develop dependable embedded solutions rather than relying exclusively on high\-level software frameworks. What You'll Do * Design, develop, debug, and maintain embedded firmware using C and/or C\+\+. * Develop bare\-metal firmware for microcontroller\-based systems and real\-time applications. * Design and improve motion\-control functionality involving motors, encoders, sensors, and actuators. * Implement and troubleshoot communication protocols, including CAN/CANopen, RS\-232, I²C, SPI, and Ethernet. * Collaborate with electrical engineers on PCB bring\-up, electronic interfaces, and hardware\-software integration. * Use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, and other diagnostic equipment to identify and resolve complex technical problems. * Develop software verification tests, investigate failures, and improve system reliability. * Document software architecture, interfaces, requirements, testing, and engineering changes. * Support prototype development, production troubleshooting, and ongoing product improvements. * Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, quality, and product engineering teams. What We're Looking For Required qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Typically 7\+ years of professional embedded software or firmware development experience. * Strong proficiency in embedded C and/or C\+\+. * Demonstrated experience with bare\-metal programming and microcontroller\-based systems. * Hands\-on experience debugging electronic hardware and firmware integration issues. * Experience with embedded communication interfaces and protocols. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to independently own technical assignments and deliver maintainable, reliable software. Highly desirable experience: * Motor control, motion\-control systems, encoders, feedback loops, or real\-time control. * Medical devices, diagnostic imaging, industrial controls, or other reliability\-critical products. * Altium Designer, PCB development, and electronic schematic interpretation. * RTOS development, firmware update mechanisms, automated testing, or hardware diagnostics. * Familiarity with medical\-device software lifecycle, risk management, verification, and quality requirements. What Makes This Opportunity Different? * Meaningful technical ownership: Contribute directly to embedded systems used in medical imaging equipment. * Hands\-on engineering: Work with actual electronics, firmware, motors, and integrated systems. * Cross\-disciplinary collaboration: Work alongside electrical, mechanical, and product engineering professionals. * Visible impact: Help improve product functionality, reliability, and serviceability. * Competitive compensation: Earn $100,000–$150,000 annually based on demonstrated expertise. Benefits: * Competitive salary based on experience and knowledge * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * STD, LTD, Life and AD\&D Insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with company match. * Paid time off, including holidays and vacation. * Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. Who Will Succeed Here? You are a hands\-on engineer who enjoys understanding how systems work, diagnosing difficult problems, and building solutions that last. You are comfortable working independently, but you also know how to collaborate with engineers from different disciplines. You take pride in code quality, sound engineering decisions, technical documentation, and seeing a project through to completion. Candidates whose experience is limited to application\-level software development without hands\-on embedded firmware or hardware integration experience are unlikely to be a fit. Apply Today If you have embedded firmware, electronics, and motion\-control experience to make a difference, we want to hear from you. Please submit your résumé highlighting your embedded development experience, microcontroller platforms, communication protocols, and a few examples of challenging technical problems you have solved. Del Medical is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications and applicable law. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: * Assist in designing, prototyping and demonstrating new features and components of front\-end and back\-end to users to ensure compliance with requirements * Assisting in the design, implementation and optimization of related approaches, tools and workflows. * Collaborate with the technical teams, business teams, and product managers to ensure that the code that is developed meets their vision. * Work on a team that crafts the solutions to meet functional and technical requirements. * Align to Security/Compliance frameworks and controls requirements. * Own quality posture. Write automated tests, ideally before writing code. * Fix problems from the development phase through the production phase, which requires being on call for production support. ### **Benefits and Perks to Help You Keep Climbing** Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way: * Competitive salary, industry\-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives * 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9% * New hires are eligible for up to 2\-weeks of vacation. This is earned for use in the following vacation year (April 1 – March 31\) * In addition to vacation, new hires are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid personal time within a 12\-month period * + 10 paid holidays per calendar year * Birthing parents are eligible for 12\-weeks of paid maternity/parental leave * Non\-birthing parents are eligible for 2\-weeks of paid parental leave * Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life insurance beneﬁts * Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back\-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages * Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health * Domestic and International space\-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members * Career development programs to achieve your long\-term career goals * World\-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint * Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies * Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together * Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare ### **What you need to succeed (minimum qualifications)** * 0\-2 years of hands\-on experience as a Software Engineer or related technical engineering capacity. Relevant technologies and programming languages include Python, Java full stack and Node.js * Knowledge of Agile Methodologies is required, while practical application is highly preferred. * Working or formal training in the full Software Development Lifecycle, building CI/CD pipelines and practicing Test Driven Development is required. * Fundamental Awareness of Application Security principles or formal training in Information Security is required. * Experience with AWS, Containers, Kubernetes, RedHat OpenShift, DevOps, Nexus, GitLab, or related technologies. * Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data. * Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles. * Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency. * Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States. ### **What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications)** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems or related technical field. * Experience working with DevOps principles, practices and tools in an enterprise technology environment. * Knowledge of software within an Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud infrastructure or other cloud solution. * Experience building computer software within the airline industry is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior UI / UX Designer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **About Us** We are a leading global media agency, shaping the future of content, advertising, and audience engagement across platforms. Our product organization powers innovative solutions for clients worldwide, leveraging data, technology, and creativity. **Role Overview** As a Senior UI/UX Designer for Dentsu, you will shape how users interact with AI\-powered workflows and agent systems. This hands\-on role focuses on designing conversational interfaces, agentic experiences, and self\-service analytics tools that make complex AI behavior intuitive and trustworthy. You will work closely with AI engineers and data scientists to translate technical capabilities into effective end\-user experiences. **Key** **Responsibilities** * **AI Product Experience Design:** Design end\-to\-end experiences for client\-facing AI agent products, including conversational flows, agent handoffs, and multi\-step automated workflows. * **AI Interaction Patterns:** Define patterns for uncertainty and confidence communication, error and fallback states, latency handling, and human\-in\-the\-loop moments. * **Conversational \& Analytics Design:** Create conversational interfaces and self\-service analytics experiences that make complex data science outputs, including MMM, forecasting, and incrementality, accessible to non\-technical users. * **Design Systems:** Create and maintain reusable AI interaction components that accelerate future product deployments. * **Cross\-functional Collaboration:** Partner with AI engineers to understand system capabilities and constraints, ensuring designs are feasible, resilient, and accurately represent model behavior. * **Research \& Validation:** Lead discovery and user research with client stakeholders to validate concepts, identify friction, and inform the product roadmap. * **Prototyping:** Produce high\-fidelity prototypes to test agent experiences before engineering investment. * **Accessibility:** Champion WCAG 2\.2 AA standards, including screen\-reader compatibility, keyboard navigation, and accessible handling of streaming and dynamic AI content. * **Standards \& Documentation:** Establish UX standards, documentation, and design rationale records for the AI product portfolio. * **Global Collaboration:** Work effectively with distributed teams, including offshore engineering, across regions and time zones. **Requirements** **Must Have** * 5\+ years of UI/UX design experience, supported by a portfolio demonstrating shipped, complex digital products. * Strong command of interaction design, information architecture, and usability principles. * Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools, such as Figma. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present design rationale to executives, engineers, and clients. * Demonstrated ability to work independently and own design decisions end to end. * Comfort working with ambiguity and changing technical constraints. **Nice to Have** * Experience designing LLM\-based products, including chatbots, copilots, or agent workflows. * Familiarity with LLM concepts such as prompting, RAG, tool use, and model limitations. * Background in media, advertising, or marketing technology. * Experience designing analytics or business intelligence experiences, including dashboards and self\-service data exploration. * Experience contributing to or maintaining a design system at scale. * Accessibility certification, such as IAAP CPACC or WAS, or experience conducting accessibility audits and assistive technology testing. * Experience designing asynchronous, event\-driven, or streaming interfaces. **What We Value** * User\-first thinking and empathy for users navigating AI uncertainty. * Attention to detail in interaction design and accessibility. * Curiosity about how AI systems behave and how to design around their limitations. * Ownership and accountability for design decisions and their impact. * Strong communication and the ability to influence across disciplines. * Pragmatic problem\-solving and comfort with ambiguity. * Collaboration across distributed teams and time zones. * Passion for building trustworthy AI experiences that users understand and trust. **Additional Information** At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in\-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, Metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office. The annual salary range for this position is $94,875 \- $95,000\. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Benefits available with this position include: * Medical, vision, and dental insurance, * Life insurance, * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, * 401k, * Flexible paid time off, * At least 15 paid holidays per year, * Paid sick and safe leave, and * Paid parental leave. Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to, providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com. To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-MS3 **Location:** USA \- Remote \- Maryland**Brand:** Merkle**Time Type:** Full time**Contract Type:** Permanent Dentsu is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We do this without regard to race, color, national origin, sex , sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religious practices and observances, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Dentsu is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to, among others, individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you need an accommodation because of a disability to search and apply for a career opportunity with us, please send an e\-mail to ApplicantAccommodations@dentsu.com by clicking on the link to let us know the nature of your accommodation request and your contact information. We are here to support you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com **Job summary** **This position is for the SSL Store, powered by DigiCert** We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and run the platform behind our certificate management, TLS and vulnerability monitoring, uptime, and security products. The platform is a TypeScript monorepo: Fastify and Express services, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL and Redis, queues and workers on AWS, deployed to Kubernetes through Terraform, Helm, and Azure DevOps pipelines. It also carries a legacy .NET estate that we are steadily retiring, and a growing set of AI\-assisted features and internal tooling. You will own features end to end, from schema and API through UI, pipeline, and production. We work in a small team with a lot of surface area, so the job rewards engineers who pick up whatever the problem needs, whether that is a new framework, a scanner's quirks, or a cloud primitive they have not touched before **What you will do** * Design, build, and ship features across the full stack: Fastify or Express APIs, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL schemas and migrations, SQS\-driven workers, and the infrastructure that runs them. * Own services in production: observability with Sentry and Grafana, on\-call participation, incident root\-causing, and the follow\-through fixes. * Build and evolve security and monitoring products that scan, probe, and score real customer infrastructure at scale, with correctness and performance budgets that matter. * Maintain and incrementally retire legacy .NET and Python components, moving behavior into the TypeScript platform with parity verified rather than assumed. * Extend CI/CD and infrastructure: Azure DevOps pipelines, Docker images, Helm charts, and Terraform for EKS, RDS, SQS, and related AWS services. * Integrate third\-party and partner APIs (certificate authorities, scanners, identity providers) and keep those integrations resilient. * Use AI\-assisted development tools as part of daily work, and build AI\-backed features where they genuinely improve the product. * Review code, write tests, and raise the bar on standards that apply to human and AI\-generated code alike. * Mentor other engineers and write up decisions so others can act on them without you in the room. **What you will have** * 6\+ years building and operating production web services and the frontends on top of them. * Strong TypeScript and Node.js, including a modern API framework (Fastify preferred, Express acceptable) and a React framework (Next.js preferred). * Production experience in more than one language or ecosystem, and at least one stack change you drove or adapted to in the last few years. Depth in a single language is not enough for this role. * Solid relational database skills on MySQL or Postgres: schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance, and transaction and locking behavior. * Comfort owning what you ship: logging, metrics, alerting, and calm, evidence\-led debugging in production. * Security awareness as a habit: authentication and authorization flows, secrets handling, input validation, and dependency hygiene. * Clear written communication. You can explain a design, a trade\-off, or an incident to engineers and non\-engineers. **Nice to have** * Hands\-on AWS (compute, queues, storage, secrets) and the ability to read and change Terraform. * Containers and Kubernetes at a working level: writing a Dockerfile, reading a Helm chart, debugging a failing pod. * CI/CD pipeline work in Azure DevOps or similar, plus Cloudflare or AWS WAF experience. * Grafana, Sentry, or equivalent observability tooling beyond basic dashboards. * Experience with PKI, TLS, or certificate lifecycle management, or with monitoring and scanning products (uptime, vulnerability, DNS or email security). * OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect implementation experience, especially multi\-tenant identity providers. * C\# and .NET, enough to read, maintain, and migrate legacy services without making them your home. * Python for data pipelines, scanners, or tooling. * Large\-scale scanning or crawling systems: fleets of workers, rate limits, timeouts, and the cost math behind them. * Building with LLM APIs, MCP servers, or agentic workflows in a product context. **Benefits** * Competitive compensation and comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Retirement savings programs with company matching (401(k) or RRSP) * Generous paid time off, including holidays, and vacation * Paid parental leave and family support benefits * Life and disability coverage * Flexible spending and health savings options (where applicable) * Health and wellness support, including gym reimbursement and wellness programs * Employee Assistance Program with 24/7confidential support for employees and families * Education assistance and professional development opportunities * Access to LinkedIn Learning and continuous learning resources * Employee referral bonus program and additional company perks and discounts * Internal rewards and recognition platform (Motivosity) to celebrate and acknowledge project wins, milestone achievements, and the outstanding contributions of our colleagues * Business travel insurance and global employee support programs To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered. DigiCert is an Equal Opportunity employer and is committed to diversity in its workforce. In compliance with applicable federal and state laws, DigiCert prohibits discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, veteran's status, status as a qualified person with a disability, or genetic information. Individuals from historically underrepresented groups, such as minorities, women, qualified person with disabilities, and protected veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. \#LI\-IW1

jobs.title: Sr. AI Solution Architect
jobs.description: **Who we are** DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com **Job summary** You will embed with various business functions (Sales, Support, Finance, Legal, HR, Procurement, Marketing), learn how the work actually gets done, and build the AI solutions that change it: automated workflows, agents on our systems of record, and AI\-native tools wired into the platforms people already use. You work in a pod with a Senior Business Architect (who owns the problem framing and business case) and an operator from the function (who owns adoption). You own the solution: design, build, launch, measure, iterate. This is not a research role and it is not a traditional software engineering seat. It is the person who can sit in a Finance close review on Monday, prototype an agent against NetSuite and Salesforce data by Wednesday, and walk the CISO through the access model on Friday. You will be measured on production value the business can point to, not pilots. **What you will do** **Embedded problem solving and delivery.** Sit inside a function for the length of an engagement. Map the workflow, find where AI removes friction or creates capacity, and ship the fix. Own each solution end to end, from discovery through production monitoring. Three to four production launches a year is the bar. **Automation, agents, and AI\-native tools.** Build on our orchestration and platform layer (Salesforce and Agentforce, Microsoft 365 and Copilot, Slack, AWS and frontier model APIs, and the integration tooling that connects them). Design agent workflows with retrieval, tool use, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop review built in. Configure and extend vendor AI tools before building custom. Know when each is the right call. **AI infrastructure and vendor architecture.** Partner with IT, Security, and Engineering to design the shared foundation every production agent needs: model access, identity and permissions, data connectivity, logging and observability, evaluation. Lead the technical side of vendor evaluations and proofs of concept. Turn one\-off wins into reusable patterns the next pod can pick up. **Enablement for everyday users.** Design the services that help regular employees use AI well: templates, guided workflows, office hours, a path from "I have an idea" to "it runs in production." Coach power users so workflows outlive the person who built them. Success is the business owning and extending what you built. **Intake and governance, the technical half.** Serve as the technical reviewer in DigiCert's AI intake and governance process. Assess proposed use cases for data exposure, security posture, and feasibility. Recommend the right build path (vendor tool, configuration, custom). Keep every AI deployment safe, auditable, and inside DigiCert's security and compliance requirements, including FedRAMP\-adjacent constraints where they apply. **ROI and measurement.** Instrument what you build. Every solution ships with a baseline, a metric, and a dashboard the sponsoring executive can read. Feed results into the company AI measurement program run with the CFO. **First 90 days** ----------------- * Days 1 to 30: learn the stack and the governance process. Shadow the current pod. Review in\-flight intake requests. * Days 31 to 60: ship a first production workflow or agent with the pod. * Days 61 to 90: second engagement in flight. First enablement service live (template library, office hours, or guided intake). Present measured results from the first launch to the sponsoring executive. **What great looks like** ------------------------- * Business leaders ask for you by name because the last thing you built is still running and still measured. * You can explain a permissions model to the CISO and a workflow change to a sales rep in the same afternoon. * You default to the smallest solution that works, and you know when a vendor tool beats a custom build. * You leave behind patterns, documentation, and trained operators, not dependency on you. * You treat governance as a design input. **What you will have** * 5\+ years building and shipping technical solutions in a business context: solutions engineering, business systems, integration, automation, or forward\-deployed work. * 2\+ years hands\-on with LLM\-based systems in production or near\-production: agent frameworks, retrieval, tool calling, prompt and evaluation design. * Working proficiency in Python or JavaScript and comfort with APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, and authentication (OAuth, SSO, role\-based access). You do not need to be a career software engineer, but you need to build and debug without waiting on one. * Experience with enterprise platforms: Salesforce, Microsoft 365, NetSuite, Jira, and modern data warehouse.s * A track record of working directly with non\-technical teams and translating messy processes into working systems. * Judgment in security\- and compliance\-sensitive environments. You know what data cannot leave the building and design accordingly. * Clear written and spoken communication. You can write a one\-page architecture memo an executive will actually read. **Nice to have** * Prior forward\-deployed, solutions architect, or embedded consulting experience. * Hands\-on with Agentforce, Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic or OpenAI APIs, or MCP\-based tool integration. * Experience with intelligent automation or workflow platforms (Power Automate, Workato, n8n, UiPath). * Exposure to SOX, FedRAMP, or similar control environments. * Experience in a security or PKI company, or another business where trust is the product. **Benefits** * Competitive compensation and comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Retirement savings programs with company matching (401(k) or RRSP) * Generous paid time off, including holidays, and vacation * Paid parental leave and family support benefits * Life and disability coverage * Flexible spending and health savings options (where applicable) * Health and wellness support, including gym reimbursement and wellness programs * Employee Assistance Program with 24/7confidential support for employees and families * Education assistance and professional development opportunities * Access to LinkedIn Learning and continuous learning resources * Employee referral bonus program and additional company perks and discounts * Internal rewards and recognition platform (Motivosity) to celebrate and acknowledge project wins, milestone achievements, and the outstanding contributions of our colleagues * Business travel insurance and global employee support programs To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered. DigiCert is an Equal Opportunity employer and is committed to diversity in its workforce. In compliance with applicable federal and state laws, DigiCert prohibits discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, veteran's status, status as a qualified person with a disability, or genetic information. Individuals from historically underrepresented groups, such as minorities, women, qualified person with disabilities, and protected veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. \#LI\-KK1

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer - Data Protection
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). **What you'll do** ------------------ As a Lead Software Engineer on the Data Protection team, you'll be a key player in building the cryptographic foundation for Docusign's global infrastructure. You'll drive the engineering for our enterprise key management platform \- owning the systems that enable customers to control their own encryption keys and extending cryptographic protection across our data stores and services. Looking ahead, you'll help define how key management and cryptographic controls evolve alongside Docusign's platform \- ensuring our data protection posture stays ahead of industry standards and enterprise customer expectations. Our team is passionate about delivering high\-quality, fully\-tested code to ensure the level of security and reliability our customers depend on. This is a hands\-on role where you'll help drive technical direction, secure our platform, and directly enable Docusign's Intelligent Agreement Management by delivering trusted data protection solutions to enterprise customers. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Sr. Manager, Software Engineering. **Responsibility** * Design and build cryptographic key management systems that support the full key lifecycle generation, distribution, rotation, revocation, and expiry across cloud environments at enterprise scale * Build and maintain operational tooling for the health, observability, and reliability of cryptographic services and key integrations * Drive adoption of encryption best practices across Docusign's platform, establishing and evolving standards for data\-at\-rest and data\-in\-transit protection * Collaborate with engineering teams across the company to ensure their systems correctly support data protection requirements \- advising on encryption patterns, key management constraints, and data isolation boundaries * Contribute to threat modeling and security design reviews for new platform initiatives, identifying cryptographic and data protection risks early in the development lifecycle * Develop high\-quality, ship\-ready code covered by a full test suite * Conduct design and code reviews with a focus on security and availability not just coding to a spec **Job Designation** ------------------- **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation) Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. **What you bring** ------------------ **Basic** * 12\+ years of hands\-on development experience in C\# or other object\-oriented languages * 12\+ years of software engineering experience in high\-scale distributed systems * Experience with cloud Key Management Services (KMS) AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP Cloud KMS, or equivalent \- including key lifecycle management (rotation, revocation, expiry) and cross\-tenant or cross\-account key access patterns * Experience with encryption fundamentals key wrapping (DEK/KEK model), asymmetric key operations, and cryptographic key lifecycle management * B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent experience **Preferred** * Experience with .NET microservice architecture (C\#) in a high\-scale production environment * Hands\-on experience with Azure Key Vault RBAC authorization model, Managed Identity integration, Encryption Scopes, and CMK\-enabled data services * Experience with cloud infrastructure provisioning at scale \- IaC tooling (Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent), per\-tenant resource automation, and multi\-region deployments * Experience building monitoring and alerting for cryptographic services, including key access health and resource state observability * Experience building large\-scale, highly available, and reliable applications * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices * Strong organizational, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations: Washington: $178,900\.00 \- $262,825\.00 base salary This role is also eligible for the following: * Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre\-established sales goals. Non\-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance. * Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Global benefits provide options for the following: * Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region * Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement * Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment * Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions * Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements * Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events **Life at Docusign** -------------------- **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
