jobs.title: Software Engineer, ML Infrastructure (MDX)
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ DoorDash's MDX team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared foundation that ML engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo rely on to build and run ML\-powered products. We work across the full ML lifecycle: feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, serving, and monitoring. Our mission is to increase the velocity and reliability of ML\-driven business impact across the company. A central pillar of that work is agentic infrastructure. We are building systems that let agents accelerate and operate the ML workflow itself, including auto research, where agents explore and iterate on modeling ideas, and self\-healing systems that detect, diagnose, and remediate failures in ML pipelines and production models with minimal human intervention. **About the Role** ------------------ You will join a small, high\-leverage team building the agentic layer of DoorDash's ML infrastructure. You'll design and build the systems that let agents accelerate how ML engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo develop, ship, and operate models. That includes auto research systems that explore and iterate on modeling ideas, and agentic developer support that helps ML engineers move through training, evaluation, deployment, and debugging faster. You'll own well\-scoped components end to end, from design through production, working across agent orchestration, tooling and integrations with our ML platform, evaluation of agent behavior, and observability. This role is ideal for an engineer with a strong backend foundation who is excited to apply AI agents to real engineering workflows, learns quickly, and wants to grow into technical leadership in a fast\-moving area where model capabilities, tooling, and best practices change month to month. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * Build agentic systems that increase the velocity of ML development across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, helping ML engineers get from idea to production model faster. * Design and implement infrastructure that lets agents propose, run, and evaluate modeling experiments. * Build agentic developer support for the ML lifecycle, such as agents that help engineers set up training jobs, debug failing pipelines, review model deployments, and navigate our platform. * Develop evaluation and observability for agent behavior, so we can measure whether agents are actually helping, catch regressions early, and build the trust needed to give them more autonomy. * Work with production standards in mind, including reliability, safety guardrails, cost controls, monitoring, and clear playbooks, so that agentic workflows can run against real ML systems. * Partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, and platform teams to understand where their time goes and turn those workflows into durable, reusable platform capabilities. * Grow quickly in a fast\-moving area, with the chance to shape how agents are used to build and operate ML systems at a company of this scale. **We're excited about you because…** ------------------------------------ * B.S., M.S., or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent * 2\+ years of industry experience in software engineering * Hands\-on experience building ML infrastructure in production including feature engineering and feature stores, data pipelines for ML, training and experimentation platforms, model evaluation, deployment, serving and inference, or monitoring * Strong backend engineering fundamentals, especially in Python and distributed systems * Experience operating systems in production, including testing, observability, debugging, and reliability * A good understanding of how ML engineers and data scientists work, and a track record of building platforms, tools, or services that make them more productive * Ability to take ambiguous, well\-scoped problems from idea to production, and to learn quickly in a fast\-moving technical area * Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) across the software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring, and releasing software ### **Nice To Haves** * Experience building LLM\-powered applications or AI agents, including tool use, orchestration, or MCP servers, in production or on substantial projects * Experience with agent evaluation, LLM observability, tracing, or building eval harnesses * Experience with ML platforms or MLOps tooling (e.g., Kubeflow, MLflow, Ray, Airflow) * Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) * Experience building developer tools, internal platforms, or self\-serve infrastructure * Experience with guardrails, safety, or cost controls for LLM systems **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Statement of Non\-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non\-binary or gender non\-conforming, LGBTQIA\+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently\-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non\-discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. **If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.** Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only We used Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About EAB** At EAB, our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data\-driven insights and best\-in\-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve. At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards. For more information, visit our Careers page. **The Role in Brief:** **Senior Data Engineer** The Senior Data Engineer for Navigate360 leads the team responsible for implementing Navigate360 data integrations across partner campuses. This role oversees delivery for Navigate Student Success, EAB’s foundational student success technology, while charting and scaling implementation practices for newer Navigate Enrollment CRM and Advancement CRM offerings. The role combines people leadership, technical and operational judgment, and a partner\-first mindset to help campuses realize successful, durable implementations. Working at the intersection of data, product, and customer outcomes, this leader establishes clear operating processes, removes barriers, and ensures the team delivers reliable integrations that create value in practice. This position is ideally based out of EAB's Washington, D.C. or Richmond, VA office, and is open to remote work within the continental U.S. This hire may be required to travel to EAB’s central office in Washington, D.C. on a quarterly basis, and occasionally visit partners to firm up engagement and kick off high\-touch projects. The current travel expectation does not exceed 12 days per year. This position is also posted at the Director, Data Engineer level; candidates are being considered at both levels for the current opening. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Lead, coach, and develop a team of data engineers implementing Navigate modules for partner campuses; set clear expectations, priorities, and delivery standards. * Own the implementation approach for Navigate Student Success and help define scalable delivery practices for newer Navigate Enrollment CRM and Advancement CRM offerings. * Establish repeatable processes, playbooks, and quality controls that enable the team to deliver high\-quality data integrations consistently at scale. * Unblock partner\-facing and technical challenges throughout implementation projects, escalating and coordinating decisions as needed to protect partner outcomes. * Partner with Product on data\-integration issues, requirements, and product enhancements that improve implementation quality and the partner experience. * Collaborate closely with Launch and Partner Success teams to align implementation plans, manage risk, and support successful partner adoption and outcomes. * Guide solution design for integrations, data mapping, validation, reconciliation, and data quality across all Navigate implementations. * Oversee delivery planning, capacity, and project health across the team; use organized, methodical processes to manage competing priorities and drive predictable execution. * Foster a culture of technical excellence through mentoring, thoughtful code and design review, documentation, and continuous improvement of team practices. * Represent the Data Engineering team with internal and external stakeholders, communicating progress, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations with clarity and credibility. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience * 4\+ years of database programming experience, including advanced SQL * 2\+ years leading, managing, or serving as a team lead for data engineering teams * Experience delivering data integration, warehousing, or analytics solutions in partner\-facing or customer implementation environments * 2\+ years of Python programming experience for relational data management, including commonly used data\-management libraries * Deep understanding of how data flows across systems, including ETL pipelines, data mapping, validation, and reconciliation * Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical and partner challenges, make sound decisions, and unblock teams * Experience ensuring data integrity through standard rules, procedures, testing, validation, and quality controls * Highly organized, process\-oriented, and effective at managing multiple priorities in a changing environment; strong written and verbal communication skills ernal partners and executive stakeholders to solve problems, build trust, and drive successful implementations * Practical knowledge of data warehouse design, scalable data pipelines, integrations across platforms, and complex stored procedures * Experience leading teams through growth, change, and continuous improvement, including developing repeatable operating processes * Ability to work collaboratively across Product, Launch, Partner Success, and technical teams to accomplish shared partner outcomes in a fast\-paced environment * Commitment to a continual learning environment and to a dynamic, welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB’s mission, values, and aspiration *If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome new perspectives and learn from each other’s unique experiences. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.* **Compensation:** The anticipated starting salary range for this role is $85,500 – $110,000 per year. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting salary range for their role. This hire will additionally be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Variable compensation may depend on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. **Benefits:** Consistent with our belief that our employees are our most valuable resource, EAB offers a competitive and inclusive benefits package. Our benefits currently include: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; dependents and domestic partners eligible * 20\+ days of PTO annually, in addition to paid firm and floating holidays * Daytime leave policy for community service and flextime for fitness activities (up to 10 hours per month each) * 401(k) retirement savings plan with annual discretionary company matching contribution * Health savings account, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending account, and pre\-tax commuter plans * Employee assistance program with counseling services and resources available to all employees and immediate family * Wellness programs including gym discounts, incentives to promote healthy living, and family access to the leading app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation * Fertility treatment coverage and adoption or surrogacy assistance * Paid parental leave with phase back to work program for birthing and non\-birthing parents * Access to milk shipping service to support nursing employees during business travel * Discounted pet health insurance coverage for dog and cat family members * Company\-provided life, AD\&D, and disability insurance * Financial wellness resources and membership in a robust employee discount program * Access to employee resource groups, merit\-based advancement, and dynamic professional growth opportunities Benefits kick in day one; learn more at eab.com/careers/benefits. *This opening is not eligible for visa sponsorship at this time; EAB will thus consider candidates who possess U.S. work authorization that does not require employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.* At EAB, we believe that to fulfill our mission to “make education smarter and our communities stronger” we need team members who bring a diversity of perspectives to the table and a workplace where each team member is valued, respected and heard. To that end, EAB is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we make employment decisions on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: About Us: At ENFRA, we blend a rich history with a forward\-looking vision. With over 100 years of experience, we are a pillar of stability in the energy infrastructure industry and a leader in innovative energy solutions. Our commitment to leveraging emerging technologies ensures that we remain at the forefront of the Energy\-as\-a\-Service sector. We believe in growth—not just for our business, but for our people. Our team members have the opportunity to advance their careers in a supportive environment that values continuous learning and development. We embrace innovation and encourage creative problem solving to tackle the energy infrastructure and energy challenges of tomorrow. Inclusion is at the heart of our culture. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard and valued, fostering a collaborative environment where diverse perspectives drive our success. Join us to be part of a legacy of excellence and a future of groundbreaking advancements. At ENFRA, stability, innovation, and growth are more than just values—they are the pillars of our continued success. Overview: **Position Purpose:** The Senior Product Manager is the accountable owner of a technology platform within ENFRA’s portfolio of software products, including AI\-powered tools and operational workflow systems. Where the Product Manager executes against a defined roadmap, the Senior Product Manager sets it: identifying which operational workflows are worth transforming, framing the problem, building the case, and driving it through delivery and adoption with minimal direction. Our users are engineers, analysts, modelers, and field staff working in highly technical domains, and our products are built by software engineers. The Senior Product Manager is comfortable working across both, drawing requirements out of subject matter experts and shaping them into specifications the technology team can build against. This role partners closely with the product leader for its business area on portfolio strategy, mentors Product Managers and Business Analysts, and is the recognized face of its platform to the teams that use it. Responsibilities: **Duties \& Responsibilities:*** Serve as the single accountable owner for an assigned platform: set the roadmap, hold decision authority over the backlog, accept or reject delivered work, and answer for the product’s outcomes. * Drive both strategic and tactical work independently, from multi\-quarter direction down to writing the story. * Maintain a discovery runway ahead of the engineering team, so that upcoming work is researched, specified, and ready before it is needed. * Develop the UI and UX of roadmap items directly, using AI\-assisted design tools to move from concept to interactive prototype quickly, and use those prototypes to validate direction with users before engineering work begins. * Hold the separation between forward\-looking product decisions and immediate delivery concerns, resisting the pull to be consumed by in\-sprint engineering issues at the expense of what comes next. * Act as the visible owner of the platform to its users: lead demos, release communications, and recurring user meetings. * Lead requirements development end to end (elicitation, analysis, specification, and validation) and raise the standard of requirements quality across the product team. * Personally conduct user research and usability testing with technical staff and synthesize findings into decisions. * Identify and pitch opportunities to modernize data\-heavy operational workflows through AI and application development, including sizing the opportunity and defining success measures. * Define and instrument product telemetry, and use adoption and usage data to evaluate whether shipped features changed the workflow they were meant to change. * Drive launch, enablement, and adoption, including the internal change management required to move teams off legacy processes. * Mentor Product Managers and Business Analysts on discovery techniques, written specifications, and stakeholder communication. * Resolve ambiguity and conflicting stakeholder priorities without escalating every decision upward. * Collaborate with product, development, engineering, and project teams across the business Qualifications: **Required Qualifications:*** A minimum of five years of related experience is required of product management experience, including full ownership of a product or platform rather than individual features. * Demonstrated ability to operate independently across both strategic and tactical work, setting direction and executing on it without close supervision. * Hands\-on experience running user research and usability testing, and genuine interest in continuing to do so rather than delegating it. * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted design tools (for example Claude Design or Magic Patterns) to produce wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes without depending on a dedicated designer. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor level of detail and technical depth to the audience. * Demonstrated ability to elicit requirements from subject matter experts in a technical discipline outside of software, and translate them into buildable specifications. * Experience transforming manual or legacy processes into modern, app\-based workflows, including the adoption work that follows launch. * Experience delivering AI\-powered features or automation (LLM integration, intelligent document processing, workflow automation), with a working understanding of what these systems can and cannot do reliably. * Comfort presenting directly to end users, including running demos and fielding unscripted questions about the product. * Excellent stakeholder management, including the ability to say no, manage competing priorities, and build credibility with technical users. * Strong analytical skills, with comfort working directly in product and operational data. * Experience with agile development processes and working closely with engineering teams throughout delivery. * Detail oriented, comfortable with multiple concurrent projects in a fast paced environment, and willing to work outside the defined scope when necessary. **Preferred Qualifications:*** Bachelor' Degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering Four years of directly related experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree. * Experience mentoring or formally leading product managers or business analysts. * Experience building and maintaining a design system, or working within one to keep prototypes consistent with an established component library. * Experience in the energy\-as\-a\-service sector, energy efficiency, sustainability, AEC, or another engineering\-services industry. * Working understanding of building systems, energy and sustainability methodologies, or comparable technical domain knowledge. * Technical background sufficient to read a data model, follow an API discussion, and reason about system constraints. **Travel Requirements:*** 0\-15% travel required for this position **Physical Requirements \& Work Environment:** The following physical requirements and work environment characteristics are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. In accordance with applicable laws, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions. Physical Activities:* Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods * Climbing stairs * Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods * Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers * Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned **Environmental Conditions:*** Quiet environment **Physical Demands:*** Light work that includes adjusting and/or moving objects up to 20 pounds Pay Range: USD $91,449\.00 \- USD $122,080\.50 /Yr. EEO Statement: ENFRA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer of Minorities, Women, Protected Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities, and participates in the e\-Verify program. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by law.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Edelman Global AI
jobs.description: We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions. Edelman is building a new generation of AI\-enabled products and workflows to support how communications teams develop earned\-first strategy. We are looking for a Product Manager to own a core part of that experience: helping client teams develop earned\-first, data\-backed strategy and creative. This is a highly collaborative, hands\-on role at the intersection of AI, product, and marketing. You will work closely with account teams, strategists, creatives, and other subject\-matter experts to deeply understand their needs and workflows, then partner with engineering and design to turn those insights into intuitive, scalable products. The ideal candidate brings strong product management experience in technically complex environments, with the fluency to work side\-by\-side with full\-stack engineers building AI\-enabled, data\-driven products. Experience in communications, agency, consulting, marketing, or other client\-service environments is also highly valuable. **What you'll do** * **Own the product:** Define priorities, roadmap, backlog, and requirements for a core set of earned\-first strategy and creative workflows. * **Research user behavior:** Conduct interviews, workflow observation, pilots, and ongoing feedback to understand how teams actually work, where friction exists, and where technology can create meaningful value. * **Shape the user experience:** Translate complex and variable agency workflows into clear user journeys and intuitive product experiences, co\-owning problem framing and ideation with UX and engineering teams. * **Manage stakeholders:** Build strong relationships across account teams, strategists, creatives, leadership, and technical partners; align competing needs and turn individual requests into scalable product priorities. * **Partner with engineering:** Translate user and business needs into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and work closely with full\-stack engineers throughout design, build, testing, and launch. * **Build AI\-native products:** Identify where generative AI, automation, and agentic workflows can meaningfully improve communications work; help define inputs, outputs, context, guardrails, human review, and evaluation approaches. * **Connect data to workflows:** Define the internal and third\-party data needed to power product experiences and collaborate with engineering on APIs, integrations, schemas, and data pipelines. * **Test, learn, and iterate:** Prototype ideas quickly, pilot with real users, define success metrics, and use qualitative and quantitative feedback to continuously improve the product. **What we're looking for** * Approximately 3\-5 years of relevant experience in product management, product ownership, digital product delivery, technology or solutions consulting, or a related role. * Experience owning technically complex software products or features from discovery and user research through delivery, adoption, and iteration \- ideally working closely with full\-stack engineering teams. * Strong product judgment and technical fluency, with the ability to discuss APIs, integrations, data flows, application architecture, and technical tradeoffs with engineers. * Hands\-on familiarity with generative AI and modern AI product development, beyond basic end\-user use of AI tools. * Strong stakeholder research and management skills: you can uncover underlying needs, navigate different perspectives, clarify ambiguity, and build alignment across business and technical teams. * Strong instincts around users and UX: you can translate complex workflows into simple, usable experiences and evaluate whether a product is genuinely solving the right problem. * Experience in communications, PR, marketing, advertising, consulting, agency, or another client\-service environment, with an understanding of how client needs translate into strategy and deliverables. Excellent communication, prioritization, and problem\-solving skills, particularly in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments. * **Particularly valuable** * Earned media, corporate communications, communications strategy, or creative strategy experience. * Media intelligence, social listening, audience or consumer insights, or other marketing and communications datasets. * Third\-party data integrations, APIs, and data pipelines. * AI\-enabled workflow products, RAG, agents, LLM APIs, prompt or context design, or AI evaluation. * Hands\-on design and/or prototyping using tools such as Figma, Vercel v0, and other AI\-assisted development environments. Building internal enterprise products where adoption and change management are critical to success. * **The person we're looking for** You are a product thinker, translator, and problem solver. You enjoy spending time with users, understanding how work actually happens, and identifying opportunities they may not articulate themselves. You can move comfortably between a conversation with an account lead about a client workflow and a conversation with an engineer about how the underlying product should work. You are curious about AI but pragmatic about where it adds value. And you care as much about whether people understand, trust, and use a product as you do about whether it ships. \#LI\-KW1 $60,000\-$85,000 a year An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, travel requirements, revenue\-based metrics, any contractual agreements, and business or organizational needs. DJEH offers a wide range of benefits: medical and dental insurance, vision, 401K, life insurance, disability insurance, paid time off, travel assistance and wellness programing. decisions, tradeoffs, dependencies, and risks. * Assess existing systems and cloud environments to identify gaps, technical debt, failure points, and opportunities for modernization, consolidation, and automation. * Set architectural direction for infrastructure as code including reusable module patterns, state and environment strategies, policy guardrails, drift management, and safe promotion practices. * Define technical milestones, manage dependencies and risks, and support delivery within the team’s Kanban and release cadence. * Define and maintain reusable cloud reference architectures and patterns for areas such as multi\-account design, networking, identity and access, compute, containers, data, integration, observability, and disaster recovery. * Apply AWS Well\-Architected jobs.title: AI Technical Lead (Principal Engineer)
jobs.description: **AI Technical Lead** **Location:** Cambridge, MA / Hybrid *(This role requires working in\-office 3 days per week: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.)* **About us:** EverQuote is a leading AI\-powered growth solutions partner for regulated property and casualty insurance entities, enabling the largest insurance carriers and thousands of agents to maximize customer acquisition across digital channels. Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share. Joining our team puts you at the forefront of this transformation. You will collaborate with a group of builders to solve complex problems and reshape a massive industry. If you want to drive real\-world impact and do the best work of your career, you've found your home. We move fast, follow the data, and hold ourselves to high standards. If that's how you work too, this is the role for you. **About the role:** As our Technical Lead, you will design and build a new kind of product: an insurance marketplace that AI agents use to shop on a person's behalf. You will own the technical architecture end to end, from the models and how they run to the MCP server and tools that other AI platforms connect to. This is a hands\-on senior role on a small team, and the decisions you make early will shape what agentic insurance shopping looks like before the market arrives. You own the technical architecture for the agent: where the model's reasoning runs, how we tune and serve it, how we keep cost and speed under control, and how the whole system stays reliable. We intend to run and tune our own open\-weight models rather than depend only on hosted APIs, so we control cost, speed, and behavior as volume grows, and owning that is central to this role. You own the MCP server, the tools, and the data the agent works with, and you set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. You are the person who decides, with testing to back it up, how this is built, and then builds it. **Responsibilities:** * Own the architecture: decide where the agent's reasoning runs, which models we use, how they are packaged, and how AI platforms connect to us, and back those calls with testing. * Build and tune the models: fine\-tune open\-weight models for our use, and decide when tuning, retrieval, or prompting is the right tool. * Stand up the serving and infrastructure: deploy the agent and MCP server so they are reliable, fast, and affordable to run, with versioning and a way to roll back. * Build the testing into the system: programmatic eval sets, guardrails, and monitoring for quality, drift, cost, and speed, so we catch problems before agents do. * Design the data model and tools with the AI product lead: the request and response payloads, the reasoning we expose, and the trust signals. * Set the engineering patterns and standards the team builds on, and keep the code and architecture documented. * Keep cost and speed honest: watch what inference costs, and make the trade\-offs that keep it sustainable as volume grows. * Work in the open. Help publish our code, architecture, and findings. * Mentor the engineers on the team and give leadership clear, regular visibility into technical progress and risks. **What You Bring:** * Deep, current, hands\-on experience in the AI and LLM space. You work on this every day, not from the sidelines. * Real experience with open\-weight models: you have fine\-tuned them (LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO, or similar) and run them yourself, not just called a hosted API. * Experience owning an LLM system in production: you have served models reliably, pinned versions, rolled back a bad change, and explained why the bill moved. * Enterprise\-level design and architecture experience, with a track record of leading large, ambitious projects and delivering them. * Strong grasp of evaluation and guardrails: building eval sets, catching failure modes, and monitoring quality, drift, cost, and speed. * Fluency with the serving and ops stack: model serving, containers and orchestration, and monitoring, on at least one major cloud. * Strong communication. You can explain a technical trade\-off to an engineer and to a non\-technical leader, and lead with data. * Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for action in a space where the standards change month to month. **Qualifications:** * 8\+ years in engineering, with senior or lead ownership of complex technical systems, including hands\-on work in machine learning or LLMs. * A track record of leading large, ambitious projects with a small team and delivering them. We care more about what you have shipped and the judgment you showed than the revenue the project generated. * Hands\-on fine\-tuning and deployment of open\-weight or open\-source models, with real production experience. * Enterprise design and architecture experience for complex, high\-reliability systems. * Strong Python, Rust, and fluency with the modern LLM stack (serving, retrieval, evaluation, monitoring). * Strong strategic thinking paired with methodical execution. You can set the technical direction and then deliver it. * Excellent communication across all levels of an organization, technical and non\-technical. * A history of teamwork and a bias for action. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant's job\-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location. The base salary for this full\-time hybrid role is $202,800\-$238,600\. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in variable cash bonus programs, equity, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility which are designated by role. Your recruiter can provide more details about additional compensation components, such as OTE structure, bonus targets, or equity, during the hiring process. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must have current, unrestricted work authorization in the United States. EverQuote is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy or a pregnancy\-related condition, veteran or military status, or any other protected characteristic. Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs or practices, upon request. For more information, visit https://investors.everquote.com and follow on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: **We don’t build rockets. We make the machines that cut the metal they’re made from.** Somewhere today a bar of superalloy is being cut to length before it becomes a turbine blade in a jet engine, an electric generator, or a rocket engine part. Someone designed the machine that made that cut, built it in a shop in Ohio, programmed it to optimize its cutting operation without user intervention, and made it run every shift for twenty years. That’s what we do. We also want to know what you do when no one is paying you. The person who rebuilt a motorcycle engine in the garage. Who runs a 3D printer at home. Who took the dishwasher apart to find out why it quit. Who spent last weekend building a tool no one asked for. If that sounds like you, keep reading. **Who We Are** Everett Industries has built abrasive cut\-off saws in Warren, Ohio for more than sixty years. Our saws and wheels run in foundries, forges, and investment casting houses, and in the shops that build jet engines and launch vehicles. We cut what other machines can’t: superalloys, titanium, tool steel, risers off castings. We make basic tool room or fab shop saws, automated systems, and one\-off cutting cells built around a customer’s part. We operate the way the best of our customers do. The engineer who designs a machine watches it get built, stands next to it when it first runs, and fixes what went wrong. There are no layers between you and the result. You’ll see your work in steel within months, not years. Orders are growing and the problems are getting more complex. We need a mechanical design engineer who will own a project from the first sales call to the day it ships...and for the balance of its useful life. **Who You Are** We’re not screening for a resume. We’re screening for a type of person. These are the things that matter to us: * **You are curious.** You want to know how things work and why they fail, and you go find out. Your engineering degree gives you the tools to do that. Your instinct to keep digging is what makes all of that useful here. * **You finish what you start.** You take an idea, design it, analyze it, and see it through to a working result yourself. You do not hand off and wait for someone else to close the loop. * **You direct your own learning.** You identify what you need to know, you go learn it, and you bring it back. We fund that and support that. We do not prescribe it… although we encourage and expect it. * **Undocumented work is incomplete work.** If your projects could not be picked up by someone else in your absence, that is a gap — not an explanation. * **You build things on your own time.** A project car, a CNC router in the basement, a robot, a boat, a house you are renovating yourself. We want to hear about it, because it tells us more than a transcript does. * **You speak up through the right channels.** When something is wrong, you say so, to the person who can act on it. Concerns that go sideways instead of upward help no one. * **You work well in a small company.** Requirements evolve, priorities shift, and there is no bureaucracy between a good idea and trying it. You find that energizing rather than unsettling even though it means you are responsible for the results. **The Role** This is a hands\-on design role at the center of what we do. You will take a customer’s requirements from concept through detailed design, analysis, production release, and support on the floor — and you will own that whole arc. Nobody hands off to a project manager here. The person we hire sees the job through. **Everyone here should know where your projects stand without asking. That is not a report we want from you. It is part of doing the job well.** **What You Will Do** **Design \& Engineering** * Turn customer’s process requirements and sales requirements into fully constrained, producible mechanical designs in Autodesk Inventor. * Identify the need for and perform engineering calculations behind every design: load analysis, component sizing, and material selection. * Produce complete 3D models and GD\&T\-compliant production drawings under appropriate revision control. * Work with our controls and electrical engineers to integrate sensors, actuators, and automation components into designs that are safe, functional, and buildable. * Release complete engineering packages to the production floor — models, drawings, BOMs, and supporting documentation the shop can build from without coming back with questions. **Collaboration \& Ownership** * Sit with the sales team during quoting and proposals to give technical input and translate customer processing needs into machine requirements. * Lead design reviews with the engineering team before release, not after a problem shows up… and be able to accept the “best” concept, even if it is not your baby. * Keep project status current and visible at all times. If a deliverable is at risk, raise it before it becomes a problem… protect your team’s commitments. * Support the machinists, fabricators and builders throughout the build, and stand on the floor with them when the machine runs for the first time. Remember, their skills may not have been acquired in a university, but they are just as essential as yours to our customer who pays us all. * Document your work so that someone else could pick up any project of yours tomorrow and so that our customer’s maintenance team can support their operation. **Continuous Improvement** * Look for better ways to design, document, and build — including new automation and AI\-assisted engineering tools — and bring them to the team. * Apply your engineering judgment to operational problems, not only design problems. The person who notices the process is wrong and proposes a better one is the person we want. * Travel occasionally (4\-8 days per quarter) for customer site visits and professional development. **What You Need** **Required** * Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering from an accredited institution. * Demonstrated experience developing mechanical systems from concept through detailed design and documentation. * Proficiency with Autodesk Inventor or a comparable parametric 3D CAD platform… but understand that we work in Inventor. * Working knowledge of GD\&T standards, ANSI/ISO/EN and other standards and engineering drawing practices. * Ability to identify the need for, perform, and document mechanical engineering and safety calculations for sizing, load analysis, and material selection. * Working understanding of controls and control theory including sensors, actuators, and automation components and how they integrate into mechanical assemblies. * Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across sales, engineering, and production. **Preferred** * Three to five years of mechanical design experience in machine design or industrial equipment. * Experience with engineered\-to\-order or custom automated machinery. * Exposure to abrasive cutting, milling, turning, grinding, material handling, and similar material removal and processing environments. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted design and engineering tools, and a habit of bringing new, productive technology into your workflow. **Short on years? Apply anyway. If you are early in your career but you have built things, taught yourself things, and can show us, we will weigh that against experience. An indomitable work ethic and a genuine drive to get better count here. We invest in and will develop people who invest in themselves.** **How We Work** Everett is a small company with a clear point of view about what makes someone excellent here. These are not values on a wall — they are how we evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, and have honest conversations when something isn’t working. **Accountability \& Ownership** *You own your work, your outcomes, and your communication. Ownership is not assigned by title. It is the baseline expectation for everyone in this building. Accountability is not a talk out behind the barn after the fact… it is clear expectations and frank communications… both ways… throughout the process.* **Innovation \& Continuous Improvement** *We want people who see a better way and say so — then do something about it. That applies to your design work and to how the work gets done. The intersection of engineering skill and operational thinking is where we grow.* **Self\-Directed Learning** *This is a learning organization. We fund development and support it actively. But the direction comes from you. Identify what you want to build, make a case for it, and pursue it. The people who thrive here do not wait to be told what to learn next.* Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Tuition reimbursement Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Junior Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Flexi Software is hiring Junior and entry\-level Full\-Stack Software Engineers to help build the next generation of our platform. You will work across C\# services and modern web front ends built with Node.js, React, and Next.js, backed by Microsoft SQL Server, and you will build, test, and deliver enterprise\-grade software for financial institutions. We are looking for engineers who embrace an AI\-empowered software development lifecycle. At Flexi, AI is part of how we design, code, review, test, and document. You will work with agentic tools every day, and you will learn to direct them with good judgment, verify what they produce, and hold the result to the standards our banking, insurance, and financial services customers depend on. Your primary focus will be delivering our next\-generation web platform. On a limited basis, you may also work on Flexi's legacy Windows desktop solutions in C\+\+ and C\#, which gives you broad exposure to how enterprise software evolves. This role is a strong starting point for an early\-career engineer who wants to grow quickly, learn from experienced engineers, and ship real software at scale. This is a hybrid position, working in person with the team in our Atlanta, GA office. **About Flexi** Flexi Software has been a trusted provider of accounting solutions for over 30 years, offering both cloud\-based and on\-premise software purpose\-built for organizations with the most complex accounting requirements — multi\-entity and intercompany accounting at scale. Our comprehensive suite includes modules like General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Purchasing, Fixed Asset Management, Project Accounting, Workflow Automation, Financial Reporting, and Budget Software. Serving industries including banking, insurance, financial services, credit unions, healthcare, and business process outsourcing, Flexi is renowned for its robust features, flexible deployment options, and exceptional customer support. In January 2025, Flexi was acquired by Quality Standard, a permanent capital holding company that acquires and grows fintech and govtech software businesses with a long\-term ownership mindset. Quality Standard is actively investing in Flexi's people, product, and operations. Flexi's office is located in Atlanta, GA. Quality Standard is headquartered in New York, NY. **Roles and Responsibilities** * Build, test, and deliver full\-stack features for Flexi's next\-generation platform, working across C\# back\-end services and APIs and Node.js, React, and Next.js front ends * Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code, including unit and integration tests, as part of every change you ship * Work with Microsoft SQL Server: write queries and stored procedures, design tables, and learn to tune for application and database performance * Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows daily across design, coding, code review, testing, and documentation, and learn to direct them effectively * Review and verify AI\-generated code with care, owning correctness, security, and quality for everything you commit * Take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback, to build skill and uphold team standards * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release practices so changes move to production safely and often * Build with the security, reliability, and data integrity expected of enterprise financial software, including input validation, error handling, and audit\-friendly design * Investigate and resolve defects, tracing issues across the front end, services, and database * Write and maintain technical documentation, including API documentation and developer notes * Partner with Product, QA, and senior engineers to turn requirements into shipped customer\-facing software * Contribute on a limited basis to Flexi's legacy Windows desktop solutions in C\+\+ and C\#, while next\-generation web platform delivery remains your primary focus, and learn how the new platform integrates with these existing products and our DevOps environment * Grow your skills through mentorship, pairing, and regular feedback, and share what you learn about AI\-assisted development with the team Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent practical experience, such as a bootcamp, internship, or substantial project work * 0–3 years of professional software development experience; internships and strong personal or academic projects count * Working knowledge of C\# and the .NET platform, including object\-oriented programming fundamentals, and a willingness to work in legacy C\+\+ and C\# Windows desktop code on a limited basis * Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with hands\-on experience building applications in React * Experience or coursework with Node.js and Next.js, including routing, server\-side rendering, and API routes * Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, with exposure to Microsoft SQL Server preferred * Familiarity with building and consuming REST APIs * Experience with Git and a collaborative, pull\-request\-based workflow * Active, hands\-on use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools in your own work, with a clear sense of when to trust their output and when to question it * A solid grasp of software testing fundamentals, including writing unit tests * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail * Clear written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to ask good questions and take feedback well **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, or Web API development * Experience with Vite, modern build tooling, and component libraries or design systems * Experience delivering web applications in a B2B software environment using modern AI\-accelerated tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, including prompt and context engineering for coding tasks * Exposure to automated testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, Jest, Playwright, or Cypress * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and containerization * Exposure to AWS or Azure cloud platforms * Interest in or exposure to secure coding practices, including OWASP guidance * Experience with ERP, accounting, financial, or other enterprise systems of record, especially B2B enterprise software, and prior experience in the financial services industry or financial accounting **Personal Characteristics** * AI\-curious and AI\-forward; you actively use AI tools in your own work, enjoy experimenting with agentic workflows, and share what works * Rigorous about quality; you treat AI output as a draft to be verified, not a result to be trusted blindly * A builder; you like turning an idea into working software and seeing it used * Eager to learn; you ask questions, seek feedback, and improve quickly * Hands\-on and persistent; you stay with a hard bug until you understand the cause * Security\- and detail\-minded; you understand that accuracy and data integrity matter in financial software * Collaborative and low ego; you work well with engineers, QA, and Product * High integrity and sound judgment; trusted with sensitive customer and product information * Positive attitude and sense of humor; work is way more fun with people you enjoy! **What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months** * Fully onboarded to Flexi's codebase, tooling, and AI\-assisted development workflow, and contributing confidently * Shipping production\-ready features and fixes across the C\# back end, SQL Server, and the React/Next.js front end * Delivering well\-tested work that passes review with steadily fewer corrections * Using AI tools effectively and responsibly, with changes that are verified, secure, and understood * Contributing meaningfully to code reviews, tests, and documentation * Understanding how the new platform fits with Flexi's existing C\+\+/C\# Windows desktop products and delivery pipeline, and contributing to them when needed * Developing a clear growth plan with your manager and mentor, with growing independence on well\-defined tasks Flexi provides excellent benefits including paid holidays and paid time off, a 401(k) Plan with company match, health and dental insurance, life and disability insurance, and a vision discount plan. **Location:** Hybrid • Atlanta, GA area only Only candidates under consideration will be contacted. Any offer of employment will be contingent upon positive criminal background check. No phone calls, please. Principals Only. Drug\-free workplace. M/F/V/H EEO

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **About this Role** =================== Fandom is growing! We're looking for a **Senior Cloud Engineer** to help evolve and support the infrastructure that powers our platform for over 300 million fans around the world. This is a hands\-on role focused on building reliable, scalable systems in a Linux and Kubernetes\-based environment. As part of the **TechOps team**, you'll report to the **Manager of TechOps** and work closely with developers, product engineers, and other infrastructure teams. =============== * Design, architect, and scale high\-availability routing architectures to seamlessly balance and secure global user traffic across a hybrid footprint of on\-premise datacenters, AWS, and GCP. * Manage and automate cloud and edge infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Chef, ensuring consistent configurations for Kubernetes, global Cloudflare services, and CI/CD pipelines. * Maintain and optimize large\-scale production environments, orchestrating high\-availability MySQL replication, automated failover, robust disaster recovery, and system monitoring. * Develop internal tools for operational automation, system/data backups, performance tuning, and comprehensive security monitoring. * Drive operational excellence by leading planning meetings, retrospectives, and RCAs, while continuously evaluating systems against industry best practices. * Participate in an on\-call rotation to maintain production stability, handle incident responses, and collaborate with/mentor cross\-functional engineering teams. **You Have...** =============== * 5\+ years of experience in Technical/Network Operations, DevOps, or SRE roles managing large\-scale production platforms (e.g., 10M\+ monthly active users). * Deep proficiency in Linux systems administration, networking protocols (TCP/IP, routing), secure systems practices, and scripting/programming (Go, Python, or Bash). * Proven hands\-on experience with core infrastructure tech: Kubernetes/container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), and monitoring/reliability systems (e.g., Prometheus). * Practical experience managing production MySQL database environments, including deep familiarity with replication topologies, failover mechanisms, and performance tuning. * Demonstrated capability using generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, NotebookLM) to enhance productivity, paired with the ability to critically audit and verify outputs for accuracy, security, and context. **Bonus Points...** =================== * Advanced Cloudflare expertise, including CDN optimization, WAF security, DNS management, edge performance tuning, and Cloudflare Tunnels. * Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, edge caching, and centralized log management using the ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana). * Experience defining SLOs and instrumentation, implementing meaningful metrics, logs, and traces to reduce alert noise and drive postmortem action items. **Benefits \& Perks** ===================== * Salary Range \= $122k \- $204k (*Actual salary available will vary based on location and market factors.)* * Vibrant team culture * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision * Training (unlimited Udemy \+ more) * Flexible working hours and time off * Equity \& Retirement Programs including 401K match * Paid Parental Leave * International work environment with start\-up culture **About Fandom** ================ Fandom is the world's largest fan platform where fans immerse themselves in imagined worlds across entertainment and gaming. Fandom's Gaming division manages the online video game retailer Fanatical. Fandom Productions, the content arm of Fandom, enhances the fan experience through curated editorial coverage and branded content from trusted and established publishing brands Gamespot, TV Guide and Metacritic, along with its Emmy\-nominated Honest Trailers and the weekly video news program The Loop. jobs.title: Sr. AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Fieldpiece** is a privately held, global leader in professional HVACR tools and test instruments. We're known for developing innovative products that technicians rely on every day \- and for investing in our people, our technology, and our future. Named***one of the Best Places to Work in Southern California for four consecutive years***, we're looking for talented people who want to make an impact while growing their careers. We're looking for a **Senior AI Solutions Engineer** to help us turn the potential of AI into practical solutions that help teams to increase their efficiency, speed, and accuracy in their everyday jobs. This is a unique opportunity to become our first dedicated AI engineering hire and help shape how AI and automation are used across the organization. You'll partner with teams throughout the business—from Sales, Marketing, Finance, and HR to Product Development, Supply Chain, Operations, Customer Experience, and IT—to understand how they work, identify opportunities for improvement, and build solutions that deliver measurable value. This position is in our Park City, UT office with an exciting move to Heber City, UT in 2027\. This role follows a hybrid work schedule, with employees typically working onsite three days per week. Additional in\-office days may be required from time to time for onboarding, training, team meetings, project collaboration, or other business needs.**Why This Role?*** This isn't a role where you'll spend your time simply evaluating AI tools or developing proofs of concept that never make it into production. You'll sit down with business teams, understand what they're trying to accomplish and where their processes are slowing them down, translate those needs into technical requirements, determine the right solution, and then build, deploy, and improve it. * The projects will vary widely. One may involve automating a manual workflow; another could involve creating an AI agent, improving access to company knowledge, connecting AI to an enterprise system, or building a decision\-support application. The common thread is using technology to solve meaningful business problems. * We're technology agnostic and want someone who can choose the right solution for the problem rather than force every problem into the same technology stack. That said, experience within the Microsoft ecosystem—particularly Dynamics 365 Business Central, Azure, Copilot, Power Platform, Fabric, Dataverse, and Microsoft 365—is highly valuable in our environment. **What You'll Do*** Partner with teams across Fieldpiece to understand their workflows, pain points, and business needs and identify opportunities where AI, automation, or better technology can make a meaningful difference. * Take business requirements from concept to solution—designing, developing, implementing, and supporting production\-ready applications and automations. * Build AI agents, copilots, workflow automations, decision\-support tools, and other practical AI\-enabled solutions. * Develop applications using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise knowledge systems, APIs, and agentic workflows. * Connect AI solutions with ERP, CRM, PLM, customer support, analytics, knowledge management, productivity, and other enterprise platforms. * Reengineer processes to improve speed, accuracy, quality, service, cost, revenue enablement, and employee productivity. * Establish testing and evaluation approaches to ensure solutions are accurate, reliable, secure, scalable, and effective. * Work closely with Information Systems, business leaders, data owners, and security stakeholders to implement appropriate governance and controls. * Help users successfully adopt new AI tools and continuously improve solutions based on feedback and results. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and make practical recommendations based on business value, implementation requirements, cost, risk, and scalability. * Bachelor’s degree in CS, AI, or related fields. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production applications. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building solutions using modern AI technologies, including large language models. * Experience taking ambiguous business problems and translating them into practical technical solutions. * Hands\-on experience with prompt design, retrieval architectures, AI application testing, and model/system evaluation. Experience building AI agents, multi\-agent systems, tool\-using agents, RAG solutions, or complex agentic workflows. * Experience integrating APIs, cloud services, enterprise applications, and data sources. * Strong proficiency in Python or another modern language used for AI application development. * Experience with data engineering, analytics, BI, MLOps/LLMOps, observability, or cloud deployment. * Experience with source control, testing, deployment, monitoring, and modern software delivery practices. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to work directly with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders and explain complex technical decisions in business terms. * A practical, curious mindset \- you enjoy learning how a business works, asking the right questions, and figuring out how technology can make it better. **Even Better If You Have*** Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or integrating solutions with ERP systems, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Fabric, or Dataverse. * Experience working in a product, manufacturing, distribution, or field\-service environment. * Exposure to Lean, continuous improvement, or business process reengineering. **Why You'll Enjoy Working at Fieldpiece*** As a privately held company, we invest for the long term—in our people, our products, and our future. That means we can focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and building lasting careers rather than chasing short\-term results. * Make a meaningful impact with a company where your ideas are heard, your expertise is valued, and your contributions help shape the future of our products and business. **Benefits \& Perks**We believe great work starts with supporting our employees. That's why we offer a competitive total rewards package designed to promote your health, financial well\-being, work\-life balance, and professional growth.* Competitive base salary with annual bonus opportunity * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting * Generous paid time off and paid holidays * Hire to Retire philosophy \- Individual Development Plans for everyone and a commitment to support career development * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Health Savings Accounts (HSA), and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Music program – music rooms in all US offices with onsite guitar, piano, and voice lessons in California (classes can be streamed for other offices) * Recognition programs, launch parties and team building events to share successes **Our Culture** At Fieldpiece, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and serve our customers every day. We use the TURTL acronym to show that we believe in:* **TRIBE** – We collaborate, support one another, and win as a team. * **Upfront Homework** – We come prepared, begin with the end in mind and address obstacles with creativity, grit and tenacity. * **Right Stuff** – We deliver innovative solutions by seeing through the eyes of our customers and use purposeful critical thinking to lead to greatness. * **Trust** – We build strong relationships through credibility, accountability and transparency. * **Lean** – We embrace curiosity, continuous improvement, learning from failures and delivering results. * **No Ego –** We leave titles and egos at the door, value the best ideas regardless of where they come from, and work together with humility, openness, and mutual respect. At Fieldpiece, we're building more than innovative products \- we're building careers. If you're looking for a place where your work matters and your contributions are recognized, we'd love to meet you. *EOE AA M/F/Veteran/Disability*

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior/Staff Design Engineer** ================================ October 15, 2026 Job Type: Full Time Job Location: Remote, U.S. ### **Job Overview** We’re looking for a Senior/Staff Design Engineer to design and build the front end of our products. You’ll work in our codebase every day, in Rails views with Hotwire, Stimulus, and Tailwind, taking work from first sketch to production and owning the code you ship. What’s designed is what ships, because you built it. This is a senior individual\-contributor role. Beyond your own features, you’ll own our design system in code, set the patterns other engineers build on, review front\-end work, and set design direction for our products alongside product. Our users are the auditors and operators on our internal team who serve procurement and finance teams at major global companies, and the software they rely on lives for a long time. Depth in our domain is part of the job here. The best design decisions come from understanding how their work actually gets done. At Fine Tune, our core values of honesty, dedication, and vigilance foster an environment of trust, open communication, and inclusivity where everyone can do their best work. If you care about your craft, want to keep getting better, and thrive in a team that’s building something meaningful — let’s talk. Our interview process includes a hands\-on technical pairing session, where we’ll work in code together and talk through product decisions as we go. This is a full\-time, salaried, remote position. Candidates must be US citizens and located in the United States. ### **Responsibilities and Duties** * **Design \& Build****:** + Design and build features end to end in Rails with Hotwire, Stimulus, Tailwind, and DaisyUI, from first sketch to production + Own your code through release, including tests, accessibility, performance, and the bugs that come back + Build and maintain the design system as code: tokens, theming, reusable components, and the guidance engineers follow without a designer in the room + Prototype in code when it answers the question faster than a mockup + Reach for JavaScript only where it earns its keep + Build interfaces that hold up at real data volume: large tables, dense forms, long\-running jobs + Establish patterns for AI\-powered features, such as confidence, human review, and correction * **Raise the Bar****:** + Review front\-end pull requests for correctness, accessibility, and fit, and explain precisely what’s wrong when it is + Raise engineers’ design judgment through pairing, review, and example + Lead design critique, audit products for accessibility and usability debt, and prioritize the fixes + Lead tool evaluation and adoption for how the team designs and builds * **Set Direction \& Shape the Work****:** + Own the design direction and interaction patterns for our products + Resolve the tension between purpose\-built workflows and general\-purpose surfaces across products + Lead discovery alongside product management, and frame ambiguous problems as answerable questions + Shape new work before it’s committed to, naming design risks and what’s explicitly out of scope + Weigh approaches against the time available, and know when to cut scope and when to escalate + Use research and prototypes to de\-risk new work, and know when there’s enough evidence to move on + Coach business stakeholders to build and vet their own prototypes, including with AI\-assisted tools * **Collaborate \& Influence****:** + Partner with product and leadership to align design direction with product and business goals + Translate design tradeoffs into terms non\-designers can act on + Improve design workflows and handoff across concurrent product teams + Influence priorities and the roadmap with credible, trusted design judgment grounded in evidence ### **What We’re Looking For** * **Craft** + 5\+ years designing and building product software, with substantial time shipping production front\-end code + Strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; comfortable debugging in the browser and reading unfamiliar code + Comfortable in a server\-rendered web app: writing view code, and working with controllers and models enough to wire up a feature (Ruby is a plus) + Day\-to\-day fluency with Git, pull requests, code review, and writing tests for your UI + A portfolio that shows both design and code: shipped work, repos, or a walkthrough of something you built + Experience building or owning a design system in code + A track record of setting design direction for complex, data\-dense B2B or operational software + Experience leading discovery and research alongside product management + Deep working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and how to design and build to them + Proficient with Figma, and fluent prototyping in code and with AI\-assisted tools * **Domain** + Deep understanding of the business your product serves, or a clear track record of building that understanding quickly + Able to bring domain reasoning into design direction, not just requirements conversations * **Professional Skills** + Exceptional communicator — you present complex information clearly and facilitate alignment across groups + A force multiplier — you drive cross\-team collaboration and build strong relationships organization\-wide + Handles the most complex problems and establishes problem\-solving approaches others adopt + Takes ownership well beyond your immediate role and drives initiatives to completion + Leads across teams without authority and influences significant product decisions + Models the professionalism, judgment, and accountability you want to see in the team ### **Nice to Have** * Prior production work in Rails with Hotwire and Stimulus * Tailwind CSS and DaisyUI * Experience working in fixed\-time, variable\-scope product cycles * Designing AI\-powered features, such as review and correction of machine\-extracted data * Data visualization for operational dashboards * Experience as the first or only designer on a product team * Exposure to enterprise software, procurement, or finance operations domains ### **Why Join** * **Build What You Design:** Design and ship the product yourself, and set the direction and system the team builds on — high\-leverage IC work without being pushed into management * **Growth Path:** We invest in your development with clear career progression, regular feedback cycles, and a rubric\-based framework so you always know where you stand and where you’re headed * **Learning Culture:** Book clubs, mentoring programs, and a team that values continuous improvement — we believe in “Learn One, Do One, Teach One” * **Collaborative Team:** Work with a tight\-knit engineering team that values quality, open communication, and professional growth in an inclusive environment * **Meaningful Impact:** Your work directly helps remove the tedious, complex work that bogs down procurement and finance teams at major global companies * **Healthy Balance:** Remote flexibility with respect for work\-life balance — we believe sustainable work leads to better outcomes **The pay range for this role is:** 130,000 – 200,000 USD per year (Remote (United States))

process improvement. * Hands\-on experience with Micr ate, Power Apps, Dataverse, AI Builder), Fabric, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. * Working knowledge of Azure networking, Entra ID, managed identities, privacy, security, access controls, responsible AI practices, and change management. * Ability to diagnose problems across platform boundaries using logs, run histories, and vendor documentation, and application development, automation, data, or related information technology work, including one year of experience building and deploying production generative AI solutions such as agents, RAG solutions, or LLM\-based automations. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure AI Foundry required. * Experience with Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, and ERP or CRM integration (Dynamics 365 or similar) preferred. * Microsoft AI\-102, PL\-400, or AZ\-204 certification preferred. **Physical Demands** (The physical demands described here must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. jobs.title: Robotics Deployment Project Manager - Bolingbrook
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. Universal Robots) * Experience working with or alongside industrial robotics system integrators * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence cross\-functional
