jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
jobs.description: In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential. FORT's platform ensures safe, secure, and dynamic control that surpasses legacy systems and next\-generation AI capabilities. While autonomous machines offer significant advantages, they also introduce new safety challenges. FORT addresses these concerns by providing solutions such as the Wireless E\-Stop, which allows operators to instantly stop any machine from a safe distance, enhancing safety during emergencies. Additionally, FORT's Safe Remote Control enables operators to manage heavy machinery remotely, reducing the risk of accidents and improving visibility. By ensuring communications integrity across any network, FORT empowers customers to protect their most valuable assets—people, data, and machines—ensuring they remain safe and secure. As an Embedded Software Engineer II, you will own specific components of our embedded stack, working close to the hardware on the real\-time firmware that our safety devices depend on. Most of your time will be spent in RTOS environments (Zephyr and FreeRTOS) and on bare\-metal targets, architecting safety\-critical systems where reliability is a hard requirement. You will also work with our Embedded Linux platforms where the two worlds meet, so you will be comfortable moving between constrained real\-time targets and richer application environments. **What You'll Do** * **Build the Core:** Design and implement robust C/C\+\+ firmware for safety\-critical embedded devices. * **Real\-Time Architecture:** Architect and implement RTOS\-based firmware on Zephyr and FreeRTOS, including task and scheduling design, ISR handling, inter\-task communication, memory and stack budgeting, and deterministic timing analysis. * **Bare\-Metal and Drivers:** Write low\-level peripheral drivers and board support code, and bring up new silicon from reset vector through to a running application. * **Platform Integration:** Interface RTOS devices with our Embedded Linux user\-space applications, ensuring reliable communication and consistent behavior across the product. * **Pipeline \& Quality:** Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) to automate testing, including on\-target and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test execution. * **Hardware Integration:** Bring up new hardware, debug complex issues using JTAG/GDB, and optimize for latency, power, and memory footprint. * **Safety Compliance:** Collaborate with the safety team to ensure code adheres to rigorous standards (IEC 61508\) while maintaining development velocity. **What You Bring** * **Experience:** 3\-5 years of hands\-on embedded software development, with a substantial portion on RTOS or bare\-metal targets. * **Core Languages:** Strong proficiency in C, along with working proficiency in C\+\+. * **RTOS Knowledge:** Solid production experience with an RTOS such as Zephyr, FreeRTOS, ThreadX, or similar, including scheduling, synchronization primitives, and interrupt\-driven design. * **Microcontroller Fluency:** Comfort working directly with MCU peripherals, datasheets, reference manuals, linker scripts, and startup code. * **Linux Exposure:** Familiarity with Embedded Linux user\-space development, sufficient to integrate and debug across the RTOS and Linux boundary. * **Connectivity:** Familiarity with IP networking protocols and standard interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, USB, CAN). * **Tooling:** Experience with Python for scripting/automation and familiarity with CI/CD workflows. * **Debugging:** Comfort using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG, and GDB to troubleshoot hard\-to\-find bugs. * **Education:** B.S. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. **Bonus Points** * Experience with Zephyr specifically, including devicetree, Kconfig, and west\-based workflows. * Experience with wireless stacks (BLE, ISM, Wi\-Fi) on constrained devices. * Background in Functional Safety (FuSa) or working in regulated industries (Medical, Automotive, Aerospace). * Low\-level Linux knowledge of Board Support Packages (BSP) and device drivers. * Familiarity with static analysis, MISRA C, or other coding standards used in safety\-critical development. #### **Compensation \& Benefits** **Base salary range:** $120,000–$150,000, based on experience and location. **Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited PTO; stock options; 3% 401(k) match, paid holidays, and parental leave. **Application window:** Applications accepted through the end of December 2026\. This date will be updated if the window is extended. FORT Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status. FORT Robotics uses AI\-assisted tools to help our recruiting team review and organize applications. These tools do not make hiring decisions; all decisions are made by FORT employees. To request an accommodation or a review without these tools, contact HR@fortrobotics.com.

jobs.description: **About Us** At FurtherAI, we’re building the AI agents that run insurance — a trillion\-dollar industry still powered by manual work. We’ve raised more than $30M from top investors (Andreessen Horowitz, YC, Nexus, South Park Commons), grown more than XY00% in the last 12 months, and work with some of the largest names in insurance — top 10 carriers/brokers, Fortune 100 companies, and public companies. We are a deeply technical company. Both founders are engineers, and engineers have an outsized say on product direction. Now, we’re looking for an exceptional AI Engineer to own how we evaluate and continuously improve the quality of AI agents across our platform. **Why Join Us** * **Outsized ambition:** We’re out to build the definitive AI company for insurance — and we’re moving faster than anyone in the space. * **Elite team:** Founders and engineers from the best companies and schools in the world — ex\-Apple AI Research, Brex, Coinbase, and Uber; 4 YC founders and 6 ex\-founders; grads of Stanford, Berkeley, IITs, and Cornell. * **Massive market impact:** Insurance is the backbone of global commerce. Our work reshapes how the industry operates. * **Founder’s mindset:** Own big pieces of the product from day one — ideal if you want to start your own company one day. **What You’ll Do** * **Own evaluations across FurtherAI:** Build the evaluation frameworks and infrastructure that measure the accuracy, quality, and reliability of our AI agents across workflows, Assistant, document processing, and computer use. * **Build high\-quality datasets:** Develop golden datasets, benchmarks, and regression suites, working closely with Forward Deployed Engineers and domain experts to capture real\-world insurance tasks and edge cases. * **Evaluate complex agent behavior:** Design evaluations for multi\-step agent trajectories, tool use, reasoning, and end\-to\-end task completion — not just individual LLM responses. * **Build automated grading systems:** Develop LLM\-as\-judge evaluations, deterministic graders, human evaluation workflows, and rubrics that accurately reflect real\-world quality. * **Make development evaluation\-driven:** Integrate offline and online evaluations into development and release processes so engineers can measure improvements, catch regressions, and ship confidently. * **Drive model evaluation and selection:** Continuously benchmark frontier and open\-weight models across accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability. Use results to inform model selection, upgrades, and production releases. * **Build continuous improvement loops:** Turn production failures, customer feedback, and agent traces into new evaluation cases and measurable improvements in agent quality. **Representative Projects** * Build an end\-to\-end evaluation framework for FurtherAI agents, measuring success across multi\-step workflows, tool calls, and complex insurance tasks. * Create a library of golden datasets and benchmarks for common insurance workflows, reusable across customer implementations and out\-of\-the\-box AI skills. * Build an automated benchmarking system that evaluates new frontier and open\-weight model releases and identifies the best models for different tasks. * Develop production evaluation pipelines that detect quality regressions, identify failure patterns, and turn them into actionable improvements. **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with strong hands\-on experience building production AI/ML systems. * Experience building evaluation frameworks, LLM\-based applications, model benchmarking systems, or applied AI infrastructure. * Strong understanding of modern LLMs, agent architectures, evaluation methodologies, and model performance tradeoffs. * Strong Python engineering skills and the ability to build reliable, production\-grade systems. * Ability to independently own ambiguous technical problems, from research and experimentation through production. * Clear communicator — both in person and in writing. * Bonus: Experience with LLM\-as\-judge, human evaluation systems, agent trajectory evaluations, or large\-scale benchmarking. * Bonus: Experience with open\-weight models, fine\-tuning, post\-training, or model routing. * Bonus: Background in B2B SaaS and 0\-to\-1 experience. * Above all: drive, grit, and ownership. If you excel here, other requirements are secondary. At FurtherAI, we set a high bar. We’re not looking for someone who just wants a job. We’re looking for someone who wants to build something transformative. If you thrive in environments where the pace is fast, expectations are high, and the rewards are outsized, you’ll love it here. **You can look forward to the following benefits:** * Fully covered, best\-in\-class health, dental, and vision benefits * Competitive compensation, meaningful stock options, company 401(k) * Unlimited PTO * Outstanding in\-office culture in the heart of San Francisco, 5x per week * Lunch and dinner onsite * Team events, such as happy hours and off\-sites * Pre\-tax commuter benefits Compensation Range: $300K \- $350K

jobs.title: AI Application Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **Introduction** Welcome to Gallagher \- a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client\-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way. **Overview** The AI Solutions Architect decides the technical shape of AJ Gallagher's AI solutions before they are built, and makes sure that shape holds up once they are live. Reporting to the Director of AI Technology, you will take business problems from divisons or departments and turn them into architectures the team can deliver \- choosing the right pattern (RAG, agent, workflow, or no AI at all), the right platform (pro\-code on Microsoft Foundry or low\-code in Copilot Studio), and the right integration, identity, and data design for a regulated, global insurance business. You will own the reference architectures and architecture decisions that Gallagher's AI solutions build on, partnering with the senior AI Engineering, who owns engineering standards and delivery, and with Gallagher's enterprise architecture, security, and data teams. This is a hands\-on technical role for someone whose curiosity runs deep: you will prototype to test an idea rather than diagram it from a distance, and you will follow a fast\-moving Azure AI platform closely enough to know which new capability solves a real Gallagher problem and which one isn't ready yet. **How you'll make an impact** * **Shape Solutions From Business Problems:** Lead technical discovery with business stakeholders and the AI Business Analyst, turning ambiguous requests into solution options with clear trade\-offs, feasibility, effort, and run\-cost estimates \- including recommending against AI when a simpler answer fits better. * **Own Reference Architectures:** Define and maintain Gallagher's reference architectures for RAG, single and multi\-agent systems, and Copilot extensibility on Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB, and Azure compute, so every new solution starts from proven, approved patterns. * **Make, Record, and Explain Architecture Decisions:** Make the platform and pattern calls — model selection, retrieval design, agent setup, datastore choice, messaging, hosting — and record them as architecture decision records (ADRs) with the reasoning, the alternatives, and the conditions under which the decision should be revisited; explain them to executives and engineers in terms each can act on. * **Design Governance and Data Residency In:** Build Gallagher's compliance requirements into the architecture itself \- Entra ID/RBAC and managed identity, Azure Policy, private networking, Standard (Regional) or DataZone Standard model deployments, Foundry agent setup with Gallagher\-owned storage, audit logging, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints aligned to internal AI governance expectations. * **Prove Ideas With Working Prototypes:** Build proofs of concept and technical spikes in Python and C\#/.NET that test a design's riskiest assumptions \- retrieval quality, latency, cost, platform limits \- before the team commits to building it. * **Run Architecture Reviews:** Review solution designs from AI developers, the AI Workflow Architect, and partner teams; catch integration, security, scalability, and cost problems early; and represent the AI program in Gallagher's enterprise architecture and security review forums. * **Design Enterprise Integrations:** Architect how AI solutions connect to Gallagher's systems of record and data platforms through Azure API Management, Service Bus, Azure Functions, MCP servers, and Snowflake, within the enterprise identity model. * **Set the Pro\-Code / Low\-Code Boundary:** Partner with the AI Workflow Architect to define when a solution belongs in Copilot Studio and Power Platform and when it needs a pro\-code Foundry build, and design the integration points that let the two work as one solution. * **Evaluate Emerging AI Technology:** Track new models, Foundry capabilities, agent frameworks (Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, CrewAI), and agent protocols (MCP, A2A); run time\-boxed evaluations against real Gallagher use cases; and turn findings into clear adopt / trial / hold recommendations for the Director of AI Technology. * **Design for Quality, Cost, and Operability:** Specify how each solution will be evaluated (groundedness, accuracy, latency), observ d A2A integration patterns. * **Copilot Extensibility:** M365 Copilot extensibility, Copilot Studio, and Agent 365, including how pro\-code agents surface in Teams and M365 Copilot. * **Infrastructure\-as\-Code:** Designing for Terraform\- or Bicep\-deployed infrastructure, with policy\-as\-code guardrails. * **AI Cost and Capacity Management:** Provisioned throughput versus pay\-as\-you\-go trade\-offs, quota and throughput planning, and token\-cost modeling across environments. * **LLMOps and Observability:** Automated evaluation pipelines, red\-teaming, tracing with Application Insights or OpenTelemetry, and drift and cost monitoring. * **Data Platform Integration:** Snowflake or similar platforms feeding AI solutions, including Entra ID federation. * **Spec\-Driven and AI\-Assisted Development:** Using spec\-driven workflows and AI coding assistants to move from design to working software quickly. * **Certifications:** AZ\-305 (Azure Solutions Architect Expert), AI\-103 (Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate), or equivalent demonstrated architecture ownership. **Core Competencies*** **Relentlessly Curious:** Wants to know how things actually work \- reads the docs, the release notes, and the source, and runs the experiment rather than trusting the marketing; jobs.description: **About GameChanger:** We believe in the life\-changing impact youth sports have on and off the field because they encourage leadership, teamwork, responsibility, and confidence—important life lessons that have the power to propel our youth toward meaningful futures. The Data Engineering team builds the platform that collects that data for analytics use cases and puts it to work for our commercial and product teams. As a Staff Data Engineer, you’ll set technical direction, lead complex initiatives across teams, and stay hands\-on building data systems and self\-service frameworks. You’ll partner with engineering and business teams to anticipate their needs, strengthen the platform, and enable new capabilities. Turn project ideas into execution plans and drive clarity and alignment on scope on large ambiguous cross\-functional projects. * Build relationships and regularly meet with technical and non\-technical partners to support their goals and understand where your intervention is a priority. Lead advocacy conversations/training to influence adoption. * Architect and build scalable, robust and efficient data platforms serving analytic and operational needs across the organization. Review relevant specs and PRs across the company to influence strong design decisions. * Champion the changes that will enable AI\-assisted self\-service analytics and AI\-assisted development * Improve existing systems' performance, observability, reliability, and scalability, identifying new infrastructure and software patterns as needed * Raise the bar for the company. Share your knowledge through technical documentation, code reviews, tech talks, mentoring, and proposing new standards. * Take part in DE’s on\-call rotation. Debug and troubleshoot complex problems across multiple systems and services. **Who You Are:** * You are an AI\-forward engineer, excited by the new possibilities and challenges created by the adoption of AI. * You are an excellent communicator, written and verbally, proficient in tailoring your message to your audience, and can influence without direct authority. * You prioritize the success and growth of the team ahead of individual ego and genuinely enjoy helping others learn and improve. * You are naturally curious and self\-motivated to bring new tools and techniques to the team. **What You’ll Bring:** * 8\+ years building data or backend systems, including experience with leading technical work that spans multiple teams * Expertise with AI\-assisted software development * Expertise in Python for data pipelines and maintainable production software * Expertise with SQL and cloud data warehousing in Snowflake or BigQuery. * Experience building software systems, or partnering closely with the teams who do * Proficient with containers and orchestration tools, preferably Airflow * Proficient with IaC tools like Terraform. * Proficient with K8s/Kafka and streaming data pipelines * Proficient with cloud computing services such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure. **Bonus Points:** * Prior experience with building CDC platforms, front\-end behavior tracking, MLOps platforms, or AI self\-service tooling **Perks:** * Work remotely throughout the US\* or from our well\-furnished, modern office in Manhattan, NY. * Unlimited vacation policy. * Paid volunteer opportunities. * Technology stipend \- $4,000 every 2 years after your start to make sure you have the latest and greatest technology. * WFH stipend \- $500 annually to make your WFH situation comfortable. * Monthly physical, mental, wellness \& learning stipend offered through Holisticly. * Monthly lifestyle stipend offered through Fringe. * Full health benefits \- medical, dental, vision, prescription, FSA, HRA, HSA, and coverage for family/dependents. * Retirement savings \- Traditional and Roth 401K plans are offered through Vanguard, with an immediate company match. * Life insurance \- basic life, supplemental life, and dependent life. * Disability leave \- short\-term disability and long\-term disability. * Company paid parental leave \- up to 20 weeks for birthing parents and up to 12 weeks for non\-birthing parents. * Family building benefits offered through Progyny. * DICK'S Sporting Goods and their family of brands teammate discount. *The target salary range for this position is between $170,000 and $185,000\. This is part of a total compensation package that includes incentive, equity, and benefits for eligible roles. Due to said guidelines put in place, we are unable to hire in AK, DE, HI, IA, LA, MS, MT, OK, and SC.* We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. **Our Interview Process \& AI** We recognize that AI has become a common part of everyday life and professional work, and its use continues to evolve rapidly. Our perspective on AI in the hiring process will evolve as well. Instead of maintaining static templates, we built an AI skill that reads the guidelines directly, drafts on\-brand presentations, and runs a linter that catches off\-brand choices. jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Position:** Senior Software Engineer, Backend — Booking Platform \& APIs **Duration:** FTE **Shift:** Monday \- Friday / Standard **Annual Salary:** $190,000 to $210,000 **Location:** New York City, four days per week in the office. We are hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to lead the technical work and be the primary hands\-on builder for the client's API. In your first year, multiple distribution partners and an authorized AI agent should complete real bookings through the same versioned API. You will evolve a production Rails and Postgres booking system used by millions of guests. The hard work is keeping prices and inventory correct, preventing overselling, surviving retries and partial failures, and reconciling systems when they disagree. **Your ownership and team** You will own the API’s day\-to\-day technical roadmap and design decisions. In this hands\-on individual contributor role, you will write production code, lead focused designs, guide migrations, and operate what you build. You will partner with our Staff Engineer on foundational domain and architecture choices. You will be the primary builder, but you will not work alone. Other backend engineers will contribute and build supply, PMS, and POS connectors using the patterns you establish. Product, Partnerships, and hotel operations will work with you from requirements through production launch. **What you’ll do** * Build and launch the external client 's API. Define stable, versioned contracts for live pricing, availability, holds, booking creation, changes, and cancellations. * Make booking operations safe under real failures. Design idempotency, recovery, webhooks, and reconciliation for retries, timeouts, duplicates, and partial success. * Evolve the core booking domain. Create clear models and invariants for products, schedules, prices, inventory, holds, carts, and bookings. * Make the platform extensible. Prove that a new category such as events or food and beverage can use the shared booking model instead of requiring a separate system. * Own the architecture for supply, PMS, and POS integrations. Create reusable connector patterns so other engineers can add partners without reinventing failure handling and reconciliation. * Define the data contracts that keep inventory discoverable through OpenSearch. Search is supporting technology for this role, not its primary ownership area. * Operate what you build. Set reliability and latency targets, and add the tests, metrics, dashboards, alerts, tracing, and runbooks needed for a critical booking path. * Turn partner needs into durable platform capabilities, explain tradeoffs clearly, and raise the engineering bar through practical reviews and mentoring.. **Tech stack** * Backend: Ruby on Rails, Node.js * Data: Postgres, MongoDB * Search: OpenSearch * APIs and integrations: REST, OpenAPI, webhooks * Infrastructure and observability: AWS, Datadog * Testing: RSpec, Playwright **Who you are** We encourage candidates to apply even if they do not match every line below. * You have 6\+ years of software engineering experience, or a track record of equivalent impact. * You have designed transactional systems, built external APIs or integration platforms, and safely evolved data models in production. * You understand relational modeling, concurrency, consistency, asynchronous workflows, and distributed failures. * You turn complex business rules into clear boundaries, lifecycle states, contracts, and invariants. * You can lead an important system as its primary builder while collaborating on foundational decisions. * You care about correctness, testing, observability, and safe rollouts. * You communicate directly, listen well, and improve the work of engineers around you. Ruby on Rails experience is useful, but not required. Experience with marketplaces, reservations, inventory\-constrained commerce, public APIs, or third\-party booking systems is also helpful. We care most about your backend judgment, track record, and ability to learn. **What success looks like in 6–12 months** * Multiple distribution partners and an authorized AI agent complete real bookings through one reusable API. * The full booking lifecycle meets agreed targets for correctness, success rate, latency, overselling, recovery, and reconciliation. * Reusable contracts and connector patterns materially reduce the work required to onboard the next partner. * The shared booking model supports at least one new category without a separate booking system. As the API becomes a company\-wide platform, this role can grow toward Staff through demonstrated impact across the booking domain, integrations, and distribution. **Benefits** * Health, dental, and vision coverage, with contributing to monthly premiums * Stock options * 401(k) plan * Unlimited paid time off * Paid parental leave Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $190,000\.00 \- $210,000\.00 per year Experience: * backend/platform engineering: 6 years (Required) * transactional system design: 6 years (Required) * Ruby on Rails/Node/Postgres/AWS/Datadog/Redfis/Kafka: 6 years (Required) * external API and integration: 6 years (Required) Ability to Commute: * New York, NY 10040 (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10040

jobs.title: Front End JavaScript / TypeScript Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ ### **About the Company** GoGoGrandparent’s (GoGo’s) mission is to help older adults live independently in their home for as long as possible. We do that by tailoring existing on demand apps to the needs of people living with mobility, visual, cognitive and dexterity impairments and letting older adults use them by making a phone call. After ordering, our service becomes a virtual caregiver that monitors the instrumental activities of daily living (mobility, meals, groceries, medication delivery \& home management) for tens of thousands of older adults around the United States. We’re profitable, have been around since 2016 \& haven’t raised any venture capital financing to date. The company was inspired by the cofounder’s grandmother, who still uses us to this day (she’s turning 95 in March)! Our engineering team is fully remote, tight\-knit, and moves fast. You’ll work closely with founders, ship meaningful features weekly, and have real ownership over architecture, reliability, and product direction. * **This is a fully remote position** **\*** **Must be able to work US timezones or 4\+ hours overlap with mainland US** ### **Job Summary** We have a Webflow designer who owns layout and CMS. He does not write JavaScript. You will own everything that makes our Webflow pages work: registration, payments, service checks, analytics, cookies, and talking to our APIs. You will also take the code from concatenated ES5/jQuery to TypeScript with a real build pipeline, without breaking production landing pages. You are not a backend hire. You are expected to read our Node/TypeScript/GraphQL/REST API well enough to decide which endpoint to call, what to send, what comes back, and what happens when it fails. We do not have complete, trustworthy API documentation for this. The source, and its tests, is the documentation. You need to be comfortable communicating and working directly with our marketing team and other company stakeholders. ### **What you will actually do** Product / integration * Wire Webflow forms and pages to existing REST and GraphQL endpoints: callers, loved ones, membership, Stripe payment, service\-area checks, grocery/home\-services leads, error logging. * Own multi\-step registration: validation, session persistence, step navigation, auth tokens, 401 handling, partner vs consumer flows. * Keep Stripe Elements, phone inputs, cookies, and tracking working across many landing\-page variants. * Coordinate with the Webflow person on DOM IDs, *required* attributes, and page structure. Our form reader is DOM\-driven; a wrong ID on a Webflow page is a production bug. * Take responsibility for our Playwright test coverage and add more tests as needed. Reading the backend (required, not optional) * Open the relevant route/controller in our backend (TypeScript, Express\-style routes, controllers, some GraphQL) and extract: HTTP method, path, auth, request body/query, success payload, error codes and shapes. * Use existing route tests as a second source of truth when the handler is messy. * Choose the right endpoint for the page (create vs patch, REST vs GraphQL, payment intent vs caller update). Calling the wrong one, or omitting a field the controller actually requires, is a failed task. * When the API cannot do what the page needs, write a clear request for backend (expected input/output, current behavior, what's missing). You will not be expected to own large backend changes. Engineering * Over time, migrate the codebase from JS IIFE modules to TypeScript. * Replace concat \+ Terser with a real bundler (esbuild/Vite/Rollup). * Untangle globals, jQuery, and implicit script order without a rewrite that takes the site down. ### **What the systems look like** Client * We use Webflow: a visual web design and development platform that lets you create, build, and host custom websites without writing manual production code, while also supporting custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for advanced functionality and customization. * Vanilla JS \+ jQuery, IIFEs, concatenated in a fixed file order. * Playwright tests already use TypeScript. App code does not. API * Large TypeScript Node service. Registration and billing are not a tiny CRUD layer; controllers have real business rules. * Auth is typically bearer tokens; some flows differ (partner vs consumer). * Error responses are not always uniform. You have to read the handler. ### **You Should Be Strong At** * JavaScript and TypeScript in the browser (DOM, events, fetch/XHR, cookies, localStorage, CORS). * Reading other people's TypeScript: routes, controllers, types, tests. You do not need to write production backend, but you cannot treat the API as a black box or wait for a spec. * Mapping a form to a real endpoint: required vs optional fields, nested payloads, auth headers, 4xx handling. Incremental migration: JS TS, globals* modules, without freezing feature work. * Build tooling: bundlers, source maps, minify, watch, CI. * Working with a designer who does not write JS: explicit contracts (element IDs, data attributes). * Playwright or similar for user flows. * Nice to Have: Stripe.js, Webflow custom code, analytics pixels, GraphQL, having changed a small backend endpoint yourself. ### **Seniority** Mid to Senior level. You should be able to: * Take a new landing flow, find the right backend endpoints, wire the page, test it, ship it — without someone translating the API for you. * Propose a TS \+ bundler plan and execute it in slices. * Push back when Webflow structure will break the JS, or when the API cannot support the page as designed. ### **How We Will Measure Success (first 6–12 months)** * You own our Webflow flows end\-to\-end: page contract, JS, correct API usage (from reading backend code), Playwright, ship. * You can explain, from the backend source, why a given page calls the endpoints it calls. * App source is being migrated to TypeScript (or a clear majority, with a path for the rest). * Build is a real pipeline: typed, module\-aware, minified, source maps, documented deploy. ### **Benefits** * Fully remote position * $80k – $120k (based on location, experience and seniority) * Paid holidays * Personal Time\-off of 15 days at start * Engineering team retreat * US Employees + Healthcare Insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision) + 401k Plan **About the interview** ----------------------- 2\-stage interview process Show more

jobs.title: Photonics Process Development Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Great Sky is a technology startup based with a mission to rebuild AI from first principles. or equivalent practical experience. * Hands\-on experience in microfabrication, nanofabrication, or semiconductor processing. * Experience fabricating devices on at least one of these platforms: silicon photonics, silicon nitride, or superconducting electronics. * Hands\-on experience with core cleanroom processes such as e\-beam or optical lithography, thin\-film deposition (e.g., LPCVD, PECVD, sputtering), and reactive ion etching. * Skill with process metrology and characterization tools (e.g., SEM, AFM, ellipsometry, profilometry). * A track record of developing, documenting, and troubleshooting fabrication processes using data. **Preferred:** * Experience with SNSPD fabrication, including superconducting thin films (e.g., NbN, NbTiN, WSi). * Experience with low\-loss SiN waveguide processing (e.g., thick LPCVD SiN, stress management, high\-temperature annealing, CMP). * Experience with heterogeneous or hybrid integration methods such as bump bonding or fusion bonding. * Experience transferring processes to external fabs or working with foundries. * Familiarity with GDS tools (e.g., KLayout) for mask preparation and pattern data checks. * Previous fabrication experience in shared, multi\-user facilities such as university cleanrooms, national laboratories, or advanced commercial R\&D centers. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Meaningful equity ownership in an early\-stage deep tech company * Employer\-matched 401(k) * Health, dental, vision, and life insurance * Flexible PTO * Support for ongoing learning, conference attendance, and skill development Our culture is onsite by default (we're founded by scientists who are used to working in the lab), with flexibility for hybrid arrangements. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: ### **Current Employees of Happen Bank: Please apply via your internal Workday Account** Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile\-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. Join us in using data, bold thinking, and a commitment to innovation to help clear the way for millions of Americans to achieve more. **About the Role** ------------------ Happen Bank is building a modern enterprise data and AI platform on Databricks. Our Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Analytics teams build the pipelines. This team builds what they build on. As a Principal Data Engineer, you'll own the technical architecture and development of the platform frameworks and infrastructure that make downstream pipelines faster, safer, and more consistent. This includes configuration\-driven ingestion frameworks, secure connectivity to source systems, reusable data protection libraries for anonymization and tokenization, and the infrastructure\-as\-code foundation that brings these capabilities together. This is a framework and platform engineering role, not a pipeline\-delivery role. Success means enabling teams to onboard new data sources, protect sensitive information, and promote work to production through configuration rather than custom code.**What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own ingestion architecture:** Define the technical vision and architecture for a declarative, configuration\-driven ingestion framework that brings data from relational databases and object\-store files into the raw data layer. Establish reusable patterns and contracts for downstream teams while evaluating tradeoffs between ingestion approaches * **Build scalable platform frameworks:** Lead the design and implementation of reusable, versioned libraries that support policy\-driven data protection, including configurable rules, governed access, consistent outputs, secure\-by\-default failure behavior, and audit trails. Maintain backward compatibility across shared capabilities used by multiple teams * **Set infrastructure and deployment standards:** Define infrastructure\-as\-code practices for safe deployment, replacement, rollback, and lifecycle management, including data ownership considerations for managed pipeline objects. Establish compute, cost, and sizing guidance for large initial loads and steady\-state incremental processing at billion\-row scale * **Drive platform reliability and observability:** Establish monitoring, alerting, reconciliation, recovery, and data validation capabilities that ensure reliable operations from source to destination. Identify and address observability gaps in underlying platform tools * **Lead evidence\-based technology decisions:** Conduct structured proofs of concept with measurable success criteria, document architectural decisions and tradeoffs, and engage technology vendors to resolve product gaps and influence future capabilities * **Drive cross\-functional platform delivery:** Translate ambiguous technical challenges into clear requirements, interfaces, dependencies, and phased delivery plans. Partner with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Information Security, DBAs, and source\-system owners to deliver early solutions while building scalable long\-term capabilities and driving framework adoption * **Raise engineering standards:** Mentor senior and staff engineers, lead technical design and code reviews, and establish best practices for testing, documentation, release management, and maintainability across shared platform capabilities **About You** ------------- * 10\+ years of software or data platform engineering experience, including designing and delivering platform\-level frameworks, libraries, or infrastructure used across multiple engineering teams * Bachelor's degree or higher, or equivalent combination of education and experience * Strong experience with infrastructure as code, including Terraform and CI/CD pipelines for data platforms * Deep experience building ingestion capabilities across diverse data sources, including relational databases, files, APIs, and custom systems, with expertise in incremental processing, change data capture (CDC), schema evolution, and protecting production source systems from excessive load * Advanced programming skills in Python, SQL, and a JVM language such as Scala or Java, with experience developing Spark UDFs and reusable libraries using strong testing, packaging, and versioning practices * Deep hands\-on expertise with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Auto Loader, workflows, compute configuration, and governance capabilities, or equivalent data platform experience * Strong knowledge of security and priva * Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles or equivalent deployment tooling **Work Location** San Francisco The above locations are eligible offices for this role. The locations have been determined to foster in\-person collaboration with this role’s team or the related business lines. We utilize a hybrid work model, and our teams are in\-office Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. In\-person attendance is essential for this role’s success, and remote placement will not be considered. Happen Bank offers relocation, based on actual job level. **Time Zone Requirements** Local hours (PT) While the position will primarily work local hours, Happen Bank is headquartered in Pacific Time and our ideal candidate will be flexible working across time zones when necessary. **Travel Requirements** As needed travel to Happen Bank offices and/or other locations, as needed. **Compensation** The target base salary range for this position is 197,000\-230,000\. The base salary of the role will be determined by job\-related knowledge, experience, education, skills, and location. Base salary is just one part of Happen Bank's Total Rewards package. You may also be eligible for long\-term awards (equity) and an annual bonus (which is based on company performance, employee performance and eligible earnings). We’re creating new financial services solutions for our members based on fairness, simplicity, and heart, and we treat our employees the same way. We offer a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision plans for employees and their families, 401(k) match, health and wellness programs, flexible time off policies for salaried employees, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave and more. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-BC1 Happen Bank is an equal opportunity employer and dedicated to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We believe that a variety of perspectives will make our teams and business stronger as we work together to transform the traditional banking system. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at interviewaccommodations@happen.com. **Notice on AI Tool Use** For select roles and locations, candidate interviews may be recorded, transcribed and summarized by tools such as artificial intelligence (AI) to assist our hiring managers with the application process. You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription, and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. We will not discriminate against you if you choose to opt out. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information from or about you: contact information, identifiers, professional and employment\-related information, sensory information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment. We will only share your interview, transcription, or summary with persons whose expertise or technology is necessary to process your application, evaluate your fitness for a position, and administer or support the tool. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, please refer to our Privacy Disclosure. jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Frontier AI Data Labeling
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ Frontier models are only as good as the data they learn from. At Hippocratic AI, that data decides whether an AI agent safely guides a patient through a medication change at 2 a.m. Our data powers Polaris, a constellation of models with a 700B\-parameter core and specialized safety supervisors. In our evaluations, Polaris reaches 99\.95% accuracy on drug\-safety benchmarks versus 87\.9% for the closest voice\-deployable frontier model. The labeling, evals, and rater calibration behind it are how we earn and defend numbers like that. We’re hiring a Technical Program Manager to run the human\-in\-the\-loop data labeling engine behind our frontier healthcare AI. That spans audio and conversation annotation, clinician\-labeled training data, preference and RLHF data, and the evaluations that decide what ships. You’ll work daily with ML researchers, applied scientists, and licensed clinicians. The data you produce feeds directly into our model training and evaluation loops. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Run the data pipelines behind our models.** Own end\-to\-end delivery of labeling and annotation programs, including audio and voice\-conversation labeling, supervised labeling, and preference and RLHF data. You’ll manage scoping, task design, execution, QA, and delivery against live model\-development cycles. * **Turn evals into products.** Work with ML and Applied Science to turn evaluation and training\-signal needs into concrete labeling tasks, rubrics, and success criteria. Your evals become the benchmarks that gate releases. * **Build and scale an expert rater workforce.** Source, screen, and onboard clinicians and specialized raters through marketplaces, vendors, and in\-house teams. This includes designing qualification tasks, setting rates, and scaling pools up and down as programs change. * **Write the guidelines that shape model behavior.** Author and iterate labeling guidelines and annotation rubrics, especially for subjective, high\-stakes clinical judgment. * **Engineer data quality at scale.** Design QC systems using gold sets, calibration sessions, spot checks, and inter\-rater agreement tracking. Catch rater drift and annotation bottlenecks before they reach training. * **Drive velocity and accountability.** Track throughput, cost, and quality. Manage vendor relationships (SOWs, performance reviews), choose labeling and QA tooling, and keep Engineering, Clinical, and Infrastructure aligned on dependencies and timelines. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * **By Day 90:** You own a live data labeling or eval program through a major delivery milestone. You’ve cleared a critical bottleneck in the pipeline and shipped one measurable quality or throughput improvement. * **By 12 months:** You run multiple concurrent labeling and eval programs. Your calibrated rater bench is trusted by ML teams, and you can trace model improvements back to the data you delivered. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years in technical program management or data operations in an AI/ML or data\-intensive environment (3\+ years considered for exceptional candidates) * 2\+ years hands\-on with data labeling, annotation, or model evaluation, including writing guidelines and managing quality at scale * Experience sourcing and managing contractor or expert annotator workforces through marketplaces (e.g., Mercor, Upwork, Toloka) or labeling vendors * Working knowledge of how annotation quality affects model training, including preference data, pairwise comparisons, and rater calibration (RLHF) * A strong grasp of quality metrics (IAA, precision/recall on gold sets, throughput vs. accuracy tradeoffs) * A track record of owning critical data or eval projects under time pressure, working with ML engineers and applied scientists, and driving results without direct authority * Comfort with ambiguity in a fast\-moving, healthcare\-adjacent AI environment **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience running or supporting RLHF or other training\-data pipelines at an AI lab or applied ML team * Clinical, healthcare, or other regulated, high\-stakes data experience * Familiarity with Label Studio, Scale AI, Surge AI, or SageMaker Ground Truth * Experience qualifying specialized raters such as clinicians or bilingual SMEs * Exposure to reward hacking and specification gaming, and how annotation design can mitigate them **Why Join Hippocratic AI** --------------------------- **Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.** We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation. **Work with the people shaping the future.** Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA. **Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.** We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3\.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others. **Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.** Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com. ***Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @******hippocraticai.com*** ***email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.***

Hollstadt wants to help you reach your long\-term financial goals and understands that planning for your future is critical. Consultants also have access to support from a Financial Advisor. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - LLM Observability
jobs.description: **What We’re Building** Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200\-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023! If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases. **Who We Are** We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers. **How We Work** We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1\. \#LI\-Remote#### **Little more about the team:** The team builds observability for AI in Honeycomb. We help customers see what their agents are doing, what those agents cost, and where errors happen. We also give them insight into individual conversations so they can debug them. We're bringing LLM and agent observability together, and we own both the data foundation and the product experiences built on top of it. You'll work in a small, cross\-functional group of engineers with a dedicated product manager and designer, shipping features customers use in production. If you want to define how people understand and debug AI systems, this is the team for you. #### **What you’ll do in the role:** * Own end\-to\-end development of AI observability capabilities, from ingestion to in\-product visualizations. * Architect and evolve the data model and infrastructure that let us observe agents and their ecosystems across the Honeycomb product. * Build systems that analyze and surface AI\-specific signals, such as cost, token usage, errors, and anomalies. * Collaborate with product and design partners to make sure what we build is usable, intuitive, and unlocks meaningful user workflows. * Teach best practices for exploring and understanding AI system behavior across conversations and workloads. * Iterate through fast feedback loops and experimentation, and share both wins and failures. #### **What you’ll bring to the role:** * Significant software engineering experience, with a record of shipping and owning features end to end. * Experience shipping customer\-facing features at a SaaS company, beyond internal tooling. * Full\-stack range, with proficiency in backend development (Go and/or Python) and frontend development (TypeScript and React). * A track record of working closely with product managers and designers. * Regular, hands\-on use of AI tools in your day\-to\-day engineering work. * Experience being on call. You'd join our rotation after about 90 days. * A track record of navigating ambiguity in a fast\-moving field where requirements shift and experimentation is a core part of the job. * Bonus: Experience building LLM or agent\-powered features in production. * Bonus: Hands\-on experience with observability tooling, such as OpenTelemetry. Base Salary based on level of experience $183,340 \- $206,000 USD **What you'll get when you join the Hive:** * A stake in our success \- generous equity with employee\-friendly stock program * It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are \- our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience * Time to recharge with unlimited PTO * A distributed\-first mindset and culture (really!) * Home office, co\-working, and internet stipend * Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents * Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood * Annual development allowance * And much more... **Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time.** Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work. **Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:** We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you: * All communications will come from an **@honeycomb.io** email address + We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—**never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo**. * Our recruiting process will **never** ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to: + Social security or tax identification numbers + Credit card numbers + Bank account information **Diversity \& Accommodations:** We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams. We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know. As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback. **Privacy Notice:** If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes. For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice. If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact privacy@honeycomb.io. Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

jobs.title: Advanced AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: As an Advanced AI Software Engineer at Honeywell, you will design, develop, deploy, and own advanced AI/ML and Generative AI capabilities that power enterprise software applications and products. You will apply deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, and software engineering to build secure, scalable, reliable, and production\-ready AI solutions. You will provide technical leadership across the AI software development lifecycle, from architecture and experimentation through evaluation, deployment, observability, optimization, and production support. You will collaborate closely with software, product, data, cloud/platform, cybersecurity, and architecture teams to translate complex business requirements into robust AI\-powered solutions. You will report directly to our Director of Engineering, and you’ll work out of our Phoenix, Arizona location on a hybrid work schedule. Note: For the first 90 days, new hires must be prepared to work onsite 100% M\-F. **YOU MUST HAVE** * 4\+ years of hands\-on AI/ML engineering experience, including designing, developing, deploying, and supporting AI/ML and Generative AI solutions in production environments. * 4\+ years of hands\-on experience with modern AI/ML technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, agentic AI prompt/context engineering, embeddings, vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, Transformers, and AI/ML frameworks. * 4\+ years of experience architecting and delivering production AI/ML applications, including APIs/microservices, cloud deployment, model/LLM evaluation, automated testing, observability, performance optimization, security, scalability, and cross\-functional technical delivery. 5\+ years of software engineering/programming experience, with strong hands\-on proficiency in Python and experience with at least one additional programming language such as C\+\+ or Java, developing scalable, maintainable, production\-quality software. * **WE VALUE** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field. * Advanced experience with AI/ML frameworks and ecosystems such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies. * Experience with enterprise\-grade vector databases and search technologies such as Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies. * Experience with Azure AI services/Azure AI Foundry and/or Google Gemini/Vertex AI and cloud\-based AI infrastructure. * Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience building automated deployment jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer - Compute & Storage - Highrise AI
jobs.description: **About Highrise AI** Highrise AI is a GPU\-native infrastructure platform built for modern AI workloads. Designed for developers and enterprises operating in performance\-critical and security\-sensitive environments, Highrise delivers scalable GPU compute across dedicated clusters, managed cloud, and confidential environments. Highrise combines bare\-metal performance with full\-stack orchestration, API\-driven access, and hardware\-enforced isolation to support training, fine\-tuning, and production\-scale deployment of AI models. From reserved GPU capacity to enterprise\-grade confidential compute, Highrise provides flexible infrastructure models tailored to the needs of builders operating at scale. Beyond infrastructure, Highrise integrates disciplined operations, advanced automation, and on\-site engineering expertise to sustain high uptime and predictable performance across deployments. These capabilities extend beyond Highrise\-owned fleets: through managed services, Highrise also operates third\-party GPU hardware on behalf of customers and partners, applying the same operational standards to infrastructure it does not own. Highrise is a subsidiary of Hut 8 Corp., an energy infrastructure platform. Hut 8 integrates power, digital infrastructure, and compute at scale. Highrise serves as the compute and operations layer—designing, deploying, and operating next\-generation GPU clusters from commissioning through production. **ROLE OVERVIEW** We are seeking a mid\-level AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer to provide Tier 2 operational support for large\-scale GPU compute and storage platforms. This hands\-on role focuses on owning technical tickets, restoring service, investigating recurring issues, and maintaining reliable day\-to\-day operation of production AI clusters. Working closely with the NOC, on\-site data hall technicians, SRE teams, and senior infrastructure engineers, the engineer will troubleshoot Linux\-based compute nodes, GPU systems, storage services, and their supporting software. Complex or systemic issues will be escalated to Tier 3 engineering with clear diagnostics and supporting evidence. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Tier 2 Incident and Ticket Management** * Own and manage escalated incidents, service requests, and problem tickets from initial technical triage through resolution, escalation, or documented handoff. * Diagnose compute and storage faults using system logs, monitoring dashboards, management interfaces, and approved diagnostic tools. * Assess severity and customer impact; coordinate with the NOC and site teams to restore service within operational and SLA targets. * Produce clear troubleshooting records, timely ticket updates, shift handovers, and actionable Tier 3 or OEM escalations. **Compute and GPU Platform Operations** * Troubleshoot Linux servers, GPU health alerts, boot failures, firmware/driver issues, hardware faults, and resource availability problems. * Support node provisioning, reimaging, configuration changes, routine maintenance, and return\-to\-service validation using established automation and runbooks. * Investigate Kubernetes and Slurm node or workload failures, working with platform engineers when application or scheduler\-level escalation is required. * Perform first\-level analysis of connectivity or GPU communication symptoms and engage network or Tier 3 engineers for deeper fabric and performance investigation. **Storage Operations and Troubleshooting** * Monitor and troubleshoot distributed and high\-performance storage systems, including capacity, throughput, availability, and client connectivity. * Investigate filesystem mount failures, storage\-node or disk alerts, degraded services, and access or performance complaints. * Execute approved recovery, maintenance, and component replacement workflows with storage vendors and data hall technicians. * Support operational tasks across file, object, and block storage platforms as deployed at Highrise sites. **Operational Readiness and Continuous Improvement** * Assist with upgrades, planned maintenance, cluster expansions, and validation activities following established change controls. * Maintain accurate asset, configuration, and ticket records; improve runbooks, troubleshooting checklists, and knowledge articles. * Identify recurring incidents and automate repeatable operational work with scripts and existing infrastructure management tools. * Collaborate with remote engineering teams, on\-site technicians, OEMs, and vendors to resolve issues safely and efficiently. **ABOUT YOU** **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 3–6 years of experience supporting Linux servers, HPC, cloud, or data center infrastructure in a production environment. * Practical troubleshooting experience with enterprise compute hardware, BMC interfaces (iDRAC/iLO or equivalent), operating systems, and monitoring tools. * Working familiarity with storage technologies such as NFS, distributed filesystems, object storage, and storage performance fundamentals. * Experience using ticketing systems, change management procedures, and Bash or Python scripting for routine diagnostics and automation. * Exposure to NVIDIA GPU systems, InfiniBand/RDMA, Kubernetes, Slurm, or AI/HPC storage platforms is a strong advantage. **Core Competencies** * Structured, evidence\-driven troubleshooting with sound judgment on when to remediate, collaborate, or escalate. * Strong ownership of tickets, attention to operational detail, and commitment to reliable customer service. * Ability to work effectively across NOC, SRE, hardware, network, storage, and Tier 3 engineering teams. * Clear written and verbal communication in English. **ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT** This is a full\-time, engineering role supporting large\-scale AI compute infrastructure across multiple sites. Travel to data centers for cluster commissioning, acceptance, and complex troubleshooting will be required. Flexibility to assist with critical incidents or maintenance activities outside regular business hours is expected. This role is hybrid or remote depending on location. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WHAT MAKES HIGHRISE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK** At Highrise, you will directly influence the performance, reliability, and production readiness of large\-scale AI clusters, work alongside experienced infrastructure engineers, and help define the technical standards for a growing global AI infrastructure platform. At Highrise, you will have the opportunity to: * Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting * Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government * Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team * Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting\-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

integrations. * Experience working independently on complex technical problems, making engineering tradeoffs, and taking accountability for services from initial design through production operations boundaries, APIs, design patterns, data flows, and engineering tradeoffs across reliability, performance, scalability, security, and cost. * Strong Python development skills, including experience jobs.description: Posted Date 10/15/2026 Description At Freddie Mac, our mission of Making Home Possible is what motivates us, and it’s at the core of everything we do. Since our charter in 1970, we have made home possible for more than 90 million families across the country. Join an organization where your work contributes to a greater purpose. #### **Position Overview:** Freddie Mac is seeking a hands\-on AI engineering leader to serve as Director within the Single\-Family Acquisitions (SFA) division, reporting to the Sr. Director of GenAI Engineering \& Enterprise Rules Platform. This role owns the technical core of SFA’s AI Systems Solutioning, including Agent Engineering \& Design. This includes (1\) the overall design and execution of AI Systems development from Ideation \& Business casing to Specification creation \& execution through deployment, (2\) the evaluation harnesses and graded assessment sets that determine whether an agent or AI System is ready for production, and (3\) the operating layer that keeps agents accountable after go\-live. The role is approximately 70% hands\-on architecture and code and 30% leadership of a GenAI engineering efforts and platform and vendor delivery partners. The Director is forward\-deployed by design. The role partners with the divisional GenAI PMO, Enterprise Operations \& Technology (EO\&T), and Digital Experience, and works alongside the Enterprise Business Rules platform team so that agent\-driven and rule\-driven decisioning share a common domain vocabulary, evaluation approach, and traceability model. **Our Impact** Freddie Mac was established by Congress to provide liquidity, stability, and affordability to the U.S. housing market. Within Single\-Family Acquisitions, our technology platforms and decisioning systems are foundational to ensuring loans sold to Freddie Mac meet eligibility, credit risk, and regulatory requirements at scale. **Your Impact** This role is a player / coach model. You will establish the engineering discipline that lets SFA move agentic workflows from pilot to production and keep them there: durable orchestration, accuracy that is measured rather than asserted, and operational transparency that satisfies both business owners and model risk oversight. Then use it. The capabilities built here—retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, and monitoring—become the shared substrate that every SFA use case inherits, so each delivery makes the next one faster. Building knowledge graphs that represent how the business functions and designing their use, matters. **Leadership** * Lead GenAI engineering efforts, execution, and delivery partners under a single delivery model, while remaining the senior hands\-on engineer * Stand up a forward\-deployed engagement model (build, consult, advise, monitor) that embeds AI engineers alongside SFA business teams and is accountable both for what reaches production and for how it behaves afterward * Institutionalize spec\-driven development as the team’s way of working: specifications, acceptance criteria, and evaluation targets are written before build loops begin, so every capability is auditable from intent through implementation * Establish and maintain the team’s pattern library—reusable kickstarters, skills, and reference implementations—built daily with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Amazon Kiro, OpenCode) under the spec\-driven workflow * Partner with the divisional GenAI PMO on capability roadmaps, prioritization, and enablement; with EO\&T on reference architectures and platform standards; and with Digital on product ownership and delivery practices * Mentor engineers on agent design, evaluation discipline, and production operations; serve as a credible technical voice with senior leadership on agentic readiness **Transformation \& Delivery** * Architect and deliver a durable agentic workflow platform: a workflow engine with persistent state, declarative agent configuration so new agents onboard without engine changes, tool and API integration, and agent interoperability (MCP, agent\-to\-agent handoffs) * Design a shared domain graph—a unified knowledge and service layer—as the common vocabulary across agents and rules, enabling validation across workstreams without coupling them to each other * Build the assessment harnesses and graded datasets that gate promotion: scored runs, full trace capture, and regression checks; use the same harnesses to drive prompt iteration and model selection across providers * Establish hybrid retrieval (vector plus graph) over a governed document substrate—Seller/Servicer Guide, policy, and procedural content—with docs\-as\-code ingestion and approvals, so every new use case inherits ingestion, guardrails, and observability * Engineer the post\-launch operating layer: trace analysis linking agent decisions back to source documents and prompt versions, token and cost telemetry per agent run, SLO dashboards (latency, cost, throughput), drift detection, and handoff packages (runboo valent tracing and observability tooling) * Knowledge graph and hybrid RAG experience at production scale with Neo4j, vector search, and governed document corpora * Track record of spec\-driven development: writing the specification and acceptance criteria first, then building with AI coding assistants against them * Production Python; TypeScript/React a plus; AWS (Bedrock) or Azure * College degree or equivalent experience; advanced studies preferred * Financial services or mortgage domain experience strongly preferred **Keys to Success in This Role** * Forward\-deployed instinct: comfortable embedding with business teams and staying in the code * Insists on demonstrating value of AI Systems delivered * Plans before building: treats the spec and the evaluation set as first\-class deliverables, not afterthoughts * Systems thinker who designs for the next use case, not just the current one * Clear communicator with engineers, business owners, and executives * First 12–18 months, success criteria includes: * + Agentic workflow platform in production with at least two SFA use cases (credit risk, quality control) running on shared orchestration * + Evaluation harness and release gates adopted as the standard for all SFA agent promotions * + Observability layer live—trace lineage, cost telemetry, SLO dashboards—with runbooks handed to business owners * + Shared domain graph in use by both agentic workflows and the Business Rules platform * + Measurable reduction in time\-to\-production for new agentic capabilities **Current Freddie Mac employees please apply through the internal career site.** We consider all applicants for all positions without regard to gender, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, physical and mental disability, pregnancy, ethnicity, genetic information or any other protected categories under applicable federal, state or local laws. We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. A safe and secure environment is critical to Freddie Mac’s business. This includes employee commitment to our acceptable use policy, applying a vigilance\-first approach to work, supporting regulatory mandates, and using best practices to protect Freddie Mac from potential threats and risk. Employees exercise this responsibility by executing against policies and procedures and adhering to privacy \& security obligations as required via training programs. **CA Applicants:** Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the *Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance* for Employers and the *California Fair Chance Act.* Notice to External Search Firms: Freddie Mac partners with BountyJobs for contingency search business through outside firms. Resumes received outside the BountyJobs system will be considered unsolicited and Freddie Mac will not be obligated to pay a placement fee. If interested in learning more, please visit www.BountyJobs.com and register with our referral code: MAC. Time\-type:Full timeFLSA Status:Exempt Freddie Mac offers a comprehensive total rewards package to include competitive compensation and market\-leading benefit programs. Develop and execute unit, integration, and system\-level tests to verify software functionality and performance. Analyze test results, investigate defects, and support debugging and performance optimization. Collaborate with systems, hardware, and navigation engineers to develop, integrate, and demonstrate assured PNT capabilities. **Required Qualifications** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Experience developing software in modern C\+\+, including object\-oriented programming, standard library features, and sound software design practices. Proficiency with Git or an equivalent modern version control system, including branching, merging, and collaborative development workflows. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated software build, test, and integration processes. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. Ability to write clear, maintainable, and well\-documented software. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering team. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with embedded software development on Linux\-based platforms. Familiarity with navigation algorithms, sensor fusion, inertial navigation systems (INS), GPS/GNSS, or other PNT technologies. Familiarity with Python or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping, test automation, and data analysis. Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, embedded system integration, or field testing. **Benefits Summary:** Competitive salary with comprehensive health and wellness benefits Dynamic and collaborative work environment Employee ownership Medical, dental, and vision care plans Paid time\-off and parental leave programs Group term life insurance 401(k) retirement plan Tuition Assistance, Training, and education development offerings
