jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – WordPress, WooCommerce & Google Cloud Integration
jobs.description: Senior Software Engineer – WordPress, WooCommerce \& Google Cloud Integration **Company:** Jay Logistics \& Trade LLC (JLT) **Platform:** JLT Innovation Platform (JLT IP) **Compensation:** $4,000 per month ($48,000 annualized) **Location:** Remote / United States **Position Type:** Contract – Ongoing, Launch \& Post\-Launch Support **Department:** Software Engineering \& Digital Infrastructure About Jay Logistics \& Trade LLC Jay Logistics \& Trade LLC (JLT) is a U.S.\-based logistics, engineering, manufacturing, distribution, and e\-commerce company developing an integrated digital platform to support domestic and international commerce. Our JLT Innovation Platform (JLT IP), powered by WordPress and WooCommerce, is being developed to connect customers, innovators, vendors, manufacturers, and businesses with products and services through a scalable digital marketplace. As JLT expands its product catalog, digital operations, and sales channels, we are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to lead the technical integration of WordPress, WooCommerce, Google Cloud, Google Search Console, Google Merchant Center, and associated data infrastructure. Position Overview The Senior Software Engineer will be responsible for completing the technical configuration of JLT IP during its commercial launch and maintaining its functionality, performance, security, and scalability after launch. The successful candidate must possess strong experience with WordPress backend development, WooCommerce product management, Google Cloud Platform, API integration, technical SEO, structured product data, database optimization, and e\-commerce automation. This position requires a hands\-on engineer who can independently diagnose technical problems, implement reliable solutions, and build systems that support product discoverability, customer acquisition, order processing, and long\-term platform growth. Key Responsibilities1\. WordPress \& WooCommerce Engineering * Maintain and optimize the JLT WordPress and WooCommerce environment. * Develop, troubleshoot, and improve custom PHP functionality, plugins, shortcodes, and backend integrations. * Maintain compatibility with Elementor Pro and the existing JLT interface. * Optimize product pages, product variations, categories, attributes, SKUs, descriptions, prices, inventory, and images. * Resolve technical problems affecting product selection, shopping carts, checkout, shipping calculations, and payment integrations. * Improve WooCommerce API performance, database queries, caching, and platform reliability. * Maintain customer, innovator, vendor, and employee registration workflows with appropriate authentication and permissions. 2\. Google Cloud Platform Integration * Audit and correctly configure the Google Cloud environment for JLT IP. * Manage Google Cloud projects, APIs, IAM access permissions, credentials, quotas, and service configurations. * Configure secure Google OAuth authentication for the JLT customer and platform registration systems. * Establish reliable communication between WooCommerce, Google services, and approved third\-party APIs. * Implement appropriate cloud infrastructure for automation, integration workloads, monitoring, and data processing. * Configure logging, error monitoring, security controls, cost alerts, and cloud performance optimization. * Maintain secure management of API keys, access tokens, and service credentials. 3\. Google Search Console \& Technical SEO * Audit and optimize the connection between the production JLT website and Google Search Console. * Configure XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical URLs, redirects, and indexing controls. * Diagnose indexing errors, duplicate content, crawl problems, and technical SEO issues. * Prevent staging and development environments from appearing in public search results. * Implement and validate structured data, including Product, Offer, BreadcrumbList, and applicable MerchantReturnPolicy and shipping information. * Ensure WooCommerce product titles, descriptions, images, availability, prices, and structured data remain consistent. * Improve Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, site performance, and Googlebot accessibility. * Coordinate with JLT's existing SEO plugin and eliminate conflicting or duplicate metadata. 4\. Google Merchant Center \& Product Feed Automation * Establish and maintain the connection between WooCommerce and Google Merchant Center. * Configure automated synchronization of eligible products using supported WooCommerce integrations or the Merchant API. * Map product identifiers, titles, descriptions, images, GTINs where applicable, brands, pricing, shipping information, availability, and variations. * Diagnose rejected products, missing attributes, feed errors, and Merchant Center policy or data\-quality issues. * Configure product data updates so inventory and pricing remain synchronized. * Support Google free listings and readiness for paid Google Shopping campaigns. * Implement re xperience with WordPress and WooCommerce development. * Strong PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, and REST API skills. * Demonstrated experience integrating Google Cloud Platform services. * Experience with Google OAuth 2\.0 and secure authentication workflows. * Practical experience with Google Search Console, Google Merchant Center, and e\-commerce technical SEO. * Familiarity with WooCommerce product schemas, variable products, product feeds, and inventory synchronization. * Experience implementing Google product structured data and resolving validation issues. * Experience with Git, staging environments, production deployment, debugging, and database optimization. * Ability to work independently and communicate complex technical issues clearly. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Google Merchant API, Google Ads, and Google Analytics 4\. * Experience with Google Sheets API and Apps Script. * Experience with Hostinger, Elementor Pro, Stripe, and Rank Math or comparable SEO plugins. * Experience building custom WordPress authentication and registration systems. * Experience with high\-volume WooCommerce product catalogs. * Experience with cloud monitoring, Cloud Run, serverless integrations, or comparable systems. * Experience connecting e\-commerce platforms to Meta, TikTok Shop, and external marketplaces. Launch \& Post\-Launch Deliverables The selected engineer will be expected to complete defined milestones: **Milestone 1 – Technical Audit \& Infrastructure** Review the existing JLT IP backend, production website, WooCommerce database, integrations, Google Cloud environment, and current SEO configuration. Produce a written technical assessment and prioritized implementation plan. **Milestone 2 – Google Search \& Product Integration** Complete Search Console configuration, verify production sitemap accessibility, address indexing barriers, validate product structured data, and implement reliable WooCommerce product synchronization with Google Merchant Center. **Milestone 3 – E\-Commerce Optimization** Improve product variation handling, checkout functionality, product imports, inventory accuracy, media data, and API reliability. Resolve critical launch defects. **Milestone 4 – Cloud Configuration \& Automation** Complete the required Google Cloud configuration, secure OAuth workflows, automated product data operations, monitoring, and technical documentation. **Milestone 5 – Post\-Launch Maintenance \& Growth** Provide ongoing support, performance improvements, security maintenance, integration monitoring, incident resolution, and scalable improvements to JLT IP. Compensation \& Work Expectations Compensation is **$4,000 per month**, equivalent to $48,000 annually if the engagement continues for 12 months. This is a continuing contract opportunity, beginning with defined launch deliverables and transitioning into ongoing post\-launch development and platform maintenance. Monthly compensation will be associated with an agreed scope of work, milestone reviews, reporting expectations, and documented technical deliverables. Applicants must be comfortable working with an active e\-commerce environment and taking responsibility for production\-quality engineering work. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit: * An updated resume or professional portfolio. * Examples of WordPress and WooCommerce integrations completed. * Relevant experience with Google Cloud, Google Merchant Center, or Google Search Console. * Experience automating large e\-commerce product catalogs. * A brief explanation of how they would approach integrating WooCommerce product data with Google's ecosystem. * Their availability and proposed working arrangement. **Company Website:** https://jlogisticsandtrade.com **Jay Logistics \& Trade LLC (JLT)** *Engineering Innovation. Connecting Global Commerce.* Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $50,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance Experience: * Google Cloud Functions: 6 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

application platforms such as Azure Container Apps, App Services, Functions, Docker, or Kubernetes. * Experience implementing CI/CD, automated testing, deployment controls, monitoring, alerting, and operational support for production services. * Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash. * Ability to diagnose complex infrastructure, networking, authentication, certificate, deployment, and runtime issues. * Clear communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work across engineering, architecture, security, governance, and product teams. **Preferred** * Hands\-on experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence, or similar managed AI services. * Experience designing or operating API gateways using Azure API Management, including policies for authentication, routing, throttling, retries, observability, and usage controls. * Experience developing reusable Terraform modules and working with Terragrunt, remote state, module versioning, and environment promotion patterns. * Experience with enterprise landing zones, hub\-and\-spoke an MSP or multi\-client support environment is a plus. * Experience maintaining IT inventory, equipment staging, or depot operations is a plus. * CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Microsoft, or similar certifications are preferred but not required. * Valid driver's license and ability to travel to client locations as needed. ### **Physical / Equipment Requirements** Because this role owns jobs.title: Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ LakeFusion is seeking a **Software Engineer \- Backend** to build and scale our real\-time API to enterprise production workloads. This is a deeply technical role focused on building resilient, fault\-tolerant, high\-throughput distributed systems that bridge enterprise backends with high\-performance Python microservices and data lakehouse platforms. A critical dimension of this role: we ship into customer environments. You won't just write code that works on our infrastructure — you'll build systems robust enough to run across Azure, AWS, and customer\-managed Kubernetes clusters where you don't control the network, the identity provider, the observability stack, or the operator. That requires a particular kind of engineering discipline: defensive design, strong observability, minimal environmental assumptions, and thorough testing under failure conditions. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Scale the real\-time API: Own the architecture and implementation of our high\-throughput, low\-latency API built in Python/FastAPI and deployed on Kubernetes. * Maintain enterprise core: Develop and maintain core enterprise backends using .NET / C\#, ensuring seamless interoperability between .NET services, FastAPI microservices, and NoSQL datastores. * Build for resilience and fault tolerance: Design for graceful degradation under upstream failures, rate limits, partial outages, and retry storms. Eliminate silent failure modes. * Engineer for autoscaling: Tune Kubernetes autoscaling behavior (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler) to handle bursty production workloads across diverse customer environments. * Optimize NoSQL data stores: Architect and optimize MongoDB collections, aggregation pipelines, indexing strategies, and asynchronous database connections for low\-latency queries. * Build streaming integrations: Develop streaming pipelines and background execution workflows that sync data between service, transactional, and analytical layers. * Integrate Lakehouse analytics: Connect backend APIs with Databricks compute, Delta Lake tables, and Unity Catalog to expose real\-time analytics and data pipelines to downstream consumers. * Design for portability: Architect services that ship into customer environments and work reliably without serverless dependencies, with customer\-controlled identity, restricted network egress, and varied observability stacks. * Own performance: Profile, benchmark, and optimize for latency and throughput. Understand and tune the full stack — from FastAPI event loops and .NET memory management through connection pooling, caching, and downstream service calls. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 2\+ years of backend engineering experience building production\-grade services and microservices. * 2\+ years of deep Python expertise, with hands\-on mastery of FastAPI, ASGI server tuning (uvloop/Uvicorn), async event loops (asyncio), Pydantic, and performance profiling. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in .NET Core / .NET 6\+ (C\#), building RESTful APIs, Dependency Injection architectures, Entity Framework Core, and enterprise backend components. * 2\+ years of experience working with MongoDB, including schema design, aggregation pipelines, index tuning, and asynchronous drivers (Motor, PyMongo). * Strong Kubernetes experience, particularly around autoscaling (HPA, KEDA), resource allocation, containerization (Docker), and production deployment patterns. * Resilience and fault\-tolerance engineering: circuit breakers, retries with backoff and jitter, bulkheads, timeouts, idempotency, and graceful degradation patterns. * Deployment portability experience: you understand how to write software that runs in environments you don't control and can adapt to restricted network egress and custom identity providers. * Strong observability instincts: structured logging, metrics, tracing (OpenTelemetry), and the discipline to make systems debuggable from the outside. * Excellent technical communication, with experience collaborating across distributed engineering teams. **Nice\-to\-have** ------------------ * Databricks experience: Familiarity with Databricks Connect, Delta Lake, Spark SQL, or MLflow integrations. * Experience with event\-driven architectures and streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS EventBridge). * Experience deploying into enterprise customer environments with strict security/compliance constraints (customer\-managed identity, private networking, private endpoints). * Experience with dual\-paradigm data access patterns bridging SQL and NoSQL/Document databases. **About LakeFusion** -------------------- LakeFusion is the modern Master Data Management (MDM) company. Global enterprises across industries ranging from retail to manufacturing and financial services rely on the LakeFusion platform to unify, govern, and deliver trusted data entities such as customers, products, suppliers, and employees. Built natively on the Databricks Lakehouse, LakeFusion creates a single source of truth that powers analytics and AI. LakeFusion enables organizations worldwide to accelerate innovation with trusted and governed data.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Console
jobs.description: Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU. If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us. * Note: This position requires presence in our Bellevue or San Francisco office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday. **About the Role** The console is where every service Lambda sells meets the human user at the customer. It is the place where disparate products can come together to create a unified experience that solves a customer problem. Conversely, it is also the place where a cloud most easily becomes hard to use, because each service is built by a different team at a different time, and every one of them arrives with its own idea of what a resource is called, where it lives, who is allowed to touch it, and what a customer should do next. The customer does not experience a portfolio of services. They experience one product, and they judge us on whether it holds together. This role owns that product. You own the console as a single surface, with one navigation model, one identity and permissions story, one set of interaction patterns, and one vocabulary, across On\-Demand GPU Instances, reserved capacity, 1\-Click Clusters, bare metal, storage, networking, Managed Kubernetes, billing, and support. Every service team ships into that surface, and the standards are yours to set. Your job is to make the whole thing feel like it was designed on purpose, which means writing the standards down, reviewing the work against them, and being the person who says no when a service wants to solve a problem in a way that only makes sense from inside that team. Three very different people have to succeed here. A machine learning researcher wants a graphics processing unit (GPU) in minutes and should never have to learn cloud vocabulary to get one. An infrastructure engineer runs large clusters, lives in the application programming interface (API) and the command line, and needs the console to agree exactly with both. A platform engineer is building their own service on top of Lambda for their own users, and needs the console to make clear what their teams can see, spend, and change. The hard part of the role is that these three pull in different directions, and the surface cannot be quietly bent toward whichever one showed up in the last customer meeting. Great product managers at Lambda are defined by three things: insight, influence, and execution. Insight means you look at the data, determine what it means for customers and business, and then figure out what to do about it. But, a great idea doesn't mean anything in a vacuum. That is where influence comes in. Influence means you take that idea and get others to want to buy into it; you win over engineers, designers, executives, and partners without relying on authority. But a great idea that everyone is excited about doesn't matter unless it is delivered to customers. Execution means you work with the right people to get the idea launched, then measure and iterate. We hire product managers who learn new domains fast and reason rigorously from evidence. Deep experience owning a customer\-facing console for a cloud or developer platform is highly desired. At Lambda, we don't work in silos, we work together, each bringing our particular crafts, to build the best customer experience as one team. This role is where that commitment is tested most often. Be clear\-eyed about the starting point. Several of the standards this role depends on do not exist yet, so the first year includes writing them and building the design and front\-end engineering partnership that keeps them alive. This is a role for someone who wants to establish the function, not inherit it. If you have held a cloud console together across a growing portfolio and want to do it while the portfolio is still being built, we'd love to hear from you. We value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and skills, and we are excited to hear from candidates who can bring unique perspectives to our team. If you do not exactly meet this description but believe you may be a good fit, please still apply and help us understand your readiness for this role. **What You'll Do** * **Own the Whole Surface:** Hold the product definition for the console as one product, decide what belongs in it and what does not, rank and sequence the work, and be honest about what Lambda is not doing this year and why. * **Set the Patterns and Hold Them:** Define the navigation, identity, permissions presentation, resource naming, states, errors, and empty screens that every service uses, write them down clearly enough that a team can build to them without asking you, then establish and run the review that console work pas te it down well enough that people can disagree with it precisely, and keep owning the decision after it is made. **You** * Have 10\+ years of product management experience, including owning a customer\-facing console, dashboard, or developer surface for a cloud, infrastructure, or developer platform. * Have shipped interaction patterns, a design system, or a surface standard that teams you did not manage adopted and kept using after you stopped pushing, and can describe how you actually got them to. * Have taken a set of separately built product surfaces and made them behave like one product, and can say what you consolidated, what you left alone, and why. * Understand cloud infrastructure well enough to reason with engineers about identity, permissions, quotas, regions, capacity, telemetry, and billing, and about what should and should not be exposed to a customer. * Understand access control models for organizations, teams, projects, roles, and API keys well enough to design how they are presented, because this is where a console either works for a platform team or does not. * Able to define iterative plans that move an organization from the current state towards the desired outcome. * Have made one product serve both a first\-time user and a daily operator without turning it into two products. * Have used research and instrumentation to settle a disagreement about a user experience, and are comfortable being the person who brings evidence to a room full of strong opinions. * Can turn ambiguous customer, technical, and commercial inputs into product definition that multiple teams execute against. * Communicate plainly, write well, say no clearly, and make decisions easier for people who do not all share the same context. **Nice to Have** * Experience with machine learning or data platform surfaces, like notebooks, training jobs, model endpoints, or experiment tracking. * Experience with the self\-serve funnel from signup to first paid usage, including conversion and activation work. * Experience partnering closely with a front\-end platform team on a component library, design tokens, or a shared application shell. * Experience owning documentation or in\-product guidance as part of the product rather than as a handoff. * Experience with accessibility standards and with making an infrastructure product usable under them. * Experience with a console that had to serve both a human and an automated caller, and opinions about what that costs. **Salary Range Information** The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. jobs.title: Staff / Principal Security Engineer, AI Safety and Security
jobs.description: **Your Impact at LILA** Lila is developing AI systems for scientific discovery, connecting advanced models with scientific tools and automated laboratories. As these systems become more capable, we need to understand how they could be misused or compromised, which protections matter most, and how to establish that those protections work together. We're hiring an experienced security practitioner to lead this work at the boundary between AI safety and security. You will investigate real systems, develop threat models, test important assumptions and recommend the protections needed for particular capabilities and deployments. Your work will address both dangerous misuse and the protection of sensitive models, data and research. This is an opportunity to help shape a developing area of AI safety through security practice. You will combine technical investigation with careful analysis and clear writing, working closely with our established Security team, researchers and engineers to turn findings into implemented improvements. You will bring security depth and develop your understanding of model capabilities, evaluations and safeguards through that work. Prior experience in AI safety is welcome, but not required. **What You'll Be Building** * **Threat\-model consequential systems and capabilities.** Investigate how dangerous misuse or compromise could occur across models, deployed services and scientific workflows. Identify the relevant actors, access routes and failure paths, and the protections that could interrupt them. * **Test the assumptions behind our defenses.** Examine architectures, code, configurations and operational evidence. Run focused adversarial tests, build prototypes and investigate weaknesses, including situations where several protections depend on the same underlying system. * **Shape the protections needed for safe deployment.** Turn dangerous\-capability assessments into concrete security requirements. Assess how compromise of models, sensitive assets or supporting systems changes the safety assessment, drawing on personnel, physical and other security specialists where relevant. * **Make evidence\-based recommendations.** Define what evidence would demonstrate that important controls and safeguards work together. Combine findings from model evaluations and security testing, explain the remaining uncertainty, and recommend improvements or conditions for use. * **Carry findings through to practical improvements.** Work with Security, Safety and engineering owners to prioritize changes, specify acceptance criteria and verify the results. Make clear recommendations about which gaps require attention first and why. * **Anticipate what more capable systems will require.** Identify where changes in capability, access or deployment call for stronger protections. Help teams plan security work with long lead times, and update assessments as systems change or new evidence emerges. * **Develop methods that others can use.** Turn your investigations into clear threat models, assessment methods and technical guidance. Help Safety and Security colleagues apply the approach to new problems and build a shared understanding of the evidence behind decisions. **What You'll Need to Succeed** * **Substantial hands\-on security experience and deep expertise in at least one relevant discipline**, such as security architecture, application or infrastructure security, offensive security, or incident response. You can reason across disciplines and identify when specialist judgment is needed. * **A record of resolving consequential security problems.** You have investigated ambiguous risks, challenged designs and followed improvements through to validation, including work involving several teams. * **Strong technical judgment.** You can examine unfamiliar systems, scrutinize code and configurations where relevant, and use technical investigation or testing to distinguish plausible claims from demonstrated protection. * **Curiosity about AI safety and scientific systems.** You want to understand how model capabilities and safeguards are evaluated, can learn unfamiliar domains quickly, and reason carefully when evidence is incomplete. * **Clear writing and effective collaboration.** You can explain a technical argument precisely, work through disagreements with specialists and turn a complex investigation into an actionable recommendation. **Bonus Points For** * Securing ML infrastructure, model assets, research environments or AI agents. * Evaluating safeguards, adversarial robustness or defenses against sophisticated threats. * Translating risk assessments into technical requirements, assurance evidence or deployment decisions. * Working in scientific or other environments where digital access can have significant real\-world consequences. jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Applied AI Evaluation
jobs.description: **About Litmus** ---------------- AI agents are starting to do real work across the economy, and the companies deploying them have no reliable way to know whether they can trust them. Litmus is building the system that lets every enterprise measure how its agents perform, understand why they fail, and make them better, starting with evaluation and building toward agents that improve on their own. Litmus was founded in August 2026 by Sidharth Srinivasan, who built and led AI evaluation at Box after Box's CEO recruited him out of Stanford CS. We've raised $5M from Pear, BoxGroup, Workbench, and Emergence, alongside the CEO of Box, the co\-founder of Dropbox, and senior executives from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. **The role** ------------ **Figure out what "good" means for AI agents doing real work, and prove it.** You'll design how we measure agents in domains where there's no answer key, and make sure the numbers can be trusted. It's research\-leaning, hands\-on work that ships to customers. You'll work on: * Verifiers and graders for knowledge work with no ground truth * Making simulated environments and tasks faithful to the real world * Knowing when you've tested enough, and when a score means something * Turning what works for one customer into something the product does automatically Why it's exciting: * Nobody has written the playbook for measuring agents in real work yet. You'll write it. * Real agents in high\-stakes domains, not academic benchmarks. * Measurement, not capability: whether agents are actually useful, and how anyone would know. **You might be a fit if** ------------------------- * You've built evals, benchmarks, verifiers, reward models, RL environments, or synthetic data pipelines for LLMs or agents * You think like a researcher about whether a number means anything, and you write production code to find out * You've chosen risk before: founder, founding engineer, early employee, or a small, high\-output team * You typically have 2–6 years of experience **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience in non\-code domains like legal, finance, healthcare, or enterprise work * Post\-training experience (SFT, RLHF, RLVR) * Statistics for evaluation, benchmark design, or published eval research **Probably not a fit** ---------------------- * Eval dashboards or observability tooling with no hands\-on eval design * Model training with little interest in evaluation **What we offer** ----------------- * Founding equity and competitive cash * One of the first hires, working directly with the founder and customers from day one * A say in how agent quality gets measured across the industry * A beautiful office in FiDi * Breakfast, lunch, and dinner * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Equinox membership or a fitness stipend * Essentially unlimited budget for AI tools and tokens * Relocation support if you're moving to San Francisco

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Backend (PST / MST ONLY)
jobs.description: **About Lively** Lively set out to raise the bar on benefit solutions, because we believe no one should have to sacrifice personal wellness for financial wellness. While traditional benefits focus more on transactions and less on the humans using them, Lively harnesses user\-centric design and innovative technology to deliver an effortless experience for employers and account holders alike. Our modern HSA is consistently top\-rated, and we have since expanded our offerings to provide a full suite of other benefits and services for companies, consumers, and financial institutions. Lively is a remote\-first company, headquartered in San Francisco with employees across the US. Come join us and help make getting the value out of your benefits as simple as it should be. **About the Role** We are looking for a strong Backend Senior Software Engineer who wants to create deep and meaningful product engagement experiences! We have an increasing user base, and you will be focusing on implementing and enhancing our investment and financial products. Our customers trust us with a lot: integrating seamlessly across financial institutions, moving funds, tracking balances, helping with their healthcare decisions, and keeping their data extremely secure. In order to take on this mission we're building our applications on modern web technologies around HTML/CSS/Javascript/React, NodeJS/Typescript, PostgreSQL, Amazon Lambdas and Kinesis etc. You should be comfortable in contributing to every part of the stack: from UI to API development, to complex integrations with financial institutions and partners, and building infrastructure, but you will be expected to be focused mostly on backend development. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are:**Lowenstein Sandler is a one of the most sophisticated law firms in the United States, with over 400 lawyers and 300 business services professionals serving clients from offices in New York, Palo Alto, Roseland, Salt Lake City, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., and Wilmington. We recruit candidates who seek a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture that prioritizes our clients, our colleagues, and the communities where we work and live. Committed to career development and to an inclusive workplace, the firm offers many programs and opportunities for personal and professional growth. We seek professionals for our business services group who share these values. **What You Will Do:**The Data Engineer plays a central role within the Software Engineering team, responsible for building and maintaining the data pipelines that feed the firm's Microsoft Fabric Data Lakehouse. Working closely with the Data Architect, this role ingests, transforms, and curates data from the firm's core business systems through a medallion architecture to deliver trusted, analytics\-ready datasets that power reporting, business intelligence, and AI\-driven applications across the firm. This role requires an engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, is rigorous about data quality and governance, and actively integrates AI tooling into their development workflow. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, build, test, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from the firm's enterprise systems into the Microsoft Fabric Data Lakehouse, using Data Factory pipelines, and Spark notebooks. * Implement and maintain the bronze, silver, and gold layers of the firm's medallion architecture, covering raw ingestion, cleansing and conformance, and curated analytics\-ready models. * Partner with the Data Architect to translate logical data models into physical implementations, including star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and Power BI semantic models in the gold layer. * Build and maintain source\-system integrations across Aderant Expert, Intapp, iManage, InterAction, Dayforce, SharePoint Online, and third\-party APIs, applying incremental load and change data capture patterns and normalizing key entities to the SALI/LMSS taxonomy. * Develop transformation logic in T\-SQL, Spark SQL, and PySpark, with built\-in data quality validation, reconciliation to source, exception handling, and alerting. * Diagnose and trace data discrepancies end\-to\-end — from source system through bronze, silver, and gold layers to the final DAX measure or report — identifying and resolving root causes. * Monitor, tune, and optimize pipeline performance, refresh windows, and Fabric capacity consumption to control cost and meet business service levels. * Implement data governance and security controls with the Data Architect and Information Security, including workspace permissions, row\-level security, sensitivity labeling, and law firm confidentiality and ethical wall requirements. * Partner with Finance, Marketing, Human Resources, practice groups, and IT stakeholders to gather requirements, and support business intelligence developers and self\-service users with reliable, well\-modeled, documented datasets. * Manage data artifacts through source control and deployment pipelines, using Fabric Git integration and Azure DevOps to promote changes across development, test, and production workspaces. * Leverage Claude Code and other AI\-powered development tools to accelerate pipeline development, testing, and documentation, and build the curated datasets that power the firm's AI and agentic applications. * Maintain data dictionaries, lineage, and operational runbooks, and provide production support and escalation\-level troubleshooting for failed or degraded data loads. **Essential Job Requirements:** * 3\-5\+ years of hands\-on ETL/ELT or data engineering experience building and supporting production data pipelines. * Microsoft Fabric experience is preferred but not required; equivalent experience with Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Databricks, SSIS, dbt, or other modern ETL frameworks will be considered. * Working knowledge of medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold), lakehouse and data warehouse concepts, and dimensional modeling. * Strong T\-SQL skills, with proven hands\-on experience in MS SQL Server including query optimization and performance tuning. * Proficiency in Python and PySpark, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on Spark\-based transformation. * Experience with incremental load, change data capture, and slowly changing dimension patterns. * Experience ingesting data from REST APIs, JSON and XML payloads, flat files, SFTP sources, and direct database connections. * Rigorous approach to data quality, including validation, reconciliation, and alerting. * Familiarity with source control (Git) and CI/CD practices for data artifacts. * Experience building, maintaining, and supporting analytics models for reporting. * Power BI development experience a plus, including semantic models, DAX, and report delivery. * Ability to deliver high\-quality work quickly in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment, with a track record of managing competing priorities effectively. * Willingness to adopt AI\-assisted development tooling as part of a regular engineering workflow. **Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience of 5\+ years in data engineering. * Data Platform: Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks, Direct Lake), Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks. * Languages: T\-SQL, Python, PySpark, Spark SQL; KQL a plus. * Architecture: medallion architecture, dimensional modeling and star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, Delta Lake and Parquet formats, partitioning. * Integration: REST APIs, JSON, XML, flat file and SFTP ingestion, ODBC/JDBC, OAuth 2\.0, change data capture. * BI and Semantic Layer: Power BI, semantic models, DAX, row\-level security. * Cloud and Security: Microsoft Azure, Entra ID, Key Vault, Microsoft Purview, data sensitivity labeling and classification. * Tools and DevOps: Git, Fabric Git integration and deployment pipelines, Azure DevOps, VS Code, SQL Server Management Studio. * AI Development: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent AI\-assisted tooling a plus. * Legal data standards: SALI/LMSS taxonomy experience a plus. * Law firm data experience (Aderant, Intapp, iManage, InterAction, Dayforce) a plus. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. * Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders. * Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment. * A continuous learner who actively tracks and experiments with emerging tools, especially in the data and AI space. **Office Location:** Roseland, New Jersey (Hybrid) **Schedule:** Full\-Time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM **Amount of Travel Required:** None The expected salary range for candidates meeting the requirements of this position is $125,000 to $140,000\. The range provided is the salary that Lowenstein Sandler in good faith believes at the time of this posting that it is willing to pay for the advertised position. Exact compensation will be determined based on individual candidate qualifications and location. Our benefits package includes coverage options for medical, dental, vision, prescription drug, life insurance, disability, FSAs, 401K, and paid time off. **Disclaimers:** This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties, or responsibilities required by employee. Lowenstein Sandler LLP is not accepting resumes from search firms for this position. Regardless of past practice, all resumes submitted by search firms are to be deemed the sole property of Lowenstein Sandler LLP, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Lowenstein Sandler LLP as a result of the referral. Lowenstein Sandler LLP is committed to equal employment opportunity and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Multi-Modal Digital Experiences
jobs.description: About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software\-defined vehicle architecture, our award\-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. Knowledge for large language models (LLMs) and AI/ML is a plus. * Experience bringing products to life that are built for embedded systems that communicate with cloud infrastructure. * Experience building and shipping iOS/Android mobile apps at a global scale. * Proven record of authoring detailed product strategy, analyzing build vs buy, and making cost and revenue projections * Successfully launched digital experiences related to entertainment and productivity at a global scale. * Deep empathy for users. Experience with converting user pain points into detailed user stories. * Strong communication and presentation skills with a clear and logical thought process. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid's equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. **Equal Opportunity:** At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. jobs.title: Master Data Engineer
jobs.description: The Master Data Engineer owns the accuracy, consistency, and governance of Marco's core master data by building and running the pipelines that create it \- across ERP, CRM, Microsoft Fabric data warehouse, and other system repositories. This role sets and enforces Marco's formal data ontology in partnership with the data architecture team, and turns raw operational data into governed, machine\-readable master data through engineered pipelines rather than manual review alone. The Master Data Engineer partners directly with Finance, Sales, Procurement, Internal Systems, and Business Unit leadership to keep master data clean, de\-duplicated, pipeline\-delivered, and thoroughly documented for aligned data definitions across the organization. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** * Design, build, and maintain automated data pipelines (Microsoft Fabric Dataflows Gen2, notebooks/PySpark, SQL) that consolidate and reconcile master data across e\-Automate, Salesforce, and Marco's Fabric data warehouse. * Serve as the primary engineer and steward of core master data domains — customer, item/equipment, vendor, and location — ensuring pipelines enforce accuracy, completeness, and de\-duplication at the source, not after the fact. * Define and enforce Marco's formal data ontology, MDM standards, naming conventions, and business rules, implemented as automated validation and match/merge/survivorship logic within pipelines. * Partner with the data architecture team to model business concepts and real\-world entity relationships, turning raw data into machine\-readable, query able knowledge. * Lead recurring data quality audits and build automated profiling and reconciliation jobs across ERP, CRM, and Fabric repositories; engineer remediation workflows for ancillary data that lives outside core systems. * Build and maintain the intake and approval workflow for create/change/merge/deactivate requests on master records as a governed, auditable process, partnering with requesting departments to validate before load. * Document data governance standards, field definitions, lineage, and stewardship procedures in a living data dictionary; publish self\-serve documentation that lets business users understand the data they use. * Partner with the BI/reporting function to catch master data quality issues via automated checks before they reach downstream dashboards and reports. * Train and support cross\-functional teams (Sales, Service, Procurement, Finance) on master data intake standards and the technical and business impact of poor data quality. * Track and report data quality and pipeline KPIs (duplicate rate, completeness, accuracy, cycle time, pipeline SLA) to the Director of Enterprise Data and Analytics. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 7\+ years of experience in data engineering, master data management, or a related data\-operations role, including experience setting standards or leading initiatives with minimal supervision. * Strong proficiency in Python (including PySpark) and SQL for pipeline development, data profiling, validation, and reconciliation * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining pipelines in Microsoft Fabric (Dataflows Gen2, notebooks, Lakehouse) or a comparable modern data platform (Databricks, Snowflake). * Hands\-on experience integrating MDM processes with ERP and/or CRM platforms (e\-Automate, Salesforce, or comparable systems). * Experience designing match/merge/survivorship logic and automated data quality rules. * Working familiarity with AI\-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) for pipeline development and documentation. * Excellent attention to detail, documentation habits, and written/verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional data governance and engineering initiatives and influence stakeholders without formal authority. **Pay Range:** $80,796 \- $125,234 annually *The pay range listed for this position is based on candidate's skill level, experience, relevant licenses, and educational background. For detailed information about our benefits, please visit our careers page at* *www.marconet.com/careers**.* **Location:** This is a remote\-eligible position, however, Marco Technologies requires employees to reside within one of the following states: DE, FL, IA, IL, IN, KY, MD, MI, MN, MO, ME, NE, ND, NJ, PA, RI, SD, TX, WI **Application Deadline:** Applications are continuously accepted until the position has been filled. Compensation: $80,796 \- $125,234 annually

jobs.title: Application Security Consultant - DAST
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ A career with us means you’ll work alongside exceptional people and be empowered to reach your professional and personal goals. Our employees are at the foundation of what enables MassMutual to deliver on our purpose to help people secure their futures and protect the ones they love. We embrace the idea that we all are stronger and better through our support for one another. We strive to create a culture where employees feel valued and are celebrated for who they are. **Job Description** ------------------- Application Security Consultant \- DAST Enterprise Cyber Security Full Time, Springfield \- MA **The Opportunity** We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Application Security Consultant to advance our application security initiatives, with a particular emphasis on dynamic application security testing (DAST). You will own and mature how we test running applications and APIs for exploitable weaknesses, drive secure development practices, and implement solutions that protect our systems and data from evolving threats. The role partners with development teams, security architects, leadership, and other stakeholders to embed security into every stage of the software development lifecycle. **The Team** Our Application Security team keeps MassMutual's software applications secure through rigorous assessment and proactive development team engagements. We work closely with security architects, DevOps engineers, and software developers, while our core focus is identifying and verifying vulnerabilities — including hands\-on dynamic testing of running applications and APIs — implementing security best practices, and helping development teams remediate. Our backgrounds span software engineering to red teaming, and we value continuous learning, innovation, and collaboration. **The Impact** Your key responsibilities will ensure applications are resilient against emerging threats, reducing the financial and reputational damage of security incidents. * Own and advance our dynamic application security testing (DAST) program — selecting, deploying, configuring, and maintaining DAST tooling across our web application and API estate. * Design and run authenticated dynamic scans against complex applications, including session handling, multi\-step workflows, single\-page applications, and REST/GraphQL APIs. * Integrate DAST into CI/CD pipelines and pre\-production environments so dynamic testing runs continuously rather than as a point\-in\-time exercise, and define the thresholds that gate a release. * Triage, validate, and tune DAST output — eliminating false positives, confirming exploitability through manual verification, and translating findings into actionable remediation guidance for development teams. * Complement automated dynamic testing with manual techniques to identify, risk\-assess, and prioritize application\-level vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10\) that scanners alone do not surface. * Conduct in\-depth security assessments, including vulnerability scanning and code review. * Conduct detailed threat modeling to identify attack vectors and potential weaknesses, and use the results to focus dynamic test coverage where risk is highest. * Collaborate with security architects to design secure application architectures aligned to industry best practices, ensuring secure coding practices are followed and security controls are built into software designs. * Partner with our SDLC Council to develop and maintain secure coding standards that empower developers to integrate security into their own workflow. * Partner with DevOps teams to implement security controls within CI/CD pipelines for automated, seamless deployment of secure code. * Maintain the broader application security testing toolchain, including static analysis (SAST) and software composition analysis (SCA), alongside DAST. * Evaluate third\-party software and APIs for security compliance, including dynamic testing of externally sourced components where appropriate. * Support incident response for application security events, providing rapid identification and mitigation guidance. * Ensure compliance with applicable security regulations, frameworks, and industry standards. * Use reporting tools As we work together to put the needs of the patient first, we are also dedicated to our employees, investing in competitive compensation and comprehensive benefit plans – to take care of you and your family, now and in the future. And with continuing education and advancement opportunities at every turn, you can build a long, successful career with Mayo Clinic. **Benefits Highlights** * Medical: Multiple plan options. * Dental: Delta Dental or reimbursement account for flexible coverage. * Vision: Affordable plan with national network. * Pre\-Tax Savings: HSA and FSAs for eligible expenses. * Retirement: Competitive retirement package to secure your future. **Responsibilities** The Senior Data Engineer \- API \& AI Gateway Platform Engineer will design, develop, and support enterprise API and AI gateway platforms leveraging technologies such as Apigee (Edge, X, Hybrid), Palo Alto Prisma AIRS (Portkey), Akamai API Security and related integration frameworks. This role requires a combination of API \& AI Gateway architecture, integration, platform engineering, and data enablement skills. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy and is expected to lead architectural decisions, influence platform strategy, and mentor other engineers in API \& AI gateway platform best practices. The ideal candidate will have experience building scalable API \& AI gateway platforms, managing API lifecycle processes, and implementing secure, high\-performing API \& AI gateway solutions across cloud and hybrid environments. The Senior Data Engineer will partner with application teams, architects, and platform teams to enable consistent API \& AI gateway delivery, governance, and operational excellence. This role is part of the enterprise Information Security Modernization (ISM) program, supporting the evolution of secure, scalable API, AI gateway and API security platform capabilities. Participation in a rotating on\-call support schedule is required. Key responsibilities include: * Lead design and architecture of enterprise API \& AI gateway platform capabilities ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, scalability, and long\-term maintainability. * Build and manage scalable API proxies and services supporting REST and SOAP\-based integrations. * Implement API security frameworks including OAuth, JWT, API key management, mTLS, and secure communication protocols. Implement and maintain enterprise AI gateway services. * Develop and enforce API governance standards including versioning, lifecycle management, and API design best practices. * Support API \& AI gateway platform deployments across multi\-cloud environments (GCP, Azure, on\-prem) and hybrid architectures. * Develop CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks to enable consistent API \& AI gateway deployments and lifecycle management. * Configure and manage API traffic policies including rate limiting, caching, throttling, and load balancing to optimize performance and reliability. * Monitor and analyze API performance using analytics, logging, and observability tools; identify and resolve performance or reliability issues. * Integrate APIs with backend systems, microservices, and enterprise platforms to enable seamless data exchange. * Participate in migration and modernization efforts including transition from legacy API platforms to cloud\-native or hybrid API solutions. * Ensure compliance with enterprise security, regulatory, and data privacy requirements including secure logging and data masking practices. * Collaborate with developers, architects, and platform teams to translate business and technical requirements into scalable API solutions. * Provide operational support including troubleshooting, incident response, and continuous improvement of API platform capabilities. * Develop and maintain platform documentation, runbooks, and onboarding materials for internal users and developers. * Support proof\-of\-concepts and innovation initiatives to evaluate new API and integration technologies. **This vacancy is not eligible for sponsorship/ we will not sponsor or transfer visas for this position. Also, Mayo Clinic DOES NOT participate in the F\-1 STEM OPT extension program.** **Qualifications** A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, mathematics, computer science, information technology, health science, or other analytical/quantitative field and a minimum of five years of professional or research experience in data visualization, data engineering, analytical modeling techniques; OR an Associate’s degree in a relevant field such as engineering, mathematics, computer science, information technology, health science, or other analytical/quantitative field and a minimum of seven years of professional or research experience in data visualization, data engine t on healthcare trends and enterprise changes. Interpersonal skills, time management skills, and demonstrated experience working on cross functional teams are required. Requires strong analytical skills and the ability to identify and recommend solutions and a commitment to customer service. The position requires excellent verbal and written communication skills, attention to detail, and a high capacity for learning and problem resolution. Advanced experience in SQL is required. Strong Experience in scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, PHP, C\+\+ or Java \& API integration is required. Experience in hybrid data processing methods (batch and streaming) such as Apache Spark, Hive, Pig, Kafka is required. Experience with big data, statistics, and machine learning is required. The ability to navigate linux and windows operating systems is required. Knowledge of workflow scheduling (Apache Airflow Google Composer), Infrastructure as code (Kubernetes, Docker) CI/CD (Jenkins, Github Actions) is preferred. Experience in DataOps/DevOps and agile methodologies is preferred. Experience with hybrid data virtualization such as Denodo is preferred. Working knowledge of Tableau, Power BI, SAS, ThoughtSpot, DASH, d3, React, Snowflake, SSIS, and Google Big Query is preferred. Google Cloud Platform (GCP) certification is preferred. **The preferred candidate will possess:** * **Experience designing, deploying, or operating API management platforms or gateways (Apigee X experience preferred), including API proxy development, policy enforcement, and integration patterns.** * **Strong experience with cloud\-native infrastructure and container platforms (Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker), including building and supporting scalable, highly available distributed systems.** * **Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm) and CI/CD pipeline development (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to enable automated platform provisioning and deployment.** * **Experience with networking concepts in cloud and hybrid environments, including DNS, load balancing, ingress/egress patterns, firewall rules, and private connectivity.** * **Experience deploying and managing multi\-cloud or hybrid environments, including integration between on\-premises and cloud platforms.** * **Google Cloud Platform (GCP) certification or Kubernetes certification is preferred.** **Exemption Status** Exempt **Compensation Detail** $141,024\.00 \- $204,526\.40/ year. Education, experience and tenure may be considered along with internal equity when job offers are extended. **Benefits Eligible** Yes **Schedule** Full Time **Hours/Pay Period** 80 **Schedule Details** M\-F daytime hours. 100% remote role, the employee must live within the US. Participation in rotating on\-call support schedule is required. **Weekend Schedule** As business needs dictate. **International Assignment** No **Site Description** Just as our reputation has spread beyond our Minnesota roots, so have our locations. Today, our employees are located at our three major campuses in Phoenix/Scottsdale, Arizona, Jacksonville, Florida, Rochester, Minnesota, and at Mayo Clinic Health System campuses throughout Midwestern communities, and at our international locations. Each Mayo Clinic location is a special place where our employees thrive in both their work and personal lives. Learn more about what each unique Mayo Clinic campus has to offer, and where your best fit is. **Equal Opportunity** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, protected veteran status or disability status. Learn more about the "EOE is the Law". Mayo Clinic participates in E\-Verify and may provide the Social Security Administration and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security with information from each new employee's Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. **Recruiter** Laura Percival

jobs.title: Senior Director - Cybersecurity Identity & Access Management
jobs.description: McKesson is an impact\-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well\-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. **The Opportunity** As the Senior Director of Identity \& Access Management (IAM), you will serve as a core cybersecurity executive, shaping and defining the enterprise identity vision and strategic architecture. In this role, you will recruit, empower, and lead a high\-performing organization of security engineers and practice leaders responsible for delivering resilient, enterprise\-wide identity services, capabilities, and governance models. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), this critical position requires extensive domain mastery in identity control frameworks and modern access management architectures. You will champion the IAM vision and multi\-year roadmap, drive operational excellence and robust risk reporting, and embed zero\-trust identity controls across all business domains. As a key strategic partner, you will collaborate with cross\-functional leadership, accelerate product onboarding to enterprise\-approved identity platforms, and proactively communicate risk posture and program progress to executive stakeholders. **Key Responsibilities** * Establish, drive, and own the overarching Identity \& Access Management vision, multi\-year strategy, roadmap, and operational model, while hiring and managing the IAM organization * Implement and oversee core IAM capabilities, including single sign\-on (SSO), multi\-factor authentication (MFA), credential vaulting, identity governance, privileged access management, secrets management, lifecycle management, access certifications, threat detection, third\-party governance, and customer IAM (CIAM) * Design tailored identity solutions for complex or non\-standard deployment scenarios where core IAM services cannot be directly applied * Oversee identity management governance to ensure performance metrics are defined and met, and partner with business teams to remediate non\-compliance issues * Develop strong relationships within the industry to ensure the latest technology and best practices is implemented * Develop and lead the cyber security metrics and executive reporting processes, including KPIs and metrics * Partners closely with technology and application teams to support onboarding applications to enterprise\-approved identity products and services as part of enterprise cloud migration efforts * Partner closely with risk management and compliance stakeholders to maintain full regulatory alignment * Establish non\-human identity (NHI) governance and secrets management controls, including machine identity lifecycle management, service account rotation, and API credential security across multi\-cloud environments * Partner with Threat Detection and Response leader to implement identity threat detection and response (ITDR) capabilities to continuously monitor, detect, and remediate anomalous access behaviors, credential misuse, and identity\-based vulnerabilities in real time * Drive cross\-functional access governance across business, HR, and technology teams to enforce least privilege, role\-based access controls (RBAC), and automated joiner\-mover\-leaver lifecycle workflows * Architect resilient cloud and federated identity models across multi\-cloud and hybrid infrastructures (Azure/Entra ID, GCP, Okta), standardizing single sign\-on (SSO), multi\-factor authentication (MFA), and zero\-trust conditional access policies * Lead M\&A identity integration and divestiture strategies, overseeing identity carve\-outs, directory consolidations, and federation separation across complex enterprise environments * Architect and deliver enterprise\-grade identity products and services engineered for maximum scalability, fault tolerance, and high availability * Leverage automation, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) to drive operational efficiency, automate lifecycle governance and user provisioning, and enhance proactive identity threat detection **Minimum Requirements** * Degree or equivalent experience. Typically requires 15\+ years of professional experience and 10\+ years of diversified leadership, planning, communication, organization, and people motivation skills (or equivalent experience). **Skills and Qualifications:** * 15\+ years of cybersecurity experience with significant depth in identity and access management, engineering and architecture, risk management, compliance, technology, cyber securi tic equipment and supplies, along with other solutions and services to virtually every type of healthcare setting and provider outside of the traditional hospital. These markets – often referred to as Alternate Care or Non\-Acute Care – include physician offices, surgery centers, long\-term care providers, laboratories, home health and hospice agencies, health systems, government facilities and online marketplaces and retailers. Alternate Care markets are growing rapidly, and MMS is proud to be a leader in this space. With a team of approximately 8,000 employees, a network of 15 distribution centers and approximately 900 delivery vehicles, we collaborate with more than 2,200 leading manufacturers and serve over 200,000 customer accounts across the U.S. Our catalog includes more than 270,000 SKUs of branded and private\-label medical\-surgical products – from bandages to specialty pharmaceuticals and COVID\-19 tests. Career Level \- M5 We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long\-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, **Our Base Pay Range for this position** $174,800 \- $291,300 McKesson has become aware of online recruiting\-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind: McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application. McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting\-related communications with candidates. McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: careers.mckesson.com. **McKesson is an Equal Opportunity Employer** McKesson provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other legally protected category. For additional information on McKesson’s full Equal Employment Opportunity policies, visit our Equal Employment Opportunity page. McKesson is committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers including job seekers with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, please contact us by sending an email to (United States) Disability\_Accommodation@McKesson.com or (Canada) Accessibility@mckesson.ca. Resumes or CVs submitted to this email box will not be accepted. **Join us at McKesson!** **Benefits** ------------ * ### **Coverage you can rely on** + Medical, Dental, and Vision + Health Spending Accounts + Flexible Spending Accounts * ### **Benefits that go beyond your base pay** + 401(k) (U.S.) + Pension (Canada) + Employee Stock Purchase Plan * ### **Support for total well\-being** + Mental Health Programs + Flexible Schedules + Paid Time Off + Wellness Program + Education Reimbursement + Volunteer Opportunities + Flexible Work Environment * ### **A culture powered by belonging** By fostering a culture of belonging, we advance our goal of being the best place to work in healthcare—connecting the right talent to the right roles to solve our most critical challenges.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
jobs.description: Job ID: 112227 * Atlanta * Austin * Boston * Charlotte * Chicago * Cleveland * Columbus * Connecticut \- Darien * Dallas * Denver * Detroit \+ 14 More Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem\-solver who is energized by challenges? **You’ve come to the right place.** **YOUR IMPACT** --------------- You will set the vision for engineering excellence and define the standards, practices, and architectures that empower clients to deliver transformative technology at scale. You will have the opportunity to work on lots of different challenges, across clients and sectors. You will partner with C\-level executives and senior leaders to shape long\-term technology strategy and drive innovation across the most complex engineering challenges in the industry. You will lead and mentor a community of technical colleagues and multiple engineering teams, setting the technical direction for the organization's largest and most complex programs. Your work will solve the most difficult and high\-impact challenges facing clients across industries. Collaborating across QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you'll guide the development of industry\-shaping software capabilities and scalable, enterprise\-grade AI solutions. You will be responsible for hiring, developing, and retaining top engineering talent, building robust technical foundations for production\-ready, AI\-enabled systems, and ensuring our clients can achieve meaningful, lasting impact. You'll be based in one of our NA offices as part of our global Software Engineering community. Working in cross\-functional teams, you'll collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and industry experts to deliver software solutions. By partnering with clients, from data owners to senior executives, you'll solve complex problems that drive tangible business value and continue to grow your skills as a client\-facing technologist. Your work offers a unique opportunity to lead at the forefront of AI and software engineering. You'll develop expertise at the intersection of technology and business by tackling diverse challenges in the evolving AI landscape. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you'll gain a holistic understanding of how software engineering enables advanced AI while collaborating with some of the leading technologists and AI practitioners in the industry. **YOUR GROWTH** --------------- Driving lasting impact and building long\-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture \- doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else. When you join us, you will have: * **Continuous learning:** Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey. * **A voice that matters:** From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. * **Global community:** With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. * **World\-class benefits:** On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family. **YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS** ---------------------------------- * Advanced degree in a relevant field; or equivalent experience * 15\+ years of experience designing and delivering large\-scale, business\-critical software solutions, with recognized mastery in frontend and backend technologies, distributed systems, and cloud\-native architectures * Demonstrated ability to set the overarching technical vision and strategy for an organization, with a track record of introducing new paradigms, reusable components, and frameworks that drive engineering efficiency and scalability at an enterprise level * Experience defining and leading the enterprise\-wide adoption of agentic engineering, establishing the operating model for autonomous agent\-driven delivery including governance, guardrails, and accountability * Experience architecting and leading enterprise AI strategy \- spanning model portfolios, build\-vs\-buy decisions, engineering discipline, and AI security standards \- and partnering with senior business leaders to maximize AI impact and identify emerging sources of leverage * Proven track record as a trusted advisor to senior executives on technology and data strategy, cloud architecture, and long\-term transformation roadmaps, with the ability to articulate trade\-offs and align technology decisions with long\-term business goals * A security\-first mindset, with experience championing secure development practices across an organization, acting as a trusted advisor on security and compliance, and ensuring alignment on secure development strategies at an enterprise level * Experience leading and developing multiple engineering teams and technical leaders across large, complex programs, fostering a strong engineering culture, and a proven ability to hire, mentor, and retain top engineering talent * Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment * Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels, from engineers to C\-level executives Please review the additional requirements regarding essential job functions of McKinsey colleagues. Our unwavering commitment to integrity drives everything we do, guiding us to always act in the best interests of our clients, our people, and the communities we serve.

jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 23 Oct 2026 Careers that change lives start here. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. **A Day in the Life** ===================== Senior Research Manager Careers That Change Lives At Medtronic, we push the limits of what technology can do to make tomorrow better than yesterday, and that makes it an exciting and rewarding place to work. We value what makes you unique. Be a part of a company that thinks differently to solve problems, make progress, and deliver meaningful innovations. The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) Operating Unit offers devices and therapies that treat patients with abnormal heart rhythms and heart failure. We are comprised of three businesses: Cardiac Pacing Therapies Cardiovascular Diagnostics \& Services Defibrillation Solutions In this exciting role as a Senior Research Manager for the Primary Battery Technology team in the Energy Solutions Technology organization of Electrophysiology Therapies you will lead a group of talented scientists, engineers and technicians engaged in research and technology development of primary battery solutions for medical devices.
