jobs.title: Associate Vice President, Head of Enterprise AI Delivery
jobs.description: Job Description The Associate Vice President, Head of Enterprise AI Delivery leads the business\-facing capability that closes that gap. Reporting to the Chief AI Officer, this leader owns the non\-engineering disciplines required to convert enterprise AI strategy into delivered, adopted and measured outcomes, organized into four functions: AI portfolio and value; process reengineering and operating model; enterprise AI products and delivery; and the AI Center of Excellence and adoption. This role is the connective tissue between our technology organization and the divisions it serves. The successful candidate will be equally credible in a technical design review and in a divisional leadership meeting, and will be measured not on what is built but on what changes as a result. **AI Portfolio \& Value:** * Facilitate the enterprise AI demand intake, triage and prioritization process, ensuring investment concentrates on the highest value opportunities. * Establish and run the delivery operating model for enterprise AI initiatives, including stage\-gating, funding checkpoints, dependency management and delivery assurance. * Maintain a single enterprise view of the AI portfolio — scope, status, investment, risk and expected value — and provide the reporting that supports executive and Board\-level governance. * Partner with Division leadership and the enterprise strategy to align AI investment with the enterprise strategic plan and annual planning cycle. * Own the business case standard for enterprise AI investment, including baselining, benefit definition and the evidence required at each stage gate. * Establish and run post\-implementation value measurement in partnership with Finance, including agreed treatment of productivity, cycle\-time, quality and cost benefits. * Report realized value to executive governance with rigor and candour, including initiatives that have not delivered. * Collaborate with various business\-side counterparts in Legal, Privacy, Quality and Compliance in the operation of the responsible AI framework, including use\-case risk tiering and intake triage. **Process Reengineering \& Operating Model:** * Establish process and task mining as standard practice to document the actual as\-is state, and build the internal capability to run it. * Own quantitative baselining of every process entering the portfolio — cycle time, cost per transaction, touch points, handoffs, rework and defect rates — agreed with Finance at the outset, and maintain a prioritized portfolio sequenced on value, feasibility and risk. * Lead task\-level decomposition of priority processes, classifying each task as automatable, augmentable, irreducibly human on judgment or accountability grounds. * Drive clean\-sheet, AI\-first jobs.description: There’s a particular joy in being the person who makes the confusing finally make sense. You follow the clues. You find the cause. You prove the answer. Imagine replacing uncertainty with confidence. Making a difficult day easier for someone else. Watching a teammate grow because you took the time to share what you know. Your curiosity will open doors. Your judgment will shape what comes next. You’ll protect the foundations people depend on to do their best work. You’ll set a new standard for dependable systems and shared knowledge. You’ll leave a legacy of confidence, capability, and people empowered by what you made possible. jobs.title: Director, Security Engineering - i3E
jobs.description: Are you interested in solving complex problems that lead to safer experiences for people using Meta’s products? Do you have an adversarial mindset and are excited about leading the pods that investigate and disrupt the most serious threats to our community? Come join us at Meta!Meta is seeking an experienced security engineering leader to lead the Integrity Investigations, Intelligence, and Events organization (i3E). i3E protects the people who use Meta’s products from the worst\-of\-the\-worst threat actors that cause real\-world harm. The organization investigates complex adversarial behavior, scales investigative insight into durable defenses, and works across product, engineering, policy, legal, and public affairs to deter that activity. The range of threats is vast: fraud and scams, human exploitation and youth safety, dangerous organizations, nation\-state threats, compromise, and the emerging abuse of generative AI; while the impact of this work is substantial. In this role you will lead an organization of security engineer and security analyst investigators operating as a set of pods, each grouped under a manager and a technical lead, spanning several distinct harm domains. You will own the strategy for how Meta investigates adversarial threats at scale: what we investigate, how we convert investigative findings into enforcement and product defenses, and how we measure whether the work is reducing harm. You will be accountable for the capability and resilience of the organization — including growing the leadership bench and developing the next generation of investigative experts.We are looking for a leader who is credible with investigators and engineers alike, who can set direction in a domain where the adversary adapts continuously, and who is deliberate about building an organization that outlasts any individual. This person will be a thought leader on investigative practice at Meta, will influence cross\-functional roadmaps and strategic investments well beyond their own teams, and will be a driving force in making investigative work AI\-native by redesigning how investigations are done rather than adding tools to existing workflows. ### **Director, Security Engineering \- i3E Responsibilities:** * Provide organizational leadership to a multi\-pod investigations organization spanning several harm domains * set and communicate a vision that connects investigative work to measurable reduction in harm. * Own the strategy and roadmap for investigations across the organization, and ensure prioritization, resourcing, and delivery against it in a continuously changing threat and business environment. * Develop and scale the management and technical\-leadership bench by hiring, coaching and growing managers and leads, building succession depth so that critical scope is never dependent on a single person. * Continue driving the organization’s AI\-native transformation: redesign investigative workflows around AI capability, set the bar for responsible use, and hold the organization accountable for measurable gains in investigative throughput and quality. * Define and own the metrics and operating cadence for the organization * ensure leaders are measuring the right things and that team health is tracked alongside output. * Partner with and influence cross\-functional leaders across product, engineering, data science, policy, legal, communications, and public affairs to organization’s priorities on partner roadmaps. * Lead the organization’s response posture for high\-severity, time\-compressed escalations. * Actively engage as a member of the leadership team on or derogatory language, and other potential objectionable material, i.e. child exploitation, graphic violence, self\-injury, animal abuse, and other content which may be considered offensive or disturbing. ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * 12\+ years of experience in security, intelligence, investigations, or a closely related technical domain, including hands\-on technical depth * 8\+ years of people management experience, including managing and developing managers, and leading distributed teams across sites and time zones * Demonstrated track record of attracting talent and of scaling and developing high\-performing teams and leaders * Strategic thinker with a track record of transforming both how an organization works and what it delivers * Experience making data\-driven decisions, and bringing clarity to problems that are ambiguous and where established principles do not fully apply * Experience collaborating with and influencing cross\-functional leaders in engineering, product, policy, legal, and public affairs * Experience developing multi\-source, evidence\-based findings and communicating them to senior and executive audiences ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize and redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g. efficiency gains, quality improvements) * Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g. risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g. prompt and context engineering, investigative capabilities, including tradecraft development and investigative tooling * Experience in crisis management or incident response environments * Experience working with diverse communities jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Applications (Precision Signal Chain, Data Converters / Linear)
jobs.description: Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000\-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi\-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc. People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally\-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values\-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the *Aggregate System* and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence. Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you. Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await! **Job Description:** ### **Help define the next generation of Microchip's precision analog and mixed\-signal products. The Mixed Signal \& Linear Division builds the complete precision signal chain: op amps, comparators, voltage references, current\-sense amplifiers, ADCs, DACs, and digital potentiometers. One applications team supports all of it.** ### **As a Principal Applications Engineer, you'll drive device specifications, work with design engineering on architecture trade\-offs, and bring a system\-level view of the customer to products that ship for 10\+ years. We're looking for depth in either precision linear/analog or data converters, and an understanding of how the two work together. Depending on your background, your initial focus will be either ADCs (primarily SAR) or linear products such as op amps, comparators, voltage references, and current\-sense amplifiers. From there you'll have room to broaden across the signal chain and a clear path to product\-family ownership.** ### **The position works closely with product marketing, architecture, design engineering, product engineering, validation, and test throughout the** **new\-product\-development** **lifecycle. It also supports sustaining and lifecycle activities for assigned devices.** ### **Core responsibilities** ### ***Definition*** * ### **Author and maintain device specifications for assigned new products and** **derivatives. Drive them through defined milestones, capturing product** **goals, key features, specifications, and application requirements.** * ### **Translate customer needs, market input, and application use cases into** **clear requirements and key specification parameters, including the specs** **that can't be compromised.** * ### **Work with design engineering during early specification phases to evaluate** **architecture trade\-offs and refine block\-level definitions.** ### ***Application evaluation and system enablement*** * ### **Perform hands\-on application\-level evaluation of new silicon, testing** **device functionality in real\-world use cases and reference circuits from** **the customer's perspective. Feed findings back to design, validation, and** **product teams ahead of release.** * ### **Design, review, and bring up reference and evaluation hardware, with a** **focus on complete signal\-chain solutions (sensor front end, amplification,** **reference, conversion).** * ### **Develop application collateral: application notes, design guides,** **reference designs, and evaluation board documentation. Support** **simulation\-model releases (SPICE macromodels, behavioral models) for** **accuracy in application use.** * ### **Write and review datasheets and spec\-derived collateral for technical** **accuracy and consistency ahead of product release.** ### ***Customer and team*** * ### **Resolve complex, escalated design issues with customers and field** **applications teams.** * ### **Deliver technical training on product operation and system\-level** **signal\-chain design.** * ### **Provide technical guidance to junior applications engineers.** **Requirements/Qualifications:** ### ***Minimum Qualifications*** * ### **BSEE, MSEE, or PhD with 10\+ years of experience in analog/mixed\-signal applications, design, validation, or systems engineering** * ### **Deep hands\-on expertise in at least one of the following:** + ### **Precision linear/analog: op amps, comparators, voltage references,** **current\-sense amplifiers. Includes stability and compensation, noise,** **offset and drift, input/output stage trade\-offs, and capacitive\-load** **behavior** + ### **Data converters: SAR and/or delta\-sigma ADCs, DACs. Includes input drive and settling, reference design, anti\-aliasing, and converter metrics** **(INL/DNL, ENOB, SNR/SFDR/THD)** * ### **Working knowledge of the other area as it applies to precision** **signal\-chain design (for example, how amplifier and reference choices** **affect converter performance)** * ### **Experience contributing to product requirements or device definition** * ### **Solid bench evaluation and debug skills with standard lab instrumentation;** **experience with PCB design and hardware bring\-up** * ### **Proficiency with SPICE simulation and tools for circuit analysis and** **design verification** * ### **Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical** **documentation such as datasheets and application notes** * ### **Able to manage multiple projects, work independently, and collaborate** **across teams** ### ***Preferred Qualifications*** * ### **Depth in both linear/analog and data converters** * ### **Embedded programming for MCU\-based device evaluation over standard serial** **interfaces (e.g., SPI, QSPI, I2C, I3C)** * ### **Data analysis or lab automation (Python, MATLAB)** * ### **Analog mixed\-mode simulation (AMS), behavioral modeling, or SPICE** **macromodel development** * ### **Direct technical engagement with customers (design\-in support,** **requirements discovery, training)** * ### **Published application notes or articles, or experience delivering** **technical workshops** * ### **Domain knowledge in an end market such as industrial, energy metering,** **medical, or automotive** **Travel Time:** 0% \- 25%**Physical Attributes:** Hearing, Seeing, Talking, Works Alone, Works Around Others**Physical Requirements:** 10% Standing 90% Sitting 100% Inside Microchip Technology Inc is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information on applicable equal employment regulations, please refer to the Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal Poster. **To all recruitment agencies**: *Microchip Technology Inc.* ***does not*** *accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our recruiting team or other Microchip employees. Microchip is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.*

jobs.title: Principal Penetration Tester
jobs.description: **Overview** Join Cloud Operations \+ Innovation (CO\+I), the organization behind the technology and infrastructure that powers Microsoft’s cloud. Within CO\+I, the Trusted Cyber Engineering (TCE) team is at the forefront of ensuring the security of our global operations. We are seeking a highly skilled security engineer to join our team dedicated to driving cutting\-edge security innovation. You will test physical and logical security systems that keep Microsoft’s global datacenter running, from cloud services and networks to hardware and operational technology for critical infrastructure such as power, cooling, and building management systems. As part of our team, you’ll provide guidance on team priorities, tactics, and methodologies. You will educate, empower, and inspire fellow cyber defenders, peers, and strategic partners. Our focus is collaboration as we perform penetration testing and ensure a high rate of issue resolution working very closely with our partners. You will be a direct hands\-on individual contributor and a technical lead for our penetration testing function with the ability to help shape the team and team’s strategy as we continue to mature our penetration testing team’s capability and growth. While there is a preference for candidates who can work from our Redmond, WA office three days per week, we welcome qualified candidates who may not be able to meet this preference. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** * Leads and participates in comprehensive penetration testing efforts across all layers of services including applications, cloud, network, hardware and critical infrastructure operational technology (OT) systems. Identifies security vulnerabilities, performs end\-to\-end adversary emulation within approved rules of engagement for multiple areas of responsibility with an ability to come up to speed on new targets and unidentified patterns without direction. * Operates in uncertain, challenging, and novel environments and execute offensive and defensive security operations. Identifies unknown risk areas and leverages expertise to appropriately handle them. * Builds relationships to enable streamlined and efficient communication and collaboration, advocating for security change across the organization. * Provides strategic guidance to teams on priorities, tactics, evaluation strategies, and development of methodologies. Chains findings into attack paths that demonstrate operational and business impact. * Organizes and directs the team focused on engagement rules, scoping, executive risk communications and technical guidance for operations. Leads the rhythm of business across team to ensure remediation of findings is completed according to the defined SLA; reporting and all communications are delivered on time. * Creates high\-quality executive level verbal and written presentations advocating for and outlining process of penetration testing, explaining technical information to non\-technical audiences, as well as present data driven reporting tracking operations, explaining impact, risks, vulnerabilities, system information and remediation plans with potential impact. * Works as a technical operator on various types of penetration testing offerings with an ability to identify and exploit misconfigurations, improve detection capabilities, and enhance threat visibility. * Research emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and tools to stay updated with the latest attack techniques, and security trends * Mentors and guide team members and partners, fostering a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and technical excellence. Partners closely with detection, threat intelligence and incident response teams to turn findings into actionable detections. * Applies AI and automation to scale reconnaissance, discovery and testing. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** * Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field AND 4\+ years’ experience in security or related field + OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field AND 6\+ years’ experience in security or related field + OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: * **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. * **Citizenship \& Citizenship Verification:** This position requires verification of citizenship due to citizenship\-based legal restrictions. articles. * Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through process improvements, automation, and standardization. * Collaborate with Network, Security, Applications, and other paths, and security requirements. * Become proficient in routine Windows Server and virtual machine support, including common troubleshooting, patching, monitoring, and service requests. * Begin d knowledge, skills, and qualifications. jobs.title: Systems Studies Engineer

(MEPPI) serves as the company’s engineering and consultancy arm that helps grid operators, utilities, generators, and major energy users plan, design, and solve complex power\-system challenges. Our specialty is delivering tailored services that uncover insights beyond the surface and proactively address technical and commercial risks. Our focus is delivering dependable, low\-friction project outcomes, reducing uncertainty around system reliability, schedule, compliance, complexity, stranded capital, and reputational exposure. MEPPI is seeking a **System Studies Engineer** with a focus on **Electromagnetic Transients (EMT) studies** to join our growing consulting team. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys analytical problem\-solving, simulation\-based engineering, and continuous learning in the evolving power industry. **What You’ll Do:** * Perform power converter\-based resources. * Execute studies from model development through analysis and reporting while maintaining high technical quality and meeting project schedules. * Prepare and present technical reports and recommendations to internal and external customers. * Stay current on industry standards, grid planning practices, interconnection requirements, and emerging power system technologies. * Contribute to technical papers, conference presentations, and industry publications. * Support MEPPI divisions on equipment and application engineering projects. **What You’ll Bring:** and experience. * Basic knowledge of electric power systems, equipment operation, and control. * Intermediate interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills required to communicate with customers and employees. * Ability to work in a team environment and on multiple projects simultaneously. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to change within a fast\-paced business jobs.description: **Join the Team Modernizing Medicine** At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care. **A Culture of Excellence** When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes: * **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work** * **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year” * **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties * **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture\-Backed Company of the Year We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started. **Ready to modernize medicine with us?** **Job Description Summary:** **About the Role** We are seeking a **Software Engineering Manager \- IAM** to lead a high\-performing engineering team driving our enterprise Identity \& Access Management (IAM) platform. In this role, you will balance technical leadership, team management, and operational execution—ensuring our central authentication, single sign\-on (SSO), and infrastructure automation deliver high performance, strict SLA adherence, and bulletproof security. While a background in IAM or security infrastructure is a major advantage, we value strong technical fundamentals, deep architectural acumen, exceptional organization, and a fast\-learning mindset above all. You will work closely with our Technical Product Owner and Staff Engineer, diving deep into our platform functionality, actively participating in acceptance testing, and ensuring high\-quality software delivery. **What You’ll Do** * People \& Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers. jobs.title: Senior Motion Planning Engineer - Safety-Layer
jobs.description: **Mission Summary:** The Safety\-Layer Team is responsible for ensuring the Motional Autonomous Vehicle executes appropriate dynamic trajectories in both nominal and safety\-critical scenarios. This team focuses on refining upstream motion plans to guarantee compliance with safety\-driven requirements, executing highly dynamic evasive maneuvers at the AV's physical limits, and implementing system\-wide safety overrides. The team pursues these goals through a process of rigorous algorithmic design, implementation, validation, analysis in simulation, and comprehensive closed\-course and public road evaluation. As the team's responsibilities are growing to support more complex scenarios and the scaling of Motional's deployment area, we are looking for a Senior Motion Planning \- Safety\-Layer to help build a robust motion planning safety\-layer. You will work on enabling cutting\-edge capabilities for Motional's AV, including algorithm design and documentation, software development, metrics definition, simulation implementation and evaluation, and in\-vehicle testing. As part of this role, you will maintain cross\-functional relationships across the organization to help understand and communicate the impacts of their work on overall AV performance. **What you will work on:** * Design, implement, and test algorithms for synthesizing trajectories and selecting trajectories across asynchronous generation sources to ensure AV behaviors adhere to safety\-critical requirement specifications. * Develop evasive maneuver planning algorithms in conjunction with low\-level control systems to safely use the full actuation capacity of Motional's AV for collision avoidance. * Evaluate the role of multiple perception sensor modalities in refining the safety\-layer's identification of safety\-critical scenarios. * Construct test/analysis tooling for isolated and system\-level evaluation of safety\-layer components and processes, select test parameters, and analyze test results. * Utilize, validate, and improve dynamic simulation environments to accelerate the design and analysis of safety\-critical motion planning algorithms, including validating simulation models against real\-world data. * Define and implement performance, comfort, and safety metrics for motion planning and safety systems, and perform quantitative analysis of fleet\-wide vehicle data to validate design improvements and identify key areas of improvement. * Build a system\-wide understanding of Motional's autonomy stack components by supporting root\-cause analysis of simulation, closed\-course, and public road events from a motion planning and safety perspective. * Travel for in\-person vehicle testing at Motional's and our partner's deployment and test track locations, typically once every 4 to 6 months. **Desired Background:** * MS, PhD preferred, in one of Control Theory / Robotics / Computer Science / Applied Math or a related field * 3\+ years of experience developing motion planning and collision avoidance related algorithms and components in an industrial setting, preferably the AV industry * Strong background in modern C\+\+ programming (C\+\+17, C\+\+20\), with an emphasis on developing high\-performance and reliable systems * Experienced with concepts from motion planning including trajectory generation through numerical optimization and sampling\-based approaches, cost and heuristic\-based methods for trajectory selection, multi\-modal prediction models, geometric and physics\-based collision detection, time\-series data processing, and data visualization * Familiarity with dynamic collision modeling, convex set processing, state machine logic, and multi\-rate decision\-making processes * Familiarity with agentic\-based development tooling * Familiarity with Linux\-based operating systems **Bonus Points:** * General familiarity with machine learning, including supervised learning, reinforcement learning, training/test validation, etc. * Familiarity with vehicle dynamics modeling, including standard longitudinal/lateral vehicle dynamics models * Publications in Robotics/Controls or Autonomous Driving conferences/journals (IROS, ICRA, CoRL, RAL, TRO, CDC, ACC, TAC, CSL, Automatica, IV, ITSC, T\-ITS) * Familiarity with SQL\-based queries * Familiarity with Python * Familiarity with Gitlab, Bazel, VSCode / CLion * Familiarity with AV industry simulation tooling \#LI\-BP1 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.** **Our journey is always people first.** We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move. **Higher purpose, greater impact.** We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do. **Scale up, not starting up.** Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges. Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, MyWave Agentic CoE \| MYWAVE.ai \| Remote** **MyWave.ai \| Partner with us** MyWave is a universal agentic AI platform. MyWave Create generates and deploys secure, governed agents in conversation, drawing on ontology best practice across 27 industries, and runs them across the whole enterprise estate \- SAP ECC, S/4HANA, SAP Business One and non\-SAP systems of record such as Oracle, Microsoft, Salesforce and ServiceNow. We are SAP certified on BTP, work with Joule and extend it, and smooth RISE and GROW with agents that solve the edge cases and complex processes standard SAP doesn't fit. Our customers are global enterprises. Our route to market runs through around 70 SI and SAP partners globally, as well as direct. We have offices in the USA, UK, India, Australia and New Zealand and a growing virtual team across every time zone. **In this position...** **Deploy agents with partners. Transform the nature of work in SAP estates. Teach partners to do it themselves.** The MyWave Agentic Centre of Excellence (CoE) is a global team of forward deployed engineers. The CoE works with partners and their end customers to deploy MyWave and the agents it generates, then transfers the skills so the partner can build, govern and run agents on their own. This role reports into the Agentic CoE and is a member of a growing virtual team. You will be based in the central to east coast USA and cover the US and EMEA time zones. Your partners are SAP SIs, GSIs and resellers and their customers running SAP ECC, S/4HANA (on\-premise, private and public cloud) and SAP Business One, together with the third\-party systems around them. Deployments range from RISE with SAP and GROW with SAP programmes to on\-premise estates where the customer wants to modernise with agents now rather than wait for migration. You do not need to arrive as an agentic AI expert. You need to arrive as a strong SAP technical consultant or architect who understands how ECC and S/4HANA work under the hood \- APIs, OData, BAPIs, IDocs, BTP \- and who wants to go deep on MCP, A2A and agent generation. We will train you in AI and MyWave. This is a hands\-on role for someone who would rather sit with a partner and get an agent running on a real system than work behind a ticket queue. **What You'll Own...** **Partner enablement and onboarding** * Own the technical onboarding of new partners in your time zones: get MyWave Runtime and MyWave Desktop stood up in their environment, connected to SAP ECC, S/4HANA or SAP Business One through the MyWave MCP servers, and through to their first successful agent run. * Run the partner\-ready checklist by screen share before enablement starts, so every partner arrives at training with a working environment. * Deliver the technical training modules to partner consultants: environment setup, SAP connection, MCP servers and InfoPlugins, A2A, roles, policies and the Supervisor, troubleshooting. Run the hands\-on labs and answer the questions that go beyond the slides. * Be the first point of contact for partner setup and connection issues in your time zones: diagnose, talk the partner through the fix, and hand anything deeper to the CoE and infrastructure teams with a clear write\-up. **Deployment with partners and their customers** * Work alongside partner delivery teams on customer deployments: landscape discovery, agent generation in MyWave Create, connection to the systems of record, roles and authorisations, policies and rules, Supervisor configuration, operating mode (autonomous, human\-in\-the\-loop or mixed) and go\-live. * Deploy in RISE with SAP and GROW with SAP programmes, in hybrid migrate\-faster scenarios, and in on\-premise ECC and S/4HANA estates. * Connect the surrounding estate \- Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday and similar \- through APIs, MCP and A2A, and reason about how data and authorisations flow between systems. * Stay close through first go\-live and protect the reference. **Technical presales support** * Support the Partner Director, Presales and partner sales teams as the technical authority in the room: discovery of the SAP landscape, architecture and security answers, demonstrations on the customer's own processes, and proofs of value. * Scope pilots with partners: environment options, prerequisites, what the agent reads and writes, where governance sits and a realistic timeline. **CoE contribution** * Build reusable assets for the CoE: reference architectures, deployment runbooks, demo agents, MCP and InfoPlugin patterns and Academy content. * Feed what you learn in the field back to Product and Engineering \- patterns partners hit, gaps in documentation and tooling, defects with enough detail to act on. * Sanity\-check each new MyWave Runtime and Desktop release on a typical SAP partner setup before it goes out. Our Test and Quality Lead owns release testing; you are the field check, not the test gate. * Share US and EMEA patterns with CoE colleagues in the other regions. **What Makes You a Great Fit...** **SAP and integration** * 8\+ years as a technical consultant, solution architect or integration lead on SAP ECC and S/4HANA, with the proven ability to learn a new platform fast and go deep on it. * Hands\-on with SAP integration and extension: REST and OData APIs, BAPIs and RFCs, IDocs, SAP BTP (Integration Suite, SAP Build, CAP), authorisations and how data flows between systems. * Exposure to SAP Business AI, Joule and Joule Studio, or the appetite to learn them quickly. * Understanding of RISE with SAP and GROW with SAP \- the migration paths, what changes for the customer and where the gaps and edge cases sit. * Working knowledge of SAP Business One (Service Layer, Web Client, Web Extensions) is a strong plus. If you do not have it, you will need to show us how you would get there quickly. **Technical plumbing** * Comfortable with the plumbing around it: REST APIs and JSON, OAuth, OIDC and SAML SSO, TLS certificates, Docker, Windows and macOS. You can read a config file, follow a log and know what a port conflict looks like. * Understanding of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) or equivalent tool integration. Hands\-on experience is a plus, not a prerequisite \- we will train you. * Able to reason about governance: roles, authorisations, policy boundaries, audit, and what must stay deterministic when writing to a system of record. **People** * Good interpersonal skills. Warm, confident and patient. You can take a partner consultant from a broken install to a running agent without making them feel stupid, and you can hold your own with an SAP architecture team. * Clear written communication. Your write\-ups need to be good enough that a colleague in another time zone can act on them without a call. * Comfortable working in a virtual, multi\-time\-zone team and flexing your hours to cover EMEA mornings and US afternoons. * Based in the central to east coast USA with the right to work, and able to travel to partner sites and industry events in the US and EMEA. **Bonus Points...** * SAP certifications (S/4HANA, BTP, Integration Suite or architecture). * Hands\-on work with LLM tooling \- Azure OpenAI, agent frameworks, MCP servers, A2A. * Experience inside a large SI's SAP practice or an SAP partner, and an existing network in the SAP ecosystem. * Experience with SAP PartnerEdge and the SAP Store. * Exposure to regulated industries and compliance frameworks (SOX, IFRS, GDPR) and how they constrain automation. * Spanish or another European language. **How to Apply** To apply, please email your CV and a brief note describing the most interesting SAP integration or deployment problem you have solved to careers@mywave.ai. Use the job title as the subject line of your email. If you have a recording of yourself demonstrating software or walking through a technical solution, we would also love to see it. Our team moves quickly. The interview process will include a conversation with our Chief Product Officer, a practical session in which you walk us through a customer landscape and how you would deploy an agent into it, and a meeting with the Agentic CoE team. Pay: $98,600\.00 \- $119,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: ***Start with the data pipeline, range across the full stack, and help take a mature, revenue\-earning platform to the next level, with AI at the center of how you build.*** About Northern Light Northern Light provides the world's most sophisticated machine learning\-powered competitive intelligence platform for market research. For over 25 years, we've been helping Fortune 1000 enterprises make smarter, faster, and more informed decisions through our award\-winning SinglePoint knowledge management platform. Our clients include global leaders across technology, pharmaceuticals, telecommunications, and life sciences who depend on us to transform fragmented data into strategic clarity. We're a company that takes pride in our compulsive drive to provide exceptional client support. We wake up each day ready to tackle the challenges of knowledge management and we never stand still. Our recent innovations include generative AI capabilities, machine learning insights, and advanced competitive intelligence automation. The Product: Search Over Content Nobody Else Has Assembled SinglePoint is an enterprise search and market\-intelligence platform. We license content from a large number of publishers and research vendors, combine it with each customer's own internal documents, normalize all of it, enrich it, index it into per\-customer search databases, and serve it through a customer\-specific portal with search, analytics, NLP enrichment, and AI summarization and Q\&A. Our customers are research and strategy teams at large enterprises. When they can't find something, it costs them a decision. The Opportunity Northern Light is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to start in our content pipeline and grow into ownership across the full platform. The pipeline brings in content from well over a hundred vendor feeds, makes it consistent, and makes it searchable for every customer. From there, the whole platform is open to you: services, search, AI features, and the customer portals. It all works, it earns real revenue, and it's ready for its next chapter. We're looking for someone who sees a 25\-year\-old platform as an opportunity, reaches for AI tools by default, and gets genuinely excited about making something proven dramatically better. What You'll Do * Build and maintain ingestion for new vendor feeds and new customers, from the vendor's delivery quirks through to documents appearing in a customer's search results. * Shape how vendor content is transformed into a consistent, reliable format customers can trust. * Migrate legacy pipelines onto the current stack, including an ongoing Perl\-to\-Python effort and a newer move toward containerized, contract\-bound services. * Help replace convention\-driven job scheduling with explicit, durable workflows. * Track down production content problems and fix them at the root. * Bring AI into the pipeline itself, using ML, NLP, LLMs, and AI tooling to classify, enrich, and validate content, and to speed up how we build and migrate. * Work across the full stack, from back\-end services to the customer portals (PHP and React/TypeScript), following problems and ideas all the way from the vendor to what the customer sees. Who We Hire: AI\-First Builders Who Finish What They Start You can take a task that isn't fully specified, go find the missing context yourself, and drive it until it is running in production, verified against the behavior it replaced, and the thing it replaced is switched off. Not “my part is done.” Done. Transforming a mature system takes creativity and energy as much as rigor. We want someone who brings fresh ideas, shares them freely, and makes the people around them better. What We're Looking For * **A track record of delivering production software.** Things you built that real users depend on, and that you kept running. * **Comfort in code you didn't write.** Much of this estate is older than the people working on it. You can read an unfamiliar system, form an accurate model of it, and change it safely. * **Strong data pipeline instincts.** You build pipelines that are reliable and repeatable, and you can prove a new one matches the old one before you cut over. * **Operational comfort.** Containers, CI/CD, and enough production instinct to know whether your change is actually live. * **An AI\-first way of working.** You use AI coding assistants, LLMs, and agents every day, and you have ideas about where they can make a pipeline smarter. * **Collaborative energy.** Small team, big ambitions. You share ideas freely, write down what you learn, and make the people around you better. * **Judgment about scope.** You know when to fix the root cause and when to ship the narrow thing and record the debt. Languages: No Language Requirement What runs here today is mostly Python, Rust, PHP, and React, plus some long\-lived Perl. New backend work is mostly Python and Rust; the portals are PHP and React. We don't require any of these on your résumé. We hire for judgment, for the ability to pick up whatever the problem happens to be written in, and for finishing. If you have been strong in two or three languages, you'll be fine in ours. One honest note: you will read Perl in this job. You don't have to love it. You do have to be willing. Helps, But Not Required * Building with LLMs, embeddings, or AI agents in production * Web crawling and scraping at scale (Scrapy or equivalent) * Search and information retrieval: indexing, relevance, faceting * Durable workflow engines such as Temporal or Airflow * Rust * Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform * PHP * Working with licensed third\-party data feeds Job Details **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Location:** Hybrid in the Boston, MA area, with regular time at our Somerville office, Eastern Time working hours. **Work authorization requirements:** Must be authorized to work in the United States (unfortunately, we cannot sponsor visas). Why Join Northern Light * Join a company shaping the future of competitive and market intelligence. * Work with a collaborative, high\-performing team that values creativity, experimentation, and measurable results. * Put AI at the center of how you build, with the room to bring new ideas into a platform customers already rely on. * Range across the full stack, from vendor feeds to the customer\-facing portals. * Competitive salary, benefits, and professional growth opportunities. * Regular team offsites and opportunities for cross\-functional collaboration. Working at Northern Light Northern Light is based in the Boston, MA area. Northern Light is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Northern Light SinglePoint, LLC participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I\-9 information to confirm employment eligibility for all new hires. For more information, visit www.e\-verify.gov. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview NCS is a leading industrial products, services and technology company whose primary end\-market is car wash operators. NCS provides a full suite of manufactured equipment, installation project services, aftermarket parts and services, chemicals (detergents, protectants, etc.), and software. More specifically with equipment, NCS provides tunnel equipment, IBA (In Bay Automatic), vacuums, dryers, water systems, doors, signage, arches, and related components. NCS also sells a range of brands – on both equipment, chemicals and software today – including Armor All, Rain\-X, Blue Coral, TSS, VacuTech, NCS, AMP, etc. The company sells primarily in N. America, operates 6 manufacturing plants across N. America, and has \~1600\+ employees. The Company operates numerous Distribution Centers and has sales/HQ offices across N. America, with its primary corporate offices in Des Moines, Iowa and Dallas, TX. NCS is currently owned by Berkshire Partners, a leading Boston\-based PE firm **We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not currently able to sponsor work visas.** **POSITION SUMMARY** The Cyber Security Cloud Engineer is the hands\-on engineer responsible for implementing, operating, and maturing security controls across NCS's cloud environment, including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, and the enterprise SaaS platforms that run the business. NCS operates within an established set of NIST\-based enterprise security requirements that define the controls, reporting cadences, and audit expectations for the business. This role implements the security controls that protect our cloud, SaaS, identity, workload, and data environments, and serves as the security lead for integrating newly acquired companies into the NCS security framework. As NCS invests in AI to transform how we serve customers and run the business, this engineer ensures those initiatives are deployed with the required safeguards in place. The engineer also partners with Product Engineering and DevOps teams to put required security controls into practice across the software development lifecycle for NCS products, connected equipment, and customer\-facing platforms. The role works closely with Infrastructure, Networking, Data, Application Development, and business stakeholders, and provides security leadership with clear visibility into control status, gaps, and remediation progress. Success in this role means delivering required controls on schedule, demonstrating their effectiveness, and reducing enterprise risk without slowing the business. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Cloud Security Implementation \& Operations** * Implement and maintain security controls across Azure and AWS in accordance with NCS security requirements and the enterprise security framework, including identity and access management, network segmentation, encryption and key management, logging, and workload protection. * Deploy and operate cloud security posture management (CSPM/CNAPP), infrastructure\-as\-code guardrails, policy\-as\-code, and automated compliance checks that enforce required baselines and provide continuous evidence of control effectiveness. * Operate and tune cloud\-native security services (e.g., Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Entra ID Protection, AWS GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, IAM Access Analyzer) and integrate cloud telemetry into enterprise SIEM detection and response workflows. * Execute detection engineering and incident response for cloud\-hosted and identity\-centric threats, including alert triage, investigation, root cause analysis, containment, and remediation coordination with managed security providers, following established playbooks and escalation paths; track emerging cloud attack techniques and recommend updates to detections, hardening, and response procedures. **Acquisition Integration \& Migration** * Support cybersecurity due diligence for acquisitions by executing technical assessments of target environments and documenting gaps against NCS security requirements to inform prioritized integration plans. * Execute the secure integration and migration of acquired companies onto NCS platforms, including identity consolidation into Microsoft Entra ID, tenant\-to\-tenant Microsoft 365 migrations, workload migrations to Azure and AWS, network and endpoint onboarding, and decommissioning of legacy infrastructure. * Maintain and follow repeatable, documented integration playbooks and security baselines that bring acquired entities to the required jobs.title: Director - Application Development
jobs.description: **About the Company:** Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically\-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross\-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations. Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. ### **I. The Mission** You will lead a world\-class engineering organization responsible for our core Fintech and Banking portfolios. You aren't just a leader; you are a **technical visionary** who ensures our systems are reliable and fast. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and elite engineering execution, pioneering an **AI\-first development culture (AIDLC)** to set a new industry standard for productivity. As the **Director of Application Development**, you will function as a high\-impact technical executive. This role is designed for a technologist who can manage large\-scale portfolios, lead multi\-disciplinary teams (Front\-end \& Back\-end), and navigate the complexities of the **Fintech and Banking** sectors. You are expected to be a "technologist first"\- a leader who can sit in an architectural review or a deep\-dive debugging session and add immediate value, while simultaneously presenting digital transformation roadmaps for your portfolios. The Director of Application Development will serve as a pivotal leader within the Netspend Product \& Technology organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Leader. This highly visible Senior leadership role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in building and scaling consumer products. The Director of Application Development will shape the long\-term technology vision, drive SaaS\-first engineering excellence, and ensure our product's solutions remain the industry benchmark for innovation, reliability, and customer value. This leader will inspire high\-performing global teams and foster strong cross\-functional partnerships. **II. The Core Mandate** ------------------------ **1\. Strategic Technical Leadership \& Stakeholder Management** ---------------------------------------------------------------- * **The Bridge:** Act as the primary interface between business units and engineering. You will translate high\-level commercial objectives into executable technical strategies. * **Portfolio Oversight:** Manage a comprehensive portfolio of applications, ensuring that cross\-functional teams are aligned, unblocked, and delivering high\-value features. * **Agile Transformation:** Lead the evolution of the engineering org into a high\-performing, fast\-paced Agile environment, optimizing for both speed\-to\-market and system stability. **2\. Technical Depth \& Innovation (AIDLC)** * **Hands\-on Guidance:** While not required to write daily production code, you must possess the technical depth of a former Solution Architect or Dev Lead. You will guide teams through complex technical hurdles and ensure code quality standards. * **AI\-Augmented Engineering:** A core focus will be the AIDLC (AI\-driven Development Life Cycle). You will be expected to implement AI tools and frameworks to drastically enhance team productivity and developer experience. * **Cloud Strategy:** Direct the architecture and migration initiatives within the AWS ecosystem, ensuring cost\-efficiency, scalability, and security. * **Move Fast with Stability:** Transition teams into high\-performing, autonomous units that ship code daily without compromising the integrity of financial transactions. * **Metric\-Driven Results:** Define and track KPIs that correlate engineering output with actual business revenue and user engagement. **3\. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Company:** Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically\-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross\-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations. Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. **About the Role** ------------------ We are seeking a hands\-on **Staff Software Engineer** to take ownership of our core card **authorization platform.** This high\-throughput, low\-latency platform processes real\-time debit and prepaid transactions over **ISO 8583** for major networks including Visa, Mastercard, Pulse, and Fiserv. Because every request operates under strict latency budgets, high availability, and PCI DSS compliance, every millisecond counts—and every failure carries direct financial impact. In this role, you will lead a team of talented engineers, drive the architectural evolution of our network connectivity and authorization services, and continue to write production\-grade code. You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for platform upgrades, network certifications, and production incident management. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Technical Leadership \& Team Management** ------------------------------------------- * Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 5–8 software engineers. * Set coding standards, conduct architectural design reviews, perform code reviews, and foster technical excellence. * Serve as the technical owner and primary point of contact for production health, network certifications, and platform upgrades. **Core Architecture \& Engineering** ------------------------------------ * Design, build, and maintain high\-throughput, low\-latency Java/Spring Boot microservices covering authorizations, financial transactions, advices, reversals, and stand\-in processing. * Manage long\-lived client/server TCP connections to card networks, ensuring robust handling of sign\-on/sign\-off, echo tests, request/response matching, and automatic failovers. * Architect distributed transaction boundaries ensuring data consistency across Oracle, Kafka, JMS, and downstream services through idempotency, compensation/saga patterns, and reversal handling. * Implement resilient concurrency models: tune thread pools and executors, control backpressure, execute row\-level/distributed locking, and eliminate race conditions on balances and card states. * Build fault\-tolerant systems using resilience patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, time limiters, retries, and graceful degradation). **Platform Modernization \& Security** -------------------------------------- * Drive platform modernization initiatives, including Spring Boot 2\.7 3\.5 / Jakarta EE migration, removing legacy RMI/JMX remoting, and containerizing microservices for Kubernetes deployment. * Collaborate with Security and HSM teams to integrate EMV cryptogram processing (ARQC), CVV/dCVV/CVC3 validation, and HSM key management. * Maintain strict PCI DSS compliance across all services (PAN masking, sensitive authentication data protection, secure logging, and secrets management). **Operations \& Stakeholder Engagement** ---------------------------------------- * Define SLIs/SLOs and create comprehensive dashboards and alerts using Dynatrace and Splunk. * Lead incident response efforts, drive root\-cause analysis (RCA), and implement permanent remediations. * Partner with Product, Network/Scheme partners, QA, and Operations to navigate card network mandates, network certifications, and release schedules. **Requirements \& Qualifications** ---------------------------------- **Must\-Have Skills \& Experience** ----------------------------------- * **Experience \& Leadership:** 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years leading engineering teams or driving technical architecture. * **Core Java Mastery:** Expert\-level proficiency in Java (11/17\+), deep understanding of java.util.concurrent, JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, and memory analysis. * **Spring Framework:** Extensively hands\-on with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud microservices (Config, OpenFeign, Actuator, Security). * **Distributed Transactions \& Systems:** Proven expertise in transaction management trade\-offs (2PC/XA vs. Saga pattern, outbox pattern, idempotent consumers/producers, and delivery semantics). * **Database \& RDBMS:** Deep relational database skills (Oracle preferred), including JDBC transaction isolation, SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, deadlock analysis, and SQL query tuning. * **Messaging \& Event Streaming:** Real\-world experience with event\-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (Avro, Schema Registry) and/or JMS (ActiveMQ). * **System Resilience:** Hands\-on experience implementing resilience frameworks (Resilience4j or similar) for high\-availability systems running thousands of TPS. * **DevOps \& Quality:** Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/Jenkins), Gradle, static code/security analysis (SonarQube, SAST, Trivy), and test automation frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito). * **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical trade\-offs for engineers, product leads, and executive leadership. **Good\-to\-Have Skills** ------------------------- * **jPOS Framework:** Experience with **ISOMsg,** custom packagers, channels (PostChannel, BaseChannel), **ISOMUX/QMUX, ISOServer,** and Q2 configuration. * **ISO 8583 Specifications:** Hands\-on experience with Visa Base I, Mastercard MIP/Debit, Pulse, or Fiserv STAR/Accel specifications (messages 0100/0110, 0200/0210, 0400/0420, 0800 network management, DE55 EMV TLV data). * **Observability Tools:** Advanced usage of Dynatrace (PurePath, Smartscape, DQL) and Splunk (SPL query generation, alerting, dashboards). * **Advanced Concurrency:** In\-depth familiarity with ReentrantLock, StampedLock, distributed locks (ShedLock, Redisson), Java 21 Virtual Threads, and Micrometer metrics integration. * **Card Payments Domain:** Understanding of EMV chip/contactless flows, stand\-in processing, settlement, chargebacks, HSM integration (Atalla, Thales payShield), and key management (KEK, ZPK, key blocks). * **Infrastructure \& Rules:** Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS (MSK, IAM), and business rules engines (Drools, Jess). **Education** ------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience). * Direct experience in the Payments, Fintech, or Banking domain is strongly preferred. * **10–15 years** of professional experience in designing, coding, developing, and scaling high\-throughput, enterprise\-grade Java/J2EE applications. * **3\+ years** of hands\-on experience in a technical lead or architectural capacity—driving system design, leading 5–8 engineers, and setting coding/quality standards. * **Proven track record** of architecting low\-latency, mission\-critical distributed systems operating under strict SLAs and high concurrency.

jobs.description: About NFF: Since 1996, Networking For Future, Inc. (NFF) has been engineering the backbone of mission\-critical systems for government and enterprise clients. About this Position / Responsibilities: NFF Inc. is seeking staff augmentation resources for software development tasks that span the full operational scope of Metro. MetroAlerts platform (Alerts 3\.0\) is the Authority’s primary customer communications and service alerting system. It distributes real\-time service information through email, text messaging, the Metro website, passenger information systems, and third\-party applications, and integrates with internal and external systems and services including GTFS, GTFS\-Realtime, and OpenTripPlanner (OTP). The resource will participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, implementation, maintenance, and documentation, and will collaborate with business stakeholders, project managers, business analysts, developers, system administrators, and other technical personnel. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Analyze business, functional, and technical requirements to develop and implement software solutions that support operational and customer communication objectives. * Review project specifications, workflow diagrams, process flows, and system documentation to determine application requirements and technical approaches. * Design, develop, modify, test, implement, and maintain software applications, interfaces, integrations, and supporting system components. * Convert business and technical requirements into computer programs, application code, scripts, database objects, and automated processes. * Develop and maintain APIs, data interfaces, integrations, and data exchange processes supporting MetroAlerts and related systems. * Create, modify, and optimize database queries, stored procedures, and data models to support application functionality and performance. * Perform unit testing, integration testing, system testing, and user acceptance support activities to validate software functionality and performance. * Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve software defects, application malfunctions, integration issues, and production incidents. * Monitor application performance and recommend or implement improvements to enhance reliability, scalability, and maintainability. * Support software releases, upgrades, patches, deployments, and application lifecycle management activities. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, system specifications, workflow diagrams, operating proc policies. * Provide production support and technical assistance for MetroAlerts and related applications. * Support application modernization initiatives, technology upgrades, and system enhancement efforts. * Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and provide documentation necessary to support operational continuity and long\-term system maintenance. * Prepare status updates, technical reports, analyses, and recommendations as requested by WMATA management. * Coordinate and collaborate with other technical resources to support project objectives and operational requirements. * Perform other related technical duties necessary to support the successful operation, maintenance, enhancement, and modernization of the MetroAlerts platform and associated systems. * Qualifications: **Required Qualifications and Experience** * **8 years** of professional experience in application development, systems analysis, software programming, application maintenance, or related IT disciplines. * **5 years** of experience developing, modifying, testing, implementing, and supporting enterprise software applications. * **8 years** of experience analyzing business and technical requirements and translating them into effective software solutions. * **8 years** of experience troubleshooting and resolving software defects, application issues, and system performance problems. * **8 years** of experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, workflow diagrams, system specifications, and user support materials. * **8 years** of experience working with software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. * **8 years** of experience with one or more programming languages, such as Java, C\#, .NET, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent modern development technologies. * **8 years** of experience developing and supporting web\-based and enterprise applications. * **5 years** of experience working with SQL and relational database management systems. * **5 years** of experience developing, supporting, or integrating APIs, web services, and system interfaces. * **5 years** of experience using source code repositories and version control tools, such as Git or similar technologies. * **5 years** of experience performing application testing, debugging, issue resolution, and performance optimization. * **5 years** of experience implementing and supporting secure application development practices. * **A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, information systems, engineering, or a related discipline**. **Desired Qualifications and Experience** * **3 years** of experience supporting transit, transportation, public sector, or government organizations. * **3 years** of experience supporting applications that utilize GraphQL, OpenTripPlanner (OTP), General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS), GTFS\-Realtime (GTFS\-RT), and related transit technologies. * **5 years** of experience working in Agile, Scrum, DevSecOps, or continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) environments. * **5 years** of experience working with Microsoft Azure cloud technologies. * **5 years** of experience supporting application modernization, systems integration, and enterprise technology initiatives. * Industry certifications related to software development, cloud technologies, Agile methodologies, or system administration. NFF Disclosures: NFF offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits and flexible paid time off options, for eligible employees: * Medical, Dental and Vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account * STD, LTD, Supplemental life insurance and ADD\&D * Comprehensive 401k plan * Paid Time Off ***NFF is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** ***Important Notice: All NFF Inc communications come from @nffinc.com. Emails from other domains claiming to be NFF are likely scams. Be cautious, verify senders, and report suspicious messages immediately.***
