jobs.title: Principal Systems Engineer, Signal-Path Performance & Modeling
jobs.description: **About Neurophos** =================== The demand for new data centers and AI compute is rapidly outpacing the planet's energy capacity. Digital solutions are hitting a power wall as we approach the physical limits of traditional silicon. Conquering this bottleneck means rethinking the fundamental architecture of inference compute. The industry's current path can't meet the need, so we're taking a different approach. Instead of traditional electronic circuits, we use silicon photonics and an active, programmable metasurface to perform matrix multiplications at the speed of light. Our optical cells are 10,000x smaller than traditional photonic components, enabling unprecedented density. By using photonics instead of electricity, our chips become more efficient as they scale. This architecture will deliver up to 100 times the energy efficiency of existing solutions while significantly improving performance for large\-scale AI inference. We’ve assembled a world\-class team of industry veterans and recently raised a $110M Series A led by Gates Frontier. Participants include M12 (Microsoft’s Venture Fund), Carbon Direct Capital, Aramco Ventures, Bosch Ventures, Tectonic Ventures, Space Capital, and others. Join us and shape the future of computing! **Location:** Austin, TX. Full\-time onsite position. **Reports To:** Chief Systems Engineer **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Position Overview** --------------------- We are seeking a highly skilled Systems Engineer to own the quantitative, end\-to\-end performance model of our optical vector\-matrix multiplication (OVMM) engine. This role is the technical center of Systems Engineering's performance\-modeling focus area: you will lead the end\-to\-end modeling, analysis, and architectural definition of high\-speed communication and signal\-processing systems. In this role, you will build and maintain the link and power budgets; quantify impairments and non\-idealities across the optical, analog, and digital domains; develop mathematical and behavioral models; define the hardware and algorithmic techniques required to meet aggressive system\-level performance targets; and determine how accuracy, throughput, and power trade against one another as the architecture evolves. You will spend most of your time running system\-level simulations and translating them into defensible allocations the rest of the organization can design against. If you have deep communication\-theory and signal\-processing intuition, are fluent in turning a signal chain into a quantitative model, and want to be the person who can answer "where does the system actually lose its margin," this role will let you define the performance envelope of a first\-of\-its\-kind computing platform. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Primary Responsibilities** * **Signal\-Path Architecture Ownership:** Own and define the architecture of the high\-speed communication and signal\-processing system that converts the digital data stream into an optical signal and back—spanning digital signal processing, D/A and A/D conversion, and the analog/optical signal conditioning surrounding them on both the transmit and receive sides. Define the blocks and processing stages that comprise this system and specify the requirements for each. Negotiate block\-level requirements with the photonic and mixed\-signal implementation teams who build to this architecture. * **Link \& Power Budget Ownership:** Own and maintain the end\-to\-end optical and electrical link/power budget for this signal path, keeping it synchronized with the as\-designed and as\-measured hardware as the architecture evolves. * **Signal\-Path Modeling:** Build and maintain the reference behavioral model of the full TX–channel–RX signal path, capturing optical, analog, quantization, and algorithmic effects with the fidelity needed for architecture decisions and requirements allocation. * **Accuracy \& Performance Allocation:** Allocate NMSE/SNR/SNDR targets across optics, analog, quantization, and algorithmic domains, and update those allocations as component and architecture choices change. * **Impairment Analysis:** Characterize and model optical, analog, and digital impairments—noise, distortion, jitter, quantization effects, crosstalk, mismatch, and nonlinearity—and quantify their impact on system\-level accuracy. * **Throughput \& Efficiency Trade Studies:** Analyze the impact of TX/RX channel configurations and architectural options on TOPS, TOPS/W, and latency. Balance the complexity, risk, and time\-to\-market of proposed architectural solutions. * **Monte Carlo \& Time\-Domain Simulation:** Develop and run statistical (Monte Carlo, corner) and time\-domain simulations to quantify design margin and manufacturing robustness. * **Model\-to\-Measurement Correlation:** Correlate model predictions with laboratory and silicon measurements; when measured performance does not match simulation, isolate the source of the discrepancy and refine the architecture, model, and allocations accordingly. **Secondary Responsibilities** * Represent this system's architecture in roadmap and planning discussions. * Supply quantitative performance data, both predicted and measured, to support other efforts across Neurophos (e.g., customer\-facing technical discussions). * Support calibration accuracy\-budget definition with sensitivity analysis. * Collaborate with analog, photonic, digital, and software engineers to keep subsystem designs consistent with the architecture and its performance targets. * Mentor engineers in system modeling, communication theory, and architecture/trade\-study methodology. * Contribute to intellectual property creation, including invention disclosures and patents. **Qualifications** ------------------ * **Degree:** MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a closely related field, with emphasis on communication theory, signal processing, or mixed\-signal systems. * **Experience:** 7\+ years of professional experience in communication systems architecture, link\-budget/signal\-chain modeling, or performance modeling of optical or high\-speed electrical communication systems. Demonstrated ownership of system architecture definition is highly preferred. Time spent pursuing a PhD beyond the MS counts toward the years of experience above. * **Communication Theory \& Signal Processing:** Deep knowledge of modulation formats, equalization, synchronization and estimation, quantization effects, and coding\-gain concepts, and how each factors into an end\-to\-end performance budget. * **System Modeling:** Expert\-level proficiency in Python (NumPy/SciPy) and/or MATLAB/Simulink for behavioral modeling, Monte Carlo simulation, and statistical/time\-domain analysis. * **Link Budget \& Noise Analysis:** Experience with optical or high\-speed electrical link budgets, including the ability to allocate impairments across components and predict the system\-level impact. * **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication, with the credibility to negotiate requirements with implementation teams and to defend an architectural position to technical leadership. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- * Experience with coherent or direct\-detection architectures, or high\-speed SerDes/networking standards (Ethernet, PCIe, OIF\-CEI). * System\-level modeling of high\-speed data converters (ADC/DAC), including quantization, sampling, and multi\-device synchronization effects. * Familiarity with Cadence Virtuoso and Spectre sufficient to validate behavioral models against circuit\-level simulation. * Hands\-on laboratory characterization or silicon/system bring\-up experience. * Familiarity with photonic integrated circuits, silicon photonics, or optical transceiver systems. * Experience carrying a signal\-path architecture across multiple product generations. **What We Offer** ================= This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in an innovative startup redefining the future of AI hardware. Work on game\-changing technology at the intersection of photonics and AI as part of a collaborative, brilliant team. You’ll contribute to a platform that redefines computational performance and accelerates the future of artificial intelligence. Come help us bring this transformative technology to the world. **Benefits** ------------ Join a team that invests in your future and your well\-being. At Neurophos, we offer: * 100% coverage of base health plan premiums for you and your dependents, plus HSA contributions. * Unlimited PTO. No rigid vacation banks, just a focus on delivery. * 401(k) matching and stock option opportunities to ensure our success is your success. * Full suite of voluntary benefits, including Dental, Vision, Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, and Accident insurance. * Personalized Benefits. Choose the plans that fit your life and take the cash back for those that don’t. Compensation Range: $245K \- $285K

Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable qualified individuals to perform essential job functions. * **Who We are:** At New Charter, we’re building a caliber of business the IT industry hasn’t yet seen. Our partner companies have career paths for many different role types, whether you want to be deeply technical or whiteboarding with clients, and we are committed to developing fulfilling career paths for all contributors at New Charter. ( *Please note: Every application submitted through Workday is reviewed by a real person, not an AI. jobs.title: Low Voltage Design Engineer- Data Center
jobs.description: Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Data Center Infrastructure Engineer to support the planning, design, and delivery of telecommunications and physical IT infrastructure for new construction projects, facility expansions, and existing infrastructure upgrades. This position works closely with facilities teams, architects, construction partners, and technology stakeholders to ensure that network rooms, structured cabling systems, equipment spaces, and supporting infrastructure are designed and delivered according to established engineering standards. The ideal candidate combines strong telecommunications design knowledge with practical experience supporting construction projects, reviewing technical documentation, coordinating vendors, and validating completed infrastructure. What You Will DoInfrastructure Planning and Design * Translate business and technology requirements into practical telecommunications infrastructure designs for new facilities and existing buildings. * Evaluate network room layouts, equipment locations, rack arrangements, cable pathways, fibre distribution, and copper cabling requirements. * Review construction drawings and provide technical recommendations, redlines, and design corrections. * Establish requirements for cable containment, grounding, bonding, fire\-stopping, labelling, and infrastructure testing. * Ensure proposed designs align with TIA\-942, applicable TIA standards, BICSI practices, and relevant building codes. Construction Coordination and Technical Oversight * Partner with facilities, construction management, electrical teams, and low\-voltage contractors throughout project execution. * Review contractor submittals, technical proposals, installation plans, RFIs, and proposed scope changes. * Develop material estimates, Bills of Materials (BOMs), preliminary cost estimates, and project documentation. * Monitor construction progress through onsite inspections and technical reviews. * Identify design discrepancies, workmanship issues, and project risks, and coordinate corrective actions with responsible contractors. * Track project milestones and help ensure infrastructure work meets approved specifications and delivery schedules. Infrastructure Validation and Project Closeout * Review fibre and copper cable testing results and verify that completed work meets acceptance requirements. * Coordinate defect resolution, punch\-list completion, and final infrastructure acceptance. * Maintain accurate records of as\-built drawings, equipment layouts, cable schedules, test results, and warranty documentation. * Support operational handover by ensuring infrastructure information is recorded in CMDB, NetBox, Nautobot, or equivalent inventory platforms. * Recommend improvements to engineering standards and construction delivery processes based on project findings. Capacity and Lifecycle Support * Assess rack capacity, available ports, fibre strand utilization, cable pathways, power distribution, and available equipment space. * Identify infrastructure limitations before they affect upcoming deployments. * Support cable plant upgrades, network room expansions, rack replacements, and other infrastructure lifecycle projects. * Assist with infrastructure risk assessments and planning for scheduled power shutdowns or maintenance activities. Required Experience and Skills * Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in telecommunications infrastructure, low\-voltage engineering, structured cabling design, or IT infrastructure construction. * Mandatory working knowledge of TIA\-942 and its application to data center infrastructure. * Strong understanding of TIA\-568, TIA\-569, TIA\-606, TIA\-607, and BICSI industry practices. * Experience with fibre optic and copper cabling systems, pathways, cable trays, racks, grounding, bonding, and network room infrastructure. * Ability to interpret and mark up architectural, electrical, and telecommunications drawings. * Working experience with AutoCAD, Bluebeam, Revit, or comparable drawing review tools. * Proven ability to coordinate low\-voltage contractors, construction vendors, and cross\-functional project teams. * Familiarity with technical specifications, material estimates, quality inspections, testing documentation, and construction closeout. * Strong communication, documentation, coordination, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work onsite in Santa Clara, California. Preferred Qualifications * RCDD certification or equivalent telecommunications design experience. **RCDD certification is not mandatory.** * Experience supporting ground\-up construction, commercial building deployments, large campus expansions, or data center fit\-outs. * BICSI credentials such as DCDC, OSP, or RTPM, or PMP certification. * Familiarity with CMDB, DCIM, NetBox, Nautobot, or infrastructure capacity reporting tools. * Experience in large enterprise technology, laboratory, cleanroom, or high\-density computing environments. Important Requirements * At least basic TIA\-942 knowledge is required. * This is an onsite position in Santa Clara, CA. * The role emphasizes infrastructure engineering, design review, and construction coordination rather than hands\-on cable installation. Candidates with a background in telecommunications design, structured cabling programs, data center infrastructure, or low\-voltage construction engineering are encouraged to apply. Pay: $50\.00 \- $52\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.description: Come build at the intersection of AI and fintech. At Ocrolus, we’re on a mission to help lenders automate workflows with confidence—streamlining how financial institutions evaluate borrowers and enabling faster, more accurate lending decisions. Our AI workflow and analytics platform for lenders is trusted at scale, processing nearly one million credit applications every month across small business, mortgage, and consumer lending. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human** Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. **The Principal Software Engineer Opportunity** The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co\-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000\+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company. You will build the harnesses and evaluations that make these workers reliable. They investigate risk, use tools, wait for approvals and complete tasks across enterprise systems. Bring depth in agent execution or model quality and help turn it into working software customers can trust. **About You** *Production builder*: You have shipped AI software and know what changes when real users depend on it. *Careful evaluator*: You investigate failures and use evidence to judge quality. *Strong owner:* You follow an improvement through code, evaluation, release and customer use. **What you will be doing** * Build the agent harness for planning, tool use, memory, context compaction, interruption and recovery during long\-running work. * Integrate OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs. Select models using measured quality, latency and cost, with clear failure handling. * Evaluate existing harnesses and build only the missing pieces. Keep the harness connected to AWS workflow execution and approval state. * Keep authorization and sensitive writes behind application policy checks. Require evidence of the resulting state before marking work complete. * Build evaluation datasets and replay tests for valid findings, access decisions, app setup and AI agent onboarding. * Measure false positives, missed risks, unsafe actions, completion rate and cost. Turn production failures into regression tests. * Test prompt injection, stale evidence, conflicting instructions and unsafe tool use. Protect tenant boundaries in retrieval and memory. * Improve prompts, retrieval, tools and model routing. Evaluate fine\-tuning or other post\-training methods when results justify them and data use is approved. **What you will bring to the role** * Strong Python engineering skills and experience shipping an LLM application that uses tools. * Hands\-on experience building agent workflows or evaluation systems for tool\-using LLM applications. For harness work, relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a custom implementation. * Experience integrating model APIs, structured outputs and asynchronous services. Experience with OpenAI or Anthropic is especially relevant. * Depth in agent execution or evaluation systems, with working code and failure analysis you can explain. * Ability to distinguish a plausible model response from a supported finding or verified action. **Scope by level** Principal: Set product engineering direction across workflows and implement the shared components that help the team ship faster. **Our stack** Our core stack is Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS and pgvector. OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs are part of the integration plan. We plan to add an agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery. The harness choice is open. Experience with equivalent tools also counts. **And extra credit for** * Open\-source contributions, agent observability, security evaluations or synthetic evaluation data. * Fine\-tuning, preference data, post\-training evaluation or model distillation using approved datasets. * Identity and security workflows. Foundation\-model research experience is optional. P26074 \#LI\-Inperson \#LI\- BB1 **The Okta Experience** * Supporting Your Well\-Being * Driving Social Impact * Developing Talent and Fostering Connection \+ Community We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in\-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one. Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, or status as a protected veteran. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and convictions records, consistent with applicable laws. If reasonable accommodation is needed to complete any part of the job application, interview process, or onboarding please use this Form to request an accommodation. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: Olive Systems partners with fast\-growing AI and technology companies across the United States to help them build and scale their engineering teams. We’re looking for experienced **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)** who can bridge the gap between complex customer challenges and real\-world technical solutions. Rather than hiring for a single position, we’re building a network of strong engineers interested in working with innovative startups and technology companies. Based on your technical background, experience, and career preferences, we’ll connect you with relevant opportunities across our partner companies. **This is not an internal engineering position at Olive Systems.** **What You’ll Do** As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work closely with customers and engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, often without predefined requirements. Your responsibilities may include: * Working directly with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into technical solutions. * Designing, developing, and deploying production\-ready applications and systems. * Building prototypes and turning successful concepts into scalable products. * Working across backend, frontend, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data, and AI technologies. * Making architectural and technical decisions independently. * Collaborating with founders, product managers, and engineering teams. * Identifying opportunities to turn custom solutions into reusable product capabilities. * Taking full ownership of technical solutions, from initial discovery through production deployment. **Who We’re Looking For** We’re interested in engineers who combine strong technical expertise with product thinking, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. You might currently be a: * Forward Deployed Engineer * Senior / Staff Full\-Stack Engineer * Founding Engineer or Technical Founder * AI / Applied AI Engineer * Solutions Architect with hands\-on development experience * Senior Software Engineer with end\-to\-end product ownership **What matters most:** * Strong hands\-on software engineering experience. * Proven track record of building and shipping production systems. * Ability to take ownership of complex technical challenges from start to finish. * Experience designing software architecture and making technical trade\-offs. * Confidence working with ambiguous or evolving requirements. * Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to move quickly from problem discovery to implementation. **Nice to Have:** * Experience building AI\-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, or AI agents. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. * Background in early\-stage startups or fast\-paced product environments. * Previous experience working directly with enterprise customers. * Experience developing MVPs, prototypes, or custom integrations. **Our Hiring Process** **1\. Initial Technical Evaluation** We’ll invite you to a short AI\-powered interview focused on your real engineering experience. We’ll explore systems you’ve built, architectural decisions, technical challenges, and how you approach solving complex problems. No algorithm puzzles or generic coding questions. **2\. Conversation with Olive Systems** We’ll discuss your professional background, career goals, compensation expectations, preferred working environment, and availability. **3\. Introduction to Relevant Opportunities** When we identify a suitable opportunity, we’ll introduce you to the company and coordinate the next steps. Depending on the company, additional technical interviews or assessments may be required. **Location \& Work Setup** We work with technology companies hiring across the **United States**. Opportunities may be fully remote, hybrid, or onsite, depending on the company. Specific location, compensation, employment arrangements, and work authorization or sponsorship requirements vary by opportunity. **Why Join Our Network?** Instead of applying to multiple companies individually, you can complete our initial evaluation once and be considered for relevant opportunities as they become available. Our goal is to connect experienced engineers with companies where their technical expertise, problem\-solving abilities, and career ambitions are a strong match. **Interested?** Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile. If your experience aligns with what our partner companies are looking for, we’ll contact you with the next steps. Pay: $160,000\.00 \- $220,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Flexible schedule * Paid time off Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Manager, Software Development
jobs.description: As Manager, Software Development, you’ll be the hands\-on leader of OnLogic’s software development strategy and a global team of about 10 engineers who build applications our business and customers run on. You’ll set how the team builds with AI, from coding tools to agentic systems, and be the leader engineers learn from. You’ll ensure our team of software developers can achieve their highest potential, raising the bar on speed and quality while delivering measurable business results. We believe in the power of in\-person collaboration and the benefits of a strong workplace community. As a member of our IT leadership team, this role requires an onsite presence at our South Burlington, VT or Cary, NC office. We encourage candidates who are able to relocate or comfortably commute to apply. **In this role, you’ll be responsible for:** * Setting the software development strategy for OnLogic’s internal and customer\-facing applications. * Leading a high\-performing team that plans against real capacity and delivers measurable business results on its commitments. * Increasing delivery speed while maintaining quality, using deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate and time to restore service to find and remove friction and blockers. * Leading the team’s adoption of AI coding tools and agentic systems, with reusable patterns, and reviewing standards for AI\-generated code and automation of repetitive work. * Keeping business\-critical and customer\-facing applications stable and secure through strong release practices, monitoring and technical debt reduction. * Developing each engineer through clear goals and regular coaching, and building a culture of trust, accountability and direct feedback. * Raising code quality and maintainability through design and code reviews, clear standards, architecture guidance and hands\-on coding when needed. * Aligning priorities and tradeoffs with business owners, and representing software development in IT leadership decisions. **The team you will be joining:** Our Information Technology team touches every aspect of our business and each of our day to day lives here at OnLogic. Made up of software developers, infrastructure and security experts, systems and network engineers and business technology professionals, our IT team is constantly working to improve our internal systems to make our lives easier, while optimizing our website to do the same for our customers. From the technology we use to do our jobs, to the infrastructure that supports the way we build, test and ship our products, our IT team keeps our business running smoothly. * Learn more about Life at OnLogic. **Requirements** * You have a Bachelor's degree in business, computer engineering or other technical field, or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years of experience in software development with at least 4 years of experience managing and growing a team of 6 or more developers. * Hands\-on experience building with AI coding tools and agentic systems. Experience building platforms and guardrails for team\-wide agentic AI deployment, preferred. * Experience owning multiple production applications the business depends on, including release management, monitoring and incident response. * Strong command of modern engineering practices: continuous integration and delivery, automated testing, code review and version control (Git). * Ability to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship, now and in the future. **Who we're looking for:** * A leader who measures success by team results delivered with quality, not personal output. * A coach who gets energy from helping engineers grow. * A builder who still enjoys code and keeps current on AI by using it daily. * A problem solver who turns complex, unclear work into clear plans. * An organized leader who keeps several priorities moving and meets deadlines. * A direct communicator who raises problems early and welcomes pushback. * A partner who explains technical tradeoffs in plain business terms. * Someone who understands how software runs on real systems, from operating systems to infrastructure, and wants to build it at a hardware company. **Who we are:** OnLogic employees have the opportunity to shape our future and drive impactful change. We design and manufacture specialized edge computing solutions for companies all over the world, helping them to make the seemingly impossible possible. Our computers are designed to work where others fail, and it's our vision to be the first choice in edge computing. To make that vision a reality, we've built a team of ambitious problem solvers, guided by the company's core values of Open, Fair, Innovative, and Independent. We have an open office, open salaries, and strive to be fair and transparent in our decision making. We encourage input and feedback from every member of our team and look to improve ourselves and our business every single day. Diversity is an essential element of our core values. Not just respecting, but actively embracing a variety of backgrounds, life experiences, and opinions, helps us foster innovation, enhances our problem\-solving capabilities, and promotes learning and engagement among the members of our team. We strongly encourage those with diverse backgrounds to apply. We are committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and harassment\-free workplace for all employees. We do not tolerate any form of harassment, discrimination, or bias based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic. To learn more about our values, our mission and what it's like to work at OnLogic, visit www.onlogic.com/careers. **Benefits** The salary range for this role is $170,000 to $200,000\. We determine final compensation based on discussions with applicants and their experience in similar roles. * A competitive Salary based upon your experience and the requirements of the role * A comprehensive Benefits package * 401k Plan with 3% Employer Contribution * An Annual Profit Share Bonus * Paid Maternity \& Paternity Leave, and Short \& Long Term Disability * A personal development plan created to help you (and us) grow \#LI\-AC1 \#LI\-Onsite

jobs.title: Salesforce Project Analyst
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ At Onterris, we build careers grounded in purpose, responsibility and real\-world impact. “For Planet and Progress” is our north star that guides everything we do. We believe environmental responsibility and human progress are interconnected, interwoven and international. Our scientists, engineers, field teams, consultants and professionals collaborate across disciplines and geographies, guiding industries and governments, ensuring that communities and environments thrive. When you join us, you’re not just forging a career, you’re joining a movement. A movement for better thinking, smarter solutions and lasting impact. Together, we will advance our way of life and protect the integrity of our environment every step of the way. **A Day in the Life** ===================== The **Salesforce Project Analyst** will be responsible for user support and administration within our Salesforce instance and supporting systems. Onboarding/offboarding, ticket\-based request support, report generation, user training, and data integrity are all primary areas of focus. This also includes front line support for Onterris employees using Salesforce, which involves responding to troubleshooting requests and questions within our ticket system. You’ll need at least 2 years of experience in supporting a CRM system, and welcome the opportunity to make an impact from day one. The compensation range for this role is $75,000 \- $85,000 USD commensurate with experience, skills, and geographic location To thrive in this role, you’ll be comfortable taking ownership of the following responsibilities: * Providing in\-person and/or remote support to end users for Salesforce and related systems. * Assisting with onboarding / offboarding tasks in relation to day\-to\-day operations, as well as during new company acquisitions. * Performing system administration, including maintaining and updating back\-end configurations and Flow automation. * Preparing and uploading CSV files for data imports when requested by users or during new company acquisitions. * Coordinating with developers to communicate and roll\-out system updates. * Providing and assisting with Salesforce training remotely. * Creating and updating recorded and written training materials for company’s internal knowledge database. * Participating in system upgrades, integration and/or testing of new functionality as requested. * Performing diagnosis and troubleshooting support for Salesforce users companywide through the help desk ticketing system. * Exercising safe work practices by following all company safety rules and OSHA regulations, including attendance at all required safety training programs. * Participating in company’s continuous improvement programs and provide support to team efforts. * Keeping up\-to\-date and current on industry trends by completing formal training, reviewing professional publications, and attending professional workshops. Performing other duties as assigned. * **Your Expertise and Skills** ============================= These requirements reflect the knowledge, skills and abilities that help you do your best work here. * Associates Degree or higher from an accredited university * Salesforce Platform Administrator I certification * 2\-5 years of experience with Salesforce or other CRM systems * Demonstrated ability to work remotely and with limited required supervision * Ability to work as part of the team and independently * Ability to learn and teach various software to other users * Proficient with Microsoft Office software and/or PC programs * Demonstrated customer service experience * Ability to meet deadlines, multitask, and prioritize as necessary * Ability to interface with cross\-functional teams and all levels of personnel/management * Strong problem solving and analytical skills * Solid organization and time management skills * Effective verbal and written communication skills * Ability to work independently, managing multiple responsibilities (i.e. self\-starter, self\-motivated) Preferred * Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Pardot. * Experience in software development or writing custom code for SaaS systems. * Experience with advanced Microsoft Excel functions (i.e. V\-lookup, pivot tables, etc.) Onterris is a leading global environmental solutions company partnering with organizations to solve complex challenges where environmental pressures, regulatory expectations and operational risks intersect. Guided by our mission to advance the way of life without compromising the integrity of our environment, we believe environmental responsibility and human progress are fundamentally connected. Our scientists, engineers, field teams and consultants apply systems thinking that unites science, data and practical expertise to deliver solutions that strengthen our clients’ resilience, mitigate risk and protect the air, water and soil that sustain communities, while uncovering responsible paths forward for planet and progress. For more information, visit www.onterris.com . We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. We acknowledge that these experiences and perspectives help to enrich our teams and contribute to our ongoing success. We are committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our employment for all applicants. For US residents, click here to learn more.

jobs.title: Power Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description:** Open Energy Solutions Inc. (OES) is an early\-stage services and software development company that is enabling utilities and utility vendors to enhance power system operations through the development and implementation of distributed intelligence and enabling technologies. OES is modernizing the electric grid through real‑time simulation, advanced distribution modeling, and cutting‑edge DER integration. **Role Description:** OES is seeking a Power Systems Engineer to bring technical skills and utility\-industry expertise to operational technology projects. OES’ primary functions are around technology solution development and utility consulting services, and this individual will play an instrumental role on a multidisciplinary team of IT/communications specialists, developers, electricians, and project managers, providing technical expertise and industry acumen. This role sits at the intersection of research and practical field application, offering a rare opportunity to be a valuable contributor in cutting\-edge power systems work deployed in real utility environments. In the role, the candidate is expected to wear several hats: technical solution designer, client subject matter advisor, power systems analyst, and modeling/simulation engineer. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com. **About the Role** ------------------ Community Intelligence is a new engineering team at OpenGov, based in our Boston office, chartered with bringing next\-generation physical\-world sensing and AI\-based detection into our Community Operations suite. Rather than treating sensing as an external add\-on, this team builds the pipeline and integration layer that make it a native, foundational capability across our products. As a founding Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will design and build the systems that turn raw sensor data into structured records, condition assessments, and automated workflows across multiple products. You will make real technical calls with incomplete information, evaluating emerging sensing technologies, reconciling third\-party data against our own systems, and sequencing a rollout across a multi\-product suite. You will also set patterns the rest of the team builds on. AI\-native tooling is expected to be embedded in your workflow. **What You'll Own** ------------------- * Design and build the sensing\-platform connector/adapter layer that maps LiDAR\- and imagery\-derived asset detections into OpenGov Products * Architect the automated detection\-to\-case pipeline that turns a sensing detection into a properly routed record in the right product's workflow engine, complete with photo evidence, GPS coordinates, and a severity score. * Evaluate, integrate, or build the computer\-vision and LiDAR\-fusion models this requires, including the technical path for consolidating with or extending EAM's existing Vision AI microservice (rd\-capture). * Design the data model and storage layer for a continuously updated spatial data that all five Community Operations products read from and contribute to. * Own the technical design for a tiered sensing\-ingestion model (satellite, fleet\-vehicle camera, full LiDAR survey) supporting different refresh cadences, accuracy levels, and price points. * Partner with engineering and product leads across OpenGov products to sequence the sensing layer's roadmap against each product's asset taxonomy and compliance requirements. * Write clear technical design docs that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit. * Establish testing, monitoring, and data\-quality standards appropriate to a system whose outputs feed regulatory and safety\-relevant workflows, including ADA compliance and FEMA reimbursement documentation. **Qualifications \& Preferred Experience** ------------------------------------------ * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross\-system integrations end\-to\-end in a production SaaS environment. * Experience building or integrating computer\-vision, LiDAR, or geospatial data\-processing pipelines; comfort with point\-cloud or 3D spatial data is a strong plus. * Strong data\-modeling and API/connector design skills, able to reconcile a third party's data schema against multiple existing internal data models without resorting to one\-off custom logic. * Experience with geospatial systems (PostGIS, spatial indexing, coordinate reference systems) preferred. * Comfortable operating with incomplete information and ambiguous vendor integration paths; makes and defends build\-vs\-integrate calls. * Experience partnering across multiple product teams and translating a strategic technical vision into a scoped, sequenced delivery plan. * A track record of shipping systems where data accuracy carries real compliance or safety consequences (regulatory, infrastructure, or public\-sector systems) is a strong plus. * Proficient in AI\-native engineering workflows: can direct AI tooling for scaffolding, test generation, and code review while retaining ownership of architecture and correctness. * Excellent written communication; can produce technical design docs that align stakeholders across five product teams. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **How This Level Is Differentiated** ------------------------------------ The following competency behaviors distinguish this level from adjacent ones: * Owns a technical domain end\-to\-end with full accountability for outcomes, from architecture through production operation. * Operates with strategic awareness across multiple downstream product teams; makes strong technical calls with incomplete vendor and data information. * Sets technical direction and milestones for the sensing\-integration roadmap; influences cross\-functional partners without formal authority. * Establishes patterns, like the connector/adapter approach, that other engineers and products reuse, elevating the work of the broader team. * Expected to embed AI\-native tooling in their own workflow and model its effective use for teammates joining the team. **Why OpenGov?** ================ **A Mission That Matters.** At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy. **Opportunity to Innovate** The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started. **A Team of Passionate, Driven People** This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune. **A Place to Make Your Mark** We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within. **Benefits That Work for You** Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including: * Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families * Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays * 401(k) with company match * Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions * Professional development and growth opportunities * A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches. Compensation Range: $205K \- $227K

Our teams develop cutting\-edge solutions that help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. From advanced data analytics and AI to cybersecurity, we use innovative approaches to solve some of health care's most complex challenges. Your contributions here have the potential to change lives. Ready to build the next breakthrough? Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people\-led, responsible AI while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** Lead the dedicated team that makes enterprise data usable across AI platforms. Within Optum Technology's Integrated AI \& Automation / AI Engineering team, you will own the end\-to\-end pipeline from intake through build and enablement, administration, troubleshooting and operations for Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI, Anthropic and Google integrations. Scope includes plugins, connectors, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and, where approved, skills artifacts. The role combines people leadership with technical quality, repeatable onboarding and reliable service. You will partner with product and business leaders to align capacity and priorities, and with Architecture, Security, Legal, Privacy, identity teams and source owners to deliver approved, supportable integrations. Your focus is building a solid team and a sustainable engineering service; project managers coordinate delivery execution, while developers own hands\-on implementation. You ensure review evidence and readiness criteria are met without overriding the authority of control or approval functions. You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Recruit, coach and develop a balanced team of connector engineers, platform administrators and troubleshooters across employees and contractors as appropriate; set clear expectations, provide actionable feedback and build collaborative ownership and sound engineering judgment * Translate business demand into a realistic engineering portfolio with product and business leaders, incorporating CIO priority input and balancing new delivery, maintenance, risk reduction and team capacity * Establish auditable intake and scoping with sponsors and source owners, capturing access, feasibility, acceptance criteria and retrievable review evidence rather than ad hoc pings or uploads. Record required approval/catalog identifiers, including AID where applicable. Coordinate catalog, hosting, IAM and network dependencies with AI Catalog, cloud/platform, identity and network owners, who retain their control authority. Help these owners define evolving custom\-agent/MCP processes * Own technical quality through design and custom\-code review, reusable patterns, testing and documentation. Validate platform\-specific packages, including manifests, contracts and skill/instruction files, and distinguish approved artifacts from unauthorized uploads through approval/catalog provenance. * Use approved development, test and production environments and least\-privilege controls to prevent direct production creation or deployment that bypasses review * Ensure Architecture, Security, Legal and Privacy reviews have complete evidence; coordinate AIRB and ESRO reviews as applicable and track required decisions before release * Guide secure configuration with AI administrators, identity and access management (IAM) teams and source teams, covering Entra app registrations, delegated OAuth, gateways, manifests, admin registration and approved API permissions * Require sandbox and staging validation of authentication, retrieval, access mapping, synchronization and performance, with traceable results and resolved issues before production progression * Be accountable for connector operations and incident response, including monitoring, alerts, recovery, support\-group ownership, access and onboarding processes, change controls and audit evidence * Ensure controlled pilots, Limited Availability and General Availability have explicit readiness criteria, approved users, required controls and completed launch decisions, including ESRO gating where applicable * Build effective vendor and platform partnerships, manage technical dependencies and evolving capabilities, and coordinate with source teams when service issues or platform changes affect integrations. Escalate complex configuration or diagnostic issues to qualified vendor technical experts as needed * Use delivery, reliability and adoption evidence to improve engineering practices; ensure training, communications and user feedback inform releases while project managers maintain execution plans and coordination You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge y  an engineering team, including hiring, coaching, performance management and capacity planning for a portfolio of integration work * 5\+ years of experience delivering enterprise AI integrations, connectors, plugins or API\-based services, with the judgment to evaluate designs and establish reusable engineering standards * Working knowledge of Python or Java sufficient to assess implementation quality, guide technical trade\-offs and coach developers; integration delivery expertise is the primary technical requirement * Platform\-administration and diagnostic depth sufficient to lead a multi\-platform integration service: hands\-on configuration, OAuth authorization/token endpoints, callback URLs, service principals, API permissions and access mapping across Microsoft and source\-managed/custom identity providers; network, internet, gateway and firewall dependencies; and the ability to explain use, troubleshoot and plan rollback. Experience applying testing, monitoring, incident response and controlled release practices * Proven ability to align business and technical stakeholders, explain risks and priorities clearly, and work effectively within security, legal, privacy and AI\-governance approval processes **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Experience with AI connectors and MCP servers, and familiarity with integration capabilities across OpenAI, Anthropic or Microsoft AI platforms * Experience with Entra app registrations, delegated OAuth, gateways, connector manifests and administrator registration workflows * Experience building repeatable onboarding and operational\-readiness practices in a regulated enterprise environment * Experience partnering with platform vendors and leading improvements informed by production incidents, user feedback and adoption evidence * All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far\-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $148,900 \- $255,300 annually based on full\-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable. Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants. *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare by harnessing technology and innovation to make care simpler to navigate, more affordable and more connected for the people we serve. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, heard and respected, empowering people to bring their authentic selves to work and strengthening our collective impact through diverse talents, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.* *UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.* *UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are a drug\-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.*

jobs.title: Lead Principal Physical Security Engineer, Hyperscale Data Center Construction (Saline Township, MI)
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is expanding its data center portfolio to support global cloud and AI infrastructure. The Physical Security Systems team works across design, construction, commissioning, and operations to deliver reliable security systems for these facilities. This Lead Principal Physical Security Systems Engineer serves as a senior technical authority for physical security systems on complex data center construction projects. The role works with design, construction, security operations, networking, commissioning, and vendor teams to ensure systems meet OCI standards and are ready for operational use. **NOTE: This is a full\-time role located onsite at our new hyperscale facility in Saline Township, Michigan. Relocation assistance will be provided.** **Required Qualifications** * Significant experience designing, delivering, or managing physical security systems in data centers, mission\-critical facilities, large campuses, or similarly secure environments. * Strong knowledge of access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, intercoms, perimeter security, and security monitoring platforms. * Experience reviewing construction drawings, specifications, submittals, device schedules, and commissioning documentation. * Understanding of low\-voltage construction, structured cabling, device installation, labeling, testing, and system integration. * Proven ability to manage integrators, contractors, and vendors while coordinating with cross\-functional teams. * Ability to identify technical, quality, and schedule risks and communicate clearly with field teams and leadership. * Experience reviewing vendor scope, change orders, pricing, and schedule impacts. * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, information technology, security management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Ability to travel as needed for project delivery and site reviews. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience delivering physical security systems for hyperscale data centers, cloud infrastructure, or other mission\-critical facilities. * Experience with large campuses, high\-density data halls, or projects with phased construction and operational handovers. * Familiarity with enterprise access control, video management, intrusion detection, badging, visitor management, and security operations platforms. * Experience integrating security systems with networks, building systems, life safety systems, and centralized monitoring. * Knowledge of commissioning, integrated systems testing, deficiency tracking, and operational acceptance. * Experience working with general contractors, security integrators, low\-voltage contractors, design consultants, commissioning agents, and owner’s representatives. * Experience developing security standards, installation details, inspection checklists, test scripts, or turnover documentation. * Familiarity with applicable codes, regional requirements, and secure facility operations. * Certifications such as PSP, CPP, PMP, RCDD, or BICSI, or relevant platform certifications for systems such as LenelS2, Genetec, Avigilon, CCure, or Axis. **What Success Looks Like** Security systems are installed consistently, function as intended, and are fully tested and documented before handover. The Principal Engineer identifies issues early, holds vendors accountable, and gives project and operations leaders a clear view of system readiness. **Key Responsibilities** * **Technical leadership:** Review security designs, drawings, specifications, submittals, and installation details. Identify design gaps, integration risks, and operational concerns, and guide teams toward practical solutions. * **Construction delivery:** Oversee security integrators and contractors through installation, configuration, testing, and turnover. Monitor scope, schedule, quality, vendor performance, and change orders. * **Systems integration:** Coordinate access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, intercom, badging, and perimeter security systems with site networks, monitoring platforms, and operational processes. * **Quality and commissioning:** Review inspection records, test plans, device schedules, configurations, and closeout documents. Participate in field inspections and functional testing, and track deficiencies through resolution. * **Operational handover:** Confirm systems are tested, documented, and ready for acceptance by OCI security and operations teams. Communicate readiness, open risks, and decisions needed to project leadership. * **Standards and improvement:** Help improve design standards, installation practices, testing procedures, and turnover requirements across projects. \#LI\-SP1

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Implements machine learning (ML) model serving for production. Ensures the readiness of machine learning models for deployment in production. Automates machine learning workflows. Evaluates potential data quality, security, and/or privacy issues and their impacts on modeling. Provides troubleshooting and debugging support. Addresses issues in machine learning serving infrastructure and workflows. Collaborates with stakeholders to integrate machine learning models into new or extant systems. Develops, maintains, and refines tools, platforms, and services for internal use. Develops efficient, bug\-free code from scratch. Maintains familiarity with current developments in the machine learning field and integrates knowledge into model development. **Key Responsibilities** Machine Learning and Data Modeling – Model Productionization: – Utilizes machine learning (ML) and software development knowledge to implement ML model serving for production. – Collaborates with multiple stakeholders, such as Development Leads, Product Management, Operations, and Release Management, to make, adopt, and communicate technical decisions, and shape the development and delivery of software. Model serving Development and Deployment – Model Deployment: – Ensures ML model serving readiness for deployment by scaling models, cleaning model code, and ensuring production quality standards are met. – Automates model serving workflows, from data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) to model deployment and monitoring, to establish the continuous integration and continuous delivery of machine learning solutions. Model Development and Deployment – Model Serving Performance: – Creates infrastructure and frameworks to monitor the performance and alignment with design criteria of trained models and/or systems. – Proactively monitors the performance of deployed models and troubleshoots independently or in collaboration with Data Science. – Develops novel metrics that provide analytical insights to non\-technical stakeholders on how well machine learning models are operating. Internal Collaborations and Impacts – Model Integration and Operation: – Collaborates with multiple stakeholders (e.g., data scientists, software developers) to integrate open source models into new or existing systems. – Understands operational considerations of model deployment (e.g., performance, scalability, stability, maintenance). – Provides expert troubleshooting and debugging support, addresses issues in machine learning engineering infrastructure and workflow, and creates robust solutions to prevent future problems. Internal Collaborations and Impacts – Tool Development: – Develops, maintains, and refines tools, platforms, environments, and services for internal use. Internal Collaborations and Impacts – Coding and Documentation: – Develops efficient, bug\-free, medium\-complexity code from scratch, and properly maintains and organizes the existing codebase. – Implements best practices for version control, code review, and code delivery/deployment. – Builds and maintains professional documentation for technical processes (experimentation, data collection and analyses, model building). – Tests and reviews code for bugs. Machine Learning Engineering Expertise: – Maintains familiarity with current developments in the machine learning engineering field and integrates knowledge into model development. – Maintains familiarity with the usage and development of third\-party machine learning frameworks, packages, and libraries (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras) to continuously evaluate their performance and scalability, and integrate them into production environments. **Core Responsibilities** Planning \& Execution: – Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. – Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. Collaboration \& Partnership: – Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. – Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. – Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. Problem Solving: – Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. – Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. – Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. Continuous Learning: – Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. – Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. – Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. Continuous Improvement: – Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. – Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. Performance and Development: – Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description: Parallax Innovations is a civic communications lab building modern persuasion infrastructure for the movement to improve American democracy and elections. We support organizations and campaigns advancing nonpartisan democracy reforms through our narrative intelligence platform. We combine technology, data, and services to help our partners reach, engage, and persuade voters in our fast\-evolving information ecosystem. We enable partners with strategic guidance and hands\-on production and editing support to build strong vertical\-video operations across TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Our products make it easier for campaigns to mobilize supporters as creators, equipping them with tools that draw on our intelligence and predictive capabilities to improve content before it ships. And our data assets – including an enriched voter file with audience\-specific insights – help campaigns deploy and amplify the right content to the specific voters they need to reach. Our primary focus is solving the Primary Problem—a system of party primaries that excludes millions of voters and rewards elected leaders for answering to a narrow partisan electorate. We help advance open primaries that give voters more voice and choice and leaders stronger incentives to represent their communities. Parallax is incubated by Unite America, and is based in Denver. As *Chief Technology Officer,* you will own the ongoing development and improvement of Parallax's primary competitive advantage: a narrative intelligence platform that learns what persuades Americans on reform issues, and how. You own everything engineering, AI, data, privacy \& compliance, infrastructure, security, with strong influence over adjacent workflows. You also serve as an organizational leader, driving strategy and organization prioritization. We approach persuasion like infrastructure: a lasting capability that helps the movement learn, improve and win across campaigns and election cycles. Our ambition is to build a closed\-loop learning system that gets smarter every time we speak. Its AI core will connect the content we create with engagement data, audience research and experiments to learn which messages, messengers and formats work with which voters—and feed those lessons back into how we create, target and distribute the next communication. Over each election cycle, Parallax will support a number of reform campaigns, many of them ballot initiatives. Each campaign has to reach different audiences: progressives, conservatives, independents, and the large group of Americans who are disengaged or simply worn out by politics. Our product lowers the barrier for supporters to become compelling content creators, and our platform provides guidance on frames, formats, messengers and messages are likely to work. This is an executive role requiring technical depth and a hands\-on approach to using modern engineering tools, as well as broader organizational leadership skills. You’ll craft the product vision, lead the contract engineers in developing the platform, and be the decision\-maker about architecture, models, data and resources. You’ll also champion the technical vision, progress, and investment requirements to executive leadership, the Board, and potential investors. You will inherit a contract data and engineering team, and from there you will determine how the team develops, including budget development and hiring. You will serve as a senior executive responsible for the technical integration of Parallax’s data, products, and services. Alongside the *Chief of Staff* and *VP of Product \& Partnerships*, you will develop and drive organizational strategy, translate priorities into work plans and budgets, and align the team around measurable results. Ideal candidates for this role will have the judgment and management ability to assume broader organizational leadership as Parallax grows. This role reports to the President, and is based in Denver. Relocations welcome. Exceptional candidates based elsewhere will be considered if they can commit to periodic trips to Denver. These will be your accountabilities: Own the development of Parallax’s core technology and competitive advantage.* Set platform strategy and capabilities roadmap: what it should measure, what its learning agenda will be, what inputs it expands to include, and how it learns and improves quarter over quarter. * Define the scoring framework: how content engagement and persuasion are quantified for Parallax, how they are weighted, and how scores connect to real outcomes. * Extend our intelligence platform beyond transcript\-analysis so that it evaluates videos, including visuals, presenters, format and production choices. * Make the model decisions: which commercial and open models to use and route between, whether fine\-tuning or custom components are worth it, and the tradeoffs in cost, speed and accuracy. * Build the data loop so that performance data from platforms, partners, audience surveys and exper ments, learn from results, and make each round of communications smarter. **First six months:** a working feedback loop connecting content, audience and outcome data; initial scoring and predictive capabilities tested against results; and initial integrations with the partner voter file and Partner Portal. The team should be using findings to improve communications, with clear measures of progress and priorities for what comes next. **Requirements** Background in technical leadership and executive accountability.* **12\+ years in engineering, machine learning, AI or data product roles, including several years leading technical teams**. A recent record of shipping AI or data products, using frontier tools and methods, that people have used to make real decisions. * **Demonstrated executive leadership beyond a technical team**: experience aligning multiple functions, managing senior leaders, making resource tradeoffs, and communicating strategy and results to a board or investors. * Experience taking a data or AI product from an early version to something an organization relies on. * **High integrity**. AI\-assisted persuasion work in a democracy needs someone who will not overstate what a model knows, and who takes accuracy, privacy and responsible use seriously. * **Low ego, default\-curious**. You let results overrule your favorite hypothesis, and give credit freely. * **A builder who leads.** You would rather show a prototype than describe one, and you raise the bar for the team by working alongside it. You are comfortable in a small, early organization where the plan is still being drawn. * Bonus points if you have supported founders or principals in raising capital or philanthropic funding. Relevant backgrounds include AI startups, intelligent platform engineering, AI\-assisted political analytics, media analytics, or adtech engineering. Political or ballot\-initiative experience is helpful but not required. Mission\-drive and political savviness.* **Genuine motivation for democracy reform, healthy elections, and electoral integrity.** Experience in govtech, civic tech, or political or ballot initiative work is a strong plus, but not a requirement. If you don’t have this type of experience, your motivation for our mission must be truly palpable. * **A cross\-partisan outlook.** You can come from any political camp, but you do not demonize the others. The Parallax team includes people from across the spectrum who share the democracy mission, and that is by design. * **A political messaging lens**, i.e. an understanding that progressives, conservatives, independents and disengaged voters hear the same idea differently, and curiosity about the science of persuasion. (You do not need political relationships to be competitive for this role.) Hard skills:* **Fluency with modern AI tools:** LLM APIs, multimodal models for video, image and audio, retrieval, prompt and agent design, model routing, and the tradeoffs of fine\-tuning. You keep up with new models, harnesses, and other tools, and have some method for testing and experimenting with new tools as they are released. * **Evaluation and measurement in practice:** Building eval sets, back\-testing, A/B testing and experimental design, and enough causal inference to know the difference between content that gets engagement and content that changes minds. * **Hands\-on technical depth:** You can write Python and SQL, design data pipelines, and review the code and architecture your team ships. * **Product sense:** You can turn what creative teams and partners need into a roadmap and specs, and decide what not to build. * **Ability to explain to nontechnical (creatives, leadership, funders) how a given product or tool works**, and what its current limits are. **Benefits** Generous benefits package including: * Competitive base salary * Unlimited PTO; generous parental leave * Health, vision, dental insurance * 401K with 3% match * Company issued laptop/equipment, and reimbursements

findings. **AI\-Accelerated Learning \& Response** * Leverage the team's AI models as a primary learning tool — using them to research unfamiliar threats, understand tooling, and build technical depth repetitive or manual tasks on the team and use AI tooling to automate or streamline them, actively working to reduce the operational load carried by the Operations team. * Document and share effective AI\-assisted workflows and prompts with teammates to raise the bar for the whole team. **Security Operations \& Monitoring** * Perform continuous monitoring of security events, logs, and behavioral indicators across the environment. * Support Phishing Email Response, including analysis, remediation, and user follow\-up. * Contribute to and maintain runbooks, knowledge\-base articles, and standard operating procedures. **Stakeholder Communication \& Support** * Provide customer\-facing support for Cyber\-related questions and issues via email and messaging platforms. * Promote good personal and professional cybersecurity hygiene through regular engagement with staff. * Set and manage expectations with sup  emerging cyber threats and industry trends. * Participate in team knowledge\-sharing sessions and post\-incident reviews to build institutional knowledge. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non\-technical stakeholders. * Strong organizational skills and self\-sufficiency; able to operate with minimal supervision during active events. * Working knowledge of core cybersecurity toolsets: Endpoint Detection \& Response (EDR), Email Security Gateway, SIEM, Vulnerability Management, Identity \& Access Management, and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB). * Genuine enthusiasm for using AI tools
