jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (SDEV)
jobs.description: PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI\-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two\-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform. PagerDuty is seeking a **Forward Deployed Engineer (SRE Agent)** to join our customer\-focused SRE Agent team! As a **Forward Deployed Engineer**, you will work inside PagerDuty's largest customer accounts, connecting the SRE Agent to their production environments (observability tools, infrastructure as code, GitOps tooling, and CI/CD pipelines) and guiding their teams from AI\-assisted incident response to supervised and autonomous actions with safety guardrails. You will also contribute code directly back to the core SRE Agent product, building reusable tools, connectors, and skills derived from real customer needs. This is an exciting opportunity to join the product engineering team as the Staff Engineer and directly shape how agentic AI operates within the most strategic customers. The ideal candidate brings a strong background as a software engineer, hands\-on experience shipping LLM/agentic systems to production, and the customer\-facing skills to bridge technical execution with business strategy. #### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Embed and drive SRE Agent adoption:** Work onsite and in regular contact with 2–4 strategic customer teams to deploy the SRE Agent, configure tools and connectors, and embed AI actions across their incident management lifecycle to drive adoption and value * **Build and contribute core agent capabilities:** Scope, design, and build reusable agent tools, connectors, and skills on the agent's extensibility surfaces, shipping them through the product team's repos, review process, and evaluation gates. * **Run pilots and unblock customer adoption:** Stand up new agentic capabilities with strategic accounts first, gather eval data, identify technical blockers (permissions, telemetry, missing connectors), and build production fixes directly into the product. * **Integrate with production stacks and progressive delivery:** Connect the SRE Agent to IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), GitOps (ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines, and observability platforms, guiding customers safely from AI\-assisted to autonomous operations. * **Set technical direction and feedback insights:** Define 3–6 month technical roadmaps across assigned accounts, provide architectural guidance to product managers and engineering managers, and bring customer friction and eval data back to the core team. #### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** * **8\+ years** of experience building and shipping production software across team boundaries (assessed against PagerDuty Staff Engineer / SDE V expectations). * **Hands\-on experience with LLM and agent systems** in production, including agent development, tool\-use frameworks (MCP or equivalent), evaluation pipelines, and guardrail design. * **Customer\-facing skills.** You can run a technical design session with a customer's engineers and present the business case to their leadership. * **Comfortable with ambiguity.** You can start from a vague problem statement in an unfamiliar environment and get to working software without much direction. Former founders and founding engineers tend to do well in this role. * **A record of shipping software that got adopted,** and the judgment to recognize which customer requests generalize and when the right answer is not to build. * **Infrastructure \& Deployment expertise:** Demonstrated experience with Terraform or Pulumi at scale, GitOps (ArgoCD or equivalent), CI/CD pipeline design, and progressive delivery patterns (canary, blue/green, soak periods). * **Willingness to travel 25–50%** during active customer engagements. #### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Practical operational knowledge of incident management and observability concepts (on\-call, postmortems, SLOs/SLIs, alerting). * Customer\-facing technical consulting, forward\-deployed engineering, or solutions architecture experience on top of a core software engineering background. * Background as a founder or founding engineer accustomed to navigating high ambiguity and driving unscripted problem\-solving. * Experience with policy\-as\-code, fine\-grained permissioning, or safety guardrail patterns for agent\-driven automation. * Production experience with PagerDuty or competing digital operations and incident management platforms. * Active open\-source contributions to the AI agent or M Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we **cannot** employ candidates residing in: **Location restrictions:** **Australia:** Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia **Canada:** Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon **United States:** Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming *Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.* **How we work** Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian. People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance. **What we offer** As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country\-specific offerings, on our benefits site. **Your package may include:** * Competitive salary * Comprehensive benefits package * Flexible work arrangements * Company equity\* * ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)\* * Retirement or pension plan\* * Generous paid vacation time * Paid holidays and sick leave * Dutonian Wellness Days \& HibernationDuty \- companywide paid days off in addition to PTO * Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non\-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)\* * Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year * Company\-wide hack weeks * Mental wellness programs * Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure **About PagerDuty** PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI\-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two\-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always\-on digital experiences to modern businesses PagerDuty is Great Place to Work\-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2\. jobs.title: Senior Staff AI Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: Remote, Washington, United States of America Global Customer Services Ref ID: JR\-023457 **Our Mission** At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. **Who We Are** In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. **Job Summary** As an AI Deployment Strategist (Customer Outcome Leader) within Forward Deployment Engineering, you are the single\-threaded business owner responsible for driving realized value, user adoption, and long\-term expansion across our enterprise AI engagements. Deploying enterprise AI is fundamentally different from traditional software delivery—it mutates operational workflows, alters decision\-making rights, and spans multiple complex technical streams. Working directly alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who build and optimize the technical architecture, you own the business realization. You will bridge the gap between executive AI vision and day\-to\-day operational reality, ensuring our solutions deliver clear, measurable ROI while insulating technical teams from reactive firefighting and unmanaged scope creep. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Single\-Threaded Business \& Value Ownership** * Own end\-to\-end business success, ROI realization, and user adoption across high\-impact enterprise accounts (e.g., global consultancies, Fortune 500 enterprises). * Establish baseline metrics, define target KPIs, and continuously measure, track, and present realized financial and operational value to client executives. * Serve as the primary peer and strategic advisor to client executive sponsors (CIOs, CTOs, Chief AI Officers, Business Unit Leads). **2\. Multi\-Stream Governance \& Scope Control** * Unite and govern complex, parallel workstreams (agent orchestration, guardrails/security, data pipelines, UI integration, and change management) under a single strategic roadmap. * Act as the strict gateway for engagement scope—eliminating unmanaged scope creep, managing client expectations, and translating ad\-hoc requests into structured roadmap decisions. * Prevent technical teams from falling into reactive firefighting by maintaining clear operational boundaries and structured delivery cadences. **3\. Workflow Redesign \& Operational Change Management** * Deeply analyze client operating models to identify high\-value business problems and redesign operational workflows around AI capabilities. * Manage organizational change, address user inertia, and re\-align decision rights to ensure end users actively adopt AI tools into daily workflows. * Conduct user feedback loops to refine the business solution, ensure outputs meet operational standards, and drive change management programs. **4\. Partnership with Technical Delivery (FDEs)** * Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to translate business requirements into actionable technical user stories. * Protect engineering bandwidth by owning executive stakeholder management, business politics, and operational blockers, allowing FDEs to focus proactively on core technical architecture, evaluations, and system reliability. **5\. Account Expansion \& Value Scaling** • Proactively identify adjacent, high\-value enterprise use cases to expand account footprint post\-initial deployment. • Turn successful proofs\-of\-concept (POCs) into multi\-year, enterprise\-wide production deployments. **Qualifications** * 6–10 years in management consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain), forward\-deployed engineering, technical account management, or forward\-deployed strategic roles in high\-growth B2B SaaS/AI companies. * **Domain Expertise:** Deep understanding of enterprise AI deployments, large language models (LLMs), multi\-agent systems, and digital workflow transformation. * **Executive Presence:** Proven track record of aligning, advising, and holding accountability with C\-suite executives and senior enterprise stakeholders. * **Business Acumen:** Demonstrated ability to construct business cases, model ROI, design KPIs, and re\-engineer complex operational business processes. * **Technical Literacy:** Ability to speak fluently with engineers, understand technical trade\-offs (e.g., latency vs. accuracy, guardrail evaluation, data integration patterns), and translate technical complexity into business impact. * **Change Management:** Strong background in organizational design, user adoption, and driving behavioral change across large operational teams. **Core Competencies \& Leadership Attributes** * **Single\-Threaded Accountability:** Takes complete ownership of business outcomes without deflecting to technical or operational complexity. * **Scope Discipline:** Firmly manages client expectations and resists unmanaged feature creep while maintaining high\-trust executive relationships. * **Strategic Clarity in Ambiguity:** Able to bring order to fragmented, multi\-stream AI initiatives and establish clear direction amidst rapid technological change. * **Cross\-Functional Catalyst:** Bridges the cultural and operational gap between technical engineering teams and non\-technical business leaders. **Compensation Disclosure** The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non\-sales roles) or base salary \+ commission target (for sales/com\-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. $112,900\.00 \- $182,600\.00/yr **Our Commitment** We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com. Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship?: Yes

jobs.title: Junior Support Engineer
jobs.description: Partner One is a long\-term investment group specializing in the acquisition and growth of successful software companies. With over 30 years in business, we own and operate some of the fastest\-growing enterprise software companies globally. More than 2,000 of the world’s largest corporations and governments rely on our software for their most critical operations and to safeguard their most valuable data. We are looking for a Junior Support Engineer to join our team based at our Riverside Data Centre, California – this DC hosts infrastructure and equipment supporting multiple companies across our portfolio. This is a hands\-on, junior technical role, ideal for someone looking to build their experience across IT support, hardware, networking, and data centre operations. You’ll work alongside our existing Data Centre Engineer and wider IT teams, helping with day\-to\-day requests and providing on\-site support when physical access to equipment is required. We’re not looking for someone who knows everything already; our goal is to identify someone practical, reliable and keen to learn, who is comfortable working with IT hardware and following technical instructions **Responsibilities:** * Install, rack and cable servers, switches and other network equipment * Assist with basic installation and decommissioning of Data Centre hardware * Provide ‘Smart Hands’ support for our wider IT teams and portfolio companies * Carry out tasks such as power cycling equipment, checking connections, reseating cables and replacing basic components * Supporting our existing Data Centre Engineer when additional resource is needed * Troubleshoot basic network connectivity issues, including checking cabling, ports, connections and device status * Escalate more complex infrastructure or networking issues to the appropriate engineer or technical team * Assist with laptop and end\-user device management * Receive returned equipment and ensure assets are correctly recorded and stored; jobs.title: GTM Engineer- AI B2B Lead Generation & Automation
jobs.description: PlanITROI is hiring a hands\-on, elite, GTM engineer to build and run our AI\-powered lead generation engine. You build the core AI agents first, then run the campaigns on them every day, turning enterprise buying signals into qualified sales conversations. You might have started in outbound, SDR leadership, demand gen, or growth, then taught yourself to build the agents and automations that do the work. Or you're an engineer who learned B2B prospecting the hard way. Either way, you've personally built systems that booked real meetings, and you can show us how you have been successful. If that's you, we would like to meet you! **About PlanITROI** For more than 25 years, PlanITROI has turned retired technology into financial value for enterprise organizations. Our services cover IT lifecycle management, repair, refurbishment, redeployment, remarketing, reverse logistics, and secure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD). We operate on reuse\-as\-intended\-use: reuse before recycling, and recycling only when reuse isn't viable. PlanITROI is recognized in Gartner's ITAD Market Guide and is an IAITAM Platinum Sponsor. Our mission is to maximize the financial value of technology while extending its useful life. Every device we recover creates value for clients and gets a second life as affordable technology. **Your mission** Build and run the AI\-powered outbound engine that finds enterprise buying opportunities and turns them into qualified meetings and signed MSAs. Your agents will research 5,000\+ enterprise accounts and reach 250,000\+ contacts. You own it end\-to\-end: signal detection, account intelligence, contact discovery, personalization, multichannel orchestration, CRM integration, experimentation, and measurement. **Build first, then run.** You start by building a few core agents. Then you run the campaigns on them: launching and monitoring sequences, working reply queues, tuning messaging and targeting every week, protecting deliverability, and handing warm conversations to sales at the right moment. Expect most of your time to shift from building to running once the agents are live. **Who we sell to.** Enterprise organizations with 5,000 to 11,000,000\+ employees, mostly knowledge workers (80%\+), complex buying committees, and an existing technology provider. Your challenge: find the right buyer, recognize the right moment, and give them a compelling reason to talk to PlanITROI. **Who you work with.** You report to the Founder \& CEO and the Chief Strategy Officer, and work closely with the VP of Marketing. No layers in between other than support. **What you'll build and own** * **Signal detection.** Ingest, evaluate, and score buying signals such as tech refresh cycles, leadership changes, office moves, M\&A, RFP activity, contract timing, job postings, and social activity. Trigger the right next action while the signal is fresh. * **Buying committee intelligence.** Identify high\-fit ICP accounts, map buying committees, select the best 1 to 5 contacts per entry point, validate contact data, and track changes. * **Personalization and challenger messaging.** Combine account intelligence, signals, persona pain points, account history, and incumbent\-provider context into relevant outreach at scale. * **Multichannel orchestration.** Run email, LinkedIn, voicemail drops, AI calling where appropriate, and human SDR follow\-up as one system, with sequencing, timing, routing, and next\-best actions. * **Objection handling and follow\-up.** Respond intelligently to objections like "We already have a provider," keep conversational context, and escalate to humans at the right moment. * **Performance and optimization.** Measure results by signal, persona, channel, and campaign. Find what's winning, kill what isn't, and run the next experiment. These are capabilities, not six separate agents. You design the architecture, build the agents, integrate the systems, and make them work together. **What you bring** **This role requires a hands\-on builder. You must design, build, and demo production AI agents yourself.** You'll integrate tools like Salesforce, Apollo, and Clay, but using them isn't the role. Building the agents that run on top of them is. You understand both sides: the engineering, and the B2B prospecting strategy that turns agents into a working revenue system. **Must\-haves** * **AI agents that booked meetings.** You've personally built and run AI agents or automated outbound systems that produced measurable B2B meetings, and you have the performance data to prove it. * **Agent engineering.** LLMs, tool calling, reasoning workflows, memory and state, multi\-agent orchestration, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls, using LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, n8n, or comparable frameworks. * **Coding and integration.** Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, and custom integrations. * **Enterprise prospecting.** Intent signals, ICP scoring, buying committee mapping, enrichment, personalization, objection handling, and multichannel sequence design. Bonus if you've displaced incumbent providers. * **GTM stack.** Hands\-on with tools like Salesforce, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 6sense or Bombora, and AI calling or voicemail platforms. * **Production operations at scale.** Monitoring, debugging, CRM sync, deduplication, deliverability, compliance, and error handling for systems reaching 250,000\+ contacts across email, LinkedIn, and voicemail without burning domains or accounts. **Nice\-to\-haves** * A background in outbound, SDR/BDR leadership, demand gen, growth, or RevOps before moving into AI and automation. * Experience in IT services, ITAD, or computer hardware, hardware as a service **What success looks like** Your primary outcome is **qualified enterprise meetings** that meet defined ICP, persona, and business\-need criteria. We also track: * **Signal\-to\-meeting conversion.** How well your agents turn buying signals into conversations and meetings. * **Contact precision.** Reaching the right decision\-makers and buying committees. * **Deployment velocity.** How fast a campaign idea becomes a working agent and a live test. * **Multichannel conversion.** Replies, conversations, meetings, and opportunities by signal, persona, channel, and campaign. * **System reliability.** Data accuracy, deliverability, CRM integrity, routing, and compliance. * **Learning rate.** How quickly you find what isn't working, fix the root cause, and scale what is. **How we hire: show us, don't tell us** We hire on proof, not interviews alone. We're not interested in theoretical AI expertise or polished slides about what agents might do. If you qualify, we'll give you a real project to show us how you build. * **Live demo.** Show us AI agents you personally built and deployed for B2B lead generation, and the results they produced. * **Build project.** Build an outbound agent from a campaign premise we give you, using your own tools. * **Live technical session.** Demo your build, work a live account, and walk us through your architecture. Across these stages, be ready to show your architecture, decision logic, prompts, tools, and integrations; how your agents handle exceptions, incomplete data, failures, and human handoff; and real performance data such as meetings, pipeline, or conversion gains. You won't need access to any PlanITROI system or need to buy software. Free tiers and trials are fine. Your work stays yours unless we hire you. If you show work from a past employer, please redact anything confidential. **Ready to build?** If you love hard technical problems and want to build something ambitious, bring your working agents, your results, and your drive. Build the agents. Own the results. Help us grow. **Explore more about us:** PlanITROI.com \| NextraTech.com \| BuyRefurbished.com *PlanITROI is an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination/harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.*

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Prudentia Sciences** ---------------------------- Prudentia Sciences is the scientific intelligence layer powering life sciences dealmaking. We bring together expert\-developed scientific diligence frameworks, AI reasoning trained on drug development, and a unified evidence base to accelerate investment in breakthrough therapies. As a trusted third party operating between buyer and seller, we help build conviction through every stage of the deal, faster. We replace fragmented workflows with a single system that surfaces what matters earlier. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), McKesson, Iaso Ventures, Virtue, and SignalFire — and built by people who have sat on every side of the table in life sciences dealmaking — we're on a mission to bring expert scientific judgment to every deal decision, at AI scale. **The Opportunity** ------------------- Our clients don't buy software in the abstract. A BD team at a top\-20 pharma company, a biotech evaluating its pipeline, or an investment fund running diligence on a drug asset each arrives with its own data, its own workflows, its own security review, and its own definition of a good answer. Closing the gap between what our platform does out of the box and what that client needs this quarter is engineering work, and it's this role. We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to be Prudentia's senior technical presence inside client engagements. You'll scope problems with client stakeholders, integrate our platform with their systems and data, build the configurations, workflows, and extensions that make it indispensable, and turn what you see in the field into product and platform improvements. You'll work across engineering, data, AI/ML, and the commercial team. **Why This Role is Hard (in a Good Way)** ----------------------------------------- Forward deployed work at Prudentia sits where several demanding worlds meet: * **Sophisticated, high\-stakes users:** BD leaders, portfolio strategists, scientists, and investors who know the domain cold and will spot a wrong number immediately. Trust is earned one answer at a time. * **Messy enterprise reality:** client data in internal systems, data rooms, spreadsheets, and licensed databases; SSO and security reviews; IT teams with their own timelines and constraints. * **AI that has to be right:** applying LLMs and retrieval to clinical trial data, scientific literature, deal history, and multi\-language sources, where hallucination isn't a quirk but a credibility risk. * **A product still taking shape:** every engagement is a chance to decide whether something should be a one\-off configuration, a reusable pattern, or a core platform feature. You'll help make that call. You'll need to be as comfortable in a client steering meeting as you are in a pull request, and able to switch between them in the same afternoon. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **Client Deployment \& Integration** * Lead the technical side of client onboarding and deployment, from discovery and scoping through go\-live and expansion. * Integrate Prudentia with client systems and data: internal databases, data rooms, document repositories, licensed datasets, and identity providers, working within their security and compliance requirements. * Build client\-specific workflows, configurations, models, and extensions on top of our AWS\-based platform, written to production standards rather than as throwaway scripts. **Applied AI \& Data in the Field** * Apply our AI capabilities (LLMs, retrieval, extraction, scenario and risk modeling) to client\-specific questions, and evaluate whether the outputs are accurate and defensible. * Partner with the data team on onboarding new client and third\-party data sources, and on the provenance and quality standards that let clients trust the results. * Build evaluations and guardrails for client use cases so that quality is measured, not assumed. **Product Feedback Loop** * Be the field's voice in engineering and product: bring back patterns, gaps, and requests with enough technical depth that they can be acted on. * Turn repeated one\-off solutions into reusable components, templates, and platform features, contributing directly to the core codebase. * Help decide what should be productized, what should stay configurable, and what we should say no to. **Trusted Technical Advisor** * Act as the technical point of contact for your accounts, from day\-to\-day users through to executive sponsors. * Support the commercial team in pre\-sales technical discovery, pilots, and proofs of value with strategic prospects. * Help build the forward deployed playbook, and help shape the team as it grows. **Who You Are** --------------- **Essential Qualifications** * **5\+ years of software engineering experience,** including meaningful time in client\-facing, forward deployed, solutions engineering, or technical consulting roles where you shipped code that clients depended on. * **Strong full\-stack or backend engineering skills:** Python and SQL as a minimum, comfort with APIs and integrations, and the ability to work across a modern web stack. * **Hands\-on AWS experience:** you've deployed and operated production systems on AWS and can reason about security, networking, and cost in client environments. * **Practical experience with LLMs and AI applications:** retrieval, prompting, extraction, evaluation, and the judgment to know when an AI output is good enough to put in front of a client. * **Excellent communication with technical and non\-technical audiences:** you can run a working session with scientists or investors, then explain the tradeoffs to engineers. * **Comfort with ambiguity and ownership:** you thrive when the problem isn't fully specified and the client is waiting on you to define it. **Bonus Points** * Experience in life sciences, biopharma, healthcare, or financial services, especially with clinical trial, scientific literature, or deal data. * Experience with enterprise integration patterns: SSO/SAML, data room APIs, data pipelines, and security questionnaires. * Experience at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup where you helped define a function rather than join an established one. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Impact:** Your work directly enables breakthrough therapies to reach patients faster * **Ownership:** Build and lead the platform as a foundational engineering leader * **Growth:** Shape our product experience during a critical scaling phase * **Compensation:** Competitive salary and equity * **Team:** Collaborative, mission\-driven colleagues passionate about transforming biopharma **Location** ------------ We are strongly prioritizing candidates based in London (UK), Dublin (Ireland), or Basel (Switzerland) to support our EU\-based clients. If we find truly exceptional talent in the US, we may consider fully remote in Eastern Time Zone in the United States. Compensation Range: €110K \- €132K

jobs.description: **Staff Data Platform Engineer** ================================ Location: NYC HQ or Remote (U.S.)\| Full\-time \| Engineering **Who we are.** --------------- Reality Defender is an award\-winning cybersecurity company helping enterprises and governments detect deepfakes and AI\-generated media. Utilizing a patented multi\-model approach, Reality Defender is robust against the bleeding edge of generative platforms producing video, audio, imagery, and text media. Reality Defender's API\-first deepfake detection platform empowers teams and developers alike to identify fraud, disinformation campaigns, and harmful deepfakes in real time. Backed by world class investors including DCVC, Illuminate Financial, Y Combinator, Booz Allen Hamilton, IBM, Accenture, Rackhouse, and Argon VC, Reality Defender works with leading enterprise clients, financial institutions, and governments in order to ensure AI\-generated media is not used for malicious purposes. *Youtube: Reality Defender Wins RSA Most Innovative Startup* **The Staff Data Platform Engineer Role.** ------------------------------------------ Reality Defender's detection models are only as strong as the data behind them, and every new generative tool raises the bar on the volume and variety of media we need to train and evaluate against. The Staff Data Platform Engineer will own the shared AI data platform behind our vision, audio, and multimodal research, turning acquired and internally generated image, video, audio, and text data into reliable, reproducible datasets, from continuous ingestion through processing, governance, and export. This is a senior, hands\-on role where you'll complete our Databricks and distributed processing platform and build the reusable infrastructure behind our in\-house synthetic data generation, including producing the very deepfakes our models learn to catch. This is a full\-time role, reporting to our Director of Data. Responsibilities include: * Own the end\-to\-end data platform for AI research: continuous ingestion, preprocessing, governance, and export of image, video, audio, and text data at high volume. * Complete and scale our Databricks lakehouse and distributed processing stack (Spark, Ray, or similar), making architecture and build\-vs\-buy decisions that hold up as data volume grows. * Build reusable infrastructure for in\-house synthetic data generation, so researchers can produce new deepfake variants across modalities on demand instead of one\-off. * Make every dataset reproducible and traceable through versioning, lineage, metadata, quality checks, and stable train/eval splits, so any model result can be tied back to the exact data behind it. * Own pipeline reliability, observability, and processing cost per dataset as core metrics of the platform. * Partner with ML researchers to understand their data needs and turn them into self\-serve tools that speed up model iteration. * Mentor engineers and raise the bar on data engineering practices: code review, testing, documentation, and runbooks. * Work with Security and compliance stakeholders to make sure data handling, licensing, and access controls meet the standards our enterprise and government clients expect. * Help shape the long\-term data platform roadmap with engineering and research leadership. **Who you are.** ---------------- * 8\+ years building data platforms or data infrastructure, including staff\- or lead\-level ownership of production pipelines that generate, ingest, or deliver data at high volume. * Deep hands\-on experience with distributed processing (Spark, Ray, or similar) and lakehouse platforms, ideally Databricks, on top of cloud object storage (S3, GCS, or Azure Blob). * Production experience with Databricks, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, and Spark on AWS, including performance tuning, access controls, and operational troubleshooting. * Experience working with large unstructured media such as video, audio, or images, including the realities of large files, decoding and transcoding, and metadata at scale. * A track record of building reproducible ML datasets: versioning, lineage, data quality validation, and orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Databricks Workflows, or similar). * Strong Python and SQL, and the judgment to own ambiguous platform problems end\-to\-end on a lean team. * Own infrastructure and deployment automation using Terraform and CI/CD, including AWS storage, IAM, compute, Databricks resources, and distributed processing environments. * Experience building synthetic data generation pipelines or running generative models (diffusion, voice cloning/TTS, video generation) at scale. (nice to have) * Background supporting ML research teams with training and evaluation data, especially for multimodal models. (nice to have) * Experience in security, fraud, trust \& safety, or another adversarial domain, or at a Series A or B startup where scope regularly outpaces headcount. (nice to have) **Within 12 months, you'll…** ----------------------------- * Own a mature, self\-serve data platform that researchers use to create, version, and export datasets without waiting on platform support. * Have scaled synthetic data generation across vision, audio, and multimodal research, broadening our detection coverage of new generative techniques. * Deliver reproducible evaluation datasets that let the company compare model versions with confidence. * Be setting the multi\-year data platform roadmap and leading high\-leverage initiatives beyond the original scope. **What we offer.** ------------------ Reality Defender offers the following benefits to all our employees, regardless of location: * Healthcare plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and partial coverage available for dependents * Dental and Vision plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and their dependents * Short/Long\-term disability and life insurance plans with 100% premium coverage for employees * FSA/HSA and 401k programs * Equity compensation * 20 days of PTO per year * 12 weeks of Parental Leave * Learning and Development budget * Monthly wellness benefits * Annual company\-sponsored offsite For employees working from Reality Defender's HQ in NYC, we offer the following benefits: * Daily in\-office lunch through UberEats * Commuter benefits * Remote Fridays * Happy Hours and other local events Base salary range: 210,000 \- 260,000, based on experience, level, and location. jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering & Analytics
jobs.description: **WHO WE ARE** Relation Insurance is a leading, innovative company with a strong commitment to excellence and a passion for delivering cutting\-edge solutions to our clients. As a key player in the insurance market, we pride ourselves on our dynamic culture, collaborative environment, and continuous drive for success. With a rich history and a bright future ahead, we are looking for exceptional individuals to join our team and contribute to our ongoing growth and success. **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** The Director, Data Engineering and Analytics leads the strategy, architecture, delivery, and continuous improvement of Relation’s enterprise data engineering and analytics capabilities. The individual in this role owns the data platform and analytics function end to end, ensuring scalable, reliable, secure, and trusted data solutions that support business priorities and measurable outcomes. The Director provides hands\-on technical leadership, advances the responsible use of automation and proprietary AI, and leads and develops data engineering and analytics professionals. The Director partners with executive, business, and technology leaders to translate priorities into a practical data roadmap and drive execution. The individual in this role establishes standards for data architecture, integration, quality, governance, security, reporting, and analytics while remaining sufficiently hands\-on to guide complex technical work, resolve issues, and clearly communicate data, tradeoffs, and risk to non\-technical stakeholders. **A GLIMPSE INTO YOUR DAY** **Ownership and Accountability** * Owns Relation’s data engineering and analytics function end to end, with full responsibility and accountability for execution and outcomes. * Translates business priorities, as set by executive and business leadership, into the data and analytics roadmap, sequences the work within those priorities, and drives it to completion, owning the outcome regardless of team size. * Serves as the primary point of contact and accountable authority for executives, business leaders, auditors, and carrier partners on data, reporting, and analytics matters. * Provides executive\-ready reporting on platform health, delivery progress, data quality, and data risk, and walks executives through the numbers in plain language. * Partners with IT, Information Security, Finance, Operations, and business leadership to obtain source access, implement controls, and drive adoption, while retaining accountability for data interpretation and outcomes. * Personally designs, builds, and maintains production data pipelines from core brokerage and enterprise systems. * Owns data processes end to end: understanding the business need, profiling source data, modeling, transforming, validating, delivering, and supporting the result in production. * Writes production\-quality SQL, Python, and PySpark as a regular part of the job; troubleshoots failed loads, data discrepancies, and performance issues down to the root cause. * Builds and maintains curated, reusable datasets and data models for core domains (e.g., Client, Policy, Submission, Carrier, Producer, Revenue, Commission). * Defines and standardizes KPI logic and Power BI semantic models (e.g., premium, revenue, retention, hit ratio, pipeline, cross\-sell, service metrics) so the business works from one version of the truth. * Builds and delivers executive dashboards and self\-service reporting, and works directly with business stakeholders to drive adoption. * Makes practical architecture decisions for the lakehouse platform (medallion bronze/silver/gold layers, ELT patterns, orchestration) with a focus on reliability, simplicity, and cost. * Directs AI coding agents as the function’s primary delivery capacity: decomposes initiatives into well\-specified tasks, delegates implementation, testing, documentation, and source\-data analysis to agents, reviews the output, and ships the result. * Builds AI\-driven validation into every data process, including automated reconciliation, anomaly detection, and agent\-based review of code and outputs, while remaining personally accountable for the accuracy of anything AI produces. * Sets and enforces the standards for secure, effective use of AI, and coaches any team members on working AI\-first, including keeping sensitive client and employee data within approved tools and environments, maintaining human review of AI output before it reaches production or the business, and partnering with Information Security on AI governance. * Identifies and delivers opportunities to apply AI and automation to manual reporting, reconciliation, and data\-entry work across the business. * Builds and operates production LLM\-powered data workflows, such as document and data extraction from carrier and client documents, classification, and automated validation, with the same engineering rigor as any other pipeline. * Keeps the platform AI\-maintainable: well\-structured, documented, tested, and erience. * Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible hands\-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, data architecture, data analytics or related technology roles. * Demonstrated ability to operate as the accountable owner of a data platform or analytics function, delivering outcomes against priorities set by the business. * Previous leadership experience, including responsibility for leading and developing technical teams, people leaders, projects, or complex cross\-functional initiatives. * Currently hands\-on: writes production SQL, Python, and PySpark as a regular part of the job, not only reviews it. * Demonstrated track record of owning data processes end to end and delivering measurable business outcomes. * Deep, daily, hands\-on use of AI across the full engineering lifecycle, including agentic coding tools, LLM APIs, and automated validation, with concrete examples of delegating substantial multi\-step work to AI agents, catching their mistakes, and owning the result. * Expertise in: + Data modeling (dimensional \+ operational/normalized patterns), MDM concepts, and entity resolution across systems and acquired agencies + SQL, Python, and Spark (PySpark) + Lakehouse and medallion architecture, ELT, orchestration, and pipeline reliability patterns + Data quality testing, reconciliation, observability, and production support + Role\-based access controls, secure data handling, and audit\-ready processes + Specifying, orchestrating, and reviewing the work of AI coding agents, including evaluation of AI\-generated code, data, and analysis * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to and advising executives, and able to explain data, tradeoffs, and risk clearly to non\-technical partners. * Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives and competing executive priorities and to prioritize calmly in a fast\-paced environment. * Detail\-oriented while maintaining a strategic, enterprise\-level perspective. **WHY CHOOSE RELATION?** * Competitive pay. * A safe and healthy work environment provided by our robust benefit program including family health and wellness programs, 401K, employee assistance programs, paid time off, paid holidays and more. * Career advancement and development opportunities. . **Note:** The above is not all encompassing of the full position description. **Relation Insurance Inc.** provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Hybrid/Remote ***Job Overview*** Who We Are Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI‑powered, cloud platform, Relativity aiR, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high‑stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we’re deeply committed to expanding access to technology for academic institutions through Relativity Academic and supporting pro bono legal work through Justice for Change. What We Do At Relativity, engineers don’t just write code; they harness AI tools to architect, optimize, and deliver scalable software faster and shape the future of legal technology. They shape how industries uncover critical insights, ensure compliance, advance access to justice and continuously evolve our platform using the latest technologies, including cloud\-native architectures, AI capabilities, and modern developer tooling. Our AI powers privacy programs, identifies confidential information, and detects language indicating misconduct. We’re reimagining how legal professionals uncover truth at scale, and engineering is at the heart of that transformation. If you’re passionate about solving hard problems, designing for scale, and building tools that matter, while working in a culture that values transparency, innovation, and shared success, Relativity offers the opportunity to make a measurable difference in the marketplace. ***Job Description and Requirements*** **About the Role** Relativity's design system is moving to UX, and we are building its next generation. You will take it from early build to production and keep it running: making the technical calls inside the library, from module format to how it behaves under micro frontends, and building most of them yourself. The framework is chosen, the first components exist, and it ships through our micro frontend. Your work is the packaging, publishing, CI, testing, and hardest component behavior that turn it into a library teams can depend on. You will also maintain the libraries it replaces while teams move off them. **Job Description and Requirements** * Build and maintain how the library is packaged and published: module format, peer dependencies, the publish path to Artifactory and CDN. * Apply versioning and deprecation practice on every release, and write the migration guides for consuming teams. * Stand up CI, execute visual regression testing, and wire the token pipeline from design token files through to CSS variables. * Test and review components built by designers and coding agents before they merge, and maintain the machine\-readable guidance that agents leverage. * Fix accessibility defects in the code and support the accessibility conformance reporting. * Respond to breaking changes caused by releases and apply fixes through timely patch releases. * Keep legacy libraries in maintenance mode, only addressing major security issues and critical fixes. * Author the component behavior that our React framework library doesn’t provide. Raise the engineering bar of the design system team through code review and pairing with designers who use coding agents. * **Preferred Qualifications** * You have helped maintain a design system that multiple teams depend upon. * You are fluent with AI coding tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor. * You have worked across platform teams. * You have guided a design system migration that included patching what broke for consuming teams. * You can explain packaging decisions to a designer and a design decision to a platform engineer. * You have a strong accessibility practice of creating accessible, keyboard\-navigable, responsive experiences and testing them with screen readers and tools like Axe or equivalent. You have experience working in legacy codebases. * **Minimum Qualifications** * 7\+ years in front\-end or UX engineering. * Deep React and TypeScript experience. * Experience keeping a published package reliable across releases. * Technical leadership on a library or product area. * Ability to turn a technical direction into a working plan and execute on it. * Experience owning build and release tooling for a published package. * Deep experience with semantic HTML, CSS, and accessible component patterns. * Clear technical communication, including in code review. Based in the United States. * **Why We Could Be a Great Fit** * Impactful Mission: *Organize Data, Discover the Truth and Act on It* \- Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading law firms managing high\-stakes matters on our platform. * Engineering Culture: Continuous delivery, strong observability, and end\-to\-end ownership. * Inclusive Environment: Diverse backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger. * Community Impact: Volunteer opportunities and company\-sponsored charitable programs. * Compensation \& Benefits: Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness resources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, two annual company breaks, home office stipend, and an equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $126,000 and $190,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role** ------------------ Rippling’s Infrastructure organization builds the technical backbone that powers our entire product ecosystem. As we prepare to quadruple our global footprint, the Cloud team is tasked with evolving our foundation to handle a significant surge in daily events and system complexity. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Cloud Infrastructure team, you'll be in a high\-leverage role tackling complex scaling challenges \- from managing massive Kubernetes fleets across all accounts to architecting multi\-region disaster recovery and agentic AI workflows. You will not just maintain systems; you will build the automated, self\-service primitives that allow Rippling to scale to the next order of magnitude. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, distributed systems and ability to drive technical consensus across the entire engineering organization. **What you will do** -------------------- * Design and implement the next generation of our cloud infrastructure to support a 4x increase in system load, ensuring resilience and performance at scale. * Own the evolution jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **SRC, Inc.** is currently seeking an AI/ML Engineer to join a team building machine learning and generative AI capabilities for defense and national security missions. This is a hands\-on, early\-career engineering role focused on the practical work of turning data into working models: assembling and curating datasets, training and fine\-tuning models, and building the evaluation harnesses that tell us whether a model is actually good enough to field. You will work under the direction of senior engineers and scientists on tasks scoped within larger programs, with increasing ownership of discrete technical tasks as you develop. The work spans classical machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and the rapidly evolving generative AI toolchain, applied to real sensor data and real mission problems in ISR, EW, and advanced sensing. This is a strong fit for an engineer who wants to build depth in applied ML on problems where the data is messy, the ground truth is hard\-won, and the results have to hold up under scrutiny. **What You'll Do** * Build, clean, label, and version datasets from real and simulated sources, including handling class imbalance, distribution shift, and sparse or noisy labels * Train, fine\-tune, and benchmark models using standard open\-source frameworks, running experiments as assigned and documenting results clearly * Develop and run evaluation pipelines — task\-specific metrics, held\-out and adversarial test sets, regression suites — and report findings honestly, including negative results * Support generative AI efforts through prompt development and iteration, structured output design, retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines, and comparative evaluation of open\-weight and commercial language models * Assist with parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA) and supervised fine\-tuning of open\-weight models for domain\-specific tasks * Implement reinforcement learning experiments in standard environments and instrument them for reproducible measurement * Maintain reproducible experiment tracking, environment configuration, and code hygiene so that results can be regenerated by others * Contribute data, figures, and written findings to technical reports, program reviews, and oral presentations * Collaborate with algorithm engineers and domain experts to understand the sensor data and physical phenomenology behind the datasets you work with **What You'll Bring** * Bachelor’s in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or a related technical discipline and 0\+ years of experience (internships, co\-ops, research assistantships, and substantial academic project work count) * Working proficiency in Python and the core scientific stack (NumPy, pandas, scikit\-learn, matplotlib) * Familiarity with at least one deep learning framework, preferably PyTorch * Exposure to the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, Datasets, Tokenizers) or equivalent open\-source model tooling * Understanding of ML fundamentals: train/validation/test discipline, overfitting and regularization, cross\-validation, and the metrics appropriate to classification, regression, detection, and generation tasks * Comfort with Git\-based collaborative development * Clear written and verbal communication, and a willingness to say when a result doesn't hold up **Ways to Stand Out** * Experience fine\-tuning open\-weight language models using PEFT methods (LoRA, QLoRA) or the TRL/Axolotl/Unsloth toolchain * Hands\-on work with RAG systems: embedding models, vector stores, chunking strategies, and retrieval evaluation * Familiarity with LLM evaluation practice — LLM\-as\-judge, rubric\-based grading, eval harness design, and the failure modes of each * Experience with experiment tracking and data versioning tools (Weights \& Biases, MLflow, DVC) * Exposure to reinforcement learning libraries (Gymnasium, Stable\-Baselines3, CleanRL) or to preference\-based post\-training methods (DPO, GRPO) * Experience with agentic workflows, tool\-calling, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP) * Work with non\-natural\-image modalities: RF, radar, SAR, audio, time series, or multimodal data * Containerization (Docker) and experience running jobs on GPU clusters or cloud compute * Master's degree in a related technical discipline **What Sets Us Apart?** SRC, Inc., a not\-for\-profit research and development company, combines information, science, technology and ingenuity to solve “impossible” problems in the areas of defense, environment and intelligence. Across our family of companies, we apply bright minds, fresh thinking and relentless determination to deliver innovative products and services that are redefining possible®. When you join our team, you’ll be a part of something truly meaningful — helping to keep America and its allies safe and strong. You’ll collaborate with more than 1,400 engineers, scientists and professionals — with 20 percent of those employees having served in the military — in a highly innovative, inclusive and equitable work environment. You’ll receive a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package that includes four or more weeks of paid time off to start, 10 percent employer contribution toward retirement, and 100 percent tuition support. Total compensation for this role is market competitive. The anticipated salary range for this position based out of Dayton, OH is estimated at $70,000 to $96,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities, geographic location as well as other business and organizational needs. SRC offers competitive benefit options, for more details please visit our website.

jobs.title: Lead Analytics Engineer — Payments, Identity & Trust and Safety
jobs.description: Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise. **Culture at Scribd, Inc.** --------------------------- We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer. We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in\-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in\-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location. So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long\-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude. This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization. **About the team and role** =========================== **The team.** Data \& Analytics is building the DNA of an AI native Scribd, Inc. Bringing together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Data Analytics, D\&A turns fragmented data and inconsistent definitions into trusted, production\-quality data foundations — and builds the AI agents and analytical tools that bring reliable intelligence directly into how teams make decisions. **The role.** This role supports the pillars that own payments, identity, security as well as trust \& safety systems — the foundations that let Scribd securely monetize and protect its products. It is the senior\-most analytics engineering role for these pillars and a purely technical leadership position with no direct reports. You will report to the Director, Analytics Engineering, and work embedded alongside Product Analytics, Data Science, Product, and Engineering partners. **Mandate.** Give core business concepts one authoritative definition, and make sure the numbers survive a PSP migration, a schema change, or a new market launch without silently going wrong. For Trust \& Safety, make it possible to say with confidence how much violating content exists on Scribd and how much of it users see with numbers that stay comparable as moderation models, policies, and review processes change. **Core philosophy.** A metric definition is an engineering artifact. We care about lineage, observability, and data quality as much as the dashboard on top — because a number that quietly breaks upstream is worse than no number at all. **About you** ============= * You are equally comfortable as the modeler and the analyst. You can build the pipeline, define the metric, and defend the number in a room full of executives. * You are skeptical by default. When payment success rate drops four points, your instinct is to go find the field that changed meaning, not to write the narrative. You have opinions about how payments data should be structured to prevent misleading narratives. * You are pragmatic. You ask what the right next version is, and you use AI where it creates measurable value. * You communicate early and plainly, and you write things down. Methodology and model documentation are part of the deliverable. **You will** ============ * **Own the canonical data models for payments, billing, and subscriptions** in Databricks modeled once across Scribd, Everand, and Fable so a new market, or payment method doesn't require a rewrite, and built with the next engineer and the AI tools on top as explicit consumers. * **Own the KPI and semantic layer for payments and identity** exposed through self\-serve dashboaring/AI tools. * **Extend the same discipline to Trust \& Safety**, owning the models and metrics behind prevalence and exposure, including evaluation of AI\-generated moderation labels. * **Drive quality, observability, and lineage** so a regional login challenge rate change or processor routing change is caught in days, not quarters and root\-cause discontinuities to separate real customer or processor behavior from migration artifacts and data quality issues. * **Build AI tools on trusted foundations**, grounded in certified metrics and tables, kept in sync as definitions change, and validated with evaluation sets that prove the answers are right. * **Raise the technical bar**, set modeling and metric conventions, influence source\-system changes before they land, and mentor analysts and analytics engineers in these domains. **You have** ============ *  ross LATAM, APAC, or EU markets, and with stored\-credential and network compliance frameworks. * Experience with on\-call rotations and incident response for production data systems. \- At Scribd, Inc., your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location. San Francisco is our highest geographic market in the United States. jobs.title: SAP Developer
jobs.description: **Overview** We are seeking a dynamic and highly skilled SAP Developer to join our innovative technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining SAP\-based solutions that drive operational excellence and business growth. Your expertise will help optimize enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, streamline processes, and support digital transformation initiatives. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies and contribute to impactful projects in a fast\-paced environment. **Duties** * Develop, customize, and implement SAP modules to meet specific business requirements, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, analyze system needs, and translate them into scalable SAP solutions. * Design and develop APIs, web services, and interfaces using RESTful API standards to facilitate communication between SAP and other enterprise applications. * Maintain and enhance backend systems by writing efficient code in languages such as ABAP (Advanced Business Application Programming), Java, C\#, and JavaScript. * Conduct system design activities utilizing UML diagrams to visualize architecture and workflows for scalable system development. * Perform unit testing, debugging, and troubleshooting to ensure high\-quality deliverables while adhering to SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) best practices. * Implement CI/CD pipelines for continuous integration and deployment using tools like GitHub, TFS (Team Foundation Server), or Jenkins to accelerate development cycles. * Support cloud infrastructure deployment on platforms such as AWS or Azure, ensuring robust security and scalability for enterprise applications. * Develop front\-end UI components with frameworks like React, Angular, or Bootstrap to create intuitive user experiences aligned with modern web development standards. * Engage in Agile software development methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban to promote iterative progress and team collaboration. **Experience** * Proven experience in SAP development roles with a strong understanding of SAP modules such as FI/CO, MM, SD, or HANA. * Extensive knowledge of application design principles including system architecture, distributed systems, microservices architecture, and system design for scalability. * Hands\-on experience with front\-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Angular, and Bootstrap for UI development. * Proficiency in backend development using.NET (C\#), Java EE/Spring Boot, Python or Ruby on Rails for developing robust server\-side applications. * Strong understanding of relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle PL/SQL; experience with NoSQL databases like MongoDB is a plus. * Familiarity with version control systems including GitHub, SVN (Subversion), TFS (Team Foundation Server), supporting collaborative code management. * Knowledge of software engineering best practices including UML modeling, application design patterns (OOP), unit testing frameworks, and debugging techniques. * Experience working within Agile environments utilizing tools like Jira or Azure DevOps to manage project workflows efficiently. * Ability to design RESTful APIs and web services using SOAP/WCF protocols for secure data exchange across distributed systems. * Exposure to cloud infrastructure management on platforms such as AWS or Azure for deploying scalable enterprise solutions. Join us if you're passionate about leveraging your SAP expertise combined with modern web technologies to create innovative solutions that transform business operations! Pay: $70\.00 \- $80\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

native SaaS/PaaS offerings. * Maintain overall industry knowledge on the latest trends and technology and demonstrate forward thinking around how technology can support the organizational direction. \- Exchange Online, MS Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint Online, Intune, \& other Office 365 services. * Expert in Azure governance, Express Route, Site Recovery, S2S VPN devices, Azure Monitor, RBAC, virtual network and subscription peering. * Ability to create scripts in PowerShell, VBS, Python, Ansible and similar languages. * Infrastructure automation through Terraform, Ansible, Python, source control tools (GIT/GitHub/GitLab), Serverless Functions * Working level knowledge of, networking, virtualization, SAN, and related technologies. * Deep understanding of Active Directory architecture, Sites \& Services, DNS, DHCP, and cloud services integration **A solid understanding of most of the following** * Networking \- WAF (Web Application Firewall), NSGs (Network Security Groups), Azure oral and written communication skills. * Technical Certification in Cloud preferred. jobs.title: Manager - Cyber Security
jobs.description: **Job Description** A major professional services firm is seeking a freelance Security Engineering Manager with strong technical expertise in application security, threat modelling, and emerging AI security technologies. In this role, you will work closely with Engineering teams and the central security team to identify and assess technical risks, drive security remediation, and strengthen the security of AI\-powered systems and applications. **Key Responsibilities** * Assess technical risks, threats, vulnerabilities, and potential exploits in collaboration with the central team responsible for security tools and capabilities. * Partner with Engineering teams to identify, prioritise, and drive remediation of security issues. * Conduct deep technical investigations into application, infrastructure, and AI security risks. * Support the implementation of security controls and best practices throughout the engineering lifecycle. * Develop threat models for local model deployments and AI\-enabled systems. * Evaluate emerging AI security risks, including agentic workflows and autonomous AI systems. * Apply experience with frontier AI models and AI\-assisted security tools, such as Claude Code security scanning, to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities. * Collaborate across Security and Engineering teams to improve security processes and reduce technical risk. **Skills and Experience** * Strong technical background in security engineering, application security, or a related field. * Experience with vulnerability assessment, threat analysis, and security remediation. * Ability to work closely with engineers to translate security findings into practical technical solutions. * Understanding of AI security, frontier models, and the risks associated with local model deployments. * Familiarity with threat modelling for agentic systems and AI\-driven workflows. * Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to operate across technical teams. Pay: $5,000\.00 \- $15,000\.00 per month Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10040

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist, Operations Research
jobs.description: The Lead Data Scientist, Operations Research leads optimization, forecasting and decision modeling for Sensata's operations, starting with Supply Chain and extending to Procurement and Engineering. The role turns complex problems in inventory, planning, scheduling and cost into production models that change how planners, buyers and engineers make decisions. It also sets the data science standards for operations AI use cases. scalable cloud infrastructure, developer environments, and foundational services that support our growing platform * Improve observability, monitoring, and operational tooling to make our systems easier to debug, maintain, and operate * Develop reusable frameworks, infrastructure components, and self\-service tooling that reduce manual work and accelerate development * Partner closely with decisions that balance reliability, scalability, and developer experience ### **What you have done:** * Spent 5\+ years building and scaling backend software, infrastructure, or platform systems in deployment systems, and production environments * Designed and implemented reliable, maintainable software that improves how other engineers build, test, deploy, or operate applications * Led technical projects end to end, from architecture and implementation through rollout, adoption, and ongoing maintenance * Collaborated across engineering teams to understand developer pain points and self\-service tooling adopted by multiple engineering teams * You've improved engineering velocity through faster deployments, more reliable CI/CD pipelines, or reduced operational overhead * You've worked extensively with AWS, serverless architectures, infrastructure as code, or cloud\-native systems * You've implemented observability, monitoring, or incident management tooling that improved production reliability * You've worked in mid\- or growth\-stage startups (Series A–C) where infrastructure and developer tooling needed to evolve alongside rapid product development * You've measured the success of your work through developer adoption, deployment frequency, system reliability, or improvements in engineering efficiency ### **The Interview Process** **We aim to complete the
