jobs.title: Infrastructure and Network Engineer
jobs.description: **State Bar of Wisconsin is seeking an Infrastructure and Network Engineer (hybrid position)** The State Bar of Wisconsin is in search of an experienced Infrastructure and Network Engineer to support and maintain our network, servers, virtualization environment, Microsoft 365 services, and cybersecurity infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be an energetic, self\-starter who can complete projects and tasks with little day\-to\-day direction. We are looking for someone who will thrive in a small IT shop, loves to learn, and will take ownership and get it done. This person will also value excellent customer service and collaboration equally with technical elegance and skill. \*Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Relocation assistance is not available. **Who We Are** The State Bar of Wisconsin is a professional association, created by the Wisconsin Supreme Court, for all attorneys who hold a Wisconsin law license. With more than 25,000 members, the State Bar exists to serve its members and the public by promoting the law and access to justice. We aid the courts in improving the administration of justice, provide continuing legal education and other services for our members, support the education of law students, and educate the public about the legal system. The State Bar of Wisconsin also provides public services \-\- such as attorney referrals and public education – and supports programs that provide reduced\-fee legal assistance for low\-income state residents. **What You Will Love** * The people, the culture and the flexible work environment! We care about our people, our work, and our members. We value work/life balance and offer excellent benefits and flexibility to support our employees and their families. Once trained, this position is eligible to work from home up to 3 days per week while working in the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. * Working with a mission\-driven organization that acts with integrity, promotes justice, and works toward a fair and just legal system. * Variety in your job! You’ll have the opportunity to work with a variety of technologies and tools to lay the foundation for the future. * Working with a collaborative, small IT team where you will be challenged and have autonomy to make impactful decisions. No two days will be the same and you will thrive in a dynamic, changing environment. **What You Will Do** * Support and maintain Microsoft Hyper\-V and SCVMM, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and related infrastructure. * Support Cisco switching, wireless, VLANs, VPN, routing, and network connectivity. * Monitor and troubleshoot network, server, virtualization, storage, and infrastructure issues. * Support Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, MFA, and identity services. * Assist with Cisco security technologies, including ISE and Umbrella, and support F5 application delivery and security infrastructure. * Perform system maintenance, patching, upgrades, configuration changes, and infrastructure lifecycle activities. * Assist with cybersecurity monitoring, vulnerability remediation, endpoint security, and incident response. * Support backup, recovery, and disaster recovery systems and testing. * Provide Tier 2 technical support for escalated infrastructure, network, authentication, and security issues. * Maintain network diagrams, system documentation, configurations, and technical procedures. * Participate in infrastructure, cloud, networking, virtualization, and cybersecurity projects. * Coordinate with vendors, consultants, and managed service providers. **What We Are Looking For** * Two\-year degree in computer science or equivalent work experience in network administration. Bachelor’s degree preferred. * 3–5 years of experience in network administration, systems administration, infrastructure support, or a related IT role. * Experience supporting Windows Server and Active Directory. * Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, switching, routing, VPNs, firewalls, and wireless networking. * Experience supporting Microsoft 365 and Entra ID. * Experience with Hyper\-V, VMware, or another enterprise virtualization platform. * Working knowledge of cybersecurity and endpoint security fundamentals. * Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills. * Experience in gathering and analyzing business requirements * Project management experience * Experience with any of the following is beneficial but not required: Microsoft Hyper\-V, SCVMM, Intune, Cisco Networking, Cisco ISE, Cisco Umbrella, F5, Enterprise Storage and Backup/Disaster Recovery, HPE Servers * Relevant certifications such as CCNA, Microsoft, CompTIA Network\+, Security\+, or similar are a plus. **Compensation and Benefits** The State Bar of Wisconsin offers competitive compensation with annual merit increases and excellent benefits including: * 3 weeks of paid vacation per year * 2 weeks of paid sick time per year * Excellent and low\-cost health and dental insurance * Fully paid life and long\-term disability insurance * 2 weeks paid parental leave * 10 paid holidays plus 2 personal days * Hybrid work schedules and flexibility * 8% 401(k) contribution!! * The State Bar is also a “qualified employer” for the federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. **How To Apply** To apply, visit www.wisbar.org/careers to upload your resume and cover letter. This position will be posted until it is filled but priority will be given to applicants who submit early, so don’t wait. Apply today! **The State Bar of Wisconsin is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a fair, merit\-based hiring process. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds and seek to create a supportive, welcoming environment for all. Candidates who share these values are encouraged to apply.** Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * What are your salary requirements? Work Location: Hybrid remote in Madison, WI 53718

The focus is on ML systems engineering, architecture, and productionization rather than developing predictive models from scratch.* ML Architecture \& Engineering: Design and build scalable, production\-grade ML systems, APIs, feature pipelines, and reusable engineering components. * Decisioning \& Recommendation Engines: Architect real\-time or near\-real\-time decisioning systems integrating predictive models, business rules, eligibility, prioritization, and optimization. * Closed\-Loop Learning: Build feedback mechanisms that capture customer interactions and business outcomes to continuously improve recommendations. * Databricks \& AWS Engineering: Develop reliable data and ML pipelines using Python, PySpark, SQL, Databricks, and AWS. * MLOps: Implement model deployment, serving, versioning, monitoring, CI/CD, and retraining workflows. * Agentic AI: Architect and develop production\-grade agentic AI applications, including LLM orchestration, tool integration, evaluation, and guardrails. * Technical Leadership: Lead architecture decisions, establish engineering standards, mentor engineers, and collaborate across technical and business teams. Qualifications: Required* 10\+ years of experience in ML engineering, software engineering, or related technical disciplines, with demonstrated technical leadership. * Programming: Expert\-level Python and strong SQL skills; experience with APIs, microservices, and production software development. * Data Engineering: Expert\-level PySpark and Apache Spark; experience building reliable data and feature pipelines. * Cloud \& ML Platforms: Deep hands\-on Databricks expertise (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows) and strong AWS experience (S3, IAM, compute, and application integration). * ML Engineering \& MLOps: Experience supporting the full production ML lifecycle, including model integration, deployment, serving, monitoring, versioning, and retraining. Familiarity with MLflow and CI/CD. * Real\-Time Decisioning: Experience building low\-latency inference services, decisioning APIs, and scalable recommendation systems. * Agentic AI: Hands\-on experience developing LLM\-powered or agentic AI applications, including orchestration, tool calling, and enterprise integrations. * System Architecture: Proven ability to independently architect and deliver complex, reliable enterprise systems. Preferred* Hands\-on experience developing or training ML models. * Experience building Next Best Action, recommendation, personalization, or decision optimization platforms. * Familiarity with contextual bandits, reinforcement learning, uplift modeling, or ranking algorithms. * Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or similar agentic AI frameworks. * Experience in insurance, financial services, or other regulated industries. Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week!* Potential starting salary range: $150,000 \- $198,000 (Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience. High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience.) * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!*** Get Paid! State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in\-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! * Develop and Grow! With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! * Give Back! jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ Application Engineer Department: IT Enterprise Applications Advertised Salary Range: Part/Full Time: Full Time About UofSC From the Upstate to the Lowcountry, the University of South Carolina system is transforming the lives of South Carolinians through the impact of our eight institutions and 20 locations throughout the state. More than 50,000 students are enrolled at one of eight institutions, including the research campus in Columbia and comprehensive four\-year universities in Aiken, Upstate and Beaufort. In addition, our Palmetto College campuses in Salkehatchie, Union, Lancaster and Sumter enable students to earn associate or bachelor's degrees through a combination of in\-person, online or blended learning. All of our system institutions place strong emphasis on service — helping to build healthier, more educated communities in South Carolina and beyond. Inclusive Excellence Statement Advertised Job Summary The University of South Carolina is searching for a talented Application Engineer to help design, support, and evolve the systems that keep our institution running. If you're passionate about building reliable, scalable, and integrated application environments—and want your work to make a real impact across a major university—this is the role for you. As an Application Engineer, you'll play a critical role in maintaining, designing, and integrating the University's enterprise application infrastructure. You will help ensure the stability, performance, and scalability of applications that support daily operations across diverse environments and platforms. You'll collaborate closely with IT teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors to deliver secure, reliable, and efficient technology solutions—all aligned with USC's strategic goals. Your work will directly enhance the digital experience of students, faculty, and staff across the university system. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Sweet James Accident Attorneys is a rapidly growing, AI\-powered personal injury firm based in Orange County, CA. In less than a decade, we've built a nationally recognized brand and a proprietary AI and automation stack that make us one of the largest and most efficient providers of legal services in the country. Our growth runs on a culture of excellence, compassion, and results: Our team is committed to exceptional client experience and to supporting one another in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. We invest in our people, encourage professional growth, and provide meaningful opportunities to build rewarding careers while making a real impact in our clients' lives. The role Technology is how we practice law, not a department beside it. We have built a highly automated, AI\-forward experience for every client\-facing role, from intake to settlement, and it is one of the leading examples of applied AI in the legal field: Our case teams run at a fraction of the headcount our largest peers need for the same work. The systems behind that result are built in\-house, and you will be one of the people building them. Sweet James is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to own AI features end to end: Learn the work from the people who do it, build the system, measure it, ship it, and run it in production. The systems you will work on read and file documents, pull facts from medical records and police reports, answer questions across a case's full history, and run agents that chase records and draft routine work for staff to approve. You will report to the Lead AI Engineer, who sets the architecture and build plan; you own delivery within it. This is an individual\-contributor seat for someone who drives work forward with urgency and high quality without waiting to be told how, and whose work reaches case teams within weeks, not quarters. Responsibilities * Build: Ship production AI features, including structured extraction, classification and routing, case search, and agents that act with a person approving the result. * Integrate: Connect those features to the firm's systems (e.g., Salesforce/Litify, Microsoft Graph for Outlook and SharePoint, Zoom, Twilio, Retell, DocuSign). * Measure: Build the evaluation sets and tests for your features so every model or prompt change is measured on facts captured, facts missed, wrong answers, cost, and speed before it ships. * Run: Deploy your services as containers on Azure, monitor them, and fix them when they break. * Learn and train: Sit with intake, case management, records, and litigation staff before automating their work, and train them on what you ship. * Document: Write each system down so anyone on the team can run it. Qualifications Required: * Experience: 5\+ years building production software, including 2\+ years shipping LLM\-powered features to real users. * Ownership: A record of taking ambiguous problems to shipped outcomes with little supervision, and of finishing what you start. * LLM craft: Hands\-on work with LLM APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI) spanning prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, retrieval, and evaluation. * Stack: Strong Python or TypeScript/Node (both preferred), SQL and Postgres, REST APIs and webhooks, Git, Docker, and cloud deployment (Azure preferred). * Communication: Care with sensitive data and the ability to explain technical work in plain language. Preferred: * Models and tooling: Vector search (e.g., pgvector), evaluation frameworks, and agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol. * Workflow automation: Platforms such as n8n. * Salesforce: APIs and SOQL; Litify a plus. * Voice: Voice AI or telephony (e.g., Retell, Twilio, Zoom). * Documents and industry: OCR and document processing; legal, insurance, or healthcare data Sweet James is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act and applicable local law. Stay safe: We will never ask for payment or banking information during the hiring process. Questions? Contact careers@sweetjames.com

jobs.title: SR MGR MACHINE DEVELOPMENT ENGINEERING
jobs.description: AI and the rapid evolution of data\-center infrastructure are creating new challenges in optical connectivity and the precision manufacturing equipment required to produce it at scale. We are looking for a machine design engineering leader who can convert complex manufacturing requirements into key precision equipment (enabling co\-packaged optics in AI) that performs reliably, repeatedly, and at production scale. As Senior Manager, Machine Design Engineering, you will lead and develop the Machine Design Engineering team while strengthening machine architecture and equipment\-platform capabilities. You will guide equipment from requirements and architecture through development, validation, production release, factory ramp, and continuous improvement. This is an opportunity for a leader who has shipped complex production equipment, learned through challenging launches, and knows how to turn successful machine designs into controlled, repeatable platforms. You will lead a team of highly capable technical leaders with deep expertise and strong points of view, and your job is to point that energy at the problems that matter most while keeping the team disciplined, decisive, and delivering. This is a high impact role enabling the most critical process. **Job Requirements** -------------------- * Lead the architecture, development, integration, validation, release, and lifecycle improvement of complex precision manufacturing equipment. * Establish equipment architecture, platform standards, and release practices that enable repeatable deployment and continuous learning across equipment generations. * Drive equipment toward safety, micron\-level performance, repeatability, process capability, throughput, yield, reliability, serviceability, and production readiness, using structured experimentation to separate machine variation from process variation and working with the process engineering team to stabilize the process. * Own the sensing, metrology, and calibration capabilities designed into the machine, and partner with the software team on controls, algorithms, and machine software, to enable closed\-loop, data\-rich automation. * Create disciplined equipment\-development and release practices, including controlled designs, bills of materials, software, validation evidence, and acceptance criteria. * Lead and develop the Advanced Machine Design Engineering team, strengthening technical depth, engineering leadership, execution discipline, and the ability to translate factory learning into better equipment and platforms. * Channel a team of strong, independent\-minded technical leaders: encourage rigorous technical debate, drive it to clear and timely decisions, and set the tempo by defining what "good enough" looks like at each stage and by when, so the team commits and executes once direction is set. **Core Competencies** * Precision Machine Development: Translates manufacturing and process requirements into robust machine architectures and production\-ready equipment. * Equipment Architecture and Industrialization: Develops scalable equipment platforms and moves complex machines from concept through production release and factory ramp. * Metrology, Calibration, and Controls Integration: Designs sensing, metrology, and calibration into the machine and partners with the software team on controls, algorithms, and machine software to deliver intelligent, closed\-loop manufacturing systems. * Cross\-Disciplinary Systems Leadership: Connects precision mechanics, motion, robotics, vision, controls, software, tooling, and inspection into integrated equipment solutions. * Leading Strong Technical Leaders: Sets technical direction, earns the respect of experts through technical credibility, turns strong opinions into shared priorities and clear decisions, develops engineering talent, and builds capability for increasingly complex equipment challenges. * Execution Discipline and Tempo: Sets clear priorities, decision rights, and dated definitions of done; holds leaders to commitments without stifling their technical judgment; resolves conflict quickly and directly. **What your background should look like** ----------------------------------------- * Hands\-on precision machine design experience, followed by experience leading and developing engineering teams that design precision machines, including senior, highly capable technical leaders, with the ability to set direction, turn strong debate into clear decisions, build capability, and hold technical leaders accountable for commitments and pace. * Proven ability to take complex production equipment from requirements and architecture through design, build, integration, debug, acceptance testing, validation, release, factory ramp, and lifecycle improvement. * Deep expertise in precision mechanical or optomechanical machine design, with systems\-level depth in related areas such as motion, robotics, machine vision, sensing, automated inspection, machine metrology, tooling, and machine safety, and enough fluency in controls, software, and algorithms to make sound architecture tradeoffs with the software team. * Process\-physics understanding and the ability to translate process windows into equipment architecture and controls, with strong design of experiments (DOE) capability, including measurement system analysis and machine capability studies, used to characterize, center, and stabilize a process, demonstrated in precision assembly, fiber or optical processes, or other similarly demanding manufacturing environments. **Experience** -------------- * Optics experience is valuable, but not required. Strong candidates may come from custom machine builders, semiconductor equipment, robotics and precision automation, medical or life\-science automation, photonics equipment, industrial laser systems, automated inspection and metrology, or other high\-complexity capital\-equipment environments. * Preferred experience may include optical packaging, fiber attach, fiber\-array assemblies, micro\-optics, active or passive alignment, photonic\-device assembly, precision optomechanical systems, modular equipment platforms, equipment replication, new\-site launches, line architecture, machine software and algorithm development, machine metrology and calibration, or configuration\-controlled equipment releases. **Education** ------------- * Minimum of 13 years of experience with a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Optical, Industrial, Automation/Controls, Mechatronics, Software, or a related engineering field. An advanced degree is preferred. **ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY** TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next\-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more. Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter). **COMPENSATION** * Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $160,600\- $240,800 (subject to change dependent on physical location) * Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity. * Total Compensation \= Base Salary \+ Incentive(s) \+ Benefits **BENEFITS** * A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits. **EOE, Including Disability/Vets** **IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD** TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity **never requests payment or fees** from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come **only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com**. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities. **Job Locations:** 780 Salt Road Webster, New York 14580\-9709 United States Posting City: Webster Job Country: United States Travel Required: 10% to 25% Requisition ID: 160810 Workplace Type: Onsite External Careers Page: Engineering \& Technology

jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer
jobs.description: **Forward Deployment Technician** Milwaukee, WI (home\-based, with frequent US travel) **About the role** Technova Industries is a startup building Nova Vision, an AI\-powered vision automation platform for supply chain operations. As our Forward Deployment Technician, you’ll take each deployment from the first technical call to a working system the customer can use. You’ll get the hardware wired, networked and running at the customer’s facility, and stay with it until it works. Our founders and engineering team handle the software and AI. You handle the field. **Location and travel** You’ll live in the Milwaukee area. Expect regular travel to customer sites across the US, often on short notice. Travel expenses are covered. **What you’ll do** *Project design and feasibility* * Join early technical calls to assess what’s feasible: site layout, camera placement, network and power constraints. * Work with our sales and customer success team to scope projects and flag risks before we commit to a timeline or price. * Bring what you learn in the field back into how we design the next project. *Network and IT setup* * Gather IT requirements from customer IT teams: network access, VLANs, QoS, VPN and IP addresses. * Configure devices and connect them to customer networks, wired, Wi\-Fi and remote. * Set up and test hardware before the visit. *On\-site installation* * Install and wire cameras, badge readers, gate\-arm beams, I/O modules and forklift\-mounted units, or direct the electricians and day labor who do. * Work out power with the customer, such as battery versus forklift wiring. * Test until trigger, timing and data are reliable, then leave the system running. *Support and handover* * Train the customer and be their first call for technical issues. * Troubleshoot on site and remotely, and escalate software issues to engineering. * Document every install so the next one is faster. **What we’re looking for** This is not a desk job, and it’s not a fixed list of tasks. You’ll be a good fit if you: * Want to be in the field: warehouses, distribution centers, maintenance shops. * Like puzzles and enjoy figuring out why something isn’t working. * Are curious and learn fast. * Are comfortable in a startup, where priorities shift and you may need to take on something new on short notice. * Want to build something new and grow with the company. If you want a job description you can follow line by line, this isn’t the right role. If you want to help build something, it might be. **Required** * Willing to travel often, on short notice. * Technical background in computer science, software or IT, formal or self\-taught. * Networking skills: configuration, VLANs, VPN, IP addressing. * Some electrical and IoT skills: wiring, power, sensors, I/O modules. * Clear explanations of technical topics to non\-technical people, in writing and out loud. * A support mindset: patient and dependable with customers and with our sales and customer success team. You’ll give technical input to sales, but this is not a sales role. * Lives in the Milwaukee area or can relocate before the start date. **Nice to have** * Interest in agentic AI. * Experience with industrial cameras, badge or access control, or warehouse and yard equipment. * Linux or edge devices * Experience working with electricians, contractors or day labor. * Startup experience. **Compensation** Base salary can range from $50\-80k, depending on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to deployment speed and success. We care more about fit than résumé length. **Start date** We’re hiring now and want someone who can join the next deployment window. Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Willingness to travel: * 75% (Required) Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer, Edge Compute
jobs.description: **About Telnyx** *Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a* *private, global, multi\-cloud IP network**, to bringing* *hyperlocal edge* *technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.* *We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real\-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.* *Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry\-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.* **What You Will Do** * Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters across multiple cloud providers and edge locations. * Build and maintain the networking that connects and isolates our edge infrastructure, including VPNs, routing, network policies, and firewalls. * Own infrastructure automation for cluster provisioning, configuration, upgrades, and recovery. * Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform/OpenTofu and configuration management tools such as Ansible. * Build and operate secure runtime environments for customer workloads, including containers, microVMs, and ephemeral sandboxed workloads. * Improve cluster reliability, observability, and capacity as the platform grows across providers and regions. * Build out Prometheus metrics and alerting for infrastructure and platform observability. * Harden workload and network isolation, and help define security boundaries for running untrusted customer code. * Participate in on\-call and troubleshoot problems across Linux, containers, Kubernetes, networking, and cloud infrastructure. **What You Bring** * 1–3\+ years of hands\-on Kubernetes experience in production, including cluster\-level operations and troubleshooting. * Strong Linux and jobs.title: SAP OTC Architect
jobs.description: **About Tessera Labs** ---------------------- Tessera is an AI\-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi\-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera address the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI\-native platform. For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for SAP and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI\-powered, multi\-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English. **Role Summary** ---------------- We are looking for an SAP Order\-to\-Cash Architect to own the OTC domain across several customer engagements at the same time. This is a specialist role, and that is deliberate. Our Principal Solution Architects hold the whole solution; you hold the part of it that most often decides whether a program lands on time — the flow from lead and order capture through pricing, availability, delivery, billing and cash application, and the twenty years of customer\-specific development sitting on top of it. Most of this work is ECC to S/4HANA. Customers come to us with order\-to\-cash estates built up since R/3: pricing routines nobody will touch, user exits in MV45AFZZ that encode rules no one wrote down, custom order types that exist because of a reorganization in 2011, and an output determination setup that only works because of a Z\-program. The job is to tell the difference between a genuine business requirement and an accident of history, and to architect the conversion on that basis — brownfield, selective data transition, or greenfield, and clear\-eyed about what each one costs. You will do that work with Tessera’s AI agents, not instead of them. The platform handles the custom code inventory, the simplification item analysis, the data profiling and a large share of the conversion and reconciliation work. What it cannot do is decide whether a customer genuinely needs four hundred condition tables, or which of six sales document types survives the move. That judgment is the role. Every time you exercise it, we expect it to go back into the platform so the agents are better at it on the next engagement. Two outcomes define the job. The first is a target\-state order\-to\-cash design the customer’s own architects will defend after we step back. The second is that their sales operations, logistics and billing teams use what we built rather than rebuilding the workarounds they had before. The second is what makes the first durable, and it is the measure you will be held to. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **1\. Order\-to\-Cash Solution Ownership (40%)** * Own the functional and architectural direction of the order\-to\-cash domain on several concurrent engagements — Sales, Pricing, Availability, Logistics Execution, Billing and Accounts Receivable, together with the credit, tax, revenue and collections processes that hang off them. * Design the target state and the route to it, including the trade\-offs between what the customer asked for, what their current system does, and what will actually create value. * Set the standard for the build: review functional specifications, define the conversion, reconciliation and cutover approach for OTC data and open documents, and hold architectural integrity through delivery rather than signing off and leaving. * Work directly with Forward Deployed Engineers, Tessera AI agents and customer architects, and be the person who can answer an OTC question without scheduling a follow\-up. * Own the integration surface out of OTC — EDI and IDoc flows, tax engines, payment and banking, CRM and commerce front ends, transportation and warehouse systems, downstream finance — and say early when a dependency will not hold. * Be the counterpart our Technical Program Managers come to first on order\-to\-cash, and get a straight answer from. ### **2\. ECC to S/4HANA Assessment and Conversion Architecture (25%)** * Lead order\-to\-cash discovery on ECC estates: custom code and enhancement inventory, interface mapping, data quality, process debt, and what each of those is costing the business today. * Own the SD\-relevant simplification items end to end — credit management moving to SAP Credit Management, rebates to Settlement Management, SD revenue recognition to Revenue Accounting, foreign trade to GTS, output management to BRF\+, the retired status and pri enior client\-facing presence: able to hold a room of customer architects, business owners and finance stakeholders, and to say no to a customer in a way that keeps the relationship. * A record of driving adoption, not just go\-live — evidence that the customer’s teams kept using what you delivered. * Proven ability to work on several engagements at once without losing control of any of them. * Proven ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and become the person others ask. You will be expected to reach real fluency in the Tessera platform within your first months. * Excellent verbal and written business English, with strong presentation ability to both business and technical audiences. * Experience working with distributed (onshore, nearshore and offshore) delivery teams, with strong asynchronous communication discipline. * Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Who This Role Is Not For** ---------------------------- If your order\-to\-cash experience is running support tickets and minor enhancements on a stable ECC instance, this is not the role — the work here is architectural and most of it is change. If you have breadth across SAP but have never owned the SD configuration and data model end to end, you would be better placed as a Principal Solution Architect, and we hire for that separately. And if you want one engagement at a time with a scope someone else agreed, you will find this uncomfortable. jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer II
jobs.description: **Position:** Infrastructure Engineer II **Job Code:** **Business Unit:** Corporate Shared Services / IT **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Reports to:** VP, Infrastructure **Supervisory Role:** No **Location:** Anaheim, CA **Salary Range:** **Bonus:** Yes **Incentive:** No **About The Change Company** ---------------------------- We take our mission to bank the underbanked seriously, fairly and responsibly. We bring digital\-first banking, lending, and financial services to underserved communities, transforming the financial landscape. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- We are a diverse, inclusive, and entrepreneurial organization that values collaboration, innovation, and customer focus. Our experienced leadership team drives growth and long\-term success while serving tens of thousands of customers through responsible lending and banking solutions. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- We have an experienced leadership team who have served in various fintech, banking and lending industries. We are a Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) serving 50,000\+ borrowers with over $10 Billion in loans since our CDFI certification. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Join us in building modern, data\-driven platforms that power financial inclusion and innovation. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **About the Role** ------------------ The Infrastructure Engineer II reports directly to the VP, Infrastructure and shares day\-to\-day ownership of the platform our lending business runs on: our Cato Networks SASE fabric and Cisco and Meraki campus network, our identity estate across Okta SSO, Entra ID, and Active Directory, our co\-located data center and virtualization footprint, and the controls that protect borrower non\-public personal information (NPI). This is a hands\-on individual contributor role on a small team. You will own defined areas outright and run changes end to end — design, validation, rollback plan, and documentation — while the VP and senior engineers set overall architecture and review the higher\-risk work. We are looking for someone who has already operated production infrastructure, brings an automation\-first instinct, and has the judgment to know which changes need a second pair of eyes in a regulated, examined environment. **Essential Job Duties / Responsibilities** ------------------------------------------- **Network Infrastructure** * Own day\-to\-day operation of the Cato Networks SASE platform — site and socket health, internet and firewall access policy, ZTNA rules for remote users, and traffic and bandwidth analysis — and design and implement policy changes with peer review. * Own configuration and lifecycle of Cisco and Meraki switching across the colocation facility and corporate offices: VLAN and trunk design, stacking, PoE, port security, firmware currency, and routing changes (BGP, OSPF, and inter\-VLAN) including planning, validation, and rollback. * Own the Meraki wireless environment end to end — site surveys and access point placement, SSID and RADIUS design, channel and power tuning, client troubleshooting, and firmware lifecycle. * Own DNS, DHCP, and IPAM as authoritative records and manage the certificate lifecycle; troubleshoot at the packet level using Cato and Meraki analytics alongside switch\-level captures. * Manage carrier circuits, cross\-connects, last\-mile providers, and bandwidth capacity planning; drive carrier escalations to resolution and evaluate circuit changes against cost and redundancy. **Voice and Collaboration** * Own the Vonage cloud VoIP platform — user and extension provisioning, call flow and IVR design, ring groups, voicemail, device lifecycle for desk phones and softphones, and E911 record accuracy. * Diagnose call quality end to end across LAN QoS, Cato WAN policy, and carrier\-side issues, and drive Vonage support cases through to root cause. **Identity, Single Sign\-On, and Directory Services** * Own Okta administration — application assignments, group and app rules, sign\-on and MFA policies, Okta Verify, and lifecycle rules for joiners, movers, and leavers — and improve those rules rather than only executing them. * Lead SSO onboarding for new applications end to end: SAML and OIDC integration, attribute mapping, SCIM or just\-in\-time provisi ability at a level where you automate real work — parameterized scripts with error handling, not just one\-liners. * Practical security engineering habits: segmentation, patch and vulnerability management, access control, and participation in real incidents. * Availability for on\-call rotation, after\-hours change windows, and incident escalation. * Clear written communication — runbooks, change records, and diagrams, and the ability to explain technical risk and tradeoffs to non\-technical business leaders. * Comfort planning and executing your own change windows, including validation and rollback, and the judgment to know which changes need senior review. * Understanding of the mortgage industry, or of another regulated environment, and the handling requirements for borrower NPI. * Production experience administering a hypervisor platform — VMware vSphere, Hyper\-V, or both — including clusters, storage, patching, and capacity, plus ownership of enterprise backup and restore testing. * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience. **Preferred** * Experience in mortgage, banking, or another regulated financial services environment. * Professional\- or specialty\-level certification such as CCNP Enterprise, Microsoft SC\-300 or MS\-102, Okta Certified Administrator, VMware VCP\-DCV, or CompTIA Security\+. * Hands\-on experience with the platforms we run: Okta, Cato Networks, Cisco and Meraki, VMware vSphere, Hyper\-V, Druva, LogicMonitor, or Vonage. * Configuration management and automation tooling — Ansible, Microsoft Intune, or Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager. * Microsoft 365 workload administration — Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams. * Experience leading a discrete infrastructure project end to end: a switch refresh, a colocation move, an SSO migration, or a backup platform change. * Experience serving as a technical contact during SOC 2, GLBA, investor, or warehouse lender examinations. * Scripting against an identity API — Microsoft Graph or the Okta API. * Experience mentoring junior engineers or help desk staff and setting technical standards. * Familiarity with an IT service management platform such as Jira Service Management or ServiceNow. **Physical Demands and Work Environment** ----------------------------------------- The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential job functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to: communicate and accurately exchange information with clients at normal speaking levels; remain standing for sustained periods of time; use hands to finger, grasp, or feel; reach by extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction; have visual acuity to view a laptop, determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned. Working conditions are generally moderate and in an office environment. This position also requires regular work in a colocation data center environment, including racking and cabling equipment, working in cold aisles, and lifting equipment weighing up to 50 pounds, as well as participation in an on\-call rotation with scheduled after\-hours maintenance windows. **Note** -------- This job description is meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required for the position. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, the Company reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks, duties, and responsibilities be performed as assigned, or to otherwise change this job description at any time with or without notice. *The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer, drug free workplace, and complies with ADA and State regulations as applicable.*

jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Live events are fun. Concerts, sporting events, and festivals create memorable lifelong experiences with clients, prospects, partners, friends, and family—and they drive real business impact. Companies spend more than $600 billion each year on client entertainment. TicketManager is the enterprise platform they trust to source, manage, track, and report on live event tickets and hospitality—while maintaining compliance, control, and visibility across the organization. Built at the intersection of live events, technology, and enterprise operations, TicketManager makes client entertainment easy and measurable. Our industry\-leading software supports everything from invitations and event execution to post\-event reporting, helping companies clearly prove ROI and strengthen relationships through unforgettable experiences. TicketManager is trusted by thousands of global brands, including Anheuser\-Busch, Verizon, American Express, Nike, and Visa, as well as Fortune 500 companies, professional sports leagues, and major organizations such as the NBA, NFL, NCAA, and NASCAR. We’re also proud to partner with some of the most iconic teams and venues in sports and entertainment, including the New York Jets, Philadelphia Eagles and Phillies, Capital One Arena, Texas Rangers, LAFC, and Seattle Seahawks, along with more than 50 professional and collegiate teams, franchises, universities, and technology providers. **Why Work at TicketManager** At TicketManager, you’ll help build technology that brings people together through live experiences—while solving complex, real\-world problems for the world’s best companies. We’re a fast\-growing, profitable company that values ownership, collaboration, and excellence, and we’re building a team that’s passionate about making work impactful and fun. If you’re excited about live events, cutting\-edge technology, and doing work that truly matters, you’ll feel right at home here. **The Role** TicketManager is building its AI and automation infrastructure from the ground up, and we are looking for a partner to build it with. As an AI Automation Engineer, you will work directly with the VP of Enterprise Technology \& AI Strategy to turn AI strategy into working systems: n8n workflows, MCP servers, LLM integrations, chat and voice agents, and AI\-driven engineering automation that makes the whole team faster. This is not a role with a fully written roadmap. Requirements are fluid, projects range from a one\-afternoon automation to a multi\-month platform build, and the technology changes monthly. You will break things and fix them faster, stay endlessly curious, and set your own priorities. When the first three approaches fail, you find the fourth, because we believe there is always a way. Your work will directly shape how TicketManager operates, serves customers, and scales. **Responsibilities:*** Build, maintain, and measure workflow automations in n8n across CRM, ERP, support, and fulfillment systems, from first prototype through stable production * Build, maintain, and measure custom MCP servers that connect Claude and other models to internal systems and data * Build and manage integrations with Claude, Gemini, and other model APIs, including prompt engineering and structured outputs * Design agentic workflows where AI takes multi\-step actions autonomously, and instrument them so we know when they work and when they don't * Build and maintain voice and chat agents for sales and support, and own the development of a full in\-app chatbot * Use AI CLI tools such as Claude Code and Codex daily, and automate code review, testing, QA, and release pipelines * Work with data lakes on AWS and Azure to keep AI systems fed with clean, current data, with security (credential handling, access scoping, audit logging) as a default * Define success metrics before every pilot, track cost, performance, and adoption, and kill what doesn't work fast * Evaluate new models and tools as they appear, and recommend when to adopt, switch, or skip * Present your work to leadership and cross\-functional teams, make the case for the technologies you believe in, and help non\-technical colleagues put them to use **Desired Skills and Experience:*** Bachelor's Degree required; MS in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or a relevant field is preferred * 1\-3 years of hands\-on experience in automation engineering, systems integration, or a closely related technical role * Hands\-on experience with AI CLI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar, and with code automation and AI\-assisted code review and QA * Real experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, or comparable orchestration tools, plus working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON * Familiarity with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, or similar) and prompt engineering fundamentals * A track record of solving problems nobody handed you a clean answer for; comfortable with fluid requirements and setting your own priorities * Strong communication skills: you can present an idea and persuade others to adopt a technology or approach * Visible evidence of constant learning, such as side projects and experiments you built to teach yourself * Nice to have: experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), or building chat and voice agents (VAPI, Deep Chat, assistant\-ui, or similar) * Nice to have: Python or JavaScript, CI/CD and release automation (GitHub Actions or similar), AWS or Azure data lakes, RAG and vector databases **TicketManager Highlights:*** **Location:** Calabasas, CA (HQ) * **Compensation:** $95,000 \- $125,000 base salary \+ Variable Compensation * **Reports to:** VP, Enterprise Technology \& AI Strategy * **Work** **Expectations**: Role is In\-Office, Monday\-Friday * **Retirement:** 401(k) \& Company Match * **Health Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision \& Chiropractic * **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO * **Interview Process:** Multistage interview process with senior leaders across TicketManager to ensure strong alignment on role scope and expectations. * **Events:** Quarterly live event credits (we practice what we preach!), monthly happy hours, and volunteering * **Perks:** Fun, collaborative, in\-office culture at our HQ with catered lunches and big company perks with the autonomy of a high\-growth startup * **Recognition:** Inc. 5000 fastest\-growing private company by Inc. Magazine six years in a row. Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work by Inc. Magazine, The LA Business Journal, and Sports Business Journal * 4\.5 out of 5 Glassdoor rating * Used by over 4,000 globally known companies including \~15% of the Fortune 500 BeVi1QHdDC

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Join an award\-winning company!** **Who are we?** Since 1967, Toll Brothers has been building luxury homes and communities in the best locations in the U.S. Today, we’re a Fortune 500 company operating in over 60 markets. We’re the country’s premier luxury builder with the widest range of product offerings and price points in the industry, serving first\-time, move\-up, active\-adult, and second\-home buyers. From the homes we build to the talent we recruit, we know that to be the best, we have to work with the best. Toll Brothers is a place where diverse perspectives and experiences are welcomed and where employees of all backgrounds are treated with fairness, dignity and respect. We believe every employee should feel safe to be their true and authentic self at work. Our employees are our family, and we strive to uphold the values that our founders instilled in us, creating an exceptional place to work that is inclusive to all. **Toll Brothers**, America's leading luxury home builder, seeks an **Applied AI Engineer** to join our team at our Corporate office in Fort Washington, Pennsylvania. **What is the opportunity?** The Applied AI Engineer builds the shared systems behind Toll Brothers’ AI products. The role creates the APIs, services, and AI workflows those products depend on, connects them to Salesforce, Snowflake, and other enterprise platforms, and refines them based on usage and feedback. This role reports to the Director, Applied AI. Toll Brothers is a large enterprise with extensive data and established systems, and the Applied AI team is small enough that engineers take features from idea to production. The work spans building retrieval pipelines, debugging enterprise integrations, and shipping workflows that automate processes teams have run manually for years. **What are the primary responsibilities?** * Build and maintain the APIs, backend services, and AI workflows that power internal tools and customer\-facing products * Integrate AI capabilities with Salesforce, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems * Implement prompt chains, retrieval pipelines, and model integrations based on the Applied AI Architect’s designs * Write production\-quality code with proper logging, error handling, and monitoring * Iterate through tight development cycles of prototyping, testing, gathering user feedback, and shipping * Debug complex integrations that span multiple services and data sources * Contribute to code reviews, shared libraries, internal tooling, and documentation * Work directly with Web, Sales, and Operations teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions that fit how those teams work * All other duties as assigned This is an excellent opportunity to join one of the nation's most respected Fortune 500 companies! **Qualifications** ------------------ **Does this describe you?** * Strong builder who delivers working systems quickly and reliably * Resourceful and self\-directed, making progress when documentation is sparse or requirements are still forming * Adapts well to changing requirements, reprioritizes effectively, and maintains momentum * Maintains code quality under time pressure through tests, logging, and clean abstractions * Communicates proactively about timelines, trade\-offs, and blockers, surfacing issues early rather than letting them escalate * Curious about new tools and techniques, and shares what they learn with the rest of the team **Do you have these qualifications?** * Essential: + Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science,Software Engineering, or a related field + 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, primarily in backend development + Strong proficiency in Python or Node.js + Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and building production features that use them + Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with third\-party platforms + Demonstrated ability to deliver end\-to\-end features in production environments * Preferred: + Experience with Salesforce, Snowflake, or similar enterprise platforms + Familiarity with RAG, vector databases, or orchestration frameworks + Cloud infrastructure experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and CI/CD pipelines + Homebuilding, real estate, or construction technology background + Open\-source contributions or a portfolio of shipped projects We offer an excellent compensation and benefits package that includes comprehensive medical/dental, 401(k) with a company match, discounted stock purchase, discounts on mortgages, homes, and much more! **Come see why Toll Brothers has been attracting and retaining some of the best professionals in the industry!** **APPLY ONLINE TODAY!** Toll Brothers is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity. All employment decisions, policies, and practices are in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local anti\-discrimination laws. Toll Brothers will not engage in or tolerate unlawful discrimination (including any form of unlawful harassment) on account of a person's sex (including pregnancy), age, race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender nonconformity, status as a transgender individual, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, family responsibility, armed services, or any other status protected by law.

jobs.description: **Who Are We?** Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it. **Compensation Overview** The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance\-based cash incentive awards. **Salary Range** $139,400\.00 \- $230,000\.00**Target Openings** 1**What Is the Opportunity?** Travelers is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join a cross\-functional, product\-centric team helping Bond \& Specialty Insurance (BSI) evolve through AI\-native development. This role is a builder and the owner of technical vision, shaping product vision together with the product owner and designer, and identifying where AI agents and tooling create the most leverage for the users their product serves. The successful candidate brings demonstrated experience shipping production AI agents and LLM\-powered systems, proficiency with modern agent frameworks and orchestration tooling, and a track record of defining technical direction within a workstream or product area. The individual will complete advanced software engineering tasks end\-to\-end, including designing, developing, testing, debugging, documenting, monitoring, and shipping production AI agents and supporting tooling. The individual will partner with product leadership to define technical specifications, serve as a subject matter expert in agent frameworks and AI\-assisted development, and provide hands\-on technical leadership within the team.**What Will You Do?** * Own the technical vision for your team’s products and shape product vision with the product owner and designer, including supporting data\-driven business cases and collaborating on the roadmap to deliver on them. * Design, build, and ship production AI agents that automate impactful parts of end\-user workflows. * Implement telemetry that supports product decision\-making and reporting. * Work hands\-on with modern agent frameworks, LLM APIs, and orchestration tooling to deliver reliable, production\-grade systems. * Set direction for agent architecture, evaluation, and observability within the team. * Investigate and resolve critical, high\-impact issues affecting agent behavior, accuracy, and reliability in production. * Apply current industry practices in AI, such as tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and prompt engineering. * Engage stakeholders to align a product’s technical strategy with broader engineering goals. * Mentor team members and contribute to a collaborative, cross\-functional team environment. * Continually expand expertise in agent frameworks, AI tooling, and the business domains your team serves. * Perform other responsibilities as assigned. **What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?** * At least one year of experience shipping production systems built on LLMs or AI agents (not prototypes or demos). * Demonstrated experience with modern agent frameworks such as Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, or AgentCore, and with LLM APIs from providers such as Anthropic or OpenAI. * Proficiency with core agent engineering concepts: tool use, retrieval, multi\-step workflows, evaluation, and observability. * Strong software fundamentals, including distributed systems, API design, testing, and CI/CD, applied to AI\-augmented systems. * Experience defining and driving the technical direction of a workstream or product area, not just executing assigned tasks. * Track record of identifying opportunities and influencing engineering or product strategy through technical insight. * Adept at making decisions that involve a significant number of factors with broad implications. * Communication \- Strong communicator who possesses the ability to describe technology concepts in ways the business can understand, document initiatives in a concise and clear manner, collaborate effectively with teammates and others regardless of role, quickly extract core issues from discussions and meetings, give and receive constructive feedback, offer help when asked, and ensure everyone has a chance to share their thoughts and is heard; an attentive and empathetic listener. * Leadership \- Advanced leadership skills with the ability to take action even when there is no clear owner, inspire and motivate others, and be effective at influencing team members. **What is a Must Have?** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience. * 6 additional years of software engineering experience. **What Is in It for You?** * **Health Insurance**: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment. * **Retirement:** Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar\-for\-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers. * **Paid Time Off:** Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays. * **Wellness Program:** The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs. * **Volunteer Encouragement:** We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice. **Employment Practices** Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions. If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you. Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life\-at\-travelers/benefits/.

Working with the CW3E Research Cyberinfrastructure Lead, this person will take the lead on system administration, maintenance, upgrades, deployments, and troubleshooting. AWARE supports both time\-sensitive "near realtime" operational forecasting and research, so system availability and careful planning of changes are important parts of the job. The work covers the full HPC environment, including compute and GPU nodes, Ethernet and InfiniBand networks, parallel storage, cluster management, job scheduling, authentication, monitoring, and data\-transfer services. The engineer will install and integrate new hardware and software, maintain system configurations and automation, monitor performance and capacity, and respond to production problems. They will also coordinate with campus teams and vendors when outside support is needed and maintain documentation for system changes, procedures, and recovery. A significant part of the job involves working directly with researchers and operational workflow managers. The engineer will help troubleshoot jobs, MPI applications, software environments, containers, memory and I/O problems, and CPU/GPU performance. This requires being able to determine whether an issue is coming from the application, software environment, scheduler, network, storage system, or hardware and then work with the appropriate people to resolve it. As a senior member of the group, the engineer will also be expected to share knowledge with other staff. The position requires applicable experience supporting HPC, research computing, or large\-scale Linux systems. Experience with technologies used at CW3E, such as Slurm, InfiniBand, BeeGFS or Lustre, ZFS, MPI, GPU computing, configuration\-management platforms (BCM, xcat), and system\-monitoring \& metric tools (telegraf, influxdb, nagios), is desired but not required. jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Build the Technology Behind Medical Imaging \- This role is not hybrid or remote, must be able to work in office in Bloomingdale, IL location. Are you an experienced embedded software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems at the intersection of firmware, electronics, and motion control? Del Medical is looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to help develop, improve, and support the embedded systems powering our medical imaging equipment. This is an opportunity to take meaningful technical ownership of real\-world products, work closely with electrical and mechanical engineers, and see your engineering solutions move from development into production. What We're Looking For Required qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Typically 7\+ years of professional embedded software or firmware development experience. * Strong proficiency in embedded C and/or C\+\+. * Demonstrated experience with bare\-metal programming and microcontroller\-based systems. * Hands\-on experience debugging electronic hardware and firmware integration issues. * Experience with embedded communication interfaces and protocols. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to independently own technical assignments and deliver maintainable, reliable software. Highly desirable experience: * Motor control, motion\-control systems, encoders, feedback loops, or real\-time control. * Medical devices, diagnostic imaging, industrial controls, or other reliability\-critical products. * Altium Designer, PCB development, and electronic schematic interpretation. * RTOS development, firmware update mechanisms, automated testing, or hardware diagnostics. * Familiarity with medical\-device software lifecycle, risk management, verification, and quality requirements. What Makes This Opportunity Different? * Meaningful technical ownership: Contribute directly to embedded systems used in medical imaging equipment. * Hands\-on engineering: Work with actual electronics, firmware, motors, and integrated systems. * Cross\-disciplinary collaboration: Work alongside electrical, mechanical, and product engineering professionals. * Visible impact: Help improve product functionality, reliability, and serviceability. * Competitive compensation: Earn $100,000–$150,000 annually based on demonstrated expertise. Benefits: * Competitive salary based on experience and knowledge * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * STD, LTD, Life and AD\&D Insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with company match. * Paid time off, including holidays and vacation. * Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. Who Will Succeed Here? You are a hands\-on engineer who enjoys understanding how systems work, diagnosing difficult problems, and building solutions that last. You are comfortable working independently, but you also know how to collaborate with engineers from different disciplines. You take pride in code quality, sound engineering decisions, technical documentation, and seeing a project through to completion. Candidates whose experience is limited to application\-level software development without hands\-on embedded firmware or hardware integration experience are unlikely to be a fit. jobs.title: Test Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Test Engineering Manager** **Department: Manufacturing Test Engineering (MTE)** **Location:** **Newark, CA** ============================================================================================================== **Position Summary** -------------------- Unigen is seeking an experienced Test Engineering Manager to lead its Test Engineering team in an electronics manufacturing environment. This role will oversee the development, implementation, and optimization of Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) test processes, with a focus on Functional Testing, In\-Circuit Testing (ICT), and Flying Probe Testing. The Test Engineering Manager will provide technical leadership, manage engineering resources, establish test strategies, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure robust test coverage, manufacturing readiness, and consistent product quality. The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in PCBA testing, proven engineering team management experience, and a track record of improving test efficiency and manufacturing yields. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **1\. Test Engineering Leadership** * Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Test Engineers, establishing technical priorities, project timelines, and performance expectations. * Define test engineering strategies, standards, and best practices across manufacturing programs. * Manage engineering resources and project deliverables to support production requirements and customer commitments. **2\. PCBA Test Strategy and Development** * Oversee the development, implementation, validation, and maintenance of PCBA testing solutions, including Functional Test, ICT, and Flying Probe Test. * Guide the development and optimization of test programs, test fixtures, test procedures, and test methodologies. * Ensure test solutions provide adequate coverage of product requirements and manufacturing quality expectations. * Evaluate test equipment, platforms, and technologies to improve test capability and production performance. **3\. New Product Introduction (NPI) and Production Support** * Partner with NPI, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Design Engineering, and Program Management to establish test requirements and ensure production readiness. * Oversee test strategy development during new product introduction, engineering builds, and production ramp\-up. * Lead engineering\-level troubleshooting of complex test failures, yield issues, and recurring manufacturing defects. * Drive root\-cause analysis and corrective actions to improve test reliability and manufacturing performance. **4\. Continuous Improvement and Quality** * Drive improvements in first\-pass yield, test coverage, test cycle time, false failure rates, and retest rates. * Analyze test data and manufacturing trends to identify opportunities for process improvement. * Ensure test processes align with customer specifications, quality requirements, and applicable industry standards. * Standardize test engineering documentation, validation procedures, and troubleshooting practices. **5\. Cross\-Functional and Customer Collaboration** * Collaborate with internal stakeholders and customers to resolve technical issues and align test requirements with product specifications. * Coordinate test engineering priorities with production schedules, NPI milestones, and customer deliverables. * Communicate technical risks, project progress, and improvement initiatives to management and relevant stakeholders. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. * 8\+ years of experience in test engineering, preferably within an EMS, PCBA, or electronics manufacturing environment. * 3\+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams. * Strong expertise in PCBA Functional Testing, In\-Circuit Testing (ICT), and Flying Probe Testing. * Demonstrated experience overseeing test program development, test fixture design, test validation, and test process implementation. * Strong understanding of electronic circuits, PCBA design, component\-level troubleshooting, and manufacturing test methodologies. * Experience supporting NPI, production ramp\-up, yield improvement, and high\-volume manufacturing. * Proven ability to lead technical projects, develop engineering talent, and manage competing priorities. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

jobs.description: **Purpose** The Lead Software Engineer will accept ownership of the end user experience through integration between different software/web\-based applications, including those of other team members, being designed and modified to support a project. The Lead Software Engineer will be responsible for the technical adequacy of the project software. As a lead, demonstrate a willingness to coach and provide effective and appropriate feedback to others in the department. **Key Responsibilities:** Meet with the project team leader and other key individuals and departments associated with the project to determine the status of the project and where this position fits into the overall scope of the project.
