Develop and/or review a project plan for development of the software integration assigned to this position, outlining key project milestones and time to completion. This includes identifying user requirements, preparation of use cases, development of critical paths and dependency relationships, and project challenges. Incorporate these into the plan. Lead discussions with the design team and vendor team in order to develop and submit a comprehensive design concept for formal review. This includes end user experience, layout best integration approach, objects, and process map. This plan needs to meet key functional requirements. Review existing integration method and its impact on end user experience for the project and recommend modifications for upgrading and improvement. Develop a time\-phased plan of action to complement the proposed changes. Complete detailed integration proposal and validate to meet project deadlines. The integration should be optimal in terms of the best digital end user experience, system performance, and the use of the system resources. This includes unit testing and preparation of complete design documentation. Inform the project sponsor ahead of time if the project deadlines cannot be met. Expect major technical issues and challenges in this position. Be in a position to present a series of alternative approaches and lead the product design reviews. During this presentation, address alternative approaches, methods used to assess these alternatives, the impact on the project schedules, and additional resources required, if any. During the design phase, continually test integration for end user experience (digital functionality) and optimize for performance to ensure the integration meets project standards. Develop the software test plans and procedures. Take initiative on coordinating this effort with the department owner and assist with all troubleshooting needs and testing efforts. Ensure that all required design changes are completed in a timely manner to meet the overall project schedule. Escalate urgent problems requiring in\-depth knowledge to appropriate internal resources. Identify opportunities to leverage AI technologies for process automation, document processing, workflow optimization, knowledge management, employee productivity, and member self\-service capabilities. Collaborate with business stakeholders to develop AI use cases and proof\-of\-concepts aligned with strategic priorities. jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate, Adaptive Learning Agents and Computational Cognitive Science
jobs.description: **Posting Number** req27365 **Department** Psychology **Department Website Link** https://psychology.arizona.edu/ **Location** Tucson Campus **Address** Tucson, AZ USA **Position Highlights** The NAIADEL Lab in the University of Arizona Department of Psychology seeks a Postdoctoral Research Associate with expertise in developing and analyzing adaptive learning agents to investigate the computational mechanisms of human intelligence and agency. The lab builds a neurocomputational theory of adaptive intelligence and agency. We study how people and artificial agents infer the structure of their environment, judge what they can control, revise those judgments after setbacks, and change their strategies when conditions change. Computational cognitive models and modern deep learning are our main instruments for this work. We treat deep reinforcement learning agents and sequence models as scientific models of human behavior. We train them, fit them to human data, interpret what they have learned, and compare them with process\-oriented cognitive models such as sequential sampling models and reinforcement learning models. These approaches offer complementary accounts of adaptation. Meta\-learning agents can model how learning strategies change with experience. Learned world models can represent environmental dynamics and support planning. Sequential sampling models characterize the dynamics of individual decisions. We ask when these accounts explain the same behavior, where they diverge, and how they can be integrated into a theory of adaptive intelligence. The candidate will lead the development of new adaptive agents for the lab’s game\-based environment, in which task structure and controllability change across game missions and over time. They will train these agents on the same games that people play, compare agent and human behavior on data from more than 1,000 participants across online, in\-person, and clinically characterized samples, and use the results to test and refine the lab’s theory of agency. The work will generate first\-author papers and an agent\-based research line the candidate can carry into an independent program. Recorded human data and a Gymnasium\-compatible runtime for the lab's games allow modeling to begin in the first weeks. Work with engineers and game designers allows new agents and new environments to be tested quickly. Resources include HPC clusters, GPU/CPU nodes, cloud compute, EEG, fMRI, and eye\-tracking. The lab is building a shared computational core of models, environments, and training pipelines on which its research runs, and the postdoc will substantially shape its design. They will join an active community of computational cognitive modelers and computer scientists across campus. International collaborations connect the candidate to machine learning, neuroscience, and clinical partners and to a global scientific network. The position offers close mentorship, funded international conference travel, dedicated compute allocations, fellowship support, and planning for independence, authorship, and project portability. The initial appointment is for one year, renewable based on satisfactory progress. The start date is negotiable; applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. *Outstanding U of A benefits include health, dental, vision, and life insurance; paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays; U of A/ASU/NAU tuition reduction for the employee and qualified family members; access to U of A recreation and cultural activities; and more!* The University of Arizona has been recognized for our innovative work\-life programs. **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and train new reinforcement learning agents for game\-based environments in which task structure and controllability change. Relevant approaches include meta\-reinforcement learning, continual learning, model\-based reinforcement learning and world models, and transformer\-based sequence models for decision\-making. * Treat trained agents as scientific models of behavior. Fit and compare them with human data from game\-based paradigms examining meta\-control, cognitive flexibility, and social learning, interpret the representations and strategies they acquire, and relate them to process\-oriented cognitive models such as reinforcement learning and sequential sampling models. * Develop methods that connect agent behavior with human behavior at the level of mechanism. Use simulation, recovery analyses, and out\-of\-sample prediction to determine which mechanisms are identifiable and supported by the data. * Formulate decisive comparisons among competing accounts of adaptation and help design or refine games and environments within the lab's game\-based adaptive platform. * Lead first\-author manuscripts aimed at machine learning venues and at cognitive science journals, and contribute to collaborative papers with partner sites. * Take scientific responsibility for the lab's agent research line, including theor  programming skills in Python and at least one modern deep learning framework. * A record of peer\-reviewed publication appropriate to career stage. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing new learning algorithms or substantially extending existing ones. * Experience with meta\-reinforcement learning, in\-context learning, or continual reinforcement learning in non\-stationary environments. * Experience with POMDPs, belief\-state inference, model\-based reinforcement learning, or learned world models for decision\-making under partial observability. * Experience with transformers or other sequence models for sequential decision\-making. * Experience evaluating LLM\-based agents as subjects in behavioral tasks, or developing LLM\-based agents with memory, planning, or tool\-use capabilities. * Experience using neural networks as models of human or animal behavior, or interpreting the representations and strategies of trained agents. * Experience fitting reinforcement learning or sequential sampling models to human behavior. Computational cognitive scientists who want to extend their work to developing adaptive agents are encouraged to apply. * Experience modeling controllability, latent\-state inference, exploration under uncertainty, or adaptive control. * Experience analyzing human or animal behavioral data, or comparing model predictions with empirical data. * Experience designing environments, tasks, or benchmarks for learning agents. * Experience with collaborative software development, version control, and reproducible research workflows. **FLSA** Exempt **Full Time/Part Time** Full Time **Number of Hours Worked per Week** 40 **Job FTE** 1\.0 **Work Calendar** Fiscal **Job Category** Research **Benefits Eligible** Yes \- Full Benefits **Rate of Pay** NIH salary guidelines, Depends on Experience **Compensation Type** salary at 1\.0 full\-time equivalency (FTE) **Type of criminal background check required:** Name\-based criminal background check (non\-security sensitive) **Number of Vacancies** 1 **Target Hire Date** **Expected End Date** 10/31/2027 **Contact Information for Candidates** Dr. Nadja R. Ging\-Jehli Assistant Professor, Department of Psychology nadjaging@arizona.edu **Open Date** 10/16/2026 **Open Until Filled** Yes **Documents Needed to Apply** Curriculum Vitae (CV), Cover Letter, and One Additional Document **Special Instructions to Applicant** Please submit your CV and Cover Letter, along with one Additional Document containing the following materials: * **Statement of Research Interest:** Identify one question about adaptive intelligence or agency that you would like to pursue in this lab, and describe how you would approach it with the methods you bring. * **Supporting Materials:** One or two representative publications, preprints, or code repositories, including at least one that shows your own algorithmic work. * **References:** Names and contact details of three referees. Please combine the Statement of Research Interest, Supporting Materials, and References into one file and upload it in the Additional Documents section of your application. **Notice of Availability of the Annual Security and Fire Safety Report** In compliance with the Jeanne Clery Campus Safety Act (Clery Act), each year the University of Arizona releases an Annual Security Report (ASR) for each of the University’s campuses. These reports disclose information including Clery crime statistics for the previous three calendar years and policies, procedures, and programs the University uses to keep students and employees safe, including how to report crimes or other emergencies and resources for crime victims. As a campus with residential housing facilities, the Main Campus ASR also includes a combined Annual Fire Safety report with information on fire statistics and fire safety systems, policies, and procedures. Paper copies of the Reports can be obtained by contacting the University Compliance Office at cleryact@arizona.edu.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer- Cascadience
jobs.description: **Position Title:** Full Stack Engineer **Location:** Remote — EST Time Zone **Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Salaried Exempt **Schedule:** Monday–Friday **About the Opportunity** Cascadience, a VIABILITY Company, is building **Volio**, an innovative AI\-powered digital companion designed to support neurodivergent individuals, including people with ADHD, Autism, and Anxiety. Volio is evolving into an engaging student companion that combines AI\-powered support, intelligent scheduling, long\-term memory, and gamified experiences to help reduce cognitive overload and support independence. This is a unique opportunity to join a **startup initiative backed by a 56\-year established organization**. As a Full Stack Engineer, you'll help build and scale the technology behind Volio while working closely with product, operations, marketing, and external partners. If you're a product\-minded engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and wants your work to have a meaningful impact, we'd love to hear from you. **Key Responsibilities** * Build and maintain our **Python/FastAPI** backend running on AWS ECS Fargate. * Develop and improve AI\-powered multi\-agent workflows using **Amazon Bedrock and LangGraph**. * Build and optimize RAG pipelines and long\-term semantic memory. * Develop mobile features using **React Native, Flutter, or native iOS/Android technologies**. * Create lightweight 2D gamification and student progression features. * Integrate GPS/geolocation functionality for school and class\-related experiences. * Design and maintain data models across **PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and MongoDB Atlas**. * Contribute to AWS infrastructure, Terraform, and secure cloud architecture. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using **GitHub Actions**. * Support mobile releases through Apple App Store Connect and Google Play. * Monitor application performance using tools such as **New Relic, OpenTelemetry, and AWS X\-Ray**. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to turn ideas into accessible, reliable products. **Required Qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience building production applications, APIs, or mobile applications. * Strong experience with **Python** and preferably FastAPI. * Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, or MongoDB. * Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure and CI/CD automation. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. * Ability to work independently and take ownership in a fast\-paced startup environment. * Genuine interest in accessibility, inclusion, and technology that improves people's lives. * Bachelors degree in relevant field is required. Master's degree is preferred. **Preferred Experience** Prior experience with any of the following is a plus: * LangGraph, LangChain, Amazon Bedrock, or OpenAI * React Native, Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin * RAG, vector databases, or AI/LLM applications * AWS ECS Fargate * Terraform * MongoDB Atlas Vector Search * Google OR\-Tools / CP\-SAT * Mobile application deployment * Observability and distributed systems **Benefits** VIABILITY is pleased to offer the following benefits to eligible full\-time employees: * **Medical/Rx Insurance offered through Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS):** Competitive medical coverage with two plan options for employees and their families. * **Health Savings Account (HSA):** Employee\-funded HSA with pre\-tax payroll deductions for eligible healthcare expenses. * **Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA):** Options include Health FSA, Limited Purpose FSA for dental and vision expenses, and Dependent Care FSA. * **Dental Insurance (BCBS)** * **Vision Insurance (BCBS)** * **Life Insurance:** Life insurance benefit equal to 100% of the employee’s salary. * **403(b) \& Roth Retirement Plans:** VIABILITY matches contributions up to 4%, subject to annual review. Employees may also contribute on a post\-tax basis through the Roth plan. * **Paid Time Off (PTO):** Available for vacation and personal time after three months of continuous employment, with additional PTO based on length of service. * **Paid Holidays:** VIABILITY observes 11 paid holidays annually. * **Long\-Term Disability Insurance:** Eligible employees receive a percentage of their salary following the applicable elimination period. * **Tuition Reimbursement:** Reimbursement of up to $1,000 per fiscal year for eligible full\-time employees; part\-time employees may be eligible for up to $500\. * **Employee Emergency Assistance Grant:** Eligible employees may receive up to $1,200 to help address unexpected and disruptive circumstances. * **Employee Referral Bonus:** Employees may be eligible for a referral incentive when a referred candidate is hired and begins employment with VIABILITY. * **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** 24/7 confidential assistance for employees and their dependents, including access to counseling and other support services. *The description of these benefits is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable insurance policies and plan documents and may be changed at VIABILITY’s discretion.* **Our Commitment** ------------------ Cascadience and VIABILITY are committed to creating an inclusive, collaborative, and mission\-driven workplace. We value diverse perspectives and seek individuals who are passionate about using technology to create meaningful, accessible, and empowering experiences for the people we serve. For more details visit cascadience.org

jobs.title: Copy of Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: Vynyl's technologists, designers and product strategists are experts at system modernization, new product development, and rescuing projects in distress. We use the best cloud\-native and AI\-enabled tools, and apply a battle\-tested combination of Agile, Lean, and design thinking to collaboratively solve our client's most pressing challenges \- and do it right the first time. We often work in regulated industries, such as healthcare, financial services, government and education. Our work helps detect diseases, identify kids who need special educational support, applies AI to support complex legal settlements, helps people access mental health services, and so much more. **The Role** ============ As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a key leader across the entire software development lifecycle, from conceptual design to deployment and monitoring. You will be responsible for building robust, scalable backend services using Python and AWS Serverless technologies (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge), developing event\-sourced systems that provide complete state history and auditability. A critical component of this role is a demonstrated fluency with modern AI/ML development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, agentic coding tools, large language models). We are looking for candidates who not only use these tools daily but can articulate a clear, thoughtful perspective on their limitations, security implications, and the strategic opportunities they create for the engineering profession. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * **Design** **and implement** highly scalable, cost\-efficient backend services using Python and AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge). * **Architect and build** event\-sourced systems and event\-driven pipelines, ensuring reliable message processing, idempotency, and eventual consistency across distributed services. * **Collaborate** with product managers and designers to translate requirements into technical designs and shippable code. * **Implement** best practices for security, logging, monitoring, and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform or CloudFormation). * **Perform** rigorous code reviews, mentor junior and mid\-level engineers, and drive technical excellence across the team. * **Actively research, propose, and integrate** new technologies and patterns, with a focus on optimizing development velocity and system performance. * **Clearly articulate** a professional point of view on how to effectively, securely, and ethically integrate AI tools into the software development lifecycle. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ * **5\+ years** of professional experience in full\-stack software development. * **Expert\-level proficiency** in Python for backend development (including Django). * **Strong** working proficiency with Vue.js (and typescript). * **Deep practical experience** designing, deploying, and maintaining applications using serverless architectures (preferably AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and managed services). * **Proficiency** with SQL, preferably PostgreSQL. * **Solid understanding** of event sourcing and event\-driven architecture patterns, including experience with message brokers or streaming services (e.g., SQS, SNS, EventBridge, or Kinesis). * **Experience** with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code. * **Demonstrated Fluency in AI\-Assisted Development**: Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, hands\-on experience using AI\-powered coding tools to achieve specific, quantifiable productivity gains, while also clearly understanding and mitigating the associated risks (e.g., code quality, security, IP concerns). **Nice to Have** ---------------- * **Experience** with advanced AWS services (e.g., Step Functions, Kinesis, SageMaker). * **Experience** working in a regulated or compliance\-focused environment. * **A Bachelor's or Master's degree** in Computer Science or a related technical field. **AI and the Evolution of Software Engineering \& Ops** ======================================================= All candidates must be prepared to discuss and demonstrate the following during the interview jobs.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer** **San Jose, CA, USA** **12 Months** **$70/HR on W2 OR $80/HR on C2C** **Any visa is fine** **Need candidates who are in California. W2 candidates are encouraged to apply.** Client is an AI\-enhanced security processor company redefining the control and management of every digital system. The company builds silicon\-rooted security and management chips — including the TCU (Trusted Control/Compute Unit) — for AI data center infrastructure, combining platform security, BMC/firmware, and on\-chip AI for real\-time threat detection and dynamic power/thermal management. **Job Description** **About the role** We’re looking for an ML engineer who works across the full stack from model to silicon — comfortable optimizing training and inference performance on GPU/AI\-accelerator infrastructure, building or tuning models, and adapting model and inference\-engine design to the constraints of the underlying chip and its NPU. You’ll move fluidly between algorithm work, systems\-level software, and infrastructure work, closing the loop end\-to\-end rather than owning just one layer of the stack. This is a rare chance to work the full cycle of AI silicon, from model down to chip — something most ML engineers at large companies never get access to. **What you’ll do** * Optimize training and inference performance across GPU and AI\-accelerator infrastructure, including MLOps pipelines * Design, train, and evaluate ML models (deep learning, LLM, CV, or recommendation systems) and take them into production * Harden and extend NPU cores (e.g. building on an open RVV/tensor core like CoralNPU) into production silicon * Build or optimize inference engines and serving runtimes against real hardware constraints — latency, memory, and power * Work below the application layer where needed — BMC firmware, embedded Linux, or RTOS (e.g. Zephyr) — so AI features run reliably on real systems * Build automated test/verification harnesses that close the loop for AI\-assisted RTL/DV, hardware bring\-up, or manufacturing test * Apply ML to security — AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security work * Collaborate closely with RTL/hardware, firmware, and QA teams to ship AI features end\-to\-end, from training through deployment and monitoring **Requirements:** * 8\-10\+ years of hands\-on AI/ML experience; Master’s required, PhD preferred * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML infrastructure and performance — GPU clusters, distributed training, inference\-serving optimization, MLOps pipelines * Model / algorithm development experience — designing, training, and evaluating ML models * Experience taking models into production — feature engineering, data pipelines, deployment * AI chip / hardware\-aware ML experience — optimizing inference engines for a specific chip, or adapting model architecture/quantization to chip constraints * Deep, hands\-on expertise in at least 2 of the following 5 specialty areas — we don’t expect all five: – **NPU / AI\-accelerator —** hardening or extending an NPU core into production silicon, mapping models onto MAC/tensor\-engine constraints, or NPU\-aware RTL/DV work – **Systems / Sys\-level software —** BMC firmware, embedded Linux, RTOS (e.g. Zephyr), or other low\-level system software – **Inference engine / runtime —** built or materially optimized an inference engine or serving runtime against real hardware constraints – **Test / verification harness —** built an automated harness that closes a loop, e.g. an agent\-driven RTL/DV test runner or a hardware bring\-up / MFG test harness – **Cyber security —** AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security

jobs.title: Critical Facilities Engineer, NA (Data Center)
jobs.description: **About Vantage** ================= Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. **This is a evergreen req for future openings \- timeline for talent conversations is TBD. We are collecting applications for future conversations.** *This role is open on a rolling basis, and we review applications as they come in. There’s no set deadline, but if you’re interested, we encourage you to apply soon—our hiring needs can shift, and we welcome applications at any time while the opportunity is available.* **Site Operations Department** The Site Operations Department is responsible for the overall health of all mechanical and electrical systems, building maintenance, and performance of all data modules in our data centers. The team is staffed 24 x 7 onsite with Critical Facility Engineers (CFEs) on each shift. This team is the face of Vantage to our customers and the first line of defense regarding the uptime of our campus as well as the performance of our customer installations. Using a Critical Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to plan and track work needed, the Site Operations department performs all preventative and corrective maintenance. Our culture expects and rewards team performance that engages directly with the customers and the facility infrastructure. This is a team that does most of the actual work versus calling upon vendors. As a result, we provide superior service that is faster and more cost effective. **Position Overview** **This role is onsite in Ashburn, VA. This is an in\-house position.** **Ideally we will be seeking experienced talent for Levels I or potentially II . One with data center, mission critical field service or mission critical military experience highly desired (US Navy, US Air Force, US Army, US Marines, US Coast Guard). These are in\-house and hands\-on roles using your critical thinking talents to troubleshoot and fix equipment vs subbing out the work.** **Electrical and mechanical expertise in a non\-mission critical field service in cross\-industry may be considered, e.g, chiller technician with larger tonnage but non\-critical environments or field service in OEM equipment outside of data center. (Johnson Controls, York, Trane, Daikin, Vertiv, Eaton, Liebert, Toshiba, Delta, CAT, ABB, Samsung, Mitsubishi, Siemens, Petra etc) . We are also able to consider those that are very trainable.** We are looking for a Critical Facilities Engineer who knows what best\-in\-class service looks like and can make that a reality. This role is an important member of our facilities team where we manage some of the most efficient and cost\-effective data center facilities in the industry. The successful candidate for this role will work with a team of other electrical and mechanical\-focused engineers performing maintenance and repair for our data center infrastructure. We take our customer requirements for uptime seriously and keep our facilities maintained to a very high standard to insure uninterrupted service for our customers. If you enjoy working on critical data center systems (UPSs, PDUs, Diesel Generators, ATS equipment and Building Controls), as well as industrial electrical equipment and systems that include power distribution components/wiring, electronic components and lighting systems. If you know the importance of getting it right the first time and not disrupting mission critical data centers. If you enjoy delighting customers with superior service and you have the desire and ability to do so, then please read on! **Essential Job Functions** * Work under limited supervision, both independently and within a team environment * Manage multiple one\-time and/or ongoing projects * Respond to safety and emergency situations and maintain a safe and secure work environment * Use discretion and judgment in organizing workflow and adapting as priorities are modified due to a changing environment * Frequent contact with employees at all levels of the organization; frequent external contact with vendors **Duties** * Operate, perform maintenance and service repairs on critical Data Center systems (UPS, PDU, Diesel Generators, ATS equipment and Building Controls, Chillers, CRAH, ETC) * Develop reliability reports to ensure availability and capacity targets are achieved and maintained with 100% uptime * Coordinate, and oversee all maintenance vendors to ensure personnel safety, protect the Facility’s critical equipment, and maintain power to the critical load * Create required MOPs (Method of Procedure), SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and EOPs (Emergency Operating Procedures) to ensure all maintenance activities are perform operating, maintaining, repairing, inspecting and testing critical electrical distribution systems, HVAC systems and building management/automation equipment * Ability to read commercial building blueprints and understand electrical single lines and schematics * Knowledge of commonly\-used concepts, practices, and procedures related to mechanical \& electrical systems needed to run data centers * Technical Writing skills and experience; as well as creating, coordinating, updating and/or modifying MOPs/SOPs/EOP’s for critical facilities equipment, to include supporting new systems and researching technical requirements * Work experience in the electrical or mechanical field is highly desired. Strong emphasis on technical skills/training, with intent to obtain license within a reasonable time * May be required to complete formal training in an area of specialty, such as UPS maintenance * Candidates must possess reliable transportation for reporting to work for shifts, or emergencies * Travel is expected to be less than 5%, occasionally for training purposes * Potential employees must complete a background check successfully **Physical Demands and Special Requirements** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Ability to stand 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to walk 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to sit 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to climb and balance 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to reach with hands \& arms 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to smell, talk \& hear * Ability to use hands to type, handle \& feel * Ability to reach with hands and arms * Ability to see at close and distance ranges and the ability to see color * Must be comfortable working in a high stress, fast paced environment with shifting priorities * Must be willing to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, late nights, holidays, and on\-call support * Ability to lift up to 50 pounds 1/3 of the time **Additional Details** * This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD\&D, short and long\-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits. * Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown. Posting range is $38\-55 / hour for level Is and IIs. **\#LI\-Onsite** **\#LI\-TS1** We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations. Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community. Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values. Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

jobs.title: IT Support Specialist
jobs.description: **About IonQ:** IonQ, Inc. \[NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier \- delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting\-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99\.99% two\-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance. Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. **About Vector Atomic:** Vector Atomic, an IonQ company, is building quantum technology to transform navigation, timing, geophysical exploration, and telecommunications. Our team of engineers, scientists, software developers, and operations professionals works together to solve complex challenges and turn bold ideas into real\-world solutions. We value collaboration, curiosity, and diverse perspectives, and we give every team member the opportunity to make an immediate impact while growing their skills. If you're excited to work on breakthrough technology in a fast\-paced, hands\-on environment, we'd love to hear from you. We are seeking an **IT Support Specialist** to join our growing IT team. This is a hands\-on position supporting approximately 100\+ employees and 350\+ endpoints in a primary Windows\-based environment with a smaller footprint of Linux systems. The ideal candidate is an experienced IT professional who excels at solving technical problems, working directly with users, and taking end\-to\-end ownership of issues. This role extends beyond traditional help desk duties to include endpoint administration, cloud productivity suite support, network maintenance, cybersecurity monitoring, and active participation in our federal and industry compliance programs. **Location:** **Pleasanton, California (Bay Area)** **Requirements** **What You’ll Do** * **Endpoint \& User Support** * + Provide Tier 2/3 technical support primarily for Windows systems, alongside foundational support for Linux environments. + Deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and peripherals. + Support cloud productivity tools, user account lifecycles, authentication, and access controls. + Maintain accurate IT documentation, asset management records, and standard operating procedures. * **Identity \& Network Infrastructure** * + Assist with directory services, central identity management, and group policy administration. + Support enterprise Mobile Device Management (MDM), Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM), and unified endpoint management platforms. + Troubleshoot local network infrastructure, including LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, switching, and firewalls. + Assist with IT infrastructure projects, network deployments, office moves, and technology upgrades. * **Security \& Compliance** * + Assist with endpoint hardening, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and baseline security configurations. + Support enterprise Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools. + Administer phishing\-resistant Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) technologies and hardware security keys. + Assist with federal and industry cybersecurity compliance programs (e.g., NIST SP 800\-171, CMMC) and evidence collection. + Interface with engineering, manufacturing, and general business teams to ensure secure, compliant operational workflows. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Formal industry certifications are not required. Relevant certifications and demonstrated technical knowledge will be evaluated as part of your overall qualifications and reflected in total compensation. * Experience administering enterprise cloud productivity and identity management platforms. * Hands\-on exposure to Linux administration and endpoint support. * Familiarity with enterprise EDR and SIEM security logging solutions. * Experience maintaining network switches, firewalls, and wireless access infrastructure. * Familiarity with cybersecurity compliance frameworks (such as NIST SP 800\-171, CMMC, or DFARS) and handling standards for sensitive data. * Practical knowledge of phishing\-resistant MFA tokens and modern hardware security keys. **What We're Looking For:** * A degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent professional experience and demonstrated capabilities will be fully considered. * **3\+ years** of professional IT support or systems administration experience in an enterprise environment. * Strong Windows OS troubleshooting and administration capabilities. * Practical experience supporting Directory Services (Active Directory) and Group Policy. * Solid understanding of core networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, and wireless protocols). * Hands\-on experience with endpoint management, deployment tools, or RMM platforms. * Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and customer\-service skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. **Benefits** Vector Atomic values teamwork, open and honest discourse, and work\-life balance. We offer competitive compensation and benefits including: * Platinum\-level family health coverage (medical, dental, vision) * Health and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Employer 401(k) contributions * 20 days of paid time off \& 11 paid holidays * Paid parental leave * Fully stocked kitchen **Pay Range** The approximate base salary range for this position is $80,000 to $120,000 per year. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity and benefits. It's atypical to be hired at the top end of this range for the role, as actual pay is based on several factors, including job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience level. *Vector Atomic is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by law.* *Vector Atomic does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third\-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.*

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: **Description** Vector Solutions is a leading, AI\-enabled, performance platform powering safe, compliant, and efficient operations for the public, educational, and commercial sectors. We bring training, safety, and workforce operations together to boost readiness, reduce risk, and drive high\-performance results for the everyday heroes who count on us. The Senior Product Manager owns the technical product definition, roadmap, and release quality of Convergence, Vector Solutions’ cloud\-hosted learning management system (LMS) for the Commercial sector. The role applies engineering and strategic business knowledge to translate customer and market needs into precise technical requirements for a multi\-tier software platform built on a .NET/C\# back end, a JavaScript front end, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure), API\-based integrations, and a mobile application, and for new AI\-enabled capabilities. The Senior Product Manager works daily with software engineers, architects, and quality assurance staff to evaluate design trade\-offs, validate that delivered software meets its specifications, and solve technical problems involving data, system integration, AI feature quality, and performance. Convergence is sold primarily to commercial industry customers, including manufacturing, oil and gas, pulp and paper, and construction companies, so the role also requires subject matter expertise in industrial operations, equipment, and safety\-critical work in order to define how the platform represents and verifies the skills, qualifications, and compliance requirements of those workforces. **What You'll Do:** **Technical Environment** * Back end: .NET / C\# services and relational data stores; cloud hosting on AWS and/or Azure. * Front end: JavaScript\-based web application. * Mobile Frameworks: both Android and iOS * Integration layer: APIs and data exchange between Convergence and external customer and third\-party systems. * AI/LLM\-enabled features: AI will be used used in various application features including search, administrative workflows and reporting. * Delivery: Agile development with sprint planning, backlog refinement, design reviews, user acceptance testing, and staged releases. **Principal Duties and Responsibilities** Approximate share of time is shown for each area. **1\. Technical Requirements, Architecture, and Integrations (approx. 30%)** * Analyze customer needs, usage data, and market gaps and convert them into product requirements, user stories, and testable acceptance criteria for the .NET/C\# services, JavaScript user interface, and API layer of Convergence. * Participate in architecture and design reviews with engineering. Evaluate the trade\-offs among performance, scalability, security, maintainability, and delivery time of proposed solutions on the cloud\-hosted (AWS/Azure) platform, and assess technical feasibility, dependencies, and technical debt when sequencing the roadmap. * Specify API and data\-integration requirements for exchanging learner, activity, and credentialing data between Convergence and external systems, including data mapping, data\-integrity rules, error handling, and the handling of edge cases and conflicting source data. * Define how the platform models industrial workforce structures, such as sites, crews, job roles, equipment\- or task\-specific qualifications, and recertification cycles, so that training and competency records reflect the operating realities of manufacturing, oil and gas, pulp and paper, and construction customers. * Maintain the technical product roadmap and backlog, defining scope, dependencies, and release timelines in coordination with the development team. **2\. AI\-Enabled Capabilities (approx. 20%)** * Define functional and quality requirements for AI\-enabled features in Convergence, including relevance and accuracy expectations, handling of ambiguous inputs, response\-time targets, and fallback behavior. * Establish evaluation criteria and acceptance thresholds for AI output quality, accuracy, and safety, and analyze test results to decide whether a feature is ready for release or needs redesign. * Validate that AI\-generated content, such as assessments and reports, is technically sound, consistent with the platform’s data model, and reflects real industrial equipment, process, and safety requirements. **3\. As a Software Development Engineer on the Product Reliability Engineering (PRE) team, you won’t just watch those systems run\- you’ll be one of the engineers building, automating, and evolving them. PRE is not a traditional ops team. We are a software engineering organization that treats infrastructure as code, reliability as a product, and automation as a strategic advantage. You’ll write Python, build agentic AI tools, manage data platforms, and contribute to the distributed systems that process billions of real\-time transactions. From day one, you are an engineer\- and from day one, your work matters. financial technology — this role was built for you. **Build Automation That Scales** * Design and ship end\-to\-end automation for deployment pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and release intervention, and make systems self\-managing. * Develop modular frameworks for release scheduling, validation, rollback, and reporting that integrate across the full software delivery lifecycle. critical payment data infrastructure. * Gain exposure to real\-time event streaming architectures that support payment processing at scale * Perform database health operations including patching, upgrades, backups, and recovery to maintain the availability and integrity of tier\-1 production databases. * Optimize query performance through index tuning, execution plan analysis, and replication monitoring — targeting metrics like query execution time, CPU usage, and replication latency. * Automate database tasks and configuration management using tools like Ansible and Liquibase, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines that govern schema changes through TEST and PROD environments safely. * Build predictive and reactive monitoring dashboards for database anomalies, surfacing health signals before they become incidents. **Ship Agentic AI \& ML\-Powered Tools** * Build GenAI\-powered engineering assistants that automate deployment orchestration, release governance, and environment lifecycle management. * Integrate LLMs into observability, incident response, and developer support workflows, transforming reactive operations into proactive, AI\-driven intelligence. * Contribute to prompt engineering, model fine\-tuning, and agentic automation initiatives that position PRE as one of the most AI\-forward reliability organizations in financial technology. **Own Observability \& Platform Health** * Build dashboards, alerts, and metrics using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or ELK that give engineers real\-time clarity on complex, globally distributed systems. * Analyze system performance and availability data and turn insights into infrastructure improvements that prevent incidents before they occur. * Contribute to self\-healing and auto\-scaling capabilities that keep critical payment infrastructure resilient without human intervention. **Engineer for Reliability \& Security** * Ensure infrastructure and data platforms meet security and compliance standards across cloud\-native deployments supporting global financial services at scale. * Support zero\-downtime deployment strategies and high\-availability architectures that Visa’s partners and billions of cardholders depend on around the clock. * Participate in threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, and audit readiness activities as part of a team that treats security as a first\-class engineering concern. **Collaborate, Learn \& Grow Fast** * Embed within Agile squads, working alongside senior engineers, product managers, and global PRE peers across sprint planning, reviews, and release discussions. * Document runbooks, SOPs, and engineering guides that make the team smarter, faster, and more autonomous over time. * Participate in on\-call rotations (with robust support structures and mentorship) to build the incident response instincts that distinguish great reliability engineers. Visa will accept applications for this role until at least October 23, 2026\. **Visa is not offering relocation assistance for this role.** **Visa is not supporting immigration support for this role.** **Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree, OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (2023–2025 graduates preferred; December 2025 graduates welcome). * Solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and systems design \-you can reason about complexity, tradeoffs, and failure modes. * Proficiency in Python and comfort writing scripts or tools in at least one additional language (Go, Java, or Bash). * Foundational understanding of relational databases (RDBMS): SQL, data modeling, query optimization, and database connectivity troubleshooting. * Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments and meaningful command\-line fluency. * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and a conceptual understanding of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). * Understanding of CI/CD principles and how modern software delivery pipelines are structured and maintained. * Genuine curiosity about GenAI platforms and agentic systems (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, or similar)\- hands\-on exposure is a plus, intellectual interest is a must. **Bonus Points:** * Hands\-on experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools: Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi \-even from coursework, a capstone, or an internship. * Experience with database CI/CD tooling, particularly Liquibase for schema change management across environments. * Experience with observability tooling: Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, or Datadog. * Database administration exposure: backup/recovery procedures, performance tuning, index management, or replication monitoring. * Familiarity with Git workflows and modern DevOps toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD). * Academic or project experience with ML frameworks: scikit\-learn, PyTorch, or LangChain / LangGraph. * Understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, service mesh, or TCP/IP. * A GitHub profile, personal project, hackathon entry, or open\-source contribution that shows us how you think and build. jobs.title: Software engineer, cloud infrastructure
jobs.description: Location San Francisco Type Full\-Time Department Engineering Compensation $166,500 \- $185,000 **About Watershed** ------------------- Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit\-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product\-building, want to work hard at a mission\-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team. We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us! **The role** ------------ Watershed’s Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the foundational systems that power our product and help every engineer ship safely and efficiently. We own core compute, databases, networking, deployments, and observability, with a focus on production reliability, predictable infrastructure costs, security, and a low\-toil developer experience. Our work spans both operational excellence and high\-leverage platform improvements. Current areas of investment include: upgrading our networking architecture, improving the usability of test environments and deployment systems, evolving our observability toolkit, hardening Watershed’s AI infrastructure as our AI product suite grows, and supporting agentic engineering workflows. **You will** ------------ * Design, build, and operate reliable cloud infrastructure that powers all of Watershed (across compute, databases, networking, deployment systems, and observability) * Contribute to technical planning, design reviews, team processes, and a culture of thoughtful, high\-impact development * Collaborate with product engineers (our internal customers) to understand their needs and provide high\-leverage infrastructure primitives that help them move faster, safely * Strengthen Watershed’s cloud security in partnership with our Security and Compliance functions, and drive infrastructure cost efficiency in collaboration with our Finance team * Participate in the team’s 24/7 on\-call rotation and help turn operational lessons into lasting improvements **You might be a good fit if** ------------------------------ * You have 2–5 years of software and/or infrastructure engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience * You have hands\-on experience in some of these areas: Kubernetes, Terraform / infrastructure as code, CI/CD, networking, relational databases, observability, reliability, or cloud security. Experience with a major cloud provider is a must; experience with GCP is helpful, but not required * You enjoy the challenge of building the appropriate level of tooling for the stage and arc of the company, in particular being on the front lines of supporting AI infrastructure and agentic products * You enjoy building enabling systems that help other engineers deliver excellent customer outcomes **Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)** Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so. **What’s the interview process like?** It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process. **What if I need accommodations for my interview?** At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long\-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy\-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: Welcome. We're glad you're here. And we're not just saying that. We're glad we're here too. We are proud of this company and take great pleasure in introducing you to the Watson difference. **We are builders.** For more than 60 years we have designed and built workspaces for some of the most dynamic and innovative companies. Our designs are functional, refined, and manufactured with respect for our people and the environment. We are proud to source the best talent and materials at our manufacturing facility in Poulsbo, WA. We're looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to design and improve the processes that let our production floor run safely, consistently, and better every day. Our floor runs CNC routers, fiber lasers, press brakes, edgebanders, weld, and a powder coat line, and you'll work hands\-on across all of it. This role is part of Watson's manufacturing engineering team, led by the Maintenance and Process Manager (MPM). The Value Stream Managers and the MPM define the current condition, the target condition, and the goals that matter. You help make it happen through process design, standard work, tooling, programs, and automation, and through a culture where problems get solved at the root, not just patched for the shift. Sitting squarely within operations, you stay guided by customer demand, giving the Value Stream Managers and floor teams the process, tooling, and data they need to execute on time, every time. This role reports to the Maintenance and Process Manager and works closely with the Value Stream Managers, floor teams, Product Development, Production Planning, and Safety to bring practical, deliberate, and well thought out changes to production. ***Please note, this role is 100% on site at our Poulsbo, Washington workplace called The Orchard.*** The Orchard is more than merely our Pacific Northwest headquarters and the land that surrounds it. With a perimeter of towering Douglas firs and vistas of the Olympic Mountains, it's quite an inspirational workplace. The Orchard is more expansive than its literal acreage. It's an oxygen rich metaphor of what we're here to do and, more importantly, what we're here to take care of. We love working here, and we think you will too! **What You'll Do:** **Process Engineering** * Use lean as the shared language with the floor (standard work, 5S, value stream mapping, A3, kaizen) to find and remove waste. * Work with the Value Stream Managers and floor teams to turn current and target conditions into process changes, layouts, and standard work. * Build and maintain the work instructions, tooling, fixtures, and CNC programs that let the floor run safely, consistently, and at quality. * Analyze workflow, equipment placement, and space requirements to improve throughput and flow. * Coach operators to solve their own problems rather than solving it for them every time. **Projects and Partnership** * Research and build business cases for new equipment, automation, and technology, including feasibility, labor, and cost estimates. * Support kaizen events and lead your own improvement projects through to completion with key stakeholders. * Work with Product Development on manufacturability during new product introduction and product modifications. * Use ERP and production data to set targets for quality and speed, and measure whether changes actually worked. **WHAT YOU'LL NEED** * B.S. in Engineering, or 2\+ years of relevant manufacturing or process engineering experience * Working knowledge of lean tools, ideally applied on the floor and not just in training * Fluency with 3D CAD and familiarity with ERP systems * Familiarity with production processes such as CNC routing, sheet metal fabrication, welding, or finishing * Ability to diagnose root cause quickly and follow through until the fix sticks * Ability to convey complex ideas simply to both the floor and leadership * Ability to manage changing priorities across several projects at once * Basic business sense and an understanding of how decisions affect cost, throughput, and revenue * A plus: CNC programming, automation, or NPI experience **WHO YOU ARE** * You think in lean and see waste and flow problems naturally. * You're insanely curious about root cause, and you're not satisfied with a fix that only lasts a shift. * You'd rather teach than do it for someone. You build rapport at all levels and earn trust by showing up on the floor. * You see how small details fit the big picture. **WAGE AND COMPENSATION** * This role can expect to earn $33\.50\-43\.25 per hour, based on experience **ESSENTIAL ATTRIBUTES OF WATSON EMPLOYEES** * Insane curiosity * Excited and enthusiastic about your work * Embrace and exhibit our values **OUR CULTURE** * Monthly BBQ * Espresso bar * Annual Bravo Night * Onsite gym and showers * Campus walking trail * Fun, challenging, and engaging culture * Pride and satisfaction of manufacturing tangible products **OUR BENEFITS** * INSURANCE \| All employees and their dependents will have the ability to enroll in medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans. If enrolled, benefits begin on the first day of the month following the 60th day of employment at Watson. * RETIREMENT \| Watson will match 50% of employees' 401k contributions, up to 2\.5% of base annual salary. All employees over the age of 21 will be automatically enrolled on the first day of the month following 6 months of employment. You can opt out, decrease, or increase contribution at any time. * PAID TIME OFF \| Hourly employees will earn 80 hours of paid time off during their first year at Watson, 120 hours of paid time off during years 2 through 5, and 160 hours of paid time off each year after being employed for 6 years. * PAID TIME OFF \| Salaried employees do not have a cap on PTO usage. However, we expect a reasonable amount to be a few weeks during your first year of employment. * PAID HOLIDAYS \| Watson is closed for 8 holidays every year and offers every employee an additional paid holiday to choose upon employment. * PROFIT SHARING \| Profit sharing is how we reward the effort and commitment of our employees. Generally, 25% of profits are allocated to the Profit Sharing Plan after the baseline profit level is met. The overall profit sharing amount varies from year to year. * EMPLOYEE ASSISTANCE PROGRAM \| This is a free service for all employees and dependents to provide support for any mental, emotional, relational, and financial need, as well as crisis and grief support. **WHY WATSON?** Everything we do is rooted in soulful design and a deep respect for how things are made. At Watson, operations isn't a back office function. It's where the promise gets kept. There's dignity in working with your hands, and we honor the commitment our people bring to their craft. The Manufacturing Engineer makes sure that craft is backed by processes built to last, so good work isn't a matter of luck. It's built in. At Watson it's all about the details and personal touches. From unique design elements and sustainable materials to the way we build and deliver our products, you'll see the Watson difference. We aren't furniture assemblers. We take the design conceptions and raw materials and turn them into finished products entirely under one roof. At Watson we don't just design and build workplace solutions, we invest in our people. Build your career and grow your skills with us today. *Watson is an equal opportunity employer of all qualified individuals, including minorities, women, veterans \& individuals with disabilities. Watson will consider qualified applicants for employment in a manner consistent with all federal, state, and local ordinances. Any job offer with Watson is contingent upon a drug screening. Please note that Watson is a second chance employer and we do not screen for cannabis unless otherwise noted.*

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **About Wildfire Defense Systems, Inc.** Wildfire Defense Systems (WDS) is the North American leader in insurer wildfire services, combining professional wildfire consulting and loss intervention services with Qualified Insurance Resources (QIR). Founded in 2001 to fulfill initial\-attack assignments for the US Forest Service, the company added professional services support in 2005 and launched wildfire loss\-intervention programs for insurers in 2008\. WDS Wildfire Loss Intervention Service (WDS Service) applies a comprehensive approach to reducing risk in catastrophic exposure on an industry scale, decreasing the average annual loss (AAL) for our insurer clients, and providing peace of mind to their policy holders during wildfire events. WDS provides these industry\-leading services to insurer clients and their policy holders across a 22\-state service area. **FLSA Status**: Exempt **Reports To**: Director of Engineering **Location**: Post Falls ID **Salary Range**: $84,900 to $124,100 DOE **Purpose and Scope of Position** The Mechanical Engineer II/III transforms ideas into field\-ready wildfire mitigation solutions that protect structures, support operations, and reduce wildfire risk. This role is for a bold, highly creative engineer who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly from concept to prototype, and is driven to build things that have never been done before. The ideal candidate is not risk\-averse. Instead, they are a disciplined innovator who learns fast, iterates relentlessly, and pushes ideas to practical, operational success. This position bridges engineering design and field deployment. The engineer owns projects end\-to\-end: conceiving, designing, prototyping, testing, refining, and helping transition solutions into production and operational use. Success requires balancing speed, ingenuity, safety, manufacturability, and cost so that innovation creates not only technical value, but also scalable and profitable business outcomes. **Organizational Relationship** Wildfire Defense Systems Inc, (WDS) operates as a family of integrated companies and subsidiaries that combine engineering, operations, innovation, and consulting expertise to deliver end‑to‑end wildfire mitigation solutions, from concept and design through field deployment and real‑world execution. jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** Workday's AI Platform builds the system of record for AI agents: the registry where Workday and partner agents are described, owned, versioned and managed. As enterprises put agents to work on HR and finance processes, customers need to know what each agent is, who is responsible for it, and whether it can be trusted. This team helps answer those questions, working alongside Workday Agent Passport, which gives agents verifiable credentials and attestations. **About the Role** As Senior Manager of Agent Trust \& Security, you will lead an engineering team building the security foundations of Workday's agent registry: how agents are identified, how they connect to Workday's security model, and how customers can verify what they're running. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You review designs and code, you build with AI code generation every day, and you bring product judgment to what the team builds. In this role, you will: * Lead, hire and grow a team of software engineers, including senior and principal engineers, and set a high bar for security engineering, design quality and pace. * Shape how agents are identified, authenticated and authorized across the registry, building on Workday's security model and standards such as OAuth. * Work with the Agent Passport team on agent identity, credentials and verification, so customers can trust which agent is running and what has been verified about it. * Bring product judgment: understand how customer administrators and security teams think about agents, and work with product management to decide what the team builds. * Partner with peer teams across the agent registry, agent gateway and Agent Passport, and with Workday security, so that security works consistently across the platform. * Make AI code generation central to how the team builds, and measure whether it is improving speed and quality. * Turn direction into written plans with dated milestones, and raise risks early. **About You** **Basic Qualifications:** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 5\+ years leading and developing engineering teams that shipped and operated production services. 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with security\-critical systems such as authentication, authorization, identity, or security platforms. * **Other Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline; equivalent practical experience also considered. * Strong, current hands\-on use of AI code generation tools, and experience leading a team that builds with them. * Working knowledge of OAuth, workload and service identity, and access control models. Experience with signed credentials, attestation or verifiable credentials is a plus. * Product sense: experience working directly with customers, or as a technical lead who shaped a security or identity product alongside product management. * Experience with AI agent platforms or protocols such as MCP or A2A, or with LLM applications in production. * Track record of predictable delivery across teams with shared dependencies. * Track record of hiring and developing senior and principal engineers, including a team split across locations. * Experience with multi\-tenant enterprise SaaS. This role builds and maintains connections among fundraising, financial, communications, payment, and reporting platforms; develops data pipelines and automated workflows; monitors data quality; and helps ensure organizational data is accurate, timely, secure, documented, and available for operational and executive decision\-making. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES HIGHLIGHTS:** The role includes but is not limited to data pipeline development, API integration, workflow automation, technical documentation, data quality monitoring, troubleshooting, and basic Domo dashboard support. **Data Pipelines** * Develop and maintain data pipelines to support accurate and reliable data movement between systems. * Create reusable data transformations and validation processes to improve data consistency and reporting. **API Development** * Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot API integrations between organizational systems. * Support automated data synchronization, authentication, and integration updates. **Workflow Automation** * Design, implement, and monitor automated workflows to improve operational efficiency. * Develop automated data quality checks to identify errors, duplicates, and inconsistencies. **Documentation** * Maintain technical documentation, including data mappings, system integrations, and workflow processes. * Document technical issues, resolutions, and process improvements. **Technical Support** * Troubleshoot data imports, exports, integration failures, and system connectivity issues. * Communicate technical issues and resolutions clearly to internal stakeholders. **Domo Support** * Provide basic support for Domo dashboard development, maintenance, and reporting needs under the guidance of CRM managers. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, data engineering, information systems, or a related field; Mondays and Wednesdays are required in\-office. Richmond, VA is the preferred location; candidates in other World Pediatrics markets—Atlanta, GA; St. Louis, MO; or Raleigh, NC—may also be considered. * Regular use of a computer, cloud platforms, databases, and collaboration tools for extended periods. * Occasional work outside normal business hours may be needed to address critical integration failures, system changes, or scheduled deployments. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively with internal teams and external technology vendors. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** include but are not limited to: * Regular use of a computer, cloud platforms, databases, and collaboration tools for extended periods. * Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and through virtual collaboration tools. **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS:** This annual starting salary range for this position is $72,500\-$80,000 based on experience.
