jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: At Worthington Enterprises, we are not just experimenting with AI—we are embedding it into how we operate, make decisions, and create value for our customers. We are looking for a hands\-on, forward\-thinking AI Engineer to transform governed enterprise data into impactful business solutions. You will build and deploy AI\-powered applications, agents, predictive models, and intelligent workflows that help people work more efficiently, make better decisions, and improve operational performance. This is an opportunity to shape reusable enterprise AI patterns, tackle meaningful manufacturing and business challenges, and see your solutions progress from idea to measurable impact. **This hybrid role is based in Columbus, Ohio, and requires at 2 to 3 days per week on\-site**. Occasional travel—approximately 10%—to corporate and manufacturing locations may be required. **This position is not eligible for relocation assistance or U.S. work sponsorship.** **What You'll Do** * Design, build, deploy, and improve AI applications including enterprise agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), natural\-language analytics, predictive models, and workflow automations. * Build Snowflake\-native AI and ML solutions using capabilities such as Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, semantic views and structured\-data tools, Cortex AI functions, Snowpark, Model Registry, and Feature Store where appropriate. * Engineer retrieval and context pipelines for structured and unstructured data, including ingestion, chunking, metadata, hybrid search, citations, permissions, and freshness. * Create reliable agentic workflows in n8n or comparable orchestration platforms, incorporating tool calling, human approval, retries, idempotency, secrets management, auditability, and exception handling. * Develop secure integrations with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, enterprise APIs, databases, file sources, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. * Establish evaluation and monitoring practices for answer quality, task completion, drift, safety, latency, cost, adoption, and business value. * Apply software engineering practices including modular design, automated testing, code review, Git\-based delivery, CI/CD, documentation, and production support. * Partner with business teams to frame opportunities, prototype quickly, translate ambiguity into a delivery plan, and guide adoption of solutions that are useful and trusted. * Contribute reusable patterns, standards, and guardrails that help other teams and AI Champions build responsibly. * Continuously evaluate new models and capabilities, separating durable value from short\-lived hype. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, information systems, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. * Typically 3–5 years of relevant experience in AI/ML engineering, software engineering, data engineering, or data science, including evidence of delivering at least one AI\-enabled solution beyond a one\-off prototype. * Strong Python and SQL skills, plus experience with APIs, source control, testing, and maintainable application or pipeline development. * Hands\-on experience with one or more of the following: LLM applications, RAG, tool\-using agents, natural\-language analytics, ML pipelines, or intelligent automation. * Understanding of data modeling, identity and access control, privacy, secure development, and responsible AI principles. * Ability to evaluate AI system quality systematically and diagnose failure modes rather than relying on anecdotal testing. * Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain tradeoffs to both technical and business partners. **Preferred Qualifications** * Snowflake AI/ML experience, especially Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, semantic views, Snowpark, Model Registry, Feature Store, or related capabilities. * n8n or comparable workflow/agent orchestration experience such as Workato, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar tools. * MCP, function/tool calling, structured outputs, event\-driven integrations, containers, serverless services, or cloud application delivery. * LLMOps/MLOps practices, evaluation frameworks, observability, model/prompt versioning, Docker, CI/CD, or MLflow. * Enterprise knowledge and productivity integrations involving Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, or governed data catalogs such as Alation. * Experience applying AI in manufacturing, supply chain, finance, operations, or another industrial domain. **Team and Collaboration Context** You will join the Corporate IT – Data, Analytics \& AI team and partner with data engineering, analytics, architecture, security, infrastructure, and business functions. We value curiosity, sound judgment, disciplined experimentation, and people who enjoy turning difficult business problems into simple, reliable experiences. **Why Worthington?** Worthington is applying modern AI inside a real operating business, where better data, smarter automation, and trusted decision support can improve how work gets done every day. This role offers the opportunity to build enterprise AI products that move beyond demos and become part of the way employees ask questions, automate tasks, and make decisions. **Benefits** * Health, dental, and vision insurance starting on the first day, including employer HSA contribution. * On\-site medical center, pharmacy, barbershop, and fitness center. * 401(k) match plus employer contribution. * Employee Assistance Program. * Flexible work schedule. * Quarterly profit sharing, with no cap. Our Company is proud to have a dynamic and inclusive workforce where employees are empowered to innovate, thrive and grow. We believe that each employee’s unique strengths contribute to the success of our organization. This belief extends to how we consider our job applicants. Your talents may align with this position or other opportunities within our organization. Apply today to start unlocking your career potential with Worthington Enterprises. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in the application and hiring process. If you are interested in employment with Worthington Enterprises and need an accommodation or assistance using the careers website, please contact careers@wthg.com. Worthington Enterprises (NYSE: WOR) is a designer and manufacturer of market\-leading brands that help improve everyday life by elevating spaces and experiences. The Company operates with two primary business units: Building Products and Consumer Products. The Building Products segment includes cooking, heating, cooling and water solutions, architectural and acoustical grid ceilings and metal framing and accessories. The Consumer Products segment provides solutions for the tools, outdoor living and celebrations categories. Product brands within the Worthington Enterprises portfolio include Balloon Time®, Bernzomatic®, Coleman® (propane cylinders), CoMet®, Elgen, Garden Weasel®, General®, HALO™, Hawkeye™, Level5 Tools®, Mag Torch®, NEXI™, Pactool International®, PowerCore™, Ragasco®, Well\-X\-Trol® and XLite™, among others. Founded in 1955 as Worthington Industries, Worthington Enterprises follows a people\-first Philosophy with earning money for its shareholders as its first corporate goal. Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, Worthington Enterprises and its joint ventures employ approximately 6,000 people throughout North America and Europe.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com. At Yext, **Product Engineering** builds and evolves the technology behind our products and services. We're looking for engineering managers who want to lead strong teams, solve meaningful technical problems, and help shape what we build next. We work in an agile environment with two\-week sprints and regular demos that keep teams aligned and give engineers clear visibility into the impact of their work. As an engineering manager, you'll partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to set direction, turn broader priorities into actionable plans, and create an environment where engineers can do their best work and continue to grow. We are looking for an engineering manager to join the **Knowledge Graph** team, which builds and maintains the systems that turn customer information into a connected, usable source of truth. The team develops the core infrastructure, APIs, and workflows that help brands model, manage, and connect their knowledge across products and experiences. The work involves challenging engineering problems, including representing complex real\-world entities, processing large volumes of changing data, building reliable distributed systems, and creating interfaces that allow other teams to build confidently on top of the graph. This is an opportunity for engineers who enjoy foundational technology, thoughtful data modeling and system design, and seeing their work enable a wide range of customer experiences. This role is based in our New York City office in the Chelsea neighborhood of Manhattan, where in\-person collaboration plays an important part in how our teams work, learn, and build relationships. We're looking for people who genuinely value that environment and are comfortable coming into the office at least three days per week. At the same time, we don't prescribe specific in\-office days and want employees to have the flexibility to handle personal needs without disrupting their work or team collaboration. **What You'll Do** * Lead and develop a team of software engineers, providing regular coaching, actionable feedback, and support for their career growth * Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate product priorities and longer\-term goals into clear, achievable plans for the team * Own the team's execution and delivery, establishing priorities, breaking larger initiatives into manageable work, and maintaining a sustainable development cadence * Create clarity for the team by resolving ambiguity, removing blockers, managing competing priorities, and protecting engineers from unnecessary organizational churn and distractions * Maintain a strong technical understanding of the team's systems and provide guidance on architecture, design, implementation, and technical tradeoffs * Foster a high bar for engineering quality through thoughtful design discussions, code reviews, testing, operational readiness, and continuous improvement * Ensure the team is prepared to respond effectively to production incidents, providing leadership and coordination during incidents and driving meaningful follow\-up afterward * Build an environment where engineers take ownership, collaborate effectively, learn from one another, and feel comfortable raising concerns and challenging assumptions * Collaborate across Product Engineering and with partners throughout the company to coordinate dependencies, resolve issues, and deliver shared initiatives * Recruit and hire talented engineers, actively participate in the interview process, and build an effective onboarding experience for new team members * Identify opportunities to improve the team's systems, processes, and ways of working, and help turn those opportunities into meaningful change * Model thoughtful use of AI\-assisted development tools and help engineers incorporate AI effectively throughout design, research, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review * Maintain a high\-quality bar for AI\-assisted work by ensuring engineers understand and validate generated output and remain accountable for its correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with engineering standards * Encourage experimentation with new AI capabilities and workflows, share successful approaches across the team, and help identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully improve engineering effectiveness **What You Have** * A BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent college\-level education * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience * 1\+ years of team or technical leadership * Experience coaching engineers, providing direct and constructive feedback, and supporting their professional development * Experience translating product or business priorities into technical plans and driving a team toward successful delivery * The ability to stay technically engaged enough to guide design decisions, evaluate tradeoffs, and help engineers work through difficult problems * Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to create clarity when priorities or requirements are ambiguous * A track record of building healthy, effective engineering teams while holding a high bar for quality and accountability * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools and the ability to evaluate their output critically as part of a responsible engineering workflow * Sound judgment regarding data privacy, intellectual property, security, and the appropriate use of confidential information when working with AI tools * Strong technical judgment and a foundation in software architecture, design, data structures, and algorithms * Fluency with Java, Go, C\+\+, Python, or a similar programming language (we code primarily in Java and Go) * Experience recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding software engineers * Openness to new technologies, new ways of working, and creative solutions * Comfort working in a fast\-paced environment \#LI\-JB1 Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results\-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers. It is Yext's policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form. **Security Alert** All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. jobs.title: Yourgi Senior Manager of Engineering Services
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Yourgi is on a mission to become Earth's most trusted pet care connector, connecting pet parents with a reliable local network of certified professionals, pet resorts, and veterinary centers. Backed by a passionate team, our mission is to make pet care simple, accessible, and joyful for all. Because pets aren't just animals—they're family. Yourgi's mission is to be pet parents' most trusted source for pet care services. We are building a differentiated experience for both pet parents and pros through our marketplace and software platform. Pet parents book grooming, boarding, daycare, and training, and independent pet\-care pros run their businesses with Yourgi Pro, Connect, and Match. We also power booking for Destination Pet's own locations. You'll build Yourgi's engineering services function from the ground up: DevOps, SRE, release engineering, infrastructure as code, data pipelines, security operations, and data governance. Your job is to make deploys boring, rollbacks instant, production visible, and data trustworthy. You'll lead a small team of DevOps and SRE engineers, some nearshore, stay hands\-on, and set the operating practices every product team follows. **LOCATION** **:** Remote (US only; must be authorized to work in the US, no visa sponsorship) **REPORTS TO**: VP of Engineering **PAY:** $190,000 base \+10% bonus **CORE RESPONSIBILITES:** * **DevOps and release engineering:** own CI/CD for API, web, and mobile (GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines), with unattended deploys, staged or canary releases, one\-click rollback, and controlled production deploy access. * **SRE:** stand up production monitoring and alerting on AWS (CloudWatch, X\-Ray, synthetics, and PagerDuty), define SLOs for critical customer journeys, and replace noisy alert channels with alerts that are actionable and owned. * **Incident and change management:** launch a shared on\-call rotation, incident response, blameless postmortems, and weekly operational reviews. * **Infrastructure as code:** bring AWS infrastructure and database operations under code (OpenTofu, Terraform, or CDK), with consistent environments and reviewed changes. * **Data pipelines:** own the reliability of pipelines that move data from our services and partner systems into the data lake and warehouse, with monitoring, retries, and clear owners. * **Security operations:** run secrets management, least\-privilege IAM, dependency and vulnerability scanning, and supply\-chain hygiene in every pipeline. * **Data governance:** set standards for data access, retention, classification, and logging so customer data is handled safely across systems. * **Measures and cost:** report DORA metrics (deploy frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and time to restore) and make cloud cost visible by team and service. * **People:** hire, manage, and develop DevOps and SRE engineers, and help product teams own their services in production. **30/60/90 plan** **First 30 Days:** Inventory the existing pipelines, environments, AWS accounts, alerts, data pipelines, and production access permissions. Establish baseline monitoring for the most critical services. By the end of the first 30 days, review the current\-state inventory and the key operational and security risks with the VP of Engineering, and ensure that baseline monitoring dashboards are live. **By Day 60:** Establish and launch the on\-call rotation and incident management process. Deliver at least one pipeline with automated deployment and rollback capabilities. Publish the initial standards for secrets management, access controls, and data handling. By day 60, ensure the on\-call rotation is staffed, the first incident postmortems are documented, weekly operational dashboards are being reported, and the standards have been approved. **By Day 90:** Define service\-level objectives (SLOs) and configure alerts for the five most important customer journeys. By the end of 90 days, ensure that SLOs and paging alerts are operational for all five customer journeys, deliver the first DORA and cloud\-cost report to leadership, and establish an agreed\-upon team hiring plan. **What will you need?** **Required skills and experience** * 8\+ years in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2\+ years leading engineers. * Deep AWS experience, especially serverless (Lambda, EventBridge, and API Gateway), IAM, and RDS. * Built CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, or similar, including automated rollback. * Infrastructure as code in production (Terraform, OpenTofu, or CDK). * Ran on\-call and incident management that measurably reduced incidents and time to restore. * Hands\-on security operations: secrets management, access control, and vulnerability scanning. * Comfortable managing nearshore or distributed team members. **Differentiators** * Data pipeline and data governance experience (e.g., Snowflake, data lakes, or event pipelines). * Datadog or CloudWatch at scale; OpenTelemetry. * Mobile release pipelines (App Store and Google Play). * PCI awareness from working with payments (Stripe). * AI tools for operations, such as incident summarization and runbook automation. **PERKS:** * Health, vision, dental, long \& short\-term disability, and Life insurance * A Startup mentality company with stable funding * 401k match * Pet Care discounts * Flexible Time Off * Opportunity to grow your career with a network of like\-minded professionals ***Yourgi affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled.*** ***Yourgi endeavors to make our employment website and application process accessible to all users and applicants. In doing so, we provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation or assistance completing the application process, please contact a member of our recruitment team.*** ***At Yourgi, we're all about creating a workplace that's bursting with diversity and inclusivity. We don't play favorites or judge folks based on skin color, religion, gender, age, disability, or any other protected characteristics. Our hiring decisions are solely based on what you can bring to the team. So, we're throwing the door wide open for all like\-minded candidates who believe in celebrating and honoring diversity and inclusion. Ready to join our pack?***

jobs.title: Data Architect Supervisor
jobs.description: **Job Title**: Data Architect Supervisor **Summary** The Data Architect Supervisor works as a full\-time employee of Zeiders Enterprises, Inc. (Zeiders) and is responsible for designing, developing, managing, and continuously improving the organization's enterprise data architecture and data technology environment. This position plays a hands\-on role in establishing a scalable, secure, and reliable data foundation that enables business operations, reporting, analytics, automation, and emerging AI capabilities. The Data Architect Supervisor will actively engage in technical work. The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and hands\-on technologist who can translate business requirements into practical data solutions and establish the standards, processes, and technologies necessary to support a data\-driven organization. They will work closely with IT, business leaders, cybersecurity, finance, human resources, and other stakeholders to ensure that data is accessible, accurate, secure, governed, and actionable. They will be responsible for the development of data policies, procedures, and technical controls. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** **Data Architecture \& Technology Management** * Develop and maintain the organization's enterprise data architecture, including data sources, databases, data warehouses, data lakes, integrations, APIs, and reporting platforms. * Design scalable data solutions that support operational systems, business intelligence, analytics, automation, and AI initiatives. * Evaluate, select, implement, and manage data technologies and platforms. * Establish data architecture standards, patterns, principles, and technology roadmaps. * Assess the current data environment and develop a multi\-year roadmap for modernization and optimization. * Identify opportunities to consolidate, integrate, automate, and improve the organization's data environment. * Maintain hands\-on responsibility for data engineering, database administration, data integration, and architecture activities as appropriate. * Monitor data technology performance, capacity, availability, and reliability. **Data Engineering \& Integration** * Design and implement data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes to integrate data from enterprise applications and external sources. * Develop and maintain data models supporting operational reporting, analytics, and business intelligence. * Establish integration patterns for connecting applications, databases, cloud services, and other data sources. * Ensure data pipelines are reliable, documented, monitored, and appropriately secured. * Troubleshoot complex data, integration, and performance issues. * Support the development and maintenance of data warehouses, data marts, and analytical environments. **Data Governance \& Quality** * Establish and maintain data governance practices, standards, policies, and procedures. * Define data ownership, stewardship, classification, retention, and lifecycle requirements. * Develop processes for monitoring and improving data quality, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. * Establish and maintain data dictionaries, metadata repositories, business glossaries, and data lineage documentation. * Partner with business stakeholders to define authoritative sources of data and establish common data definitions. * Promote data as an enterprise asset and establish appropriate controls around its use. **Government Contracting \& Security** * Ensure data architecture and solutions align with applicable government contracting, cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance requirements. * Support the protection of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), Personally Identifiable Information (PII), and other sensitive organizational information. * Collaborate with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to implement appropriate access controls, encryption, monitoring, logging, and data protection mechanisms. * Support compliance with applicable contractual, regulatory, and organizational requirements, including NIST\-based security controls where applicable. * Ensure appropriate data segregation, access, retention, and handling practices within government and commercial environments. * Participate in security assessments, risk reviews, technology evaluations, and compliance activities as required. **Business Intelligence, Analytics \& AI** * Partner with business and technology teams to establish a reliable data foundation for enterprise reporting and analytics. * Support the development of dashboards, management reporting, operational metrics, and executive\-level analytics. * Enable data solutions supporting automation, machine learning, and AI initiatives. * Establish standards for data preparation and accessibility for analytics and AI use cases. * Help identify opportunities to leverage data to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, program performance, and decision\-making. **Project \& Stakeholder Management** * Work with ex a architectures, data warehouses, data integration solutions, and data pipelines. * Experience with relational databases, Python, and SQL. * Experience with cloud\-based data technologies and platforms. * Experience developing ETL/ELT processes and integrating data from multiple systems. * Experience working with Data orchestration tools Kafka, FiveTran, dbt, and others. * Experience with data modeling, data governance, data quality, and metadata management. * Experience supporting a government contractor or federal government organization. * Experience working with CUI, NIST SP 800\-171, CMMC, FedRAMP, or other government cybersecurity requirements. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, SQL Server, Power BI, Databricks, or similar technologies. * Experience supporting enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, or Lakehouse architecture. * Experience with APIs, integration platforms, and modern data architectures. * jobs.title: Senior Staff Inference Performance Engineer
jobs.description: At **d\-Matrix**, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of **respect and collaboration.** We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our **team is inclusive**, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution. Ready to come find your playground? **Together**, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI. **Senior Staff Inference Performance Engineer** **Location:** Santa Clara, CA / Remote, US **Role Overview** The Inference Cloud Engineering team builds the deployment and orchestration technology behind d\-Matrix’s inference services: an internal cloud where teams test and tune models, and a customer\-facing Cloud with self\-service inference endpoints and compute. As the team’s Inference Performance Engineer, you will own end\-to\-end performance of the workloads we deploy, from the moment a request arrives to the moment a result is returned. The standard is that a workload on our orchestrated platform should perform at least as well as it does on bare metal. Today’s workloads include speculative decoding and attention\-FFN disaggregation across d\-Matrix Corsair accelerators and GPUs, with more heterogeneous architectures coming. Because there is no fixed system to master, the job is a method: profile first, form a hypothesis, test it, and then change the system. You will own the outcome, not every fix. Many root causes sit with other teams, so you will fix what you understand well and hand off the rest with evidence the owning team can act on. **What You Will Do** * Diagnose performance problems across the full serving path, from orchestration (scheduling, placement, networking, autoscaling) to inference internals (batching, KV\-cache, prefill/decode, serving framework, driver and runtime, interconnect, host OS and NUMA, accelerator). * Isolate each problem to a specific layer and owner, then decide whether to fix it directly, route it to the owning team, or both, with a workaround now and a tracked handoff for the permanent fix. * Write minimal, reproducible problem statements for cross\-stack findings so owning teams can act without repeating the investigation. * Protect throughput, latency, and stability targets for orchestrated workloads by finding and closing gaps against bare metal, such as placement overhead, non\-performance power defaults, and extra network hops. * Assess what it takes to scale from single deployments to fleet operation, including routing, placement, and shared\-resource contention. * Capture each workload’s node requirements (CPU placement, memory and NUMA locality, network path) in the orchestration layer’s configuration so performant deployment is the default. * Build lightweight telemetry and benchmarks that reach into prototype stacks to isolate or hand off problems. * Turn recurring investigations into playbooks and mentor engineers in the profiling\-first method. **What You Will Bring** * 8\+ years of hands\-on performance or systems engineering, including resolving hard regressions that crossed multiple layers of a stack. * Track record of finding performance overhead through profiling in unfamiliar, sparsely documented systems, valued more than experience with any specific vendor stack or accelerator. * Deep systems fundamentals, including Linux internals, NUMA, CPU pinning and cpusets, PCIe, memory and cache behavior, and network paths. * Experience running performance\-sensitive workloads on Kubernetes, including identifying when scheduler defaults, network overlays, or orchestration abstractions cost latency or throughput, and closing the gap. * Working knowledge of LLM inference serving, including batching, KV\-cache, prefill/decode, quantization, and speculative decoding. * Proficiency in Python and C/C\+\+, sufficient to instrument, debug, and patch code across the stack. * Clear technical writing that hardware, firmware, or platform teams can act on without context from your part of the stack. * Sound judgment about ownership, with examples of correctly handing off problems that were not yours to fix. * Fluency with AI and agentic tools for investigation, code search, log triage, and drafting instrumentation, with the discipline to verify output against real data. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with LLM serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT\-LLM. * Hands\-on experience building or tuning speculative decoding, disaggregated serving, or heterogeneous serving architectures. * Experience tuning KV\-cache management, request and batch scheduling, or weight prefetch and residency in an LLM serving system. * GPU programming and profiling experience (such as CUDA, Nsight, NCCL), valued as transferable background. * Experience with pre\-production or bring\-up hardware, or in organizations where root causes routinely cross team boundaries. * Rust experience. * Startup experience or comfort in environments where priorities shift quickly. **Equal Opportunity Employment Policy** **d\-Matrix** is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day. **d\-Matrix** does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individual interested in opportunities with d\-Matrix apply directly through our official channels. This approach allows us to streamline our hiring processes and maintain a consistent and fair evaluation of al applicants. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Compensation Range: $175K \- $265K

jobs.title: Staff Front-End Network Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nscale** Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost\-effective, high\-performance infrastructure for AI start\-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI\-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud strengthens technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future. **About The Role** ------------------ The Network Operations and Engineering teams at Nscale operate some of the most demanding networking environments in the industry, supporting large\-scale AI GPU clusters where network performance directly impacts customer outcomes. We're looking for a **Staff Front End Network Engineer – AI Infrastructure** to provide deep technical leadership within Nscale's front\-end networking domain. This role focuses on owning and evolving the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our high\-performance Ethernet front\-end networks. These networks support inference traffic, cluster management, data ingress/egress, shared storage connectivity, long\-haul circuits, and carrier handoffs. You will act as a key technical leader and domain expert, driving architecture decisions, improving operational practices, and helping solve the most complex networking challenges in the front\-end network stack. While not the ultimate technical authority, you will significantly influence design direction and cross\-team outcomes. **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ * Leading technical direction and operational improvements for Nscale's front\-end AI infrastructure networks within your domain * Designing, reviewing, and evolving large\-scale Ethernet leaf\-spine / Clos fabric architectures (Arista and Nokia platforms) to support growth, inference workloads, and storage requirements * Serving as a senior escalation point for complex front\-end network incidents and driving deep technical root cause analysis and remediation * Driving cross\-team initiatives to improve fabric reliability, performance consistency, observability, and operational maturity * Defining and evolving engineering standards for hardware configuration, routing, congestion management, firmware lifecycle, automation, and change safety across Nvidia Cumulus, Arista EOS, and Nokia platforms * Partnering with SRE, Compute Platform, Storage, and Network Architecture teams to influence end\-to\-end system design, including DCI and storage networking integration * Mentoring senior engineers and contributing to the growth of technical excellence across the organization * Delivering measurable improvements in uptime, latency consistency, capacity efficiency, and incident reduction for front\-end services **About You (Skills / Qualifications)** --------------------------------------- * 10–12\+ years of experience in network engineering, with a strong focus on hyperscale data center, cloud, or AI infrastructure networking * Deep hands\-on experience with large\-scale Ethernet data center fabrics (leaf\-spine / Clos topologies) * Strong production expertise with Nvidia (Cumulus), Arista EOS, and/or Nokia platforms at scale * Solid understanding of data center routing and control planes (BGP, OSPF, ECMP, EVPN\-VXLAN) * Experience with long\-haul circuits, DCI, and optical transport (dark fiber, carrier Ethernet, coherent optics, ZR/ZR\+) * Strong understanding of storage networking over Ethernet in large\-scale environments * Ability to debug and resolve complex cross\-layer issues across hardware, optics, routing, and application layers * Proven ability to lead technical initiatives across teams and influence outcomes without formal authority * Strong systems thinking, balancing performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience operating Arista, Nokia, or Nvidia networking platforms at hyperscale * Familiarity with AI infrastructure network design patterns (inference, management, storage tiers) * Exposure to DCI / long\-haul optical or carrier network design and operations * Strong automation experience (Python, Ansible, telemetry pipelines, validation frameworks) * Experience contributing to infrastructure strategy or large\-scale platform improvements **What We Can Offer You** ------------------------- At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions create real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core. * Highly competitive package (base \+ equity) with annual reviews * Opportunity to join a fast\-growing AI infrastructure company and work on cutting\-edge systems * A progression path tailored to your growth, with opportunities to lead, innovate, and expand your technical scope * Flexible benefits including medical, dental, vision, PTO, parental leave, and retirement plans *For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee \& Candidate Privacy Notice:* *Here.* *Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.*

jobs.title: Senior ML Data Scientist - Women’s Health
jobs.description: Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. We are seeking a highly experienced and driven Senior Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our Women's Health team. You will play a pivotal role in developing and commercializing cutting\-edge machine learning models and algorithms, leveraging wearable health data to improve women's health outcomes. You will lead complex projects, mentor junior team members, and contribute significantly to the strategic direction of our technology.. **What You Will Do:** * Contribute to the development and deployment of advanced machine learning pipelines and models for innovative Women's Health features, focusing on time\-series analysis and robust validation. * Drive the commercialization of machine learning models and algorithms, collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams including scientists, product managers, software developers, product designers and test engineers. * Design and execute rigorous statistical analyses for model performance evaluation, monitoring, and generating actionable insights to inform strategic product decisions. * Conduct in\-depth exploratory research to identify and characterize novel health sensing features, translating proof\-of\-concept ideas into scalable, commercialized products. * Contribute to the development of best practices for machine learning within the Women's Health team. * Present and communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. * This is a remote US role with a preference for candidates based in San Francisco, San Diego, or Boston. This is a remote US role with a slight preference for candidates based in San Francisco, San Diego, or Boston. **What you'll bring:** * PhD in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related field. And 3\+ years of industry experience in machine learning and data science. * 5\+ years of advanced programming experience in Python and SQL. * Extensive experience with a wide range of machine learning and statistical modeling techniques, including deep learning, time\-series analysis, and signal processing. * Demonstrated experience in the full lifecycle of developing and commercializing machine learning models and algorithms. * Excellent communication skills, and the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Self\-driven, motivated, have a pragmatic can\-do attitude and delivery\-focused mindset: you can move quickly and prioritize effectively. **Nice to have:** * Strong domain knowledge in Women's Health and experience with health data from wearables are significant plusses. ### **Benefits** At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: * Competitive salary and equity packages * Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources * An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends \& family * 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off * Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market\-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Region 1: $172,550 \- $203,000 Region 2: $158,950 \- $187,000 Region 3: $147,900 \- $174,000 A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location. We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI). Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers! We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note: * Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards. * We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront. * Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email. Stay cautious and protect your personal details. To all recruitment agencies: Oura does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Oura employees, or any other organization's location. Oura is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Turing is looking for candidates with strong experience in software development, programming, and system design. **Role overview:*** In this role, you will contribute to projects that help evaluate and enhance AI systems using your software engineering expertise and analytical problem\-solving skills. * No prior AI experience is required. These projects will help you explore how AI can be leveraged to improve software reasoning, coding accuracy, and development efficiency. * **What does day\-to\-day look like:*** Design and solve real\-world software engineering and algorithmic problems to test AI reasoning. * Write clear, step\-by\-step coding solutions across data structures, APIs, debugging, and optimization techniques. * Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, efficiency, and adherence to software design principles. * Collaborate with researchers to refine AI understanding of code generation, problem\-solving, and real\-world development workflows. **Requirements:*** 4\+ years of experience as a Software Developer, Engineer, or Programmer. * Background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. * Proficiency in one or more languages: Python, Java, JavaScript, C\+\+, or Go. * Familiarity with Git, REST APIs, and agile development methodologies preferred. Excellent English communication and ability to document and explain code logic clearly. * **Perks of freelancing with Turing:*** Strong compensation (exact amount varies by project). * Fully remote work environment. * Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer, potentially full\-time. Duration of projects: approximately 1 month, with the possibility for extension. * **What Turing is NOT seeking from your expertise:*** Confidential or proprietary information from any employer, university, etc. * Trade secrets or internal company or university data. * Specific client information or case details. * Any information that would violate NDAs, employment agreements or other confidentiality obligations. **About Turing:** Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high\-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P\&L.
